name: Inside the Chapel
description:
You are in a small, dark chapel.  The dark brown glass in the tiny windows
do not let much light through.  A few rows of worn wooden benches stand here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "glass windows", "description": "The windows must be meant to be dark.  At least they are completely clean.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The chapel door is made of dark wood.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3604, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2a6d23087b69f5d8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba434c1d9c76e9c65"}

name: North entrance to the catacombs
description:
You are almost surprised to see a tunnel leading off to the south
into utter darkness.  The floorboards above you haven't been moved
in a long time, yet there is life down here.  A beam of light from
the opening above you falls upon a message scrawled on the wall here.

The message reads:
Adventure for the strong yet calculating
Death for the weak and shallow
Treasure for the smart and lucky
Death for the stupid and accursed

An ancient Glyph above the entrance keeps monsters from wandering up
from the catacombs.

name: A Mountain Path
description:
You are on a mountain path which ascends a steep mountainside.  The trail
curves around the mountain so that you cannot really see what lies ahead.
You do sense great power though coming from the area behind the mountain.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above the ground north of the city.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: The Dwarven Drop Off
description:
This is where the dwarven mommies and daddies come to drop off their
annoying little brats.  You have the urge to leave.  There is a sign here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "This is an area for newbies, so have fun.  -- Sandman", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a large room full of noisy brats.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6602, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1a4baeafe8419418", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb970c06c7e31a478c"}

name: On the spider web
description:
You are balancing carefully on the giant sticky threads that holds the giant
web in place.  To the south leads a strand to a cave-like structure made from
many layers of a spider web.  Another silky strand continues to the north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "web", "description": "The immense spider web moves softly.", "valid": true}

name: The Tower Gates
description:
You are at the entrance to a tall tower.  Lightning flashes periodically and
it is raining.  You think it might be a good idea to turn back into the grove.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "gate", "description": "The gate is tall and secure.  Whoever built it values privacy.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a large steel gate.  Beyond is the Foyer of the Tower.", "keyword": "gate steel", "exit_flags": 1, "key": 2231, "to_room_vnum": 2202, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6ccf679153bb544f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8645c442ab424ab1"}

name: The Bottom of the Rainbow
description:
You are standing before a shimmering rainbow arching high up into the
sky.  You feel somehow separated from the natural world, even though the
temple spire is only a few meters below you.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "rainbow", "description": "The rainbow softly glows with beams of light, in colours that defie\ndescription.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "The rainbow extends above you, fading out of existence only meters away.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7701, "room_id": "69f4d0cb84607ba936fd9d9c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb046b149fcb18ec26"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You can see the Temple of Midgaard below you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1036, "room_id": "69f4d0cb84607ba936fd9d9c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb8cc1ece8b6e9d81"}

name: A Mountain Path
description:
You are on a rocky mountain path leading up and around a steep mountainside.
You sense a glow from the area beyond the mountain, which you cannot see yet.

name: On the spider web
description:
You are balancing carefully on the giant sticky threads that holds the giant
web in place.  To the north leads a strand to a cave-like structure made from
many layers of a spider web.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "web", "description": "The immense spider web moves softly.", "valid": true}

name: The Foyer
description:
This is the entrance to the Tower.  The hallway continues to the north,
leading towards a staircase.  You notice a grim painting on the wall,  and
quickly look away.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "painting", "description": "This painting depicts the grisly death of a foolish human.  You hope you do\nnot share his fate.", "valid": true}

name: Day Care Center
description:
You are in the north-east corner of the main part of the center.  Toys and
toddlers are all over the room.  There is a kitchen to the east.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a large room full of noisy brats.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6604, "room_id": "69f4d0cb970c06c7e31a478c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2d58358a616a07c8"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a large room full of noisy brats.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6603, "room_id": "69f4d0cb970c06c7e31a478c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2a7196d34c17af91"}

name: North/south tunnel
description:
This part of the catacombs looked roughly hewn and man-made. There is
a large cross painted on the floor of the tunnel.To the south it seems
maybe a bit lighter for some odd reason.  To the north a ray of light
comes in from a hole in the ceiling.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "cross paint floor", "description": "The cross is a Templar's cross. It seems to have had a fresh coat of\npaint recently.", "valid": true}

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 20 meters above the inside wall of West Midgaard.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Stairwell into Darkness
description: You sense even more danger coming from below but are urged onward ...

name: On the Rainbow
description:
You are standing on the rainbow, surrounded by many beams of multicoloured
light.  Through the bottom of the rainbow you can barely make out the Temple
of Midgaard, which is now quite far away.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "rainbow", "description": "The rainbow softly glows with beams of light, in colours that defie\ndescription.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "The rainbow extends far above you, slowly fading into darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7702, "room_id": "69f4d0cb046b149fcb18ec26", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb13d83e090d01176c"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The rainbow extends below you towards Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7700, "room_id": "69f4d0cb046b149fcb18ec26", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb84607ba936fd9d9c"}

name: On the spider web
description:
You are balancing carefully on the giant sticky threads that holds the giant
web in place.  To the east leads a strand to a cave-like structure made from
many layers of a spider web.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "web", "description": "The immense spider web moves softly.", "valid": true}

name: Mountainside Tombs
description:
There are a few stone heaps here and there, the tombs of those who did not
last the arduous journey up the mountain.  Curiously you notice a few
uncovered bodies which don't seem to have died of exhaustion.  The path curves
east around the mountain.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "heaps stones tombs", "description": "You are sure glad that YOU aren't under one of those piles!\nMany of the tombstones have the same name on them, 'Raff'.  He must come\nhere a lot.", "valid": true}

name: Hallway
description:
This hallway seems to stretch on forever.  You notice a stairway in
the distance.

name: Day Care Center
description:
You are in the north-west corner of the main part of the center.  Toys and
toddlers are all over the room.  There is a bathroom to the west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a large room full of noisy brats.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6602, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2a7196d34c17af91", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb970c06c7e31a478c"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see a large room full of noisy brats.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6605, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2a7196d34c17af91", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb045977156fe73318"}

name: Weapon training area
description:
This is a place to keep up on there weapon skills.  Much of the
equipment looks old and worn but upon further inspection seems quite
sturdy in fact.

name: The Acolyte's Bedroom
description:
This is why you were not welcomed at the entrance by the tomb's faithful
servants ... blood and gore is ankle deep in here.
Oh NO! the door shut behind you!  It's a trap!
A bloodied corpse of an acolyte is lying here ...
A bloodied corpse of an acolyte is lying here ...
A bloodied corpse of an acolyte is lying here ...
extraDescription: {"keyword": "corpse corpses", "description": "Mauled and torn apart ... throats were ripped out and guts spilled on the\nfloor ... you slip and land, planting yourself firmly in the slick wetness\nand splattering yourself with offal.", "valid": true}

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 20 meters above the west gate of Midgaard.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: On the Rainbow
description:
You are standing on the rainbow, surrounded by many beams of multicoloured
light.  Through the bottom of the rainbow you see the City of Midgaard and the
land surrounding it.  It seems to be miles below you.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "rainbow", "description": "The rainbow softly glows with beams of light, in colours that\ndefie description.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "The rainbow extends far above you, slowly fading into darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7703, "room_id": "69f4d0cb13d83e090d01176c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbeafc770fa2e9c9a0"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The rainbow extends below you towards the land you once knew as home.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7701, "room_id": "69f4d0cb13d83e090d01176c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb046b149fcb18ec26"}

name: On the spider web
description:
You are balancing carefully on the giant sticky threads that holds the giant
web in place. A single silky strand lead to the south, while another leads
off into the northern direction.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "web", "description": "The immense spider web moves softly.", "valid": true}

name: A Blind Curve on the Mountain Path.
description:
This looks like a normal mountain path, but it is NOT!  This section of the
path is habitated by a huge (and of course, man-eating) Cyclops.  The path
makes its final ascent to an overlook.

name: Hallway
description: You trudge down the hallway.  You notice doors to the east and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign says \"NURSERY\" in bold letters.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a door.  You notice a sign.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 2205, "room_id": "69f4d0cb424ec338fecf08c4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc43fb06abfa64957"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see an oak door.  There is an inscription on it.", "keyword": "oak", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 2206, "room_id": "69f4d0cb424ec338fecf08c4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf6e0f1f6481b3bf8"}

name: Day Care Center
description:
You are in the south-east corner of the main part of the center.  Toys and
toddlers are all over the room.  There is a playground to the east.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a large room full of noisy brats.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6602, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2d58358a616a07c8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb970c06c7e31a478c"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a large room full of noisy brats.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6605, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2d58358a616a07c8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb045977156fe73318"}

name: Prayer training area
description:
The templar's curious mix of religion and fighting is evident here.
A central painting depicts a cross composed of swords.  The elders
teach the ancient art of prayer to the young pages.

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above Wall Road.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: On the Rainbow
description:
You are standing on the rainbow, surrounded by many beams of multicoloured
light.  The rainbow extends above and below you as far as you can see.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "rainbow", "description": "The rainbow brightly glows with beams of light, in colours that defie any\ndescription.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "The rainbow extends far above you.  You see a glowing white light at the\nrainbow's end.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7704, "room_id": "69f4d0cbeafc770fa2e9c9a0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3e336759a638187c"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The rainbow extends far below you, slowly fading into darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7702, "room_id": "69f4d0cbeafc770fa2e9c9a0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb13d83e090d01176c"}

name: Vista
description:
This is a stunning vista overlooking a canyon.  There is a sign here that says:

BEHOLD -- ELEMENTAL CANYON

Fire leaps up from firepits in the western part of the canyon.  The sky looks
funny, and the air seems hazy to the northwest.  Electricity sparks
intermittently in the northeast.  To the east you see a strong, magic-looking
river flowing through the canyon.  Also to the east you spy a cave entrance
leading into the canyon wall.  The path descends to the north to another
overlook.

name: Webbed Entrance
description:
Sticky, sticky, sticky!  The ground is cluttered with leaves, decayed
remains of webbed crickets, beetle, rats, dogs (?), and even humans.
You begin to wonder about what lies ahead.  The air is damp here,
and even the little light that shines through the canopy seems
absorbed into the webbing.

name: Nursery
description:
It looks like a tornado has been through here.  Toys are scattered everywhere,
and a small group of dragon hatchlings are fighting over a bone.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a large stone door.", "keyword": "door stone", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 2297, "to_room_vnum": 2223, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc43fb06abfa64957", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb72551cbceba6b78d"}

name: Junction of hallways
description:
Training facilities are evident to the west. To the south lies a hallway
which has doors every couple of feet, looks like living quarters of some
sort.  To the east the tunnel leads back into the natural catacombs.

name: Day Care Center
description:
You are in the south-west corner of the main part of the center.  Toys and
toddlers are all over the room.  There is a staircase to the west.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a large room full of noisy brats.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6603, "room_id": "69f4d0cb045977156fe73318", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2a7196d34c17af91"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You see a large room full of noisy brats.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6604, "room_id": "69f4d0cb045977156fe73318", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2d58358a616a07c8"}

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above Wall Road.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: The Overlook
description:
You see various elemental servants wandering around the canyon.  The noise of
humming coming from the canyon gets louder.  The path makes a steep descent
into the canyon here.

name: On the Rainbow
description:
You are nearing the end of the rainbow.  The beams of multicoloured
light have begun to merge and solidify.  All around you you see glowing
starlike motes of dust.  Ahead of you is a bridge.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "rainbow", "description": "The rainbow brilliantly glows with beams of blinding light, in colours that\nsweep together and merge before your eyes.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "The rainbow extends above you, merging into a brilliant glowing\nbridge.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7705, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3e336759a638187c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb60a4b79899a38608"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The rainbow extends far below you, slowly fading into darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7703, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3e336759a638187c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbeafc770fa2e9c9a0"}

name: Webby Passage
description:
You find that footing here is very good, almost too good.  The
limbs are coated with cobwebs and seem unusually strong for tree
branches.  Paths lead in four directions.  The eastward path goes
down a bit.

name: Storage Room
description: This room is covered with dust, it looks as if no one has been here in ages.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "dust", "description": "As you look closely at the dust, you notice the outline of a trapdoor!", "valid": true}

name: Hallway
description:
The hallway takes on a more indoor look to the west.  To the east it
looks awfully dark.

name: The Grand Hall of Kings
description:
You are at the west end of the Grand Hall of Kings.  There is a doorway to the
south with something strange written above it.  Also on the floor are dried
blood stains, but their color seems a little wrong.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "stain stains", "description": "That's odd ... they seem a little GREEN.", "valid": true}

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above the ground north of Midgaard.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: The Messy Bathroom
description:
You hold your nose as you realize you have made the worst mistake of your
life.  The air is rancid and the walls are stained.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a large room full of noisy brats.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6603, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1f464138ffcc17f8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2a7196d34c17af91"}

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8606, "room_id": "69f4d0cb349491be0e20d6a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb8225389c1170741"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8620, "room_id": "69f4d0cb349491be0e20d6a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf6c5e97cd9139e4a"}

name: Entrance to Elemental Canyon
description:
You are awed by the sounds and sights of great powers at works here.
Elemental servants bustle back and forth doing the biddings of the elemental
rulers.  You see a sort of cross roads to the north, and you can climb up to
the overlook here.

name: The Glowing Bridge at the Rainbow's End
description:
After a long climb you have reached the end of the rainbow.  The brilliant
colours have twisted and merged into a beautiful glowing bridge that leads
toward a massive white gate to the north.  All around you is a soft, peaceful
glow interrupted only by the passing of starlike dust motes before your eyes.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "rainbow", "description": "The rainbow seems to be forming directly from the light of the bridge.  It\ndrops out of sight below you.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The bridge leads on to a massive white gate.  You see a large grey figure\nstanding there.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7706, "room_id": "69f4d0cb60a4b79899a38608", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb351f007ba4686f6a"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The bridge disassociates into a beautiful spectrum of colours that\ndrop out of sight below you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7704, "room_id": "69f4d0cb60a4b79899a38608", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3e336759a638187c"}

name: End of the Hallway
description:
You have finally reached the end of the hallway.  A huge staircase leads up.
You see a sign at the base of the staircase.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign reads:
This area is kind of tough.  You probably shouldn't go up these stairs
alone if you are under 18th level, or at all if you under 14th level.
Have fun! -- Wench", "valid": true}

name: Wasp Hive
description:
Drones scuttle about in this room.  The cells on the walls
are honeycomb in shape and many of the maggots and wasps you see
have fang-marks on there bodies.  You sense some order in their markings.

name: Intersection
description:
The tunnel continues to the north and the south, becoming less hewn and
more natural to the south.  A passageway lined with paneling leads west.

name: The Shrine of Shohan
description:
BLOOD EVERYWHERE!
The walls are coated with blood, bits of bloody flesh lie at your feet,
and torn clothing is scattered about.  It wouldn't disturb you in the least
except that it is all FRESH!  What ever used to pass as an altar here,
lies overturned and smashed.  Doors lead to the south and to the north.

name: The Staircase
description:
You stand on top of a staircase leading down, and wonder what mystery could
lie down under.  Beware!
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a large room full of noisy brats.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6605, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf94ac4f01fef54a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb045977156fe73318"}

description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 20 meters above the magic shop.
It seems like you can see forever!

description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel

same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.

name: The Astral Gate
description:
Here the bridge ends before a massive, pearly-coloured gate beyond which
you can see a field of blackness filled with silvery snake-like tendrils,
stars, and occasional flashes of of light.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "gate", "description": "You see a huge, glowing gate wrought from an incredibly hard translucent
material.  Each of the intricately carved bars of this mighty gate are about
as thick as a man's wrist, rising from the floor to a height of forty feet.
A plaque is inset into the wall next to one side of the gate.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Through the gate you see a massive field of blackness that extends as far\nas you can see.", "keyword": "gate", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7707, "room_id": "69f4d0cb351f007ba4686f6a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb711709c723dd8e6a"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The bridge extends towards the rainbow, which drops out of sight\nbelow you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7705, "room_id": "69f4d0cb351f007ba4686f6a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb60a4b79899a38608"}

name: The Floor of the Canyon
description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon.  Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all.
In general, it is calm, yet there is always a incessant buzz of things
going on about.  The canyon continues north and east.

name: Guardian's Room
description:
You climb down the rickety stairs and find yourself face to face with a
gargantuan hydra.  How fast can you climb UP stairs?
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see the storage room.", "keyword": "door trap trapdoor", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 2206, "room_id": "69f4d0cb97a1c6984f29d3ed", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf6e0f1f6481b3bf8"}

name: Webby Passage
description:
Another webby passage, all sticky and wet.  Tiny ballooning
spiders fill the air.  It seems that these young ones are newborns.

name: Pages' sleeping quarters
description:
Several bunk beds are lined up across the room.  It looks rather spartan
and there is little evidence of toys or games.  Most of the desks are
filled with books and papers of little interest.

name: The Tomb of Shohan
description:
Once beautiful, this place has been turned into a slaughterhouse by the hands
of evil beings ... even more blood and dead, rotting flesh.  This place looks
like the feeding grounds of beasts and monsters.  The overturned sarcophagus
of the once powerful King Shohan lies here.  A door leads to the north and a
doorway has been hewn to the east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "coffin sarcophagus", "description": "Now destroyed ... there is writing on it: 'All hail the new king; we serve\nthe Roch'tar, the Undying One!  Those who decline his worship shall be\nslaughtered!'", "valid": true}

name: The Playground
description: You are in the north-west corner of the playground.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above Main Street.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Into the Astral Plane
description:
You step through the gate, and into another reality...

You find yourself floating in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is very disorienting, although it is not too late to return
through the gate to the south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "gate", "description": ">From here the pearly-coloured gate seems very small and insubstantial.  Through\nits bars you can see the Astral Guardian, protecting your world from the perils\nof this plane of existence.", "valid": true}

name: Elemental Gateway
description:
To the west a path dips and winds among some flowing firepits.  To the
northeast a path goes toward the river.  Beyond toward the northeast and
northwest are outcrops which rise up from the canyon floor. To the east there
is a cave mouth which leads into the canyon wall.  And to the south the path
leads up, away, and out of the canyon.  Various pure and cross-breeds of
elemental forms wander the canyon floor, which extends in a wide swath
northwards.

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.

name: The Treasure Room
description:
You have made it past the hydra into the vault.  You are astounded by
the treasure here.  Not only are you now rich, you can probably rest here
safely.  The west wall seems to have a large door made entirely of ruby.

name: Beneath the Busy Path
description:
You hear the sounds of crawling arachnids above.  The rhythms of
the footsteps suggest a primitive order in their movement.  The light
seems brighter upwards.

name: Templar Knights sleeping quarters
description:
This is a huge room which is filled wall to wall with beds. Apparently
all the low level knights all sleep in this one room.  A door on the
south wall is labelled "Elders only!".

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: Exploring the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself floating in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is very disorienting, and it is difficult to maintain your
bearings and sense of direction.

name: The Second Floor
description:
You have made it up to the second floor.  You hear hissing and see several
dragon men rushing you.  You wonder how long you will be staying here.

name: On the Busy Path
description:
Spiders, spiders, everywhere!  It is almost ant-like in efficiency
with one big difference.  The spiders here are carrying ant-corpses,
as well as rats, wolves, and humans.

name: Entrance to the Lower Chambers
description:
You can tell that this area wasn't a part of the original construction.
The walls have been hewn by a mighty force look as though they were CLAWED.
The passage slopes upward here and also continues to the north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "walls", "description": "Something BIG must have done this job!  There are traces of BLOOD in the\nclaw marks.", "valid": true}

name: N/S hallway
description:

the east.  The decoration looks rather sparse here.

description:
As the tunnel leads south it gets more humid and damp.  Moss covers the
walls and ferns even grow in the cracks here and there.  To the north it
seems much more sterile.

name: City Entrance
description:
You are at the entrance to a small underground city. A great adamantite
gate lies open to the west allowing entrance into the city.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "gate", "description": "A large adamantite gate with giant spider shaped emblems stands here.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A huge gate opens to the west allowing entrance into the city.", "keyword": "gate", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5101, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2c017dd6941de15f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb078d479d26bec51a"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "A small hole in the ceiling leads up into darkness.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5270, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2c017dd6941de15f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb6029f98d56033ab"}

name: The Shrine of Cristis
description:
Different than the rest, this place has not been desecrated.  An altar still
stands here and the walls show scenes from the life of Cristis the Kind,
a ruler of the outlying regions west of Midgaard.  There is a stone staircase
leading down.  The Ghost of Cristis the Kind stands here.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "altar", "description": "It stands 2 feet high with the remnants of candle-wax on top.  There is
an inscription on the side:  'Praise the almighty Cristis the bringer of
good and justice to the world.  He who fought the evilest finally is at
peace.  May the Gods remember him forever ...'", "valid": true}

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.

name: The Court
description: You are continuing down the hall.  To the east and west you see ornate doors.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 20 meters above the bakery.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: A Split in the Path
description:
As always, there is a split in the road.  One road is strewn
with cricket feelers.  The other is well-kept and suitable for smooth
travelling.  The webbing that was prevalent in earlier rooms is almost
non-existent now.

name: The Floor of the Canyon
description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon.  Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at
all.  In general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of
things going on about.  The canyon floor extends north, south, and west.
A path follows a stream to the east.

name: Entrance to the Mini-Maze
description:
You stand in the entrance to a small, but confusing maze.  You really hope
that you don't get lost.

name: Exploring the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself floating in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is very disorienting, and it is difficult to maintain your
bearings and sense of direction.

name: Path to Dwarven Village
description:
All around you are the mountains of the southern range, home of dwarves and
giants.  You can climb back down the mountains to the west and leave these
realms, or seek riches in the northern mineshafts.  A dirt road leads south,
towards a small building.  You can hear crying and shrieking coming from it.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You hear the patter of little feet.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6601, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8ef287d9c58b113e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1a4baeafe8419418"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A rocky road leads back to Midgaard and the mines of Moria.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6562, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8ef287d9c58b113e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbeb5da1f0fe942fc5"}

name: City street
description:
You walk along a highly ornate street going north-south. A large gate
lies to the east while a building lies to the west.

name: Administration room
description:
The elders gather here to discuss training strategies and count their
loot.  You notice papers which look like important secret documents
lying around. An escape passage leads west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "papers documents secrets", "description": "It seems that the loot comes from raids on the towns in the surrounding\nareas above ground.  From the documents it seems that the pages and\ntrainees are kidnapped from the villages too!", "valid": true}

name: The Tomb of Cristis
description: Everything here has simply been destroyed.   Exits lead north and west.

name: A fluffy white cloud.
description:
You find yourself standing on a small cloud.  The cloud feels kind
of spongy beneath your feet.  You find it hard to see anything in
the distance as wisps of cloud blow over your face.

A floating sign says:

"Scubdu's Area--Tread carefully! Only high levels should attempt
this place. Leave messages on the board if you have problems."
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The way back to solid footing, it seems.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7900, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc3ef49c7d8e9ebd9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8ce7e6b53ce8e1d9"}

name: The Library
description:
You have entered a huge room, filled with books.  A peaceful man is
sitting at a table, studying.

name: The Floor of the Canyon
description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon.  Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at
all.  In general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of
things going on about. The canyon floor extends north, east, and south.
To the west a garden is on fire.

name: Mini-Maze
description: You are in a small passage that looks just like every other one.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above Main Street.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Fuzzy Tree Limb
description:
You are on a "fuzzy" tree limb.  Interesting, since the branches
seem to have "hairs" sprouting from its bark.  As you look
closer you see millions of aphids covering each limb.

name: Roaming the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself floating in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is somewhat disorienting.
All exits lead off into the astral field.

name: A long tunnel
description:
You encounter some rapids as you enter this tunnel cut out of
the mountains by the river.

name: Path, base of mountain
description:
Now you are at the bottom of a rugged mountain.  The forest around you is
very dense, and it seems very dark to the north.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The path heads toward the main city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6500, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc1c2754666a77d9e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8ef287d9c58b113e"}

name: N/S hallway
description:
The hallway continues to become more important-looking as you wander
south.  A room to the east looks rather more pleasant that some of the
others.

name: City street
description: You walk along a highly ornate city street going north and west.

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

description:
This small room is modestly decorated with small dragon icons.  Its sole
occupant is deep in thought.

description:
You feel that you can rest here safely.  There is evidence of
webbing here, but it is of a finer quality.

description: The tunnel branches off north.

name: Path, middle of mountain
description:
Standing on the middle of the mountain, you can easily see the turning
point to the south, and the top of the mountain is very near to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The top of the mountain is easily seen from here.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6503, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbb6f2b043ba8b222", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0d6ed3a699a75a37"}

name: Mid-level leader's room
description:
A rather nice looking room considering the drab conditions down here.
Through all the signs of decoration you can still see evidence of water
leaks.

name: City street
description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going east-west. A large house
stands to the south.

name: Entrance Chamber to the Grand Hall of Kings
description:
Whoever built this place must have been very rich indeed!  Though you did
enter through a rather small door this place has enough room to hold several
score of people.  The floor has a beautifully woven carpet, and the walls are
covered in finely crafted tapestries. You can tell that these things must have
been worth much but they have not lasted well throughout the ages.  Massive
doors lead off to the south and a large stone staircase leads up.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "stone door trapdoor", "description": "It's rather small and looks quite heavy but maybe with some kind of leverage\nyou could move it.  It has a queerly shaped hole that looks big enough\nfor an equally queerly shaped pole to fit inside.  If only you had it!", "valid": true}

name: The Court Ends
description:
You have reached the end of the court.  A huge Draconian is sitting in a
chair here.  As you enter, he motions with his hand and you are rushed by three
of his bodyguards.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above Poor Alley.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Mini-Maze
description: You are in a small passage that looks just like every other one.

name: Roaming the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself floating in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is somewhat disorienting, though your instincts say you are
close to home.
All exits lead off into the astral field.

name: Tree Lair Entrance
description:
It seems the inhabitant of this place does not web her
victims, as evidenced by the remains before you.  The area
is cluttered with desiccated corpses, apparently bitten
but unwebbed, and drained of their life juices.

name: A long tunnel
description: The tunnel branches off south.

name: Mess hall
description:
The a huge table with an immaculate white table cloth stretches way off
to the south.  The room is kept immaculately clean by the nights
themselves.  They truly belive that cleanliness is next to godliness.

name: Top of mountain
description:
You are now on the top of the mountain.  To the south you see a path
leading down the mountain.  To the east and west you see entrances to
what seems like mines.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "An entrance to the mountain which seems to lead underground.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6540, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0d6ed3a699a75a37", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb11d77ecdf9bdf4b"}

name: Inside a Tavern
description:
You are inside a dimly-lit room.  The atmosphere makes you feel uncomfortable.
In front of you stands a mysterious gypsy.  She whispers 'Your fate and
destiny lie beyond this world.'  You are still wondering what she means when
you suddenly notice the crystal ball ... it glows fiercely and displays the
Universe!

name: 3rd House
description:
You stand inside the 3rd house of the city; it is fairly well decorated
by drow standards having a few statues, murals and such. A door leads to the
south.

name: The Grand Hall of Kings
description:
A long hallway stretches east and west.  On the southern side of the hall
there are many doors, each with the name of a king who has died and is
entombed here.  The hallway is beautiful yet chilling.  Even though the area
has been kept well by acolytes, there remains a stench of the undead.

name: A fluffy white cloud.
description:
You find yourself standing on a small cloud.  The cloud feels kind
of spongy beneath your feet.  You find it hard to see anything in
the distance as wisps of cloud blow over your face.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can barely make out a cloud to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9103, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6ee9eba690b059a1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8065633f3404f29e"}

name: The Floor of the Canyon
description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon.  Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at
all.  In general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of
things going on about. The canyon floor extends east and south.  You can
climb a rise in the canyon floor to the north.

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.

name: Mini-Maze
description: You are in a small passage that looks just like every other one.

name: bedroom
description: This is the personal room of the draconian king.  It is not empty.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 10 meters above the temple spire of Midgaard
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Wolf Spider Lair
description:
Very dark, as all lairs of spiders are.  Not much of furnishings
save an exit.  The wolf spider keeps no corpses here, but rather
throws them out at her leisure.

name: A long tunnel
description: The tunnel branches off to the south.

name: N/S hallway
description:
The hallway continues north and south.  A peculiar kind of glow seems
to come from somewhere further along the hallway to the south. The room
to the east looks like the lap of luxury.

name: Narrow Path
description:
This is a narrow path leading to the Dwarven Kingdom.  It looks less
travelled than the others, and it is very creepy.  The path opens up
to the south, and continues to the north.

name: Inside the Crystal Ball
description:
You have touched the crystal ball and find that you have gone inside it:
a world of stars and wonders!  As you look back you figure out there is no
choice but to go forward.

name: Roaming the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself floating in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is somewhat disorienting, though your instincts say you are
close to home.
All exits lead off into the astral field.

name: Throne Room
description:
The throne room of the 3rd house is about as decorated as the inner
courtyard except with a blood covered altar in the center of the room.

name: The Shrine of Crotus
description:
Mostly rubble, this place used to be the shrine of the famous king Crotus,
who saved the northern regions from being overrun by the goblin hordes of
100 years ago.  If not for him, Midgaard of course would have eventually been
conquered as well.  Though Crotus was a goodly king, it was rumored that he
turned to the dark ways in his dying years ... and died an evil man.

same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above the Temple Square.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Entrance to the Crypt
description:
You have entered a large room which smells heavily of reptile.  You wonder
what awaits you here.

name: End of the Mini-Maze
description:
You stand at the end of your journey.  There is a big sign here and you had
better read it!
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "If you are not level 6 or above, then don't go south!!!!  It is a dangerous\narea, but congrats for getting this far - Sandman", "valid": true}

name: The Webless Path
description:
Strange.  No webbing here.  In fact, no sounds whatsoever.
The path continues northward, where you find that you may have to
tightrope your way across a ravine.

name: High officer's room
description:
First thing you notice in this room is the pleasant aroma of cedar.  All
the paneling in the room is made of fine cedar.  A painting of an
elegant knight hangs on the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "painting elegant knight", "description": "Something oddly familiar about the knight.  He carries a glowing sword\nwith a silvery blade.", "valid": true}

name: An underground lake
description:
You are floating on a jet-black underground lake fed by dripping
water and lime from above. The tunnel continues to the east and the river
leads back west. To the north is a roughly-hewn hallway. There is also
a tunnel south.

name: Inside the Galaxy
description:
You are now inside the galaxy, around you you see stars and nebulae smiling
at your presence, and comets and meteors wandering around you.  You realize
that this world may not be the true galaxy after all, but just another
fantasy zone.  Exits lie virtually in all directions.

name: Entrance to Mountain
description:
Here is an entrance to the mountain.  The door looks very well built,
and you can hear noise coming from within.

name: Wandering the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself floating in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is highly disorienting.  Nearby you see a large silvery
strand of light.
Most exits lead off into the astral field.

name: The Tomb of Crotus
description:
A sarcophagus lies in the middle of the room and seems undisturbed.
A hole has been knocked into the east wall.

name: City street
description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going east-west. To the north
is a large building.

name: The Floor of the Canyon
description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon.  Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at
all.  In general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of
things going on about.  The canyon floor extends south and west.  You can
climb a rise in the canyon floor to the north.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above Market Square.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Crypt
description:
You are in a large room which continues to the west.  You notice many
coffins here.  Open coffins reveal remains of something other than man.
The smell of reptile is very strong here.

name: Above the Ravine
description:
Stranger still.  Your feet get a real firm grip on the spiderline.
You are above a deep ravine.  This line connects you between two trees.
Below you can see a prismatic web with lots of animal bones caught in it:
some bear and small deer bones in fact.  No human skeletons are visible
(yet).

name: Mossy intersection
description:
There is a turn off to the passage here.  The main passage leads north
and south. To the south it seems to get impossibly darker.  To the east
you hear... birds?  A small rivulet of water seeps in from the passage
east.  The air is very humid and damp here.

name: Entrance to Gnome Village
description:
You stand on a dusty path that leads north and east.  To the east you hear
the sounds of a small village.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A dusty path heads towards the eastern road.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3526, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc05c00eeac54b835", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9272c968f7636ae5"}

name: Messy Kitchen
description:
You stand in the kitchen and eating area of the day care center.  Pots and
pans are everywhere, while the toddlers continue to create chaos.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see a large room full of noisy brats.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6602, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6ca59fb269e7acbd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb970c06c7e31a478c"}

name: A long narrow tunnel
description: The tunnel rises sharply to the east.

name: Bend in Narrow Path
description:
This is a narrow path that bends to the east here.  The trees hang over
the path, and it is very overgrown.  The narrow path continues to the
south and to the east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees", "description": "They hang over the road in the most ominous of ways.", "valid": true}

name: On an InterGalactic Walkway
description:
You are on a well-paved path which seems that it was made deliberately for
visitors like you.  The walkway continues north and a small exit lies west.

name: Wandering the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself floating in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is highly disorienting.  Nearby you see a large silvery

name: City street
description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street leading north and east. To the
south is an extremely large house.

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: Dark Cave
description:
You notice a path winding east among some huge boulders.  You feel a powerful
source of energy from that direction.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above Market and Commons.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: The Lair
description:
You have entered a large room dominated by a great white dragon.  It growls
at you before it attacks.

name: The Rainbow Web
description:
This is the rainbow web--each strand, each link, a hue of violently
sharp colors and contrasts.  The resident here seems to have a command
of light as well.

name: The holy grove
description:
A small grove of birches grow seem to grow from solid rock.  You hear
birds singing but try as you might you cant see any.  A strange glow
emanates from a place somewhere to the southeast in the grove.

name: The End?
description:
You have reached the final lair.  It is dominated by a huge five headed
dragon (actually an overgrown brat with a Halloween mask).

name: A Dusty Path
description:
This is a path leading into the village.  It continues east and west and
there is a small house to the north.

name: A Gravel Road in the Graveyard
description:
You are on a well-kept gravel road that leads north-south through the
graveyard.  On both sides of the road grow dark evergreen trees.  An iron
grate is to the north and narrow gravel paths lead east and west.

name: A wide tunnel
description:
The tunnel continues east and west. To the east the tunnel dives
down into a bright light.

name: Narrow path
description: This path is very narrow, and it continues to the north and west.

name: End of the InterGalactic Walkway
description:
You notice the walkway has come to an abrupt end and you wonder why. You see
that there is still a small path which leads north and one to the west.
To the east lies a bridge.

name: Wandering the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself floating in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is highly disorienting.  Nearby you see a large silvery
strand of light.
Most exits lead off into the astral field.

name: 2nd House
description:
You stand inside the 2nd house of the city. The room is highly decorated
with statues of spiders and murals everywhere.

name: The holy grove
description:
You are standing amidst the ancient oaks and poplars in the holy grove. You
can feel a strange sensation of contentedness and relief seeping through You,
as if great burdens have been lifted from Your shoulders. From here, friendly-
looking paths lead east and south.

description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: Darker Caves
description:
You can barely see your way even with a light source.  The rocks of the cave
are even darker than the darkness.  You hear a powerful humming all around
you.  Cave paths go south and east roughly, its hard to tell exactly when you
can't see where you are going.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above ground, overlooking the Common Square.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: The Web Forest
description:
The trees here take on a different appearance--they are not trees
anymore, but disjointed make-shift silken made shafts, sticky to the touch,
and webby in texture.  This is another world it would appear.

name: A Lair
description:
You have entered a large room dominated by a great black dragon.  It looks
as though it is amused by your presence.

name: The edge of the forest
description:
You are standing at the eastern edge of a big forest.  To the east is the West
Gate of Midgaard and to the west is a narrow trail, leading in through the
forest.  A dimly lit path leads north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The forest trail winds westwards through the trees.", "valid": true}

name: The holy grove
description:
The trees seem real enough even though they take root in solid rock.
You hear other small animals scampering through the light undergrowth
yet you see nothing. The grove continues south, east and west. An out of
place passage way for some reason heads north.

name: A Road in the Village
description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village.  There
are a few people moving around, but not many.

name: A Gravel Road in the Graveyard
description:
You are on a well-kept gravel road that leads north-south through the
graveyard.  On both sides of the road grow dark evergreen trees.

name: The Grand Hall of Kings
description:
You are in the western part of the Grand Hall of Kings.  To the south is a
door and to the east and west the hall continues.

name: Throne Room
description:
The throne room of the 2nd house is just a little more decorative than
the inner courtyard having an altar in the center of the room.

name: Cave-in
description:
You stand at the edge of a large pile of rubble created from the last
rockslide.

name: At the Undeveloped Part of the Galaxy
description:
This place looks deserted, covered with space debris.  Not a sign of life
is around.

name: Narrow north-south path
description:
This path leads to the north and south.  To the north you can see a
door, and to the south the path continues.

name: The Crypt Ends
description:
You have come to the end of the Crypt.  It seems deserted.  There is a
strange coffin lying against the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "coffin", "description": "A coffin lies a against the east wall.  It is closed.", "valid": true}

name: The holy grove
description:
You are standing amidst the ancient oaks and poplars in the holy grove. You
feel unusually happy here, as if great burdens have been lifted from Your
shoulders. From here, pleasant-looking paths lead east, west and south.

name: A trail through the light forest
description:
You are on a trail leading through the forest.  To the east is the forest edge
and to the west, the trail leads further into the forest.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The forest trail winds east-west through the trees.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The trail continues eastwards out of the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6000, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6b6e0dcd21956edd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8ee3d7875764ab6c"}

name: The Slave Pit
description:
You have entered the slave pit.  A voice blares in the distance,
"Get back to work, maggots!"  Rails upon rails of mined gold and silver
clutter the trail beneath you.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above the ground just north of Midgaard.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: The holy grove
description:
The grove continues west and south.  The glow is roughly to the south
somewhere.

name: A Dusty Path
description:
You are on a dusty path on the far side of the village.  Houses are to the
north and south, while the path continues east.  There is a sign here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "Warning:  The area to the east was written mostly by Vougon\n(giggle)    - Sandman", "valid": true}

name: An ominous storm cloud.
description:
You find yourself in a storm.  Lightning flashes and thunder
crashes, making you wish you were dry and warm.

name: A Gravel Road in the Graveyard
description:
You are on a well-kept gravel road that leads north-south through the
graveyard.  On both sides of the road grow dark evergreen trees.

name: Entrance to the Shadow Grove
description:
Before you, the grove of shadows lies. Giant grey trees are all that
can be seen through the thick shadows. A great sense of both power and
menace permeates the surrounding area. You have a strange urge to turn
back and go back the way you've come.
A small path leads north into the shadows and back south to the road.

name: The Chat Room
description:
You are lounging in a quiet cosy parlour, warmed by a gentle magical fire
which twinkles happily in a warm fireplace.  This is one of the many rooms
where the heroes and gods come to socialize.  It is by far one of the most
comfortable!

name: At the foot of the rubble
description:
You are at the bottom of a large pile of rubble. A tunnel branches
off to the north and east.

name: The Shrine of Mitnar
description:
Mitnar was a gruesome beast of a man ... he loved battle ... and nothing
else.  Warriors did love Mitnar, and all fighting men honored him.
On the wall is depicted battle after battle after battle.
A small opening has been shaped carefully to the east.

name: A Dark Alleyway
description:
The walls of the alleyway have been spray-painted over many times
over the years.  One section of graffiti actually looks legible,
it says:    This section has been designed for levels 5 through 10
If you are above level 15 please don't expect much fun.
If you are below level 5 enter at your own risk.
Another section of graffiti says "Raff Rules!"
There is a boulevard to the east and Emerald Avenue is visible to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You can see Emerald Avenue, a much nicer place to be.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3119, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8be9ad4d96ec2245", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0d5f0b72ec026f20"}

name: Main Gate
description:
You are at the entrance to the 1st house of the city. A large gate, almost
as big and elegant as the one at the entrance to the city, stands here.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A large gate lies to the west.", "keyword": "gate", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5111, "room_id": "69f4d0cb39748228ad06240f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb14409806f8c52e94"}

name: Door to Kingdom
description:
Here the path turns to the west.  You can see a door in front of you,
and the path continues to the west and south.

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.

name: The Void
description: You are floating in nothing.

name: Darker Caves
description:
You can barely see your way even with a light source.  The rocks of the cave
are even darker than the darkness.  You hear a powerful humming all around you.
Cave paths go north, south and east roughly; it's hard to tell exactly when
you can't see where you are going.

name: A clearing in the woods
description:
You are standing in a clearing in the light woods. Somehow, this place
seems powerfully DIFFERENT from the rest of the forest, as if something is
severely strained in the fabric of reality here.  There is a small tablet
on one of the trees.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tablet", "description": "This zone has been populated by Merc.  1993", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A small, narrow path winds north, and is quickly lost in the bushes. It\nlooks quite a wilderness there!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5378, "room_id": "69f4d0cb022161cb2e66d2a0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf8228d2aa47f704b"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "There is a path winding its way south through the tall poplars, disappearing\nout of sight some 100 yds. away.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8906, "room_id": "69f4d0cb022161cb2e66d2a0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb775a50d4e254056e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "There is a friendly-looking path leading west through the tall trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8902, "room_id": "69f4d0cb022161cb2e66d2a0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb962fe3d5d633b789"}

name: A trail through the light forest
description:
You are on a narrow trail leading east and west through the forest.  To the
west, the forest gradually becomes more dense.  A small forest path leads
south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The trail continues eastwards through the young trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6001, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9b60a125b551d3ad", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6b6e0dcd21956edd"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The small path leads south through the young trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6011, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9b60a125b551d3ad", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7af1c126373f5ea1"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see the narrow forest trail winding westwards into the dense forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6003, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9b60a125b551d3ad", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3b76bde0fa046914"}

name: The Tether Path
description:
Another tether path just like the rest of them.  Surprisingly well
-lit by the golden orbs that hang from the sides, you can see the paths
become finer and finer in quality.

name: Entrance to the Great Hall
description:
You have entered a huge hall.  It has been carefully decorated with
beautiful tapestries depicting a great battle between dragons and men.  The
dragons appear to be the victors.

name: On the Bridge of Stars
description:
This bridge has been made by the stars to honour their ancestors.  The
bridge itself shines brightly and makes you feel that you are walking on
a path of light.  An entrance to an ancient building lies north and to
the east lies the Milky Way.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above the west gate of Midgaard.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Mess hall
description:
"mess" isn't exactly the best word to describe this room.  On the
contrary, it is immaculately clean.  A very long table stretches way off
to the north. A hallway is to the east.

name: A Road in the Village
description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village.  There
are a few people moving around, but not many.

name: A Gravel Road in the Graveyard
description:
You are on a well-kept gravel road that leads north-south through the
graveyard.  On both sides of the road grow dark evergreen trees.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The gravel road continues southwards to an open space before a small\nbuilding.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3604, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0eb1346cb0706b63", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba434c1d9c76e9c65"}

name: High and perilous cliff
description:
You are on a high and rocky cliff.  To the west you see a huge
ominous storm cloud moving this way.  You might want to take cover
before the storm hits.  You think that there is a narrow trail
leading to the south.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "An ominous storm cloud looms to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9110, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8ab8f3c8a14aaf8d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1bc135f24b6fb8eb"}

name: Travelling the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself floating in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is extremely disorienting.  Nearby you see a large silvery
strand of light.
Most exits lead off into the astral field.

name: The Shadow Grove
description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you
from all sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange
sounds of moaning and growling come from all directions.
All exits lead into shadows, you are very confused.

name: Moses' Hangout
description:
You see here a cozy little room with a fireplace.  You can tell it is Moses'
room by the two stone tablets and a bible on a small ledge near the fireplace.
This room was designed for total relaxation.  You can watch television, listen
to the stereo, even soak in a hot tub.
There is a bell here for the butler.

name: Cave entrance
description:
You stand in the middle of a large and beautiful cave. A path leads
deeper into the darkness.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You look down into the cave. Bones are strewn about everywhere.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5011, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcfe2401d1fdb1e6a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb312afe270375793e"}

name: Beginning of White Dragon Boulevard
description:
This section of town has been overrun by the Troll gang.  Even the
police stay out of here for fear of being brutalized.  This was once
a nice lower-middleclass neighborhood, but know the gangs run the
streets.  All the shops and homes have been boarded up and abandoned.
An alleyway is to the west and the street continues east.  An over-
grown lot is to the south.

name: 1st House
description:
You stand in the inner courtyard of the 1st and largest house in the city.
The room is extremely large and decorative. Mural and paintings hang on the
walls depicting some battles and a spider queen.

name: The Tomb of Mitnar
description:
The wall paintings show men and women warriors alike bowing down to Mitnar,
prisoners of war being put to the sword by Mitnar, and great heaps of gold
and weapons under the feet of Mitnar.  Where his coffin was, there is now
only a rectangular blemish on the floor of the dusty room.

name: Path to the Castle
description:
You are on a path that will eventually lead to the castle.  It
continues north to the castle, and there is a door on the western wall.

name: A trail through the dense forest
description:
You are on a trail leading east and west through the dense forest.  To the
east, the forest gradually seems to become lighter.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The forest trail seems almost fragile compared to the massive trunks.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The trail continues eastwards to the younger part of the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6002, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3b76bde0fa046914", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9b60a125b551d3ad"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see the narrow trail winding westwards through the dense forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6004, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3b76bde0fa046914", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7f65af2c1f5c6f18"}

name: Limbo
description:
You are floating in a formless void, detached from all sensation of physical
matter, surrounded by swirling glowing light, which fades into the relative
darkness around you without any trace of edges or shadow.
There is a "No Tipping" notice pinned to the darkness.

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above west gate of Midgaard.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: On the Bridge of Nebulae
description:
This bridge, like the other, was made as a memorial.  The nebulae had to
make one just to show that they are as capable as the stars.  North lies
a throne room.

name: A Road Crossing
description: Another shifty little strand of webs, almost ethereal in nature.

name: Darker Caves
description:
You can barely see your way even with a light source.  The rocks of the cave
are even darker than the darkness.  You hear a powerful humming all around you.
Cave paths go north, south and west roughly, it's hard to tell exactly when you
can't see where you are going.

name: The Great Hall
description:
You are working your way down the Hall.  To the north, you notice a smaller
passageway, while the main hall continues to the east.

name: The holy grove
description:
You are standing amidst the ancient oaks and poplars in the holy grove. You
feel calm and relaxed here, as if great burdens have been lifted from Your
shoulders. From here, pleasant-looking paths lead east, north and south. To
the west, through the trees, You can see a faint trail leading towards the
eastern road.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The path wind its way through the tall trees, disappearing out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8901, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf26d9aa13d321734", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9dafe4c7a1e57484"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can barely see a path leading back towards the eastern road.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8951, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf26d9aa13d321734", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5bf77c5a8eb980a5"}

name: End of a hallway
description:
You hear voices coming from a room to the west.  the hallway goes north.
To the east lies a room which seems to glow with power and piety.

name: The dark woods
description:
You are travelling through woods that are as dark as night. The trees above
block all light and wind. The air is stagnant and smells of death and decay.
The lack of sounds and other signs of life make your skin crawl and you feel
very much like turning back and heading for safer areas. The path leads north
into more open lands while it also leads south into the darkness of the forest.
A small sign is posted here.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "[]================================[]
|      BEWARE!      | Hope you   |
|   Travellers are  | enjoy it!  |
|  advised to stay  | <------->  |
|   in groups for   |  Skurge    |
|      safety.      | Ragnarok   |
[]================================[]", "valid": true}

name: A Road in the Village
description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village.  There
are a few people moving around, but not many.

name: Muddy Path
description:
This section of the path is slowly being drowned by the nearby swamp to the
south, which is creeping slowly inland.  Several caved-in buildings sprawl
here, torn apart both by battle and the elements.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "swamp", "description": "The swamp to the south even reaches as far as this point ... it makes the\nground and air about you moist and fetid.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A broken road leading southward into the marsh.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8302, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9e35d77cc164e3a3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb84ec8ce31091e904"}

name: In front of the Chapel
description:
You are on an open space before a small chapel.  A gravel road leads north
through the graveyard and the chapel entrance is to the south.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The gravel path leads eastwards between the dark evergreen trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3638, "room_id": "69f4d0cba434c1d9c76e9c65", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb333ccd0298ed364d"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The chapel door is made of dark wood.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3405, "room_id": "69f4d0cba434c1d9c76e9c65", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2a6d23087b69f5d8"}

name: Giant cave
description:
This cavern overwhelms you. The walls and ceiling seem miles away.
Bones of previous adventurers lie strewn on the cavern floor.

name: The Center of the Universe
description:
You are at the centre of the universe, everything is filled with bright
light in all colors. You feel time and space no longer exist here.
Exits fill the room in all 42 dimensions, leading everywhere.

name: The Shadow Grove
description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you
from all sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange
sounds moaning and growling come from all directions.
All exits lead into shadows, you are very confused.

name: Narrow rocky trail.
description:
A narrow trail leads down towards the mountain and north toward the
cliff.  It seems to fade in and out as it winds up the hill.
Obviously, it has not been maintained in years.

name: Along White Dragon Boulevard
description:
Everywhere you look you see signs of recent violence.  Patches of blood
lie everywhere and broken sticks and abandoned knifes are strewn here
and there.  An over-grown lot is to the south.  White Dragon Boulevard leads
east and west.

name: Throne Room
description:
The throne room of the 1st house is in one word...awesome. It is so
horrifying it is almost beautiful.

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: Still on the path to the Castle
description:
You are still on the path to the castle, or back to the
Dwarven village, whichever way you wish to go.  The path
continues to the north and south.

name: A trail through the dense forest
description:
You are on a trail leading east and west through the dense forest.  To the
west, the trees are so huge and their crowns so dense that forest remains in
total darkness.  A small path leads south through the trees.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The trail continues eastwards through the dense forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6003, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7f65af2c1f5c6f18", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3b76bde0fa046914"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow trail almost seems to disappear between the enormous trunks.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6100, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7f65af2c1f5c6f18", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe8a8d0b60e494463"}

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above wall road.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: The Throne Room of the Nebula King
description:
You can only faintly make out that it is a throne room as it is too
dark in here.  In the middle is an empty throne.  You wonder where
the King has gone, maybe he is hiding from you?

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.
