name: A Leader Strand
description:
This strand is weightier, more sturdy.  It shimmers as you step on
it.  You are definitely not in the Midgaardian realms anymore.  Just
where you are you can't tell.  It feels like you're moving through
ether.  You can still get back down to more surer lands.

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The gravel path continues eastwards towards a gravel road.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3600, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9ea1d59b830632fb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba15557d97dd98d0c"}

name: A Narrow Passageway
description: This Passageway branches off from the main hall and leads somewhere ... where?
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a large Lair.  It looks dangerous.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 2226, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4f8b0d7ef81b0013", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7e7dae77079d2e83"}

name: Darkest Caves
description:
Your light doesn't even seem to work here.  Even magical light sources seem
only to illuminate about a foot ahead of you.  You suddenly realize that the
path has descended quite a bit but you didn't notice before because of the
darkness.  You sense a great presence off to the east aways.

name: Grand Templar's room
description:
All the items in this room look ancient yet strangely very powerful and
rich.  There is an aura of great holiness about the room.

name: A Road in the Village
description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village.  There
are a few people moving around, but not many.

name: The sacred glade
description:
You are standing in the middle of the sacred glades, where the citizens of
Midgaard come to celebrate the spring, where farmers give thanks for bountiful
harvest in the fall, and where lovers stroll in summer. You feel seasons of
remembered happiness and joy taking Your sorrows and worries away from You,
leaving You calm and invigorated, ready for the world. Paths lead into the
holy grove to the east, north and west, while to the south a wide, sunny field
slopes down to a sparkling lake.  Above you is a strange shimmering, almost
like something from another world....
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The path wind its way north, disappearing through the tall trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8902, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe2114abd1f21ecce", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb962fe3d5d633b789"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The path wind its way through the tall trees, disappearing out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8906, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe2114abd1f21ecce", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb775a50d4e254056e"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, a wide, sunny field stretch out, sloping down towards a brightly\nglittering lake.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8908, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe2114abd1f21ecce", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb93a3fe94e3bf757d"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The path wind its way west between stately poplars and oaks.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8904, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe2114abd1f21ecce", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf26d9aa13d321734"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "The shimmering grows in intensity as you look at it, beckoning you to reach\nupwards...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9000, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe2114abd1f21ecce", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4e931fe1f33b42af"}

name: The dark woods
description:
You wearily travel through the darkness of the forest. Huge skeletal trees
line the edges of the path and tower above you. Errant rays of light spear
down through the gaps in the canopy above and provide small spots of light
that seem to attract what little foliage can grow on the dark forest floor.
The path winds north and south into darkness.

name: Valhalla
description:
This is the huge Hall of Valhalla, where the Gods rule supreme.  The
cavernous building stretches infinitely in all directions.  Valhalla
continues to the east, and the gods make their homes north and south of
the halls.  The golden gates are to the west.  You know not what lies
upward...
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A sea cave is south of here.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1208, "room_id": "69f4d0cb06a33b512f857e85", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe4fa0f24bb197ab2"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The entrance to Valhalla is to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1216, "room_id": "69f4d0cb06a33b512f857e85", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba1c1d69ba9211c5b"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "If you want to know what is up there, you shall have to go look...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1, "room_id": "69f4d0cb06a33b512f857e85", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2aa55833117c3f85"}

name: Narrow bend
description: The tunnel turns to the south and west.

name: Swamp's Edge
description:
Briars and marsh plants stick to your boots and clothes, and clouds cover the
skies above the murky marsh, leaving the path before you dark and sinister.
You see some disturbances in the marsh, but after a few strangled screams,
the sounds stop.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east lies a series of bogs and shallows that look rather threatening.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8303, "room_id": "69f4d0cb84ec8ce31091e904", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe81865e6505f738f"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You notice a large hill rising out of the marsh to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8304, "room_id": "69f4d0cb84ec8ce31091e904", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbf10cc035675abf6"}

name: The Shadow Grove
description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem the glare at you
from all sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange
sounds of moaning and growling come from all directions.
All exits lead into shadows, you are very confused.

name: Entrance to Mega-City One
description:
A road begins here in the glowing sands.  You follow it through a gate
in a Plasteen wall onto the Megway of Mega-City One.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the glowing sand of the badlands.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5062, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8826263cbe36b963", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1b2da87cd53e1664"}

name: Travelling the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself floating in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is extremely disorienting.  Nearby you see a large silvery
strand of light.
Most exits lead off into the astral field.

name: Small valley.
description:
You are in a lush valley full of trees and other vegetation and the
odd carcass or two.  The trail leads south and it leads up.

name: A small path in the dense forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest.  The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination.  The path
continues north and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The small path leads north through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6004, "room_id": "69f4d0cbffee959d40ccab60", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7f65af2c1f5c6f18"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The small path leads south through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6006, "room_id": "69f4d0cbffee959d40ccab60", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb8b2814746391f5b"}

name: White Dragon Boulevard at Armory
description:
Only gang members dare wander the streets here.
What used to be the armory lies to the south.  White Dragon Boulevard
leads east and west.

name: The Plains
description:
You are standing on the plains. This is a vast desolate place where the
wind can howl undisturbed since nothing but you bars its way. However you
are not the first to wander here. Before you somebody has left a small path.
The path looks rather bewildered and is not the kind of path to lead to
anywhere significant or important but it seems to have made up its mind to
enter the hills far away north.

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: Door to Castle
description:
Here there is a door to the castle to the east.  The castle
is elegantly designed, and looks much like a roll of toilet paper
standing on end.  A sign says:

******************************************
*  WELCOME TO THE CASTLE OF STRANGELOVE  *
*      Here, celibacy is uninvited       *
******************************************

name: Main Chamber
description:
This is the council chamber for the Matron Mother herself. A huge table
and chairs surrounding it sits in the center of the room.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above wall road.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: At the Start of the Milky Way
description:
It is here that the famous old Milky Way starts flowing.  You are surrounded
by streams of mist the moment you tread on it.  You can't see well in
here ... luckily you haven't fallen yet!

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: The Entrance of the Ethereal Web
description:
You are at the entrance to ethereal web.  Flickering in and out,
in and out, each strand reveals a different hue from black to green
to blue.

name: Darkest Caves
description:
Your light doesn't even seem to work here.  Even magical light sources seem
only to illuminate about a foot ahead of you.  You suddenly realize that the
path has descended quite a bit but you didn't notice before because of the
darkness.  You sense a great presence directly to the east.

name: Lair
description:
You have entered a large lair with bones strewn about the ground.  You
notice the source of these as you come face to face with a rather large red
dragon.  You notice a trap door in the floor.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see a trap door.", "keyword": "door trap trapdoor", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 2227, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7e7dae77079d2e83", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba565651adf741bf0"}

name: Priscilla's Pleasure Palace
description:
As you look around you, you see the largest collection of erotic toys
in the world!!!  On a table in the middle of the room lies a book titled :
"All You Ever Wanted to Know About Sex..But Were Afraid to Ask"
There are things here that you never even imagined in your wildest dreams!

name: The holy grove
description:
You are standing amidst the ancient oaks and poplars in the holy grove. You
can feel a strange sensation of joy and calm seeping through You, as if great
burdens have been lifted from Your shoulders. To the south, You glimpse an open
area through the trees, while paths lead away north and west.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "mansion", "description": "The mansion is a sprawling, two-story affair with three wings, where the top
of one wing serves as balcony. The walls look as marble would do, if marble
changed color slowly, continuously, through the entire spectrum. There are
large windows all over the house.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The path wind its way through the tall trees, disappearing out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8903, "room_id": "69f4d0cb775a50d4e254056e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb022161cb2e66d2a0"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, just beyond the trees, you can see a wide green lawn, and past\nthe lawn, a softly shimmering, rainbow-colored mansion.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8909, "room_id": "69f4d0cb775a50d4e254056e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbde65a809970652a6"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The path wind its way through the tall trees, disappearing out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8905, "room_id": "69f4d0cb775a50d4e254056e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe2114abd1f21ecce"}

name: Very dark passage
description:
This room is so dark that even powerful magic lights seems to barely
illuminate the ground in front of you.  If its possible it seems even
darker to the south.  The passage also leads back north.

name: A Road in the Village
description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village.  There
are a few people moving around, but not many.

name: The small intersection in the forest
description:
The forest path splits here in three directions. Small paths lead to the east,
north, and south. The trees above leave a gap which allows light to fill the
intersection. It is almost as though you are in a circle of light that
provides sanctuary in this land of darkness.
Something has been scrawled in the dirt in blood here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "blood dirt scrawl", "description": "BeWAre tHe SwAmP oGreS......", "valid": true}

name: Large cave
description: You are standing in a large cave. Many furs are spread out on the floor.

name: Marshy Forest
description:
This area is by no means a forest, but for those who dwell in these sparse
trees it is one.  Occasionally you see a whole humanoid form floating face down
in the water, but mostly you only find pieces.  You hear a loud bellow in the
distance.  And feel fear creep into your heart.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "humanoid corpse", "description": "He looks mangled and shredded.  You see one large gash mark that looks\nlike it came from the claw of some huge beast.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Eastward is the thick bog of ooze...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8305, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe81865e6505f738f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc497ff8bbb073897"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Westward lies the remanents of a broken and shattered roadway being swallowed\nby the marsh.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8302, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe81865e6505f738f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb84ec8ce31091e904"}

name: Mahmount Allesh Megway
description:
You are on one mile of over 13 and a half billion kilometers of
roadway in Mega-City One.  The Megway continues north and south.

name: The Shadow Grove
description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you
from all sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange
sounds of moaning and growling come from all directions.
All exits lead into shadows, you are very confused.

name: A small path in the dense forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest.  The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination.  The path
continues north and east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The small path leads north through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6005, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb8b2814746391f5b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbffee959d40ccab60"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The small path leads east through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6007, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb8b2814746391f5b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc4cbfc0eb9b8560a"}

name: Small valley.
description:
You are in a lush valley full of trees and other vegetation and the
odd carcass or three.  The trail leads north and it leads down into
a crevasse.

name: The Grand Hall of Kings
description: You are still walking through the gloomy hallway.

name: White Dragon Blvd.
description:
Black Dragon Avenue used to run south from here but the way has been
blocked by the toppling of a building into the street.  White Dragon
boulevard continues east and west.

name: The Lane
description:
You are strolling along a pleasant, shady lane. The road is lined on both
sides by tall, stately trees which lend the scene with a sense of quiet
serenity. You can follow the road north or south.

name: City street
description: You walk along a highly ornate city street leading north-south and east.

name: The Temple Of Mota
description:
You are in the southern end of the temple hall in the Temple of Mota.
The temple has been constructed from giant marble blocks, eternal in
appearance, and most of the walls are covered by ancient wall paintings
picturing gods, giants and peasants.
Large steps lead down through the grand temple gate, descending the huge
mound upon which the temple is built and ends on the temple square below.
Equally large steps lead UP through a small door into the ENTRANCE to MUD
SCHOOL.  (type 'up' to go to MUD SCHOOL.)  A small plaque is on this wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "plaque", "description": "This entire world has been integrated, modified, debugged, and enhanced by
Hatchet, Kahn, and Furey of MERC Industries to be run by any MERC Mud.
1992 December 17
ROM enhancements by Alander.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "At the northern end of the temple hall is a statue and a huge altar.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3054, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0ce695cd67b76c67", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb611c25622176521c"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "You see the entrance to Mud School.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3700, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0ce695cd67b76c67", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9f43475fa9ee8c91"}

name: Inside the entrance
description:
Everything here is covered in soot and very grimy.  The path continues
to the east and north, and there is a door to the west.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The little underground path continues to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6514, "room_id": "69f4d0cb30fb7b7fc045b9c9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdcfd5ef48b5ad218"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "This looks like an entrance to some type of store room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6526, "room_id": "69f4d0cb30fb7b7fc045b9c9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1a3c347fd23b5ede"}

name: The Grand Gate of Thalos
description:
You stand in the archway of a gigantic stone archway. The two
steel gates look indestructible, yet they are elaborate in engravings.  You can
hear laughter and good cheer from the other side of these gates.  Obviously,
the city is teeming with activity!  There is a small gold plaque on mounted
on the archway.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "plaque sign", "description": "This zone has been heavily modified by Kahn and Hatchet of MERC Industries\nand integrated by Kahn of MERC Industries.\ncopyright 1993", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You are saddened at the thought of leaving this beautiful place.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5356, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd307fac9092c97cc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4e550d2b3f1ad93f"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see happiness everywhere. Houses cover your vision. You see strange cute\nbeasts walking hand in hand with people.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5301, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd307fac9092c97cc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5bab048cf01c56a8"}

name: Entrance to the Mob Factory
description:
You find that you have entered a strange factory. This factory doesn't
make cars or computers or something - it makes mobs! The sound of
machinery can be heard in the background; the grinding gears drive you
crazy! To the north you see the storage area, to the south the
foreman's office, to the east the entrance hallway, and to the west the
familiar paving of wall road.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above the ground north of Midgaard.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Along the Milky Way
description:
You are still travelling inside this path of mist.  You notice a small
opening to the east.

name: The Young Wormkin's Crib
description:
A playpen of sorts, with maggots of wasps and other baby vermin
lying about.  You feel that humans have been played with here too,
and eaten later.  You sense that the maker of this place has
an appetite for dragon meat, and uses this room as a breeding
area.

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads north and west.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}

name: Earth Chamber
description:
This is the abode of the Earth Ruler.  He decides about earthquakes,
landslides, and avalanches.  The Earth Ruler sits upon a huge marble throne
carved into the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "marble throne", "description": "The ruler notices your stare, and doesn't like it one bit!  The whole\nearth seems to shake with his emotion.", "valid": true}

name: Underground Tunnel
description:
You have entered an underground tunnel.  It is dark and dirty, and you find
yourself wishing you were back in Midgaard.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see the red dragon's lair.", "keyword": "door trap trapdoor", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 2226, "room_id": "69f4d0cba565651adf741bf0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7e7dae77079d2e83"}

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8628, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9ae918ade2d6588a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb36ef367b894ee3d3"}

name: The Eye of the Hurricane
description:
The shrieking winds of a monstrous storm surround you, spinning you around
in an endless web of fury. But then, in the middle of turmoil, you find a
strange calm. You find yourself hovering in the calm eye of a hurricane. All
around you you can see the desruction caused by the powerful storm. White
hot flashes of lightning flicker from the depths of the hurricane.  But
everything is strangely peaceful in here, with the sun shining in from above
and a flock of birds winging across the sky.  You stretch out and relax, this
storm is going to be here a while.

name: The holy grove
description:
The grove continues north and east.  To the east a strange humming can
barely be heard.

name: The holy grove
description:
You are standing amidst the tall, majestic trees in the southern end of the
holy grove. Paths lead north and east. To the east, You can see a wide, open
field, sloping gently down towards a bright, glittering lake. Somehow, here
you feel an inexplicable happiness, as if the world's troubles no longer
really matter to you.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "mansion", "description": "The mansion is a sprawling, two-story affair with three wings, where the top
of one wing serves as balcony. The walls look as marble would do, if marble
changed color slowly, continuously, through the entire spectrum. There are
large windows all over the house.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The path leading north is soon lost out of sight amongst the ancient oaks and\npoplars.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8904, "room_id": "69f4d0cbaa7dc7242b193c31", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf26d9aa13d321734"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "To the east, the path leads out into a wide, sunny summer's field, sloping\nsouth towards a beautiful lake. Past the field You can see a stately mansion,\nshimmering gently in all the rainbow's colours.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8908, "room_id": "69f4d0cbaa7dc7242b193c31", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb93a3fe94e3bf757d"}

name: A Small Gnome House
description:
This is a small suburban house made from quality wood.  You can see the
expert workmanship that went into making it, but it lacks creativity.

name: The edge of the forest and hills
description:
You stand at the edge of a dark forest. A path leads north into the forest and
its deadly darkness and silence. Looking west, you see a path that leads up
into a foothills region. Standing here on the boundary between light and
darkness, you feel very vulnerable and alone.

name: Damp hallway
description: The walls here are extremely damp, as well as the floor.

name: On a hill.
description:
You stand atop a hill on the northwestern side of the evil swamp. Dark
clouds whip around you and the wind raises its voice and assails you.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north lies a damp broken roadway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8302, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbf10cc035675abf6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb84ec8ce31091e904"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "A dark pool congeals to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8309, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbf10cc035675abf6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbef0086b07c0fbd81"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A gloomy path leads down the hill into the swamp.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8310, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbf10cc035675abf6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdf97d5856cf2df5e"}

name: Intersection of Junket Way and Megway
description:
The Megway intersects with Junket Way here.  Junket Way is to the east,
the Megway continues north and south, and the Pustule Palace Cafe is
to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The Pustule Palace Cafe is in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8021, "room_id": "69f4d0cbab7f48b8054b8e4a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb78b2901f6eb9394a"}

name: The Shadow Grove
description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you
from all sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange
sounds of moaning and growling come from all directions.
All exits lead into shadows, you are very confused.

name: Travelling the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself floating in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is extremely disorienting.  Nearby you see a large silvery
strand of light.
Most exits lead off into the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The astral field leads off into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7726, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe93b9dbddddb2a61", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc3f81a1ec7d8833b"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "The astral field leads off into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7731, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe93b9dbddddb2a61", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb03858da5cbc1690b"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see a tangible strand of silvery light.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7744, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe93b9dbddddb2a61", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcaf74c0b1c636275"}

name: An intersection in the dense forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest.  The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination.  The forest
gradually lightens to the east.  Paths lead east, west and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You can barely make out a clearing to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6008, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc4cbfc0eb9b8560a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb4771855cde0b90b"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The small path leads south through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6012, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc4cbfc0eb9b8560a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0e4741c433f28a54"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The small path leads west through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6006, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc4cbfc0eb9b8560a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb8b2814746391f5b"}

name: West trail around Midgaard
description:
You are on a dusty trail following the outside wall of Midgaard.
To the east the wall towers over you and to the west you see the
forest of Haon-Dor. The trail leads north and south along the wall.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The dusty trail winds north closely to the wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3901, "room_id": "69f4d0cba73a38951a935f03", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc5c85e6de622612e"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The dusty trail leads to outside the west gate of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3052, "room_id": "69f4d0cba73a38951a935f03", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd67a94ec11b8c2fb"}

name: Deep, slippery crevice.
description:
The crevice is deep and a little dim and it is hard to make your
way around.  A mist makes everything a little damp and slippery.
Better take your time climbing through here.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The mist looks thicker in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9116, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5009dfdd0c529cab", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7b1d2ae61764b837"}

name: The Shrine of Frath
description:
Little chunks of dried meat are spattered throughout this room.  The walls
are covered in gore.  Almost as if they were painted ... ICK!  You can
almost make out the design!

name: Corner of Ice and White Dragon
description:
Ice Dragon Way leads south from here.  It used to run the whole length
of the neighborhood and way lined with beautiful crystal sculptures.
White Dragon boulevard leads east and west from here.

name: Cleric's Inner Sanctum
description:
This is the inner sanctum.  A picture of the mighty Mota is hanging on
the wall, just above the altar which is set against the western wall.  A well
in the middle of the floor leads down into darkness.  Vile smells waft from
the depths.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see your favorite place, the bar of divination.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3003, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1c346e82db71d32a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb454bf3408303be2e"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You can't see what is down there, it is too dark.  Looks like it would be\nimpossible to climb back up.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7026, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1c346e82db71d32a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbeec659edfd2269ef"}

name: The Cross Roads
description:
Here, the great eastern road intersects with an older road between the mines
of Moria and the ruined city of Thalos.  The outskirts of Midgaard lie to your
west, and the highway continues the the east.  An old northern road leads to
the dwarven kingdom and the abandoned mines of Moria, while the southern road
shows the scars of the war which destroyed Thalos.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "An old road leads towards the abandoned mines of Moria and the Dwarven Kingom.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3501, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3f7642ccf1afb737", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb489fed1443d96317"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The road continues east, where you hear faint singing.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3525, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3f7642ccf1afb737", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb78230f7039845fd6"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A once mighty road leads through the dwarf forest towards ruined Thalos.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5261, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3f7642ccf1afb737", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5a82fb1f427453db"}

name: The Entrance to the Dancing Daemon Inn
description:
You find yourself in an entrance foyer to the Dancing Daemon Inn. Chrome
plated stairs spiral up to the reception area. To the south you hear the
sounds of merriment and drinking and from the west you hear the bustling
activity of New Thalos.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see people walking by on Sultan's Walk.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9520, "room_id": "69f4d0cb087af69911d2e51b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9774df901266594f"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "The spiral stairs lead up to the reception area.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9501, "room_id": "69f4d0cb087af69911d2e51b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1cbe37b2c39c1453"}

name: City street
description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street leading south. A building is
to the west.

name: Mob Factory Storage Area
description:
This is where the raw materials from which mobs are manufactured are
stored. You see sacks of sawdust, cans of pink paint, a large box
containing wigs and a bottle mysteriously labelled "solution x". Exits
are more of storage to the east and north, and entrance to the mob
factory to the south.

name: Path
description:
You are on a path in the dwarven village which leads north to the shops
and south to the corner of the area.

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: Main Street
description:
This is a magnificent street, immaculate all over. The streets are filled
with people rushing from building to building and a balmy zephyr blows by
you.  The whole city is teeming with activity.  A cobbled alley leads north
and south.  Children run pass you as they play tag.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The entrance to the city lies this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5300, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5bab048cf01c56a8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd307fac9092c97cc"}

name: The Base of the Web
description:
Large strands connect at this point.  The node shimmers and
flickers within the ether.  You see many flying creatures--
insects, pegasi, and dragon wormkins--navigate the dangerous
passages of the web.  Exits go in many directions.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above the magic shop.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: At the End of the Milky Way
description:
Just as you started enjoying this journey inside the mist, you have come to
the end of it.  West leads to a bridge and east leads to somewhere else.

name: By the River
description:
The water in the river seems to bubble and froth with magic.  Though it
splashes playfully on you, it does not seem wet.  The path leads north closer
to the water. To the west you see a T-intersection.

name: Entrance to the Plane of Nirvana
description:
You stand before the entrance to a plane of absolute balance and order.  It is
equally hot and cold, equally light and dark, and made of equal parts of solid
and liquid.

The plane extends to the west and east, while an exit lies downward.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east, the plane extends for what seems to be forever.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9001, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4e931fe1f33b42af", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc15845fdbdcfb28e"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "Downwards, you see the portal leading back to home.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8905, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4e931fe1f33b42af", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe2114abd1f21ecce"}

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.

name: The holy grove
description:
All of a sudden all the mysterious sounds of the grove stop. Or perhaps
its just the strange humming and glowing from a clearing to the south
drowning out everything else. There is a sort of magical forcefield door
to the south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "a glowing forcefield with a small circular hole in it.", "keyword": "glow glowing field forcefield door", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 2001, "to_room_vnum": 2032, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5659e0dec825d257", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2baca6a0a758ac8c"}

name: Walking on the Moon
description:
The proud and lonely silence of Mare Imbrium surrounds you, as you gaze upon
the sterile splendor of the moon.  All around is the velvet curtain of night,
studded with a thousand gleaming jewels.  Below you hangs the beautiful
fields of Earth, looking fragile and far away, but full of hope.  A sense of
wistful regret touches you, as you think about what might have been, and what
will be.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "crater mare imbrium", "description": "A small shipping tag is pinned to the ground with a worn hunting knife.\nUpon it is a dedication to Robert Anson Heinlein, the father of the future.", "valid": true}

name: Underground Tunnel
description: This tunnel has come to a dead end.  You feel nervous about being trapped here.

name: The sunny field
description:
You are standing in the middle of a wide, summery, sunlit field. There is a
fragrance of spring in the air, a sound of summer and a feeling of eternal
Saturday afternoon. To the south is a clear, sparkling lake, and to the north
and west is the holy grove. In the wood's edge, to the east, is a stately man-
sion, shimmering softly through the colors of the rainbow. You feel as if You
could spend the rest of your life here, lying on your back and looking at the
patterns of the clouds as they gently drift across the sky.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "mansion", "description": "The mansion is a sprawling, two-story affair with three wings, where the top
of one wing serves as balcony. The walls look as marble would do, if marble
changed color slowly, continuously, through the entire spectrum. There are
large windows all over the house. There is a terrace in front of the house,
next to the low wing, which is almost completely windows.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "There is a path leading north towards the sacred glade.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8905, "room_id": "69f4d0cb93a3fe94e3bf757d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe2114abd1f21ecce"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "To the east, You can see the rainbow-colored mansion, shimmering like some-\nthing out of this world.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8919, "room_id": "69f4d0cb93a3fe94e3bf757d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc608e1936ff5ad69"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "There is a small path leading into the woods to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8907, "room_id": "69f4d0cb93a3fe94e3bf757d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbaa7dc7242b193c31"}

name: In the dense forest
description:
You walk along a small path leading through a dark forest. No sounds can be
heard and little light penetrates the canopy of trees above you. The air here
smells musty and you long for a fresh breath. You see an intersection of paths
to the west. The path you are on leads south into the darkening woods.

name: Underground pool
description: You are wading in a knee deep pool of lime-water.

name: A Small Gnome House
description:
This is a small suburban house made from quality wood.  You can see the
expert workmanship that went into making it, but it lacks creativity.

name: The Shadow Grove
description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you
from all sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange
sounds of moaning and growling come from all directions.
All exits lead into shadows, you are very confused.

name: An Oozing Bog
description:
You stand in an oozing quagmire.  A creaking beat fills the air,
accompanied by groans and soughing of the air.  Several large winged
beasts flap over you and send chilling glares your way.  You feel out
of place, and feel that the occupants of this realm will soon
have you for a feast.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "beasts", "description": "You see a large creature, possibly a demon, flapping heavily above you.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Eastward lies a horde of disgusting looking monsters.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8306, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc497ff8bbb073897", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb412c653dba7b8ca8"}

name: Mahmount Allesh Megway
description:
The traffic here is really congested due in part to the over 11 million
people driving Mo-Pads, the mobile homes which are constantly on the
move until their owners can find an apartment in one of the City-blocks.
The Megway continues north and south.

name: Traversing the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself deep within in a dark field filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is extremely disorienting, and you are having trouble
keeping your sense of direction.
All exits lead off into the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The astral field leads off into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7709, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc760d17ba8185cb1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb31ba8f09102973d"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The astral field leads off into the depths.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7747, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc760d17ba8185cb1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbeb018b5f8e2449b7"}

name: West trail around Midgaard
description:
You are on a dusty trail following the outside wall of Midgaard.
To the east the wall towers over you and to the west you see the
forest of Haon-Dor. The trail leads north and south along the wall.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you notice the path makes a turn, following the City wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3902, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc5c85e6de622612e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb897f51d2340f1f9b"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The dusty trail continues towards the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3900, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc5c85e6de622612e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba73a38951a935f03"}

name: The forest clearing
description:
You are in a clearing in the forest.  Lots of fresh stumps of varying sizes
protrude from the ground and heavy logs are stacked neatly in a big pile
supported by stakes set into the ground.  Paths lead north, east and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "log logs", "description": "Even though the logs have been chopped to shorter pieces, they are quite heavy\nas they are fresh and still filled with sap.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The small path leads north through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6011, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb4771855cde0b90b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7af1c126373f5ea1"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The small path leads east through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6009, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb4771855cde0b90b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb2d2b8bb37b9ccb0"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The small path leads west through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6007, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb4771855cde0b90b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc4cbfc0eb9b8560a"}

name: The Tomb of Frath
description:
UGH!  The sarcophagus is opened up and the mummified body lies out in the
open, ripped to pieces.  Gnawed pieces of flesh and bone are strewn here.

name: Incredibly slippery crevice.
description:
The crevice is getting more and more slippery.  You are getting
incredibly nervous and want to turn back.  To the east is the
crevice and trail you were following.  Below, you can just see the
edge of a cliff through the mist.  There is no trail leading there,
just a smooth, flat, dew-covered rock that almost resembles a
slide ...

name: White Dragon Boulevard
description:
A once majestic inn with a white marble facade lies to the south.
Unfortunately, it has fallen into disrepair and decay.  You can continue
east or west.

name: The Reception Area
description:
You are now standing in the reception of New Thalos. A huge mahogany
desk is here along with two sofas and a coffee table covered in magazines.
The plush carpeting under your feet is a nice change from the rugged paths
you are used to travelling. A chrome stairway spirals downstairs to the
tavern of the Dancing Daemon Inn, and your future adventures in New Thalos.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "1.1picture", "description": "You see a picture of Felix here, standing before the arena.\nHe seems to be doing a body count.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "The stairs lead down to the Daemon.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9500, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1cbe37b2c39c1453", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb087af69911d2e51b"}

name: Turn in road
description:
You are on a path that leads to a Hide & Tooth shop to the west, and the
path continues to the south.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The Hide & Tooth shop is seen to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6516, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbe964140c31b2ead", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd339d381e8aceef4"}

name: Cleric Academy
description: This is the most lavish of the academies being that it is for the clerics.

name: Cleric's Bar
description:
The bar is one of the finest in the land, lucky it is members only.  Fine
furniture is set all around the room.  A small sign is hanging on the wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign reads:
Free instructions provided by the waiter:

Buy  - Buy something (drinkable) from the waiter.
List - The waiter will show you all the different drinks and
specialties, and tell the price of each.", "valid": true}

name: City Entrance
description:
You stand on the outskirts of a large city - Midgaard; the capital of this
land. The road leads east into the peace and quiet - and dangers - of the
forest; and to the west it becomes the main street of the town; surrounded by
a confusion of shops, bars, and market places.

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads east and south.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}

name: Mob Factory Storage Area
description:
This is where the raw materials from which mobs are manufactured are
stored. You see sacks of sawdust, cans of pink paint, a large box
containing wigs and a bottle mysteriously labelled "solution X". Exits
are more of storage to the east and south.

name: Main Street
description:
This is a magnificent street, immaculate all over.  The streets are filled
with people rushing from building to building and a balmy zephyr blows by you.
The whole city is teeming with activity.  On one side is a beautiful house
while on the other is the entrance to a large mansion.  Sounds of people hard
at work echo within the mansion.  Near the center of town you see a large
domed building, magnificent and immense.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The main building in the city, the City Hall is there.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5332, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0da0cbb06a690587", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb81fe43cb3d39e332"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A lush, green garden path lies this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5303, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0da0cbb06a690587", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb908d2ac682ef666f"}

name: Through the Trees
description:
This part of the web intersects through the branches of some
trees.  Various leaves and other debris that the many drones
have not picked up yet lie here.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above main street.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: A Small Clearing
description:
You are inside a small clearing.  You can see that there are signs of a
living creature nearby.

name: Very dark caveway
description:
This room is so very dark that no one is quite sure whats in it, so
there's nothing really to describe except maybe the powerful sense of
evil coming from the east and the almost overcoming urge to run to the
west.

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8627, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb0ed92987657bf82", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb045d9f5409d236be"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8623, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb0ed92987657bf82", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5a763326b0e16c03"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "You see a mountain ridge against the sky.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8638, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb0ed92987657bf82", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb30ec0909aa19f7fd"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8614, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb0ed92987657bf82", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb373a281fc34a2906"}

name: In the River
description:
To continue you had to walk right in the river.  Though you walk along in
water up to your knees, you do not seem to get wet.  A bay stretches out to
the north and the river goes south.

name: The Plane of Nirvana
description:
You are traveling the Plane of Nirvana.  It has endless boundaries to the east
and west
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east, there seems to be a bend in direction of travel.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9003, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc15845fdbdcfb28e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb086f585dc0e61802"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west, the plane seems to extend forever.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9000, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc15845fdbdcfb28e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4e931fe1f33b42af"}

name: The croquet lawn
description:
You are standing on a immaculately manicured green lawn, the kind you only
get after 200 years of meticulous work. There is a winding stone path leading
from the wood's edge to the north, to the softly shimmering, rainbow-colored
mansion to the south. This place enjoys a perpetual cool, sunny summers after-
noon.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "mansion", "description": "The mansion is a sprawling, two-story affair with three wings, where the top
of one wing serves as balcony. The walls look as marble would do, if marble
changed color slowly, continuously, through the entire spectrum. There are
large windows all over the house.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north, the winding stone path leads into the holy grove.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8906, "room_id": "69f4d0cbde65a809970652a6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb775a50d4e254056e"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, the path leads straight up to the front door of the mansion.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8910, "room_id": "69f4d0cbde65a809970652a6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba7d3b68db28582df"}

name: The Great Hall Ends.
description:
You have come to the end of the great hall.  You see before you a huge
golden door, it must be at least twenty feet tall!  It has beautiful etchings
of dragons.  You see a sign on the door.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "Congratulations on making it this far!  Watch out, it gets a little\nnasty here... :) - Wench", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a great golden door.", "keyword": "door great golden", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 2299, "to_room_vnum": 2230, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb238b8d28e2a4cb7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9d783f4e34a8d838"}

name: The Satin Memorial Reading Room
description:
Half read books lie everywhere: Yeats, Tennyson, Chandler, Barrie;
a battered paperback de Laclos; a dusty leather-bound Donne.  A
damp novel perches precariously on the edge of a large bathtub.
As your eyes travel beyond the steam rising to the air toward the
rose-brambled balcony railing, you notice a well-creased printout
of a poem sitting on a the velvet cushions of a rosewood chair
that has been set so as to see the stark black mountains
from one angle, or the wine-dark sea from another.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "dusty leather bound leather-bound Donne", "description": ".       `Cruel and sudden, hast thou since
Purpled thy nail in blood of innocence?
Wherein could this flea guilty be,
Except in the drop it sucked from thee?
Yet thou trimph'st and say'st that thou
Find'st not thyself, nor me the weaker now;
'Tis true, then learn how false fears be:
Just so much honour when thou yield'st to me
Will waste as this flea's death took life from thee.'", "valid": true}

name: The dark forest path
description:
You continue on through darkness and gloom. The path below you has become a
wet quagmire. It is difficult to walk, and you make squishing sounds as you
move on. Looking east, you see a swampy path. The main path leads north and
south into darkness.

name: Damp hallway
description:
The walls of the tunnel are extremely damp here. You hear the faint
sound of running water to the south.

name: The Shadow Grove
description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you
from all sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange
sounds of moaning and growling come from all directions.
All exits lead into shadows, you are very confused.

name: A Small Gnome House
description:
This is a small suburban house made from quality wood.  You can see the
expert workmanship that went into making it, but it lacks creativity.

name: An Oozing Bog
description:
The ground here is soft and oozing.  You feel slimy water seeping into your
boots.  Better stop and check for leeches when you get out of here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "limb", "description": "The limb looks like it is attached to a trap door in the ground.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see a large tree limb that looks easily moved.", "keyword": "limb", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8305, "room_id": "69f4d0cb412c653dba7b8ca8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc497ff8bbb073897"}

name: Outside a small cabin in the forest
description:
You are outside a small cabin built entirely from heavy logs.  There is a
wooden door to the north and small paths lead west and south through the trees.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "cabin logs", "description": "It looks simple but comfortable and the slender trees make the whole place seem\npretty idyllic.  It's a cabin built from logs.  Wooden logs, not system logs.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The wooden door is quite sturdy but does not appear to be equipped with a lock.", "keyword": "door wooden", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6010, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb2d2b8bb37b9ccb0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2deda39cb62f1993"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The small path leads south through the dense forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6014, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb2d2b8bb37b9ccb0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfaef488aa1c2dd85"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The small path leads west through the light forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6008, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb2d2b8bb37b9ccb0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb4771855cde0b90b"}

name: Steep mountainside.
description:
From here, you can see forever.  Clouds, birds, the forest.
Midgaard is far, far to the west.  What a postcard perfect view!

name: Mahmount Allesh Megway
description:
The Megway continues north and south.  On the off-ramps here you see
many of the citizens of Mega-City One doing nothing.  You see of
every hundred citizens, it can be guaranteed that 87 of them will
be totally unemployed, and that a further five will not work more
than ten hours a week.  To the east there is a dark alley and to the
west is Rietzik's Shuggy Hall.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A dark alley lies to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8011, "room_id": "69f4d0cb60e6dbb4432e2455", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb4960f422b20584e"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A large plaza is in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8006, "room_id": "69f4d0cb60e6dbb4432e2455", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2632118095d48d34"}

name: Traversing the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself deep within in a dark field filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is extremely disorienting, and you are having trouble
keeping your sense of direction.
All exits lead off into the astral field.

name: Northwest corner of dusty trail.
description:
You are standing outside the northwestern corner of the city wall.
The trail leads east following the north wall and south towards the gate.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The dusty trail winds close up to the north wall of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3903, "room_id": "69f4d0cb897f51d2340f1f9b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb8be9915199ff72d"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The dusty trail leads south towards the gate.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3901, "room_id": "69f4d0cb897f51d2340f1f9b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc5c85e6de622612e"}

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: Corner of Bronze and White Dragon
description:
This is the north-east corner of the neighborhood. White Dragon
boulevard heads west and Bronze Dragon street heads south.

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: Hide & Tooth Shop
description:
You are in the Hide & Tooth shop.  Here you may buy the finest in Dwarven
weapons and armors. The path continues to the north and east.

name: The Dancing Daemon Inn
description:
A huge circling wet-bar takes up most of the east end of the Daemon. An
old mage reclines against the mirror behind the bar absentmindedly pouring
several drinks at once with his refined telekinesis. The Lokettes, a local
band, are playing their usual gig on the stage. The large booths along the
wall are filled with people drinking and having a grand time. You feel like
partying here.
The only obvious exit is to the north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bar", "description": "The bar looks slightly out of place and you can only assume the powerful\nmagic of the bartender allows it to revolve.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the entrance to the Daemon.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9500, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe5c61780a34fa8af", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb087af69911d2e51b"}

name: City street
description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going east-west. To the north
is a giant temple.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The entrance to the temple of Lloth.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5119, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1d03599dec06375e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb666ac7ece30359c4"}

name: Entrance to Cleric's Guild
description:
The entrance hall is a small modest room, reflecting the true nature of
the Clerics.  The exit leads east to the temple square.  A small entrance to
the bar is in the northern wall.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the bar, richly decorated with really stylish furniture.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3003, "room_id": "69f4d0cb06bf44a8ad5edb4f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb454bf3408303be2e"}

name: A Garden Path
description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center
of the city. Flowers grow on the sides of the path and the lush trees are
laden with fruit.  Vines and ivy snake up the sides of the temple, making this
temple truly a blend of nature and man's work of art.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The garden path continues around the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5304, "room_id": "69f4d0cb908d2ac682ef666f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7e854aa2475fc185"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "This is the main street leading to the city's entrance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5302, "room_id": "69f4d0cb908d2ac682ef666f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0da0cbb06a690587"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The garden path continues around the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5306, "room_id": "69f4d0cb908d2ac682ef666f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5e376ea94dcae7b0"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can hear music coming from within the temple.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5350, "room_id": "69f4d0cb908d2ac682ef666f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc680d534e21008f9"}

name: The Trail to Miden'nir
description:
You are in a light forest. A path leads south, but the passage to the
east is easy enough. To the west, smoke can be seen rising above the
treetops. The sprawl of Midgaard lies north of here.

{"direction": 2, "description": "This path cuts through the darkness of the Miden'nir.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3507, "room_id": "69f4d0cb09c66241aac00b33", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb95b0e86895c39c61"}

name: Foreman's Office
description:
This is the office of the mob factory foreman. The room is sparsely
furnished with a metal desk, a couple of chairs, a shelf with helmets
of various sizes and a Sports Illustrated Swimsuit calendar on the west
wall. Exits lead north to the mob factory entrance and south to the
foreman's bathroom.

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.

name: Above the Clouds
description:
You can see all of Midgaard in this ethereal web.  Many
of the larger dragons that do wish to fly seem to fly
away from the sticky strands of the web.

name: The foyer
description:
You are standing in the foyer of Dragon's mansion. The wide double door to
the croquet lawn is to the north, flanked by large windows. The walls are
panelled in oak and hung with strange paintings.  There is door in the south
wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "painting paintings", "description": "They are strange indeed, works of breathtaking precision depicting obviously
impossible motifs, like a sky filled with headless men, all dressed in some
black costume (including hats), or a lady standing, blue from the waist up, or
some pieces of plankwood that seems to be melting away like snow, or a night
sky with a dove-shaped hole of bright day sky in the middle.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Through the windows next to the door you can see the croquet lawn, bathed in\nafternoon sunlight.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8909, "room_id": "69f4d0cba7d3b68db28582df", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbde65a809970652a6"}

name: Elemental Bay
description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30 feet
below you.  Then you realize you are walking on the water itself.  Truly
magical water indeed.  Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above the mage guild.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Deep within the catacombs
description:
It stinks like a lair in here.  A rotten smell of humanoid flesh
lingers.  You stumble over what you think are corpses in the utter
darkness. You sense a evil growl from somewhere in the room. maybe
everywhere in the room. . ..

name: An Edge of the Galaxy
description:
You are on the very edge of the galaxy.  Nothing is here except that there
is a path which leads down.

name: THE Lair
description: You have entered a huge lair.  You feel that something big lives here or at least did.  The golden door lies back to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see a great golden door.", "keyword": "door golden great", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 2299, "to_room_vnum": 2229, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9d783f4e34a8d838", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb238b8d28e2a4cb7"}

name: The Plane of Nirvana
description:
You are on a western strech of the plane.  Boundaries to the east and west seem
nonexistent.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The plane seems to strech forever to the east", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9000, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf77124ae88b9fa23", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4e931fe1f33b42af"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The plane continues to the west where is appears to change direction", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9004, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf77124ae88b9fa23", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2a15632905bb9fb4"}

name: Narrow crawlway
description:
This crawlway is just big enough for a human to crawl through or a
halfling to walk through.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You smell the fragrant odor of fungus.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5019, "room_id": "69f4d0cbca3113f7999713df", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb30f2938b1682a302"}

name: A Sea Cave
description:
You are in a small cave in a cliff next to a deep green sea.  Fine
gold and pink sand blanket the floor.  Shells are scattered and strewn
about.  A blow hole in the roof of the cave allows beams of light to stream
in and illuminate the cave.  The wind blows outside the entrance, but
you are protected from the weather in your cozy cave.  The foamy surf
never seems to quite reach your feet.  Several boulders here have been
worn by time into a shape similar to a comfortable chair.

name: A turn in the path
description:
The forest path turns here towards the north and west. To the north, you see
that the ground has become dank and swampy, while the western path appears
to be entering a hilly area. You hear sounds of swamp creatures to the north
east.

name: The Shadow Grove
description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you
from all sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange
sounds of moaning and growling come from all directions.
All exits lead into shadows, you are very confused.

name: Inside the cabin
description:
You are inside a small one-room cabin made entirely from heavy logs.  It is
very sparsely furnished, containing only most basic housekeeping equipment,
such as a bed, a chair and a table.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bed", "description": "It is definitely not the most comfortable bed you have seen in your life.", "valid": true}

name: Swamp Thing's Lair
description:
A horrible swamp thing resides here.  Mutilated corpses suffuse the air with
the overwhelming stench of putrid flesh.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "corpses", "description": "You notice a note on one of the corpses reading:  'Best ye forget the temple,\nit is not for the likes of you...'", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A pool of quick sand lies to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8308, "room_id": "69f4d0cb42c02daa0462f6c5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb242e9fd1e57a74fb"}

name: A Small Gnome House
description:
This is a small suburban house made from quality wood.  You can see the
expert workmanship that went into making it, but it lacks creativity.

name: Central Plaza
description:
You are at the Central Plaza of the downtown district.  There are a couple
of juves Boingging (tm) in the air above you.  Max Jaffa Boulevard goes
east, the Megway continues north and south, and Bazza's Home for the
Terminally Sarky is to the west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Max Jaffa Boulevard goes in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8012, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2632118095d48d34", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb263e4289295d07cb"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A home for Sarky people is to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8023, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2632118095d48d34", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6c15e8a4df9ee898"}

name: Steep mountainside.
description:
From here, you can see forever.  Clouds, birds, the forest.
Midgaard is far, far to the west.  What a postcard perfect view!

name: Traversing the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself deep within in a dark field filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is extremely disorienting, and you are having trouble
keeping your sense of direction.
All exits lead off into the astral field.

name: Dusty trail along north wall.
description:
You are walking on the trail following the outside of Midgaard's
northern wall.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The dusty trail is winding along the north wall of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3904, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb8be9915199ff72d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb17c6a5a4a5e661d4"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The dusty trail turns left around the corner of the wall, behind it Haon-Dor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3902, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb8be9915199ff72d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb897f51d2340f1f9b"}

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads north and east.  A small shed is to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "It is a small black-painted shed with a wooden door.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3613, "room_id": "69f4d0cb126b9d83b1dce144", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3145111427e37a26"}

name: Path to the north of shop
description:
You are on a path to the north of the Hide & Tooth shop.  The path continues
to the north, and there is Granite Head's bakery to the west.

name: An over-grown lot
description:
A huge building was going to be built here, but they gave the
project up when violence took over the town.  Now it is just a
weed-strewn plot of land.  The lot continues east and there is a road north.

name: The Medina
description:
You stand on the Medina, on the larger open areas in New Thalos. People
walk to and fro carrying on their day to day business. The Common Square
of the people opens up to the south and the Medina continues north.

name: A Garden Path
description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center
of the city. Flowers grow on the sides of the path and the lush trees are
laden with fruit.  Vines and ivy snake up the sides of the temple, making this
temple truly a blend of nature and man's work of art.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A side street leads off to the northern half of the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5311, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7e854aa2475fc185", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb99f4950be0e8cc58"}

name: Foreman's Bathroom
description:
This is the place where the foreman makes frequent visits. The smell
here is very strong and reminds you of bovine excrement! There is a
shower to the back, and a urinal to the left. On the floor you can
see stains of a very suspicious nature. The only exit leads north to
the foreman's office.

name: Warrior's Academy
description: This looks more like a barracks than a school.

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.
