name: The hallway
description:
You are in the north end of a connecting hallway, tastefully decorated with
oak paneling and the coat-of-arms of various famous nobles hung on the walls.
The hallway leads south, and there is a door in the eastern wall.

name: Elemental Bay
description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30 feet
below you.  Then you realize you are walking on the water itself.  Truly
magical water indeed.  Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

name: The Miden'nir
description:
You are in a dark forest. To the east, mountains block passage. From
here, only the lighter forest to the west or south offer a way to travel.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The forest is darker to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3509, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6a8b464f45945001", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3de8445227f28d4f"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The forest gets lighter as you go west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3505, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6a8b464f45945001", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb09c66241aac00b33"}

name: Very dark cavern
description:
The cavern is hard to describe due to the extreme magical darkness.
Probing with a light source seems to reveal nothing but more darkness.

name: The Temple Square
description:
You are standing on the temple square.  Huge marble steps lead up to the
temple gate.  The entrance to the Clerics Guild is to the west, and the old
Grunting Boar Inn, is to the east.  Just south of here you see the market
square, the center of Midgaard.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the good old Grunting Boar Inn.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3006, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd8ae997a2d9beb57", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb1ffe7ca0dfbba1c"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see the entrance to the Clerics Guild.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3004, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd8ae997a2d9beb57", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb06bf44a8ad5edb4f"}

name: On A Cloud
description:
Rather thick in consistency.  You realize this is not
a typical cloud, but it might be the nest of an aerial creature.

name: Very Near to a Gigantic Star
description:
You are very near to a gigantic red star.  While you are still fascinated
by its beauty, the star keeps on growing ... suddenly you realize that you'd
better leave.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above poor alley.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: The End...
description:
You have reached the final lair.  It is dominated by a huge five headed
dragon.  You suddenly realize that you have SERIOUS problems...
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the top of the mountain.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 2241, "to_room_vnum": 2243, "room_id": "69f4d0cbedf711146bb0fb2a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2c2e711b36eadc77"}

name: A Change in Direction
description:
Here, the plane seems to direct you to the north.  Also, the plane continues
to the west.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The plane continues to the north with no end in sight", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9005, "room_id": "69f4d0cb086f585dc0e61802", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb832ca6fbf52c96dd"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The plane contiues to the west with no end in sight", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9001, "room_id": "69f4d0cb086f585dc0e61802", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc15845fdbdcfb28e"}

name: Large cavern
description:
You have entered a very large cavern. The rock formations would amaze
almost any dwarf.

name: The Archmage's Workroom
description:
This well-lit room is absolutely filled with clutter -- enchanting gear,
reagents, spell components, ancient tomes, scrolls, braziers, exotic incense
and countless other tools of the magical trade, all jumbled together with
seemingly no attention paid to organization.  You have no doubts that Alander
can find whatever he needs without delay, however.  A heavy oak door stands
barred to the south, to discourage idle visitors, and Alander's quarters
are east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "clutter mess", "description": "You notice Jimmy Hoffa's ring.", "valid": true}

name: The bloody intersection
description:
This is a small intersection. Paths lead east, west, and south. You are struck
by the carnage here when you enter the clearing. There appears to have been a
great battle here. Blood is everywhere and the ground is all torn up. Pieces
of beaten armour and broken blades lie all around. Examining the tracks here
lead you to believe that the dead and wounded were dragged off in two
directions, south and east.

name: The Shadow Grove
description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you
from all sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange
sounds of moaning and growling come from all directions.
All directions lead into shadows, you are very confused.

name: Pool of Quick Sand
description:
You stand by a large oozing pool of quick sand.  Luckily only a complete
klutz could not avoid it.  Dancing lights fly about you and one seems to
be taunting you towards the pool.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "lights", "description": "From the stories you have heard, you recognize them as will-o-wisps.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A dark pool lies to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8309, "room_id": "69f4d0cb242e9fd1e57a74fb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbef0086b07c0fbd81"}

name: A Small Gnome House
description:
This is a small suburban house made from quality wood.  You can see the
expert workmanship that went into making it, but it lacks creativity.

name: A small path through the light forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the forest.  The trees are tall and
slender.  Paths lead north and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The path leads north through the young trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6002, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7af1c126373f5ea1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9b60a125b551d3ad"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The path leads south through the young trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6008, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7af1c126373f5ea1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb4771855cde0b90b"}

name: Treacherous Cliff.
description:
The cliff is rocky and difficult to negotiate.  One wrong slip and
you could fall and break a leg or impale yourself or something else
nasty.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "Above you is an almost vertical cliff.  It looks dangerous but\nclimbable.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9120, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe1f6015f9755e4b3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfc2e9b50d19a4749"}

name: Corner of Ed Hilldreth Memorial Parkway and Megway
description:
Another major intersection which is being negotiated by vehicles that
are bound to minimum speed limits.  Many Slow Driving offenses are being
handed out by the Judges.  The Megway goes north and south, a Parkway
goes east, and Nu Phisog Parlour is west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Ed Hilldreth Mem. Parkwy is to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8013, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd187097bab4bffb6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbacdcd34a589bd9a0"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A City Block lies to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8024, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd187097bab4bffb6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb885af677507c1ee5"}

name: Traversing the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself deep within in a dark field filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is extremely disorienting, and you are having trouble
keeping your sense of direction.
All exits lead off into the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The astral field leads off into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7732, "room_id": "69f4d0cb03858da5cbc1690b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7567e71713f4e548"}

name: The Grand Hall of Kings
description:
You are at the western end of the Grand Hall of Kings.  There is a
door leading north and the hallway continues west.

name: The long dusty trail following the north wall.
description:
You are just outside the northern gate of Midgaard.  You can continue along
the trail to the east or west, head onwards to the plains of the north, or
enter Midgaard to the south.  You can just barely make out the buildings of
Midgaard from here, the Temple of Mota looks impressive even from this
distance.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A small path extends into the plains.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 300, "room_id": "69f4d0cb17c6a5a4a5e661d4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5a759092a9dee6ee"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The dusty trail is winding along the north wall of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3905, "room_id": "69f4d0cb17c6a5a4a5e661d4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb91679a6a601dcba2"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see the south gate of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3268, "room_id": "69f4d0cb17c6a5a4a5e661d4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0b2d97945d803202"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The dusty trail is winding along the north wall of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3903, "room_id": "69f4d0cb17c6a5a4a5e661d4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb8be9915199ff72d"}

name: North of Shops
description:
Here the path bends to the east towards the barracks. To the
south you can see the shops.

name: East end of an over-grown plot of land
description:
This was planned to be a park, but the developer was scared out
of town by the gang.  Now it is just a dusty square of land. The
park was started to the south.  The lot continues west and there
is a street to the north.

name: In a shed on the Graveyard
description:
You are in a small shed that looks as if it is used to store all sorts of
gardening equipment.  The only exit appears to be through a door to the east.

name: The Medina
description:
You are walking along a wide open expanse of road connecting the market
square to the common square. Panhandlers, beggars, and other such riff-
raff wander about hoping to catch those few who with open hearts.
The medina continues to the south and the market spreads out to the north.

name: Entrance to the Temple of Lloth
description:
The temple is the largest building in the city. Even it's doors are beyond
imagination. Inside of the temple entrance, the walls are made of gold and
adamantite.

name: A garden path
description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center
of the city. Flowers grow on the sides of the path and the lush trees are
laden with fruit.  Vines and ivy snake up the sides of the temple, making this
temple truly a blend of nature and man's work of art.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The garden path continues around the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5304, "room_id": "69f4d0cb424293a818745bc1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7e854aa2475fc185"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You can hear music coming from within the temple.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5350, "room_id": "69f4d0cb424293a818745bc1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc680d534e21008f9"}

name: Mob Factory Storage Area
description:
This is where the raw materials from which mobs are manufactured are
stored. You see sacks of sawdust, cans of pink paint, a large box
containing wigs and a bottle mysteriously labelled "solution X". Exits
are more of storage to the west and south, and an inspection room to
the east.

name: Entrance to the Grunting Boar Inn
description:
You are standing in the entrance hall of the Grunting Boar Inn.  The hall
has been wisely decorated with simple but functional furniture.  A small
staircase leads up to the defunct reception room and the bar is to the east.

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8624, "room_id": "69f4d0cb045d9f5409d236be", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb0ed92987657bf82"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8617, "room_id": "69f4d0cb045d9f5409d236be", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb28eb31350171a420"}

name: The blue room
description:
You are in the blue room, one of the guest rooms in Dragon's mansion. The
walls are (surprise!) blue, and the rest of the room is decorated in similar
shades, producing a very nice, cool effect. There is a large bed and a
matching set of sofas, easy-chairs and a coffee table. Through the venetian
blinds in front of the large east window you can see the edge of the grove.

name: Elemental Bay
description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30 feet
below you.  Then you realize you are walking on the water itself.  Truly
magical water indeed.  Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

name: A Link in the Ethereal Web
description:
This is another link in the ethereal web.  Various creatures
seem to get caught (or hypnotized) by its sticky strands.

name: Too Bright to Tell
description:
Indeed it is too bright to tell.  Because what you are witnessing is the
rare event of a Supernova, how a star explodes itself into galactic dust.
You may find yourself lucky to witness this rare event but even luckier,
you have finally got out of this galaxy as your body turns into dust.
That really HURTS!

name: The Miden'nir
description:
The forest is deep here and the wind blows through the trees and
through your hair. To the north, the forest gets lighter. However, the
southern and western paths place you even deeper in the wood.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The forest is lighter in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3505, "room_id": "69f4d0cb95b0e86895c39c61", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb09c66241aac00b33"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "There is a small path leading west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3508, "room_id": "69f4d0cb95b0e86895c39c61", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb45e3bfd2c2a2bdf7"}

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above the ground north of Midgaard.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: The holy place
description:
A glowing stone lies in the center of the clearing.  You recognize it as
the stone of the Excalibur.  The strange humming glowing makes it
difficult to see if the Excalibur is there or not. Might want to take a
closer look if possible.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "a glowing forcefield with a small circular hole in it.", "keyword": "glow glowing field forcefield door", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 2001, "to_room_vnum": 2028, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2baca6a0a758ac8c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5659e0dec825d257"}

name: Stairwell
description:
This is an old decrepit stairwell that leads to the wine cellar.  It looks
like it hasn't been used for decades.  Well, at least not by anything living.

name: A Change in Direction
description: Here, the plane goes to the north and bends to the east
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The vast plane seems to have no end to the north", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9006, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2a15632905bb9fb4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb47f28004b2d27e94"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "To the east, the plane has no visible end", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9002, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2a15632905bb9fb4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf77124ae88b9fa23"}

name: Fungus patch
description:
As you walk through the fungus patch, you are shot at by many millions of
spores. You can hardly breathe.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The fragrant smell of fungus spores continues to the east", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5020, "room_id": "69f4d0cb30f2938b1682a302", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4e960a8365d5a00b"}

name: Office
description:
The first thing you notice about this office is the floor; it
is a black & white checkerboard pattern, with 8 squares to a side.  The
south wall is a HUGE picture window that produces a magnificent view of
the land.  In front of the window is a large desk.  Completely covering
the east wall is a bookshelf, that is crammed full.  In the northwest
corner, you notice a statue.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bookshelf", "description": "This is the most amazing collection of chess books you have ever seen.\nEverything from Damiano's manuscripts, to a complete collection of the\nEncyclopedia of Chess Openings, to the latest Imformants are all here.", "valid": true}

name: The rocky path
description:
The path here winds among the low rocky hills. The long trek up and down the
hills begins to tire you greatly. Looking east, you see a small clearing. More
hills are to the north of here.

name: A small clearing
description:
You are in a small clearing in the shadow grove. There is charred grass
underfoot, and the signs of fire here and there. It is almost as if the
plant life shuns this spot. The shadowy mist hovers all around, obscuring
your view into the grove.
A small path leads north to some shadowy structure. All other exits are
shrouded in shadowy mist.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can barely make out some sort of building to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1312, "room_id": "69f4d0cb55b697ea259afebb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2071fab17a22e7e9"}

name: Mahmount Allesh Megway
description:
As you travel the Megway you notice many citizens participating in their
favorite hobbies such as spot welding and metalwork, scratch building
fashion Kneepads, giving blood, or just looking out the window.  The
Megway continues north and south.

name: A Dark Pool.
description:
You stand beside a large dark pond.  The water boils not with heat, but with
motion, as if it is alive.  A creaking beat pulses through the air, leaving
you with a cold sweat and fear in your heart.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "pond", "description": "It looks ALIVE ...", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A large pool of quicksand lies to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8308, "room_id": "69f4d0cbef0086b07c0fbd81", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb242e9fd1e57a74fb"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see a cloud of darkness to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8311, "room_id": "69f4d0cbef0086b07c0fbd81", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb79a9f2bee039104e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A hill rises out of the swamp to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8304, "room_id": "69f4d0cbef0086b07c0fbd81", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbf10cc035675abf6"}

name: A Gnome Shop
description:
You are in one of the several shops of this fine town.  The wares look fine,
but unfortunately the gnomes don't do business with outsiders.

name: An intersection in the dense forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest.  The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest floor in an unreal twilight illumination.  Paths
lead north, east and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The small path leads north through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6007, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0e4741c433f28a54", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc4cbfc0eb9b8560a"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The small path leads east through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6013, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0e4741c433f28a54", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf02977655b8b01f4"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The small path leads south through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6021, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0e4741c433f28a54", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb819fa27db75209df"}

name: Cliff Face.
description:
You are more than a little nervous climbing on this almost vertical
cliff face.  You miraculously find places to grab onto and little
ledges to rest on.  You see a small cave here.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "A large ledge that looks pretty safe.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9122, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfc2e9b50d19a4749", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb74ee7896da29d612"}

You find yourself deep within in a dark field filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is extremely disorienting, and you are having trouble
keeping your sense of direction.
All exits lead off into the astral field.

name: The Shrine of Jubal
description:
This was once beautiful.  Now the huge tapestries have been torn down and the
carpeting pulled up ... the paintings on the ceiling are unreadable and the
altar is crumbled.

name: Path by Hospital
description:
Here the path passes by the Hospital to the north.  It continues
to the east to the barracks, and to the west.

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads south and west.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}

name: Dusty trail along north wall.
description:
You are walking on the trail following the outside of Midgaard's
northern wall.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The dusty trail turns right around the corner of the wall.\nYou notice some mountains in the distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3906, "room_id": "69f4d0cb91679a6a601dcba2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd5cdcafb9ee67af3"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The dusty trail is winding along the north wall of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3904, "room_id": "69f4d0cb91679a6a601dcba2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb17c6a5a4a5e661d4"}

name: Armory
description:
Well actually, this is what USED to be the armory.  The equipment has
all been stolen or broken beyond repair. The back wall of the
building has been bashed down, allowing you to go south.  White
Dragon Boulevard is north.

name: The Southern Market Square
description:
The large square of markets fills your vision. Strange sights and sounds,
those known only to the New Thalos market, barrage your senses. The only
hope of making any sense of what's going on here is to wander around. The
Market continues north, west, and east, with the Medina trailing off south.

name: Mage's Academy
description:
The mages academy is fairly well decorated see that the drow prefer magic
over physical power greatly.

name: A Garden Path
description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center
of the city. Flowers grow on the sides of the path and the lush trees are
laden with fruit.  Vines and ivy snake up the sides of the temple, making this
temple truly a blend of nature and man's work of art.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The garden path continues around the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5303, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5e376ea94dcae7b0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb908d2ac682ef666f"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A small side street leads to the southern half of the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5312, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5e376ea94dcae7b0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb5a4b0ed5dd8912e"}

name: Mob Factory Storage Area
description:
This is where the raw materials from which mobs are manufactured are
stored. You see sacks of sawdust, cans of pink paint, a large box
containing wigs and a bottle mysteriously labelled "solution X". Exits
are more of storage to the west and north, an inspection room to the
east and the entrance hallway to the south.

name: The Grunting Boar
description:
You are standing in the bar.  The bar is set against the northern wall, old
archaic writing, carvings and symbols cover its top.  A fireplace is built into
the western wall, and through the southeastern windows you can see the temple
square.  This place makes you feel like home.
A small sign with big letters is fastened to the bar.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign reads:
Free instructions provided by the Grunting Boar Inn.

Buy  - Buy something (drinkable) from the bartender.
List - The bartender will show you all the different drinks and
specialties, and tell the price of each.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the exit to the entrance hall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3006, "room_id": "69f4d0cb85157135136097f0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb1ffe7ca0dfbba1c"}

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8625, "room_id": "69f4d0cb36ef367b894ee3d3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1499d36561018196"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8618, "room_id": "69f4d0cb36ef367b894ee3d3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8237ab7047b7c86d"}

name: The hallway
description:
You are standing in the south end of the hallway. There are doors in the
elegant oak-panelled walls to the south, east and west. Many different
coat-of-arms adorn the walls here.

name: Elemental Bay
description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30 feet
below you.  Then you realize you are walking on the water itself.  Truly
magical water indeed.  Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

name: The Star Cluster
description:
You are inside the home of the stars.  All you can see around you are stars
and nothing else.  You eyes become pretty hurt as you look at them.

name: On a Small Path
description:
A path is here, leading east and south through the dark woods of
Miden'nir. Mountains slash the scenery to the west of here.

name: The Tenuous Strand
description:
Very windy here since it goes up into the sky somewhat.
Still, it's safe enough to move around.

name: Wine cellar
description:
This is the old wine cellar of the Dragon Tower.  The shelves are empty.
Nothing living has been in here for a long time.  You see a tunnel leading
off to the east and boy does it smell bad.  Kinda of like rotting flesh.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above bakery and cleric guild.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Misty passageway
description:
Warm mist swirl about you making you feel threatened as well as
protected at the same time.  The swirling mist makes it tough to tell
directions quite clearly, but you seem to be able to go north or south.
The mist gets denser to the south.

name: Arena of Judgement
description:
The scene lain before you is one that gives you the feeling of being placed
under a higher authority.  The jury is out.  A statue of Pontius Pilate is
in the aft of the Arena.  Staring balefully, the statue faces a distant
hillside where many aged crosses still stand.  The Arena is set in a wide
pit-like field of trampled bloodstained grass, and is guarded by high walls
of veinous marble.  A bloodstone seat awaits the true paragon of Romanity.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "statue", "description": "A statue of Pontius Pilate is here.  On it's face is the expression of some\nage old contemplation.  Standing at the statues bronzy feet is a Blood red\nshield that glimmers like a pool of blood.", "valid": true}

name: A North-South direction of the plane
description: The plane continues to the north and south
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north, the plane stretches as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9012, "room_id": "69f4d0cb832ca6fbf52c96dd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4e4ed0fbedace8f3"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, the plane stretches as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9003, "room_id": "69f4d0cb832ca6fbf52c96dd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb086f585dc0e61802"}

name: Fungus path
description:
As you walk along the path, millions of spores are shot at you. You can
hardly breathe.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A giant mushroom temple stands to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5021, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4e960a8365d5a00b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb49c92fd3b1ac1c71"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The fragrant smell of spores continues to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5019, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4e960a8365d5a00b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb30f2938b1682a302"}

name: The rocky path
description:
The path here is very rocky and treacherous. The travelling is rough and you
slip and fall often. Looking south, you see that the path continues into the
hills. Smoother ground is to the east, but the path seems to lead into a dark
forest in that direction.

name: Entrance to the High Tower
description:
You have reached the entrance to the high tower of sorcery. The
tower looms above you at an incredible height. It seems to disappear
into the storm clouds above.
A diamond gate is to the north, guarded by a huge golem. The trail
back south has disappeared behind you.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The diamond gate looks incredibly strong.", "keyword": "gate diamond", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1313, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2071fab17a22e7e9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb758751032fd2b080"}

name: Mahmount Allesh Megway
description:
The Megway ends here.  To the west is Ziggi Piggi's Home for the
Semi-Stiff, to the east and south are construction areas, and the
Megway goes north.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "Ziggi Piggi's Home the Semi-Stiff is ahead.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8025, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7c06bfb3ff02dcbc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4dfe2212d7886278"}

name: Gloomy Path Through the Marsh.
description:
To the north lies a hill, shrouded in dark clouds, and to the south lies
a huge patch of vegetation.  You sense an evil presence and notice
a beast flying overhead to the south east, towards what looks to be a
huge fortress, half buried in the marsh.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "clouds", "description": "The clouds look dark and foreboding.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north a hill protrudes from the marshes.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8304, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdf97d5856cf2df5e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbf10cc035675abf6"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south a huge mass of vegetation seems to quiver with life.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8312, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdf97d5856cf2df5e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5bacba9d83bdafef"}

name: A Gnome Shop
description:
You are in one of the several shops of this fine town.  The wares look fine,
but unfortunately the gnomes don't do business with outsiders.

name: The Tomb of Jubal
description:
The smell coming off of the opened sarcophagus is nauseating.  The floor is
slightly crumpled and walls are raked ... but the worst part is the mummy ...
Jubal the Benevolent is missing his head!

name: Dank, dark, smelly hole.
description:
This hole must have been used as a lair or nest.  There are
feathers and bones everywhere and the floor is covered with
something disgusting.

name: A small path in the dense forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest.  The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination.  The path
continues east and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The small path leads east through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6014, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf02977655b8b01f4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfaef488aa1c2dd85"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The small path leads west through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6012, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf02977655b8b01f4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0e4741c433f28a54"}

name: Path next to barracks
description: Here the path continues west, and east to the barracks.

name: Lost in the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself in in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is incredibly disorienting, and you are having trouble
keeping your senses straight.
All exits lead off into the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The astral field leads off into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7727, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7f7ddcdfb237ab82", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe93b9dbddddb2a61"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The astral field leads off into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7718, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7f7ddcdfb237ab82", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8879d90b264e9cf0"}

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: The Center of Market Square
description:
You are standing on the Center of Market Square, the famous square of
New Thalos. A large, peculiar looking statue is standing in the middle
of the square. The square extends in every direction.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "statue", "description": "Before you is a statue of the Mighty Beholder!\nA great beast with multiple eyes and wicked... wicked... um.... eyes...\nThe Mighty Beholder is in Excellent condition.", "valid": true}

name: Northeast corner of dusty trail.
description:
You are standing outside the northeastern corner of the city wall.
The trail leads west following the north wall and south towards the gate.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The dusty trail leads south towards the gate.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3907, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd5cdcafb9ee67af3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5769d18795e785e3"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The dusty trail winds close up to the north wall of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3905, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd5cdcafb9ee67af3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb91679a6a601dcba2"}

name: Entrance Hallway to Mob Factory
description:
You are standing in the entrance hallway of the mob factory. The sound
of machinery gets louder now, and you can hear people shouting in the
distance. Every once in a while you get creepy feeling that a pair of
eyes is observing you...... Exits are north to the storage area, east
to the entrance hallway, south to the cafeteria and west to the mob
factory entrance.

name: A Bend in the Way
description:
Ice Dragon Way bends east and south from here.  You notice a lot of
blood dried into the dirt here.

name: City street
description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going eastward. To the north is
a building.

name: The Defunct Reception
description:
You are standing in a dusty, defunct reception.  The staircase leads
down to the entrance hall.

name: The market place
description:
You stand in the middle of a large square lined on each side with
baskets, carts, and stands of all shapes and sizes.  The little shops are
filled with goods sold to the demanding public.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A small table is here, laden with fine jewelery and gems sold by the jeweler.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5325, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf534c05d6879a2b4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb86ca20499bf3b0ab"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Fruits and vegetables are piled on boxes waiting to be sold and eaten.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5320, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf534c05d6879a2b4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6b5facbff922340c"}

name: Road to Newfane
description:
You are on a gently curving north-south road.  On your east side a youthful
river sparkles blue and rushes in the sunlight.  On the west, green leaves and
green ferns burst against the rich brown earth.  You feel the heat of your
healthy muscles as you travel swiftly down the well-paved road.
You may recall now if you like.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8611, "room_id": "69f4d0cb61984deca3157c48", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb51c274d07414ced9"}

name: The red room
description:
You are in the red room, one of the guest rooms in Dragon's mansion. The
walls are wallpapered a deep warm red, and dark mahogany panelling nicely com-
plements them. There is a large, warm waterbed and a sofa group in dark wood
with leather upholstery, including a coffee table. Heavy brown curtains are
pulled away from the wide windows, to reveal a nice view towards the grove.

name: The Miden'nir
description:
The trees of Miden'nir are lush and green, hiding the evil that lurks
in these woods. The trees become too thick to the west, but you may go
north, south or travel toward the mountains that lie east of here.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The trees lighten up a bit this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3506, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3de8445227f28d4f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6a8b464f45945001"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Huge grey mountains lie in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3512, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3de8445227f28d4f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe974ed6ff8d3c6d7"}

name: Another Edge of the Galaxy
description: This is another uninhabited place.  Exits lie north, east and south.

name: Elemental Bay
description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30 feet
below you.  Then you realize you are walking on the water itself.  Truly
magical water indeed.  Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

name: Intersection of caverns
description:
Caverns head north, south and east from this peculiar spot. Medium
sized caverns from the east and the north join to form a huge cavern
heading south.  The walls of the cavern are made of a bizarre mixture
of many shiny crystals.

name: The Elder Wormkin's Room
description:
A more mature wormkin it seems resides here.  Various tomes of
arcane lore clutter the area, along with shards of armor and weaponry.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above main street.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Tunnel
description:
This tunnel seems to stretch for miles.  You try to distinguish the end but
your eyes soon tire from the strain.  The smell here has increased two fold.
The tunnel continues to go to the east.  The wine cellar lies back to the
west.

name: The Realm of the Dead
description:
You are standing on an immense, grey stone floor that stretches as far as you
can see in all directions.  Rough winds plunging from the dark, starless sky
tear savagely at your fragile body.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "floor", "description": "The stone floor is the same shade of grey as the sky and is completely plain\nand unscratched.  It is probably too hard for anything to leave as much as a\nscratch on it.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The hard floor seems to go on forever.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1212, "room_id": "69f4d0cb50b1408accabac68", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb50b1408accabac68"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The hard floor seems to go on forever.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1212, "room_id": "69f4d0cb50b1408accabac68", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb50b1408accabac68"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The hard floor seems to go on forever.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1212, "room_id": "69f4d0cb50b1408accabac68", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb50b1408accabac68"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The hard floor seems to go on forever.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1212, "room_id": "69f4d0cb50b1408accabac68", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb50b1408accabac68"}

name: A North-South stretch of the plane
description: The plane continues to the north and the south
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north, the plane stretches as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9013, "room_id": "69f4d0cb47f28004b2d27e94", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf7c8a46073f5f950"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, the plane stretches as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9004, "room_id": "69f4d0cb47f28004b2d27e94", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2a15632905bb9fb4"}

name: Fungus temple
description:
You find yourself standing inside of a giant mushroom. The inside
is decorated in the fashion of a temple.

name: Inside the High Tower of Sorcerery
description:
You are inside the high tower of sorcery. The sight is truly amazing.
From here, it is obvious that somehow, the tower is much larger on the
inside than it is on the outside. Young mages walk about, completely
oblivious to your presence.
Exits lead north to the common room, west to the dinning room, east to
a plain hallway and back south through the gate.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The common room looks quite busy and noisy.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1314, "room_id": "69f4d0cb758751032fd2b080", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9d5378601de51bad"}

name: Junket Way
description: Junket Way a small Skedway continues east and west.

name: Up the rocky hillside
description:
You are climbing on a rocky hillside. As you scramble about, loose rocks and
small boulders bounce and fall down below you. Looking to the east and west,
you see more stable ground. The hillside itself goes on higher to the south
and it drops away to the north.

name: Cloud of Darkness.
description:
As you travel through this cloud of darkness, a fear such as you have never
known before assails you.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A dark pool lies to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8309, "room_id": "69f4d0cb79a9f2bee039104e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbef0086b07c0fbd81"}

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: A Gnome Shop
description:
You are in one of the several shops of this fine town.  The wares look fine,
but unfortunately the gnomes don't do business with outsiders.

name: Large, sturdy ledge.
description:
You are on a ledge above a steep cliff face.  You can climb down
if you want, but be careful!  After viewing the scenery, you notice
two small caves here, one north and one west.

name: Entrance to barracks
description:
Here there is an entrance to the barracks to the south, and
the path continues to the west.

name: An intersection in the dense forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest.  The forest gradually
lightens to the north.  Paths lead north, east and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The path leads north to a lighter part of the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6009, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfaef488aa1c2dd85", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb2d2b8bb37b9ccb0"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The small path leads east through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6015, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfaef488aa1c2dd85", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4bf91d79ecb96a54"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The small path leads west through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6013, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfaef488aa1c2dd85", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf02977655b8b01f4"}

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads north and south.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}

name: East trail around Midgaard
description:
You are on a dusty trail following the outside wall of Midgaard.
To the west the wall towers over you and far to the east you see
some mountains. The trail leads north and south along the wall.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you notice the path makes a turn, following the City wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3906, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5769d18795e785e3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd5cdcafb9ee67af3"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The dusty trail continues towards the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3908, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5769d18795e785e3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba38ce67f3924cfcd"}

name: Lost in the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself in in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is incredibly disorienting, and you are having trouble
keeping your senses straight.
All exits lead off into the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The astral field leads off into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7728, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5fe0480d49c1099c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc760d17ba8185cb1"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The astral field leads off into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7725, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5fe0480d49c1099c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb37c6e94ab91da8b6"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The astral field leads off into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7731, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5fe0480d49c1099c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb03858da5cbc1690b"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "The astral field leads off into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7722, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5fe0480d49c1099c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2579408424ebbca7"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The astral field leads off into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7719, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5fe0480d49c1099c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb25717fbee49aecb1"}

name: Mob Factory Cafeteria
description:
You find that you have entered the cafeteria of the mob factory. There
are many workers eating at the numerous tables placed around the room.
The food doesn't look too appetising, but the factory workers don't
seem to care. There are many places where food and drink have been
spilled on the ground. Exits are north to the entrance hallway and
south to the mob factory cafeteria.

name: The Southeastern Market Square
description:
In this corner of the market some of the largest warriors in the land
tower over you. It's easy to understand why they hangout here once you
notice the weapon shop and the armory close by. Perhaps you might stop
in and take a look at the wares these shops have to offer.

name: Ice Dragon Bend
description:
Ice Dragon Way bends to the north and west here.  There are footprints
here.  They seem to indicate a large struggle took place here
recently.  What used to be the town Magic shop is to the east.

name: Slave Chamber
description:
The room is in shambles. Straw is strewn all about the room as beds for the
unfortunate creatures who have fallen prey to drow imperialism.

name: The market place
description:
You stand in the middle of a large square lined on each side with
baskets, carts, and stands of all shapes and sizes.  The little shops are
filled with goods sold to the demanding public.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Beautiful carpets and enormous bales of silk are being stared with awe by\nthe citizens.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5322, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7f5dbed65513e5f7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf2124acb1cd72999"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The center of the market lies this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5307, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7f5dbed65513e5f7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf534c05d6879a2b4"}

{"direction": 2, "description": ">From the great smell, the meat and poultry stand must be south!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5317, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7f5dbed65513e5f7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb58a494f0aadf3872"}

name: The Bakery
description:
You are standing inside the small bakery.  A sweet scent of Danish and
fine bread fills the room.  The bread and Danish are arranged in fine order
on the shelves, and seem to be of the finest quality.
A small sign is on the counter.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "danish pastry", "description": "You see that this is truly delicious pastry.  Must be made by a Dane from
Denmark (which surely is not the capital of Sweden!).  Former ruler of
Scandinavia, England, Northern Germany, Northern France, Russia, Greenland,
Iceland, Estonia etc. etc.
The sight of those large, wholesome chokoladeboller makes your mouth water
and your soul sing.", "valid": true}

name: Newfane Village Square
description:
You are on the lawn of the village square of Newfane, resting against an oak
after your vigorous journey.  The late spring breeze feels warm and sensuous
on your body.  An Ale is in progress: you spy more than a dozen fiddlers and
hundreds of Morris Dancers dressed in white cotton and wearing colorful hats
and bells.

name: The kitchen
description:
You are standing in the middle of Dragon's kitchen. Contrary to popular
belief, He *doesn't* eat virgins, which is amply demonstrated by the large
variety of foodstuffs found here on the shelves. There are numerous cans of
tomatoes, peas, corn etc., vines of garlic, a *Huge* array of small spice jars
along several shelves and a large combo refrigerator/freezer. A big oven and
stove is lurking in a corner. There is some proof here that Dragon is a less
than meticulous housekeeper... There are doors to the north and west.

name: A Crossroads
description:
Here footworn paths meet leading north, south and east. The trees seem to
be closing in on you at this point, and you can barely see the sky
through the thick branches above your head.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Trees as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3507, "room_id": "69f4d0cb063ce3a939a4d95e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb95b0e86895c39c61"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "There is an especially dark part of the forest this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3514, "room_id": "69f4d0cb063ce3a939a4d95e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2c6a527b3256719d"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "There is an especially dark section of forest this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3516, "room_id": "69f4d0cb063ce3a939a4d95e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe947b4d3315b6d49"}

name: Corner of the Galaxy
description:
You wonder why the galaxy is limited.  All you have done in Astronomy
courses now prove worthless.  Well who told you to take one at the start?

name: Elemental Bay
description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30 feet
below you.  Then you realize you are walking on the water itself.  Truly
magical water indeed.  Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

name: Entrance to the burial grounds
description:
You have entered what appears to be a burial ground of sorts. The
templars buried their dead here.  Chills go down your spine as you feel
something watching you.  You hear the random groan of a ghost, the howl
of a wraith, and the dry clanking of bones.

name: Another Tree Limb
description:
Once again the web crosses another tree limb.  To the side you
see the possible entrance to another creatures lair.

name: A cave opening
description:
You stand at the opening of a giant cave.  There are many bones strewn across
the room.  Some human, some indistinguishable.  It smells very bad in here.
You can hear movement in the cave to the north.  The tunnel goes back to the
south.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 40 meters above the armoury.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: In the Tower of Nirvana
description:
Entering the tower, there seems to be enough light to see by, but no source is
visible.  The hall continues to the east, while a door lies to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A great door lies to the west", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9013, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe8a2d05e7dc06676", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf7c8a46073f5f950"}

name: Common Room
description:
You are in the common room. There are many apprentice warlocks here
talking and resting, playing games, comparing notes. Obviously they
are taking a break from their rigorous studies. There are benches,
tables and a small water fountain here, otherwise the room is quite
unremarkable.
Exits lead off in all directions.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The mages bar can be seen to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1318, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9d5378601de51bad", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5b3a60e3ba61b3cb"}

name: Sloping passage
description: You follow a path sloping down from the fungus temple.

name: Asgard
description:
You stand on a huge expanse of glass.  Below you are clouds and the
pains of mortality.  As you stand in Asgard, home of the bravest of the
brave, you are frozen in awe of the power held within these walls.  A
huge mansion lies to the east beyond a set of magnificent golden doors.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The chat room is to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1200, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5a77e50d443d4d51", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb34a2eb6eeb7688fd"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The golden doors of Valhalla are to the east", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1216, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5a77e50d443d4d51", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba1c1d69ba9211c5b"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The center of the universe is to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1202, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5a77e50d443d4d51", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb416ef0b66a335dc8"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The Rainbow Bridge is below you.  You can barely see it through the clouds.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1215, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5a77e50d443d4d51", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1d89d233d56bd8ae"}

name: Davies Alley
description:
You are in a very dark and seedy alley.  This is just the right place for
a bite fight.  Bite fighting is an illegal activity where both combatants
can only use their sharpened teeth as weapons.

name: The sparse foothills
description:
You are in foothills that are sparsely covered by scraggly bushes and weather
beaten trees. There are little signs of life here. Only bare rock and dry dirt
can be seen. Looking east, you see a small pass that will allow you to leave
the foothills. The foothills themselves extend to the south.

name: Near Vegetation from Hell.
description:
You stand near some of the strangest plant life you have ever seen, a mixture
of tumescent vegetables, evil-smelling fruit trees, and malignant ferns.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "plant plants", "description": "They look rather violent, and snap at you when you come near.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north is a gloomy path through the marsh.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8310, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5bacba9d83bdafef", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdf97d5856cf2df5e"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Eastward is a large, black stone monolith.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8313, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5bacba9d83bdafef", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb851a7e505644cf6a"}

name: Path by a Stream
description:
You are on a small path leading north and west, that is surrounded on the
other two sides by a small stream.  The water looks mighty cold.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "stream", "description": "The stream is pretty small, but it looks too cold to swim.", "valid": true}

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: Absolutely disgusting lair.
description:
The stench in here is quite foul.  There are feathers, bones and
rotting carcasses everywhere.  This place is absolutely gross and
you have to strain yourself not to lose your lunch.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Your only hope to keep your lunch down is to head this way...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9122, "room_id": "69f4d0cb61dd4c42f9334d28", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb74ee7896da29d612"}

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: A small path in the dense forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest.  The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination.  The path
continues south and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The small path leads south through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6016, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4bf91d79ecb96a54", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbaaf46bd73ab91af2"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The small path leads west through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6014, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4bf91d79ecb96a54", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfaef488aa1c2dd85"}

name: Guard House
description:
You are in the guard house to the west of the entrance
to the castle.  There are nude posters covering the walls.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "poster", "description": "There is a wall poster of a nude Minne Pearl.", "valid": true}

name: East trail around Midgaard
description:
You are on a dusty trail following the outside wall of Midgaard.
To the west the wall towers over you and far to the east you see
some mountains. The trail leads north and south along the wall.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The dusty trail winds north closely to the wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3907, "room_id": "69f4d0cba38ce67f3924cfcd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5769d18795e785e3"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The dusty trail leads to outside the east gate of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3053, "room_id": "69f4d0cba38ce67f3924cfcd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6aa2f8999708dda0"}

name: Lost in the Astral Plane
description:
You find yourself in in a field of blackness, filled with tiny tendrils
of silvery light and insubstantial shining motes of dust.  The weightlessness
of this environment is incredibly disorienting, and you are having trouble
keeping your senses straight.
All exits lead off into the astral field.

{"direction": 5, "description": "The astral field leads off into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7720, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc55352ce25f259f3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba24bfd753d7f0247"}

name: Mob Factory Cafeteria
description:
You find that you have entered the cafeteria of the mob factory. There
are many workers eating at the numerous tables placed around the room.
The food doesn't look too appetising, but the factory workers don't
seem to care. There are many places where food and drink have been
spilled on the ground. The only exit is north to the mob factory
cafeteria.

name: The Southwestern Market Square
description:
This area of the market seems relatively quiet, save the high-pitched
banter of the shopkeeps attempting to lure you into their stores.  South
you see the bread stand and west is the entrance to the general store.
The market's sprawl continues east and north of here.

name: The remains of the magic shop
description:
The wizard was tough but he couldn't take on 50 of them at once.  So he
died and they took all his stuff and used it on their fellowmen.
The front door leads west back out to the street.  There is a back
door leading to another street to the east.

name: City street
description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street leading west and south. To the
north is a relatively small house.

name: A Side Street
description:
This small side street leads east and west into back alleys while
to the south you see a beautifully designed temple. Shrieks of little
children playing games in the distance catch your attention.

name: The General Store
description:
You are inside the general store.  All sorts of items are stacked on shelves
behind the counter, safely out of your reach.
A small note hangs on the wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "note", "description": "The note reads:

List  - Show which various items are in the store.
Buy   - Buy an item.
Value - The shopkeeper will (free of charge) tell how much he will
pay for your item.
Sell  - Sell an item.", "valid": true}

name: A Large Dance Hall
description:
You are inside a large dance hall with a very polished, very slippery wooden
floor.  You see three long lines of dancers, alternating men and women, in
some sort of progressive country dance.  Two fiddlers, a flautist, and a
harpsichord player provide the music.  You hear scattered screams of joy
from the dancers.
You may recall now if you like.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "dancer dancers", "description": "The dancers have been here all night and intend to dance until dawn.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8615, "room_id": "69f4d0cbef6dc05800c5ce4b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe53ef29bac045c0c"}

name: The ballroom
description:
You are standing in the middle of a vast palisander floor. This is where
Dragon entertains large number of guests, but the cloth-covered chairs
standing forlornly in a corner suggests that this does not happen often.
There are doors in the south and east walls, while to the west there is a
short corridor to the greenhouse.

name: Lost in Space
description:
You are now lost in space.  Compasses don't work here, sorry.  What's more
you can sense darkness engulfing you.  You'd better get out quick.

name: The Trail
description:
You are on a north-south trail through the woods. To the west, impassable
mountains glare at you, and the thick woods and undergrowth prevent any
movement westward.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, the path re-enters the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3515, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5989612f33e06894", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9fb8b8ca9707afed"}

name: The burial grounds
description:
Random tombs to unknown warriors were lain in rows as far as the eye
can see.  To your horror many of the graves are empty and desecrated.
A gap in the rows of tombs leads south and there are more graves to the
east and west.

name: Water Chamber
description:
This chamber was magically created here on the floor of the bay.  It looks
like it's been here for a long, long time.  Though you are 'under water' there
is no difficulty breathing normally, and oddly you do not feel the pressure of
the water above you.

name: The Bird Spider's Lair
description:
This is a big game hunter among most spiders.  Crush jewels
and other weapons suggest the inhabitant must have powerful jaws.
Beware!

name: The Hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway, it seems rather unremarkable.
The hallway continues east and back west.

name: The End of the tunnel
description:
You have finally come to the end of the tunnel.  Back to the west lies
the miles of tunnels you have walked through.  You see the faint outline of
a trapdoor above you.  A bridge over an underground river lies to the south.

name: A hallway in the Tower of Nirvana
description:
You are in a east-west hallway in the tower.  to the west, the hall continues
and a door lies to the east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A great door lies to the east", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9012, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5d08b4b3aee6af4f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4e4ed0fbedace8f3"}

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above poor alley.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: The Room of Lost Souls
description:
This is the room full of souls that never made it to Asgard.  They are
trapped here eternally, left to wander about in misery.  They were infidels
and cowards.  Their cries of misery send a shiver down your spine.

name: Sloping passage
description: You are on a path that gently slopes up from the underground pool.

name: Standing on level ground
description:
You are standing at the edge of a steep set of foothills. Looking down, you
see what appears to be a marshy, dark forest. It reeks of death and decay.
Even here, you catch its scent on the winds. From here, you can travel south
deeper into the foothills or to the west where a small pass will allow you to
climb down.

name: By the Monolith.
description:
You are standing near a monolith which protrudes some 20 feet from the
marsh into the air.  Its black obsidian surface shines darkly in the
strange, almost unearthly light that enters through the clouds above.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "monolith", "description": "This huge monolith resembles nothing you have ever seen before.\nYou have a strong feeling not to go within.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north is a cloud of darkest evil.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8311, "room_id": "69f4d0cb851a7e505644cf6a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb79a9f2bee039104e"}

name: Max Jaffa Boulevard
description: Max Jaffa Boulevard continues east and west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A large plaza is to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8006, "room_id": "69f4d0cb263e4289295d07cb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2632118095d48d34"}

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: Absolutely disgusting lair.
description:
The stench in here is quite foul.  There are feathers, bones and
rotting carcasses everywhere.  This place is absolutely gross and
you have to strain yourself not to lose your lunch.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "Your only hope to keep your lunch down is to head this way...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9122, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfd99a5d60837426b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb74ee7896da29d612"}

name: Path by a Stream
description:
You are on a small east-west path.  The path shows new grass, as if it
has stopped being used sometime in the recent past.  A river is to the south,
and a small hut is to the west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "stream", "description": "The stream is pretty small, but it looks too cold to swim.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see a small hut that is starting to fall apart.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1519, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfbd029333ec39e4f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1b1db2123fb89dc6"}

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads north and east.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The gravel path continues eastwards towards a building of some sort.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3604, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2ff988d9410383b3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba434c1d9c76e9c65"}

name: A small path in the dense forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest.  The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination.  The path
continues north and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The small path leads north through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6015, "room_id": "69f4d0cbaaf46bd73ab91af2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4bf91d79ecb96a54"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The small path leads south through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6017, "room_id": "69f4d0cbaaf46bd73ab91af2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5bddf2a44f8fea55"}

name: First Barrack room
description:
Here is the first of two main rooms of barracks.  The
barracks continue to the south, and you can leave the room
to the north.

name: Walking the Silvery Strand
description:
You are standing atop a silvery strand of light that twists and turns
through the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The strand of light twists and turns out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7737, "room_id": "69f4d0cb19c91f4dc9ccce8c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6a583a154c38b579"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "You see the infinite expanse of the astral field.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7718, "room_id": "69f4d0cb19c91f4dc9ccce8c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8879d90b264e9cf0"}

name: Mob Factory Inspection Room
description:
You have entered the mob factory inspections room. This is where the
mobs manufactured on the assembly lines are inspected for defects. A
whole team of inspectors from the Midgaard Inspections Bureau is
standing around, trying to look busy. Exits are south to the mob
factory inspection room, east to the primary assembly line and west to
the storage area.

name: The hills
description:
You are on a small bewildered path winding its way between the hills in
lack of better things to do. To the south you have a splendid view over the
flat, vast, desolate plains. To the north the hills grow steadily darker and
foreboding. This is the cause of no sunset, it is rather the power of evil
penetrating these quiet hills. Glancing around you notice only a single bird.
The mountains of the dwarven kingdom rise up to your east, you can barely
make out the queen's mines from here.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the mountains of the dwarven kingdom.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 6562, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0a2e5d219d316314", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbeb5da1f0fe942fc5"}

name: The Western Market Square
description:
This area of the square seems a bit more subdued than the rest. You
notice that most of the outland adventurers mill around the southern
end of the market, while the townfolk seem to keep their business in
the northern end.  West Main Street begins here and heads for the
gate. The market's expanse fills the other directions.

name: Bronze Dragon Street at wizard's back door
description:
Bronze Dragon street goes north and south.  The back door to what
remains of the magic shop is west.

name: 4th house
description:
You stand inside the 4th house of the city. Its inner courtyard is rather
dull by drow standards and rather small as well.

name: A Side Street
description:
You are in the common section of the city. More buildings made of
clay and stone be dazzles you. Most of these homes are designed so
beautifully you just cant keep your eyes off them.  The street
continues north and south and buildings line the street.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A small doorway leads into a little humble dwelling.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5344, "room_id": "69f4d0cb489fa9764f82f314", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbaffe19586a30dda5"}

name: A Small Hall
description:
You are inside a small hall with a rough wooden floor.  You see dozens of
people in the hall chasing one poor man who is yelling at the top of
his lungs.  Wait a minute.  These people are all holding hands and smiling!
The man in front is leading them in a spiral!  They're DANCING!  And you
thought people didn't dance like this any more!
You may recall now if you like.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8617, "room_id": "69f4d0cb832299d002c40e2d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb28eb31350171a420"}

name: The Weapon Shop
description: You are inside the weapon shop.  There is a small note on the counter.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "note", "description": "The note reads:

List  - Show which various items are in the store.
Buy   - Buy an item.
Value - The shopkeeper will (free of charge) tell how much he will
pay for your item.
Sell  - Sell an item.", "valid": true}

name: The greenhouse
description:
This is Dragons' greenhouse. Green light filters in slantwise through the
plants, giving the room a subtropical ambience. It is not really hot in here,
though, rather a pleasantly warm temperature. The walls are all windows, except
the eastern one joining the greenhouse to the main building, but it is hard to
see out for all the greenery here. There is a set of easy-chairs and a glass
coffee table. To the south, there is a wide double door out to a sunlit
terrace.

name: Black Hole
description:
Well you have chosen the wrong path, sorry.  Nothing can escape from this
monster, not even light.
PANIC!  You can't escape!

name: The Miden'nir
description:
The trees of Miden'nir are lush and green, hiding the evil that lurks
in these woods. You can go north toward the mountains, or west to the
forest, but the steep mountains prevent any movement east.

name: A Fiery Pathway
description:
You tread carefully along a path which dips and turns among geysers of fire.
Miniature volcanoes spew lava in rivers.  The fire is hot but not altogether
dangerous.  The path extends east and south.

name: A Link in the Ethereal Web
description:
This is another link in the ethereal web.  Various creatures
seem to get caught (or hypnotized) by its sticky strands.

name: The burial grounds
description:
It seems as if many of the warriors could not stop fighting even in
death.  They fight amongst each other and flail at any living being
that would wander near.

name: The Bridge
description:
You are walking along an old wooden bridge.  Its not that secure.  You
might want to hurry along.  To the south, on the other side of the bridge,
lies a small opening.

name: Dining Room
description:
You are in the dining area of the student mages. From the number of
tables and chairs here, you can see that this room could easily seat
several hundred people. It is oddly deserted here, obviously not meal time.
Exits lead west to the kitchen, and back east.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 30 meters above the temple spire.
It seems like you can see forever!
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "The rainbow leads onward and upward into the sky.\nIt looks safe to travel on.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7700, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb8cc1ece8b6e9d81", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb84607ba936fd9d9c"}

name: Head of the Rainbow Bridge
description:
Standing on the mortal end of the Rainbow Bridge, the bridge arches up
before you and seems to disappear into the clouds.  You wonder if it is
wise to venture upward into the realm of the gods.  But it seems so calm
and peaceful here that it would be a shame to leave...
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "The Rainbow Bridge stretches ahead before you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1220, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1d89d233d56bd8ae", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb38f3553f4e08f484"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The altar of Midgaard is below you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3054, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1d89d233d56bd8ae", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb611c25622176521c"}

name: An east-west hallway in the Tower of Nirvana
description: The hallway continues to the east, and stretches to the west.

name: The Sands of Sorrow
description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around you.
You feel lost.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5030, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5d11bcd4a41d4ce8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb47e6538ea676626e"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5025, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5d11bcd4a41d4ce8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbadfcd09baf4a3a51"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5027, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5d11bcd4a41d4ce8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb30adb5b5df7cd98b"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5026, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5d11bcd4a41d4ce8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba458502735a3bf59"}

name: In the foothills
description:
You are in a barren set of foothills. Looking around, all you see are dead
plants and boulders. From the south, you get a whiff of salty air. Barren paths
lead east, north, and south into more barren hills.

name: Ed Hilldreth Memorial Parkway
description: The Parkway goes east and west.

name: Murky Bog.
description:
A murky bog surrounds you.  To the east a black monolith juts forth from the
ground.  Far to the north lies a huge pool of quicksand.  Snarls can be heard
echoing as if from a great distance.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "monolith", "description": "This is a huge obsidian stone block stuck in the marsh.", "valid": true}
