exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north lies a huge pool of quicksand.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8308, "room_id": "69f4d0cb593f65eff4f988df", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb242e9fd1e57a74fb"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "To the east the marsh turns into a small lake.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8315, "room_id": "69f4d0cb593f65eff4f988df", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb7bf5eb9f2c6c39f"}

name: A Small Hut
description:
The hut is a mess!  Blood has stained the grass walls into a dark rich
crimson color.  Torn clothes and trash lie all around, and you think you
see a skeleton in the corner.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "skeleton", "description": "The skeleton still has a little flesh clinging to it and it is definitely\nhumanoid.  The skull has been cracked open, but it is otherwise undamaged,\nexcept by time.", "valid": true}

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: A small path in the dense forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest.  The forest seems to
become lighter to the west.  The path continues north and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The small path leads north through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6016, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5bddf2a44f8fea55", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbaaf46bd73ab91af2"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The small path leads west through the trees to a lighter part of the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6018, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5bddf2a44f8fea55", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb1ecac065f68bc59"}

name: A fluffy white cloud.
description:
You find yourself standing on a small cloud.  The cloud feels kind
of spongy beneath your feet.  You find it hard to see anything in
the distance as wisps of cloud blow over your face.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "An ominous storm cloud looms to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9110, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd85f62a3e8c2680c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1bc135f24b6fb8eb"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "There is another cloud above you.  If you jump you might make it...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9126, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd85f62a3e8c2680c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9a43504556d5913a"}

name: Back of Barracks
description:
Here is the back of the dwarven barracks.  There are rows
of beds here, and there is a stench that is unbearable.

name: Mob Factory Inspection Room
description:
You have entered the mob factory inspections room. This is where the
mobs manufactured on the assembly lines are inspected for defects. A
whole team of inspectors from the Midgaard Inspections Bureau is
standing around, trying to look busy. Exits are south to the mob
factory inspection room, east to the primary assembly line and west to
the storage area.

name: Walking the Silvery Strand
description:
You are standing atop a silvery strand of light that twists and turns
through the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the infinite expanse of the astral field.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7723, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6a583a154c38b579", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9cf212f0eecf63ed"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The strand of light twists and turns out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7736, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6a583a154c38b579", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb19c91f4dc9ccce8c"}

name: The Common Square
description:
People pass by talking to each other, or rest their weary bones on this
grassy field. You can hear faint sounds of the river to the south of you
as it passes through the city. Ishtar drive heads east and west from here
and the medina is to the north. South lies the Ishtar River bridge and the
southern gate.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the bridge over the river.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9512, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc69152961637daf7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd8e7e056f6067d31"}

name: The hills
description:
You are surrounded by dark and sinister hills. Although they seemed fairly
small from a distance you now get the feeling that they're closing in on you,
towering over you, overwhelming you ...  The small path seems to have second
thoughts about these hills because it starts winding unnecessarily, turning
several times around itself.  To the south the hills have a lighter hue of
dark. To the north however, the hills have become nightblack holes in the
distant mountains.

name: Throne Room
description:
The throne room is basically similar to the inner courtyard in regards
to decor. there is a small throne behind the altar but that is about it.

name: Dracolich Plaza
description:
They began construction of a pleasant plaza here, though you wouldn't
have known it if I hadn't told you.  It has been renamed in honor
of the Dragon gang's idol, the Dracolich.  It has become sort of a
training ground.  There is a short cut to the east and an overgrown
lot of land to the north.

name: A Side Street
description:
This small side street leads away from the garden path to the south.
Around you stand large numbers of commoners' houses.  Many citizens
pass by you with a friendly hello.  You almost feel like home here.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "An unusually tall dwelling stands looming over you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5337, "room_id": "69f4d0cb99f4950be0e8cc58", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd3ed7ec8a1a2c4e8"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A garden path circles around the temple.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5304, "room_id": "69f4d0cb99f4950be0e8cc58", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7e854aa2475fc185"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Here lies a small stone house with a thatched roof.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5327, "room_id": "69f4d0cb99f4950be0e8cc58", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb529c0f62bb04d6db"}

name: Road by a Pond
description:
You are passing by a large pond, almost a small lake.  You notice a small
wooden shack by the side of the road.
You may recall now if you like.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "shack", "description": "The shack looks hand-made by an amateur.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8613, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb27b11aa2e70e218", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd2330f51407460f6"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a wooden church set back among the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8637, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb27b11aa2e70e218", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb58fa036194fbd421"}

name: Main Street
description:
You are at the end of the main street of Midgaard.  South of here is the
entrance to the Guild of Magic Users.  The street continues east towards the
market square.  The magic shop is to the north and to the west is the city
gate.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the entrance to the Guild of Magic Users.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3017, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd06b5a895a0d4f1a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8408a2d51cc66734"}

name: The Homes of the Pleiades
description: This is where the famous Seven Sisters live.  You'd better not disturb them.

name: The dining hall
description:
This is Dragons' dining hall. There is a large long solid oak table,
seating at least 24, with heavy, wooden chairs to match. The oak panel walls
are filled with paintings. There are doors to the north and east, and to the
west there is a wide double door opening out onto the sunlit terrace.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "painting paintings", "description": "There are many, many beautiful paintings of famous dragons of history and
literature. There is a big one of Smaug, a group picture of Cuspidorian Toxic
Dragons, a rather fearsome picture of Norse Chaos incarnate, a grainy black-
and-white photograph of Vorgulremik the Steel Dragon, a romantic picture of
Dalvenjah the Mindijaran and Allan the man become dragon. There are three
empty frames labeled 'The Chimerical', 'The Mythical' and 'The Hypothetical',
A panoramic picture of Strabo flying between the worlds dominate one wall,
while a dragons-eye view of Pern (with dragons in the foreground, of course)
fills another. There even are a few rare medieval renditions of the great
beast of the Revelation. Over the head of the table hangs a rather modest
portrait of a silver Dragon, sparkling with blue lightening, looking amused.", "valid": true}

name: A Fiery Pathway
description:
You tread carefully along a path which dips and turns among pits of fire and
beds of coals.  A garden to the west glows with an everlasting fire.

name: The Miden'nir
description:
The forest is dark, and becomes even darker west.  You sense
that there is something evil hidden in these woods.  The forest gets
lighter to the north.  The wind kicks up as you ponder your options.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "There is a small clearing to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3512, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcfa995c3a14c36a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe974ed6ff8d3c6d7"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "It gets darker and thicker this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3514, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcfa995c3a14c36a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2c6a527b3256719d"}

name: The Quiet Tree Top
description: Here is a quiet tree top.

name: The burial grounds
description:
Legions of skeletal warriors wander by and battle the enemy even in
death.  Old battlelines have been forgotten and new ones made. Its a
gruesome scene.

name: A small opening
description:
You are standing in a small opening.  To the north lies the old wooden
bridge.  To your south the you can see a clearing.  You can see sunlight
again.  What a welcome relief!

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above the temple square.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Dark Hallway
description:
You are in a dark hallway. It is apparent that this area is seldom
used by the regular occupants of the tower. Dust covers the floors
here.
The faint outline of a trapdoor can be seen in the dust.

name: An east-west passage in the Tower of Nirvana
The Entrance of Valhalla
description:
The huge ornate entrance of Valhalla is before you.  It seems as though
atleast eight-hundred soldiers could walk abreast of one another through
these doors. You stare in awe at the sparkling mansion before you.  You
wonder what secrets are held behind these doors and long to hear the stories
of bravery and glory that you know are kept within the walls of Valhalla.

name: The Sands of Sorrow
description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around you.
You feel lost.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a nomad camp by an oasis.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5056, "room_id": "69f4d0cbadfcd09baf4a3a51", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1f04fd450b00a477"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5026, "room_id": "69f4d0cbadfcd09baf4a3a51", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba458502735a3bf59"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5028, "room_id": "69f4d0cbadfcd09baf4a3a51", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb66246fea12fbe6d3"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5024, "room_id": "69f4d0cbadfcd09baf4a3a51", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5d11bcd4a41d4ce8"}

name: Before the huge tree
description:
You enter a large ring of boulders. Sheltered by this wall of stones, a small
cluster of plants have sprung up. In the center of this group of trees and
bushes is a huge gnarled tree. It appears to have been twisted and torn by
the forces of nature. It sways and moans as a strong wind from the south tears
through its old feeble branches. The hills themselves lead in all directions.

name: Construction site of the Harold Finkelbaum Block.
description:
A Mega-City One City Block is being constructed at this site.  A
typical block is from 100 to 1000 stories high with hundreds of
thousands inhabitants.

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: Northern Lake Side.
description:
Floating on this boiling lake is not what you would consider an enjoyable
experience.  Many a creature bumps the bottom of your boat, and glares
at you through unblinking eyes from the waters below.  The southern
portion of the lake looks calm and serene compared to this wild place.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The southern portion of the lake lies to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8316, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb7bf5eb9f2c6c39f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb91ca3d07acb8b3de"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west lies a murky bog.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8314, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb7bf5eb9f2c6c39f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb593f65eff4f988df"}

name: On the Stream
description:
The stream is cold and frigid, yet it supports plenty of life beneath its
surface.  The current trickles west and there is a field to the south.

name: An intersection in the light forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the forest.  A path leads north to a
small field and other paths lead east and west into the dense forest.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The path leads north to a small, grassy field.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6023, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb1ecac065f68bc59", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1c74eb554d516968"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The path leads east to a dense part of the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6017, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb1ecac065f68bc59", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5bddf2a44f8fea55"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The path leads west to a dense part of the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6019, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb1ecac065f68bc59", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1f0ca21139830f6e"}

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads north and west.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The gravel path continues westwards towards a building of some sort.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3604, "room_id": "69f4d0cb333ccd0298ed364d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba434c1d9c76e9c65"}

name: A fluffy white cloud.
description:
You find yourself standing on a small cloud.  The cloud feels kind
of spongy beneath your feet.  You find it hard to see anything in
the distance as wisps of cloud blow over your face.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A cirrus cloud hums peacefully to itself.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9131, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9a43504556d5913a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb870fd03ece10954c"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "There is another cloud above you.  If you jump you might make it...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9107, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9a43504556d5913a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0c4a75e88e5c76cb"}

name: Inside of Castle Strangelove
description:
You are just inside the castle.  It is very tubular in shape,
and it is very featureless.  There is a set of stairs that lead
up, and the door leads out of the castle to the west.

name: Entrance Hallway to Mob Factory
description:
You are standing in the entrance hallway of the mob factory. The sound
of machinery gets louder now, and you can hear people shouting in the
distance. Every once in a while you get creepy feeling that a pair of
eyes is observing you...... Exits are north to the inspection room,
east to the primary assembly line, south to the reject room and west
to the entrance hallway.

name: Outside the Southern Gate of New Thalos
description:
You see before you the expanse of the Sands of Sorrow.  The shifting sands
stretch on endlessly to the south, hiding treasure and adventure.

name: Walking the Silvery Strand
description:
You are standing atop a silvery strand of light that twists and turns
through the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The strand of light twists and turns out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7739, "room_id": "69f4d0cb77a4fd0ed4a7216a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb71d00003a234828"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "You see the infinite expanse of the astral field.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7719, "room_id": "69f4d0cb77a4fd0ed4a7216a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb25717fbee49aecb1"}

name: Shortcut
description:
This is a shortcut between Dracolich Plaza and the center of town.
Dracolich Plaza is to the west and the shortcut continues south.

name: Entrance Way
description:
You stand in the entrance way to the temple which opens up to the north
into a large hallway going east and west. Small statues of spiders line the
entrance way's walls.

name: End of the path
description:
At this point the path has had enough. With a terrified shudder it cowers
to the ground, only staying here because you're standing on it. with a slight
feeling of unease you look around noticing only a few bushes and a large sign
carved into the mountain.  You feel you can hear the cry of help from a
thousand silent voices all coming from an even darker hole in the mountain to
the north marking the entrance to a cave (or a grave :-).
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bushes", "description": "Small crippled bushes desperately trying to grow south.", "valid": true}

name: A side street
description:
This small side street leads south away from the temple into the
business section of town. To the east is the famous City Hall of Thalos.
Well disciplined guards stand at attention, watching over the city hall, but
you don't see any source of threats in THIS city.  North is a garden path,
west is a smithy, and this side street continues south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A small garden path encircles the temple.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5306, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb5a4b0ed5dd8912e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5e376ea94dcae7b0"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You see what is most definitely city hall.  This building is the most\nelaborate of all the building here in Thalos.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5332, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb5a4b0ed5dd8912e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb81fe43cb3d39e332"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Inside the building you see long pieces of metal, an oven, and some\nanvils.  Obviously a smithy.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5321, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb5a4b0ed5dd8912e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7efb2336b30895ef"}

name: Main Street
description:
You are on the main street passing through the City of Midgaard.  South of
here is the entrance to the Armoury, and the bakery is to the north.  East of
here is the market square.

name: An Old Wooden Church
description:
As you enter the hall, you see the largest crowd of people you've ever seen in
your life.  They're also the noisiest crowd you've ever heard, and as they
press around you, the SWEATIEST crowd you've ever felt!  At the front of the
hall, a group of musicians are playing 'Chorus Jig'.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a road by a pond.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8636, "room_id": "69f4d0cb58fa036194fbd421", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb27b11aa2e70e218"}

name: The Burning Gardens
description:
Everywhere around you the landscape is afire; the rocks, the shrubs and even
the air seems to be aflame.  Curiously, the magical fire does not seem to
consume its hosts.  A path leads east among some fire pits.

name: Deep Forest
description:
It is quite dark here, forest surrounds you. With each step, the forest
seems to close around you, and get darker and more foreboding.  It might just
be time to head back to somewhere safe.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Lighter forest and mountains in the distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3513, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2c6a527b3256719d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcfa995c3a14c36a5"}

name: The terrace
description:
You are standing on a sunlit terrace in front of Dragon's mansion. To the
west, there is a splendid view over the field down over the lake. To the north
is the greenhouse, its large windowpanes shimmering with weird and wonderful
colors, while a double door leads into the house proper to the east. It is
warm and calm here. There is a white-painted table with a parasol here,
together with a matched set of chairs.

name: Western Side of the Temple
description:
You are still wandering around this temple.  You notice exits lie in all
directions except west.

name: On The Web
description:
RRRRRRRRRRROOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAAAAAARR!  You hear the roar
of a powerful beast.  Dragon, you think.  You shiver in your boots
as you tiptoe on this section of the web.

name: New graves
description:
The tombs in this section seem somewhat more recent.  Rotting zombie
warriors groan and wail with blank stares.  You hear sounds of digging
off a bit to the south.

name: Clearing
description:
You stand out in a clearing.  Mountains are all around you.  There is a
well in the middle of the clearing.  Lying against the well is a sign.  A
path leads up the mountain.  The small opening is back to the north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "well", "description": "You peer over the side of the well.  It looks VERY, VERY deep.  It appears\nto be ENDLESS.", "valid": true}

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above market square.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: Mages Tavern
description:
You are in mages tavern. The air is smokey and filled with the smells
of foreign food and drink. The other patrons pay you little heed, as
they obviously have more interesting things to contemplate. Strick the
bartender is here waiting to take your order.
The only exit leads back west.

name: An intersection in the Tower of Nirvana
description:
You are at an intersection where the east-west passage continues, but a large
passage leads to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The passage continues to the north where it seems to get wider.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9023, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8cfd2b2779b86fdc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbde15655d623383ba"}

name: Valhalla
description:
You are standing in the halls of Valhalla.  Pictures of Odin, Thor, Tyr,
Loki, Freyr, Feyja, and Balder line the walls.  The cavernous hall extends
to the east and west.  Rooms belonging to the gods lie to the north and
south.  There appears to be an exit above you, but you do not know what is
up there...
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The Satin Memorial Reading Room is north of here.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1207, "room_id": "69f4d0cbac55cbed38058cf6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4b0ae9c02f958b6c"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "If you want to know what is up there you shall have to go and look...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1212, "room_id": "69f4d0cbac55cbed38058cf6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb50b1408accabac68"}

name: The Sands of Sorrow
description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around you.
You feel lost.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5032, "room_id": "69f4d0cba458502735a3bf59", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba728b9b7c3bfb432"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5024, "room_id": "69f4d0cba458502735a3bf59", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5d11bcd4a41d4ce8"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5029, "room_id": "69f4d0cba458502735a3bf59", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb81856b58e50eeb9"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5025, "room_id": "69f4d0cba458502735a3bf59", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbadfcd09baf4a3a51"}

name: Before the dark cave
description:
You stand directly before a huge dark cave. The rocks and boulders outside the
cave are covered with blood stains and all types of broken and shattered bones
lie around. An unbearable stench comes from within the cave itself. The dark
cave entrance looms to the east. The hills themselves lead towards the
north, south, and west.

name: Corner of Junket Way and Threep Lane
description:
There is a second-hand kneepad stall is doing a brisk business with a
group of juves on their way to school.  Junket Way goes west and Threep
Lane travels south.

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: Southern Lake Side.
description:
You are floating on a calm section of blue crystal water.  You feel much more
at ease then you were before in this area.  Then a wave of fear passes over
you.  You are not alone.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "north", "description": "The way to the north seems to be impassable, due to the rough water and\nstrange wild life.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "To the west is a beach where your boat can land.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8317, "room_id": "69f4d0cb91ca3d07acb8b3de", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6f98da77e7858f87"}

name: A small path in the dense forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest.  The forest seems to
become lighter to the east.  The path continues north and east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The small path leads north through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6020, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1f0ca21139830f6e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb68c5de7f3595aeb7"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The small path leads east through the trees to a lighter part of the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6018, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1f0ca21139830f6e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb1ecac065f68bc59"}

name: On the Stream
description:
The current here flows from the east, but a logjam blocks you from
continuing onward.

name: A fluffy white cloud.
description:
You find yourself standing on a small cloud.  The cloud feels kind
of spongy beneath your feet.  You find it hard to see anything in
the distance as wisps of cloud blow over your face.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you see an angry cloud lashing out.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9130, "room_id": "69f4d0cb560c60241977ce63", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcc41bb96759c6d32"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "There is another cloud east of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9126, "room_id": "69f4d0cb560c60241977ce63", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9a43504556d5913a"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "There is another cloud above you.  If you jump you might make it...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9128, "room_id": "69f4d0cb560c60241977ce63", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9b64bf214a49453a"}

name: The Southern Bridge
description:
Walking over the bridge you see the rushing waters of the Ishtar River.
To the south you see the Southern Gate of New Thalos and the Common
Square stretches out to the north.

name: Walking the Silvery Strand
description:
You are standing atop a silvery strand of light that twists and turns
through the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The strand of light twists and turns out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7738, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb71d00003a234828", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb77a4fd0ed4a7216a"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "You see the infinite expanse of the astral field.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7724, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb71d00003a234828", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb34fd2fb18bc9b8e9"}

name: Mob Factory Reject Room
description:
This is the factory reject room. All the mobs that are manufactured
incorrectly or have some defect are placed here before subsequent
destruction. You shudder at the many deformed and grotesque shapes
present before you. Exits are south to the reject room and north to
the entrance hallway.

name: A store room
description:
There is a layer of dust on the floor at least 3 inches thick!  It is
probable that not many people have been in here for many months.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "floor dust", "description": "After blowing all the dust off the floor, you notice a trapdoor!", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A lighted area that looks like a well worn path.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6513, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1a3c347fd23b5ede", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb30fb7b7fc045b9c9"}

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: The cave
description:
You are in a large cave. The ceiling is lost somewhere above the reach of
your light. The floor, however, is highly illuminated, your light flickering
over several tombstones. Only one is whole, the rest have been shattered by
some savage blow. The remaining tombstone looks disturbingly new...
A small breeze of fresh air enters from the south (probably lost too). Take a
good breath, it may be your last mouthful of air in a long, long time that
others haven't breathed before you.
To the north a small tunnel continues into the mountain.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tombstone", "description": "The stone is inscribed with the unfortunate player's famous last words:\n\n\"What are you worrying about, it is just a small harmless snake\"", "valid": true}

name: Hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you
look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you.
To the north is a obsidian stairway.

name: Ice Dragon Way
description:
Several smashed crystal statues line the Way here.  You begin to wonder
who smashed them, and with what.  The Way bends out of sight to the north
and continues south.  To the east is a courtyard.

name: A side street
description:
This small side street is lined with great beautifully designed
buildings. To the north is the magnificent temple while to the
east lies the entrance to a small friendly tavern. The street continues
north and south.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "From the looks of it, this is a very impressive two story abode.\nThe entire first floor is covered with a huge marble bar with merry men\ntelling tall tales and drinking their fill.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5330, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc06ad2a349e6920c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe777614666677015"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "This seems to be the only guild house in the entire city. You feel uneasy\nabout this building.  For some reason it seems not to belong.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5319, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc06ad2a349e6920c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5989fb08871d07a3"}

name: Light Forest
description:
The forest is light here and you can easily pick your way through the
trail.  To the east, the forest becomes thick and darker. South, the trail
continues.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The trees get thicker as you go east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3516, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9fb8b8ca9707afed", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe947b4d3315b6d49"}

name: Mountain Road
description:
You are following a road at the top of a mountain ridge with sky all around
you.  Distant valleys are spread out below you on both sides.  There are
many horsemen and horsewomen on this road, riding hell-for-leather out of
sheer exhilaration.  You wish you had a horse!
You may recall now if you like.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see several acres of thickly planted, very young Yule Trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8639, "room_id": "69f4d0cb30ec0909aa19f7fd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb23de5d72afb86c12"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8624, "room_id": "69f4d0cb30ec0909aa19f7fd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb0ed92987657bf82"}

name: The Fire Chamber
description:
The fire ruler sits upon a throne made of blue flame.  Little flickers of
flame dance to and fro for the entertainment of the ruler.

name: Market Square
description:
You are standing on the market square, the famous Square of Midgaard.
A large, peculiar looking statue is standing in the middle of the square.
Roads lead in every direction, north to the temple square, south to the
common square, east and westbound is the main street.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "statue", "description": "What you see is the Midgaard Worm, stretching around the Palace of Midgaard.", "valid": true}

name: At the edge of the grove
description:
You are standing at the entrace of a beautiful grove of trees, and your
heart is filled with pure, peaceful thoughts.  This looks like a safe place
to recover from the wounds of adventuring.  A faint path through the grove
lies to the north, and you can see the eastern road to the south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A faint trail leads deeper into the grove.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8951, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcfa66de9a1d689f1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5bf77c5a8eb980a5"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A wide road lies to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3526, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcfa66de9a1d689f1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9272c968f7636ae5"}

name: The Ki-Rin Chamber
description:
A wise ki-rin was entrapped here many years ago.  It is from her
that the ruler of this realm steals his magical strength.

name: Orion's Hunting Lodge
description:
This is dedicated to the Great Hunter of all time -- Orion.
Scattered on the floor is the famous hunting equipment used by him.

name: Misty cavern
description:
A chilling icy mist swirl about you.  The dampness and warmth has become
bitter cold.  The walls of the cavern are several feet thick with ice
here.  An icy wind blows from the south.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above market square and commons square.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: A path
description:
This path leads up the side of the mountain.  A clearing lies below you.
There is a cave opening to the west.  The path continues up the mountain.

name: The Magic Shop
description:
You are in the High Tower's store of magic. Tatorious stands behind
the counter, selling all sorts of herbs, parchment and other reagents
used in magical studies.
The only exit leads back east to the common room.

name: At the door to the Tower of Nirvana
description:
You stand on the plane where a mighty door lies to the west.
The plane also continues north and southward.  There is a large sign on the
door.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign reads:
WARNING
Only those brave of heart and high of level should
enter the Tower of Nirvana.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The plane continues northward as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9014, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4e4ed0fbedace8f3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7739176b282beb93"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The plane continues southward as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9005, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4e4ed0fbedace8f3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb832ca6fbf52c96dd"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A mighty door lies to the west", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9008, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4e4ed0fbedace8f3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5d08b4b3aee6af4f"}

name: Inside the horrid cave
description:
The stench is overwhelming. You can hardly breathe as you enter the cave.
Looking around, you realize that some bizarre and horrible creature uses this
cave as a home. Skeletal remains lie all over. Several half-eaten corpses are
rotting away slowly in the gloomy darkness. In the back of the cave, you see a
large pile of rotting cloth, fur, and plant matter. Light and safety is
towards the west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "pile", "description": "It appears to be some sort of nest......", "valid": true}

name: The Sands of Sorrow
description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around you.
You feel lost.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5024, "room_id": "69f4d0cb30adb5b5df7cd98b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5d11bcd4a41d4ce8"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5028, "room_id": "69f4d0cb30adb5b5df7cd98b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb66246fea12fbe6d3"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5030, "room_id": "69f4d0cb30adb5b5df7cd98b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb47e6538ea676626e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a river flowing into the mountain.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5007, "room_id": "69f4d0cb30adb5b5df7cd98b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfffeecd7dbc3c1aa"}

name: Threep Lane
description:
Threep Lane continues north and south.  There is a building to the east
with a sign next to the door.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "Throt and Gleep's Megger Store est. 2107", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A door to the east bodes ill.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8026, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd69212c5c943affa", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbac26467712b6b736"}

name: Valhalla
description:
You are standing in the halls of Valhalla.  Tapestries of the gods line
the walls.  A statue of Odin is here.  The halls continue to the east and
west, and there are doors to the north and south of you.  There is some
sort of exit above you, but you do not know where it leads...
extraDescription: {"keyword": "statue odin", "description": "The statue of Odin has been exquisitely crafted.  It is of white marble\nwith black and gold veins.  It looks to be of magical origin.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "Priscilla's Pleasure Palace is south of here.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1204, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbebc0d3fcbbf6305", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb68a9eb534baeb978"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "If you want to know what is up there you shall have to go up and see...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 2, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbebc0d3fcbbf6305", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcd69e4f0e0719637"}

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: The Field of Mice's Dreams
description:
This is a large green field of waist high grass.  You feel something
scurry over your feet.  There is a cave to the east.

name: Beach
description:
You are on a sandy shore.  Marsh life creeps across the surface.  To the west
lies an evil fortress.  You see figures walking along the battlements.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "fortress", "description": "It is hewn of black stone and heavily fortified.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east lies the southern portion of a small lake.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8316, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6f98da77e7858f87", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb91ca3d07acb8b3de"}

name: A small path in the dense forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest.  The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination.  The path
continues south and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The small path leads south through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6019, "room_id": "69f4d0cb68c5de7f3595aeb7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1f0ca21139830f6e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The small path leads west through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6021, "room_id": "69f4d0cb68c5de7f3595aeb7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb819fa27db75209df"}

name: A fluffy white cloud.
description:
You find yourself standing on a small cloud.  The cloud feels kind
of spongy beneath your feet.  You find it hard to see anything in
the distance as wisps of cloud blow over your face.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a cloud somewhere south of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9103, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9b64bf214a49453a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8065633f3404f29e"}

name: Walking the Silvery Strand
description:
You are standing atop a silvery strand of light that twists and turns
through the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The strand of light twists and turns out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7741, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe781b29d67c8b068", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb387b1114f25e6429"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "You see the infinite expanse of the astral field.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7720, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe781b29d67c8b068", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba24bfd753d7f0247"}

name: Inside the South Gate of New Thalos
description:
Two large stone towers rise up to greet you with the massive iron gate
swinging on ornately crafted hinges and emblazoned with the crest of
New Thalos. The makers of the city spared no expense in rebuilding the
defenses or their home. The Ishtar River bridge lies to the north and
wilderness to the south.

name: Mob Factory Reject Room
description:
This is the factory reject room. All the mobs that are manufactured
incorrectly or have some defect are placed here before subsequent
destruction. You shudder at the many deformed and grotesque shapes
present before you. The only exit is north to the reject room.

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads north and south.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}

name: Wine cellar
description:
This room smells like wine, and you can only assume it used to be
a wine cellar at one time.

name: Long Hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you
look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you.

name: The tunnel
description:
You squeeze your way through a small, narrow tunnel. The sharp-edged rocks
protruding from the walls threaten to scratch and cut you.
To the south you sense a freshness in the air which is rather unusual in these
damp, stuffy tunnels. To the north the tunnel continues.

name: Courtyard North
description:
Once it was the courtyard of a beautiful building complex.  But alas,
someone forgot to water the plants and they all died.  Then again,
you wonder how many people have died here too.  The courtyard extends
to the south and there is a road to the west.

name: A side street
description:
You are at the end of a long street leading to the center of the city.
A long alley runs east and west.

name: Muddy Ground
description:
The ground is quite muddy here and puddles are all around. Your boots
make a disgusting SQUISH as you walk here. You can go in any of the
four cardinal directions from here. Hopefully, it will be dryer.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The trees get VERY thick to the south. You can barely see...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3519, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe947b4d3315b6d49", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdc09c5403193a33d"}

name: Yule Tree Farm
description:
This is the Yule Tree Farm at the top of Mountain Road.  All around you,
young Yule Trees saturate your senses with dark green needles and pine
essence.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see a mountain ridge against the sky.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8638, "room_id": "69f4d0cb23de5d72afb86c12", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb30ec0909aa19f7fd"}

name: Electric Pathway
description:
The pathway glows and hums because of the electricity pulsing through it.
It seems almost soothing to your weary feet.  To the north there is a
sunken-in area.  A path leads east also.

name: The Main Street
description:
You are on Main Street crossing through town.  To the north is the general
store, and the main street continues east.  To the west you see and hear the
market place and to the south is the Jeweller's Shop.

name: Northern Side of the Temple
description:
You are still wandering around this temple.  You notice exits lie in all
directions except north.

name: Inside the grove
description:
As you walk among the stately oaks of this grove, you feel at peace and
in harmony with this beautiful forest.  If only the rest of the lands were
so tranquil.  The trail turns towards the east, leading into the secluded
trees of the druids' holy grove, and a path back to the eastern road lies
south.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the stately oaks and poplars of the holy grove.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8904, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5bf77c5a8eb980a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf26d9aa13d321734"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A faint trail heads towards the eastern road.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8950, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5bf77c5a8eb980a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcfa66de9a1d689f1"}

name: A Link in the Ethereal Web
description:
This is another link in the ethereal web.  Various creatures
seem to get caught (or hypnotized) by its sticky strands.  To
the north you sense the heavy breathing of a fiery animal.

name: Misty cavern
description:
The temperature is a pleasant and mild here.  This is due to a warm wind
blowing in from the east and a chilly breeze blowing in from the west.
The updrafts create bizarre icy-steamy mists which dance along the
walls.

name: A cave opening
description:
You stand before a huge cave opening.  You hearing heavy breathing from
within the cave.  There are a few skeletons lying about.  The cave lies to
the south.  The path is back to the east.

name: In the air ...
description:
You are flying!
Currently you are about 60 meters above commoners square and the dump.
It seems like you can see forever!

name: At the door to the Tower of Nirvana
description:
The plane continue to the north and south, while a mighty door lies to the
east.  There is a sign on the door.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign reads:
WARNING!
Only those brave of heart and high of level
should attempt to enter the Tower of Nirvana.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The plane stretches to the north as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9015, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf7c8a46073f5f950", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd3d50e506fb7d46a"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "A mighty door sits to the east", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 9007, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf7c8a46073f5f950", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe8a2d05e7dc06676"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The plane continues to the south as far as the eye can see", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9006, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf7c8a46073f5f950", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb47f28004b2d27e94"}

name: the kitchen
description:
You are in a small kitchen. All the usual kitchen type utensils and
equipment is here, including some not so usual ones. Among the later,
a huge black oven against one wall, it must be at least 12 feet high.
Opposite the oven is an equally enormous meat locker, large enough to
comfortably store several hapless adventurers no doubt. In the middle of
the room, hanging in mid-air is a spice rack.

name: The hills overlooking the shore
description:
Standing at the edge of the foothills, you are able to look down upon a rocky
shoreline. It appears as though a vast ocean is to the south. Sea birds have
made their nests here in the rocks and you are heartened by the presence of
life here. It is possible to climb down to the shore here. The hills
themselves are to the north. The edge of the hills leads to the east along the
shoreline.

name: The Sands of Sorrow
description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around you.
You feel lost.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5025, "room_id": "69f4d0cb66246fea12fbe6d3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbadfcd09baf4a3a51"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5029, "room_id": "69f4d0cb66246fea12fbe6d3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb81856b58e50eeb9"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5031, "room_id": "69f4d0cb66246fea12fbe6d3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6306924c55d35b54"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5027, "room_id": "69f4d0cb66246fea12fbe6d3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb30adb5b5df7cd98b"}

name: Threep Lane
description: Threep Lane continues north and south.  There is a dark alley to the west.

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: The Dark Cave
description:
The cave gleams as your light reflects off of it.  As you squint your eyes
and try to look ahead, you think you see something move.

name: Valhalla
description:
You have reached the end of the halls of Valhalla.  There are heavy doors
on 3 walls.  They lead into the rooms of the gods.  The hall goes back to
the west, and there is some sort of an exit above you.  Torches sputter
softly and the scent of incense is strong here.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The Temple of Stupid is south of here.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3170, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5cd774422d1ff90b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb23412aa2e7663b7d"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "If you want to know what is up from here, you shall have to go up and see...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1214, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5cd774422d1ff90b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb054780b2cb1e3808"}

name: Before the Great Gates.
description:
You stand before the gates of a huge fortress.  The drawbridge is up, the
gates closed, and the portcullis down.  This place looks very dangerous,
and you decide not to continue onward.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east is a marshy beach.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8317, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7fe3a298bc48c1e5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6f98da77e7858f87"}

name: A small path in the dense forest
description:
You are on a small path leading through the dense forest.  To the west there is
a cave entrance.  The path continues north and east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "path paths", "description": "The narrow path is probably used by the animals living in the forest.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The small path leads north through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6012, "room_id": "69f4d0cb819fa27db75209df", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0e4741c433f28a54"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The small path leads east through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6020, "room_id": "69f4d0cb819fa27db75209df", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb68c5de7f3595aeb7"}

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: Sleepy little cloud.
description:
This cloud is peacefully snoozing away, enjoying himself.  There
is grumpy cloud to the east and a rather shy cloud north of here.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The cloud to the north blushes and tries to hide when you look at\nit.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9132, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8accf766e967cddb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7bd26216b7a21716"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The cloud to the east mutters and grumbles at you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9130, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8accf766e967cddb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcc41bb96759c6d32"}

name: Primary Assembly Line
description:
This is the primary assembly line of the mob factory. Here, all the
mobs seen roaming around the city of Midgaard are manufactured from
raw materials. There is a big conveyor belt present which makes a lot
of noise! It seems that the workers are making drunks today. Exits are
east to the secondary assembly line, south to the primary assembly
line and west to the inspection room.

name: The Northwestern Market Square
description:
This corner of the market contains some of the most civilized folk in
New Thalos. To the north lies the humble store of the merchant Ahkeem, his
weavings known to be the best in the city. West of here is the entrance
to Nabil's Exotic Animals.

name: Stairs in castle
description: The stairs continue to circle up and down here.

name: Walking the Silvery Strand
description:
You are standing atop a silvery strand of light that twists and turns
through the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the infinite expanse of the astral field.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7725, "room_id": "69f4d0cb387b1114f25e6429", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb37c6e94ab91da8b6"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The strand of light twists and turns out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7740, "room_id": "69f4d0cb387b1114f25e6429", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe781b29d67c8b068"}

name: Long Hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you
look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you.
To the north is a door.

name: Bronze Dragon Street
description:
There used to be a gate out to the east here which led to the rest of Midgaard.
The gate has rusted permanently shut.  The street goes north and south.

name: Near the Mountains
description:
The most prominent feature here is the mountains that lie to the east.
You can only go north and west from here as the rocks stop all other
movement.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "There is a bit of a slope downward to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3516, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4421c5b07c7a61c6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe947b4d3315b6d49"}

name: Under another grand watchtower
description:
You stand at the base of a tall ivy covered watchtower built to
protect the city from invaders.  You get the feeling of safety here in
Thalos.

name: The tunnel
description:
You are in a part of the tunnel that looks uncannily like the rest except
that it goes in a east-north direction. To the north the tunnel widens into
a cave.

name: The Electric Playground
description:
Though there is a seemingly carefree atmosphere here, you sense that
something much more important takes place near by.  The electric playground
extends north and east.

name: The Void
description:
You are suspended in cool electric space above a translucent plain.  You feel
synesthesia invading your nerves and reshuffling your senses.  The sky is the
same obsidian color as the ground and you can't find a horizon.

name: The Main Street
description:
The main street, to the north is the weapon shop and to the south is the
Guild of Swordsmen.  To the east you leave town and to the west the street
leads to the market square.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the main street leading to the market square.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3015, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd3c3c314e5b35427", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb82a5103085593588"}

name: The Offering Chamber
description:
This is the sacred offering chamber in which sacrifices are made.  You see a
young girl here, chained to the wall, as if she is waiting for execution.
You look up and realize the chains are sent down directly from above.
Below you recognize the temple of Thalos.

name: The fog
description:
You are in a grey fog, falling, screaming in pain as you realize
that you are being torn to nothing, atom by atom, falling and falling
and falling ...
...
.

name: Yevaud's Lair
description:
Yevaud, the Usurper of Midgaard, resides here.  A voice cries
out, "BEWARE, the Usurper of Midgaard lives here!  FLEE while you can!"
But even Yevaud has his master...or so you deduce.

name: A north-south area of the Plane of Nirvana
description: The plane continues to the north and southward.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The plane continues endlessly to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9027, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7739176b282beb93", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfae55f7693338ba5"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The plane continues endlessly to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9012, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7739176b282beb93", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4e4ed0fbedace8f3"}

name: Mist cavern
description:
A warm wind blows in from the east.  The air is still stifling hot in
here despite the breeze.  The mist seems thick enough to be alive. . .

name: The hills overlooking the shoreline
description:
You stand on a barren section of hills that overlook a rocky shoreline. The
stiff ocean wind has blown the rocks smooth here and you have to lean forward
a bit to keep your balance. The salty sea air fills your nostrils and you
notice signs of life in the rocky crags here. You can climb down towards the
shore or head north into the hills themselves. The rocky summit you are
standing leads east and west along the shoreline.

name: Below the trapdoor
description:
You are below the trapdoor. It is very dark and dusty here, very little
light filters through from above. A faint sound of dripping water can be
heard in the distance below.
A rope ladder leads down.

name: The path continues
description:
The path continues up the mountain to the top.  The path also goes down.
Thats it, nothing more to see.

name: The Sands of Sorrow
description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around you.
You feel lost.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5026, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb81856b58e50eeb9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba458502735a3bf59"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The sand is glowing in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5062, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb81856b58e50eeb9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1b2da87cd53e1664"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5032, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb81856b58e50eeb9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba728b9b7c3bfb432"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5028, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb81856b58e50eeb9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb66246fea12fbe6d3"}

name: Corner of Max Jaffa Blvd and Threep Way
description:
A proprietor of Uncle Sumpty's Ugly Emporium meanders by.  Threep Lane
continues north and south while Max Jaffa Boulevard goes west.

name: On the Rainbow Bridge
description:
You have reached the center of the Rainbow Bridge.  Clouds and mist swirl
around your feet.  The view from here is incredible.  It is little wonder
that the heavens were saved for the gods personal pleasures.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "clouds", "description": "The clouds are beautiful.  There are shades of gray, pink and purple swirled\ninto the blue sky.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "The Rainbow Bridge continues upwards into the heavens.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1221, "room_id": "69f4d0cb38f3553f4e08f484", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba42f179d6025d060"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The Rainbow Bridge disappears down into the clouds.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1215, "room_id": "69f4d0cb38f3553f4e08f484", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1d89d233d56bd8ae"}

name: Darker Cave
description:
The cave gets even darker as your terror grows stronger.  You fear for your
life as something emerges out of the shadows.

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description:
This room has been totally hollowed out and smoothed, and a pit has been
drilled in the center of the floor.  There are extensive gruesome paintings
of beasts and monsters terrorizing the countryside; vampires sucking the
blood of beasts and humans alike.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "painting paintings mural", "description": "There is a tiny painting of a vault in this mural ... and it seems to be a\nreflected picture of the vault ... the word in tiny print is 'rathcor'.", "valid": true}

name: Inside the cave
description:
You are in a natural cave.  Various sorts of debris cover the stone floor,
emitting a rather unpleasant smell that makes the air thick and hard to
breathe.  The only obvious exit is east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "debris", "description": "It consists mostly of gnawed bones mixed with small pieces of torn fur.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The cave opening is to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6021, "room_id": "69f4d0cb921c2654f9dc7f31", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb819fa27db75209df"}

name: Grumpy little cloud.
description:
This cloud mutters and grumbles at you.  You have to jump quickly
to avoid a lightning bolt that passes by your toe.  Your aren't
sure but you think you hear the cloud snicker.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A happy little cloud is humming peacefully to itself.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9131, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcc41bb96759c6d32", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb870fd03ece10954c"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see a cloud somewhere south of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9127, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcc41bb96759c6d32", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb560c60241977ce63"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A sleepy little cloud to the west yawns and rolls over.  You hear\nsnoring.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9129, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcc41bb96759c6d32", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8accf766e967cddb"}

name: Primary Assembly Line
description:
This is the primary assembly line of the mob factory. Here, all the
mobs seen roaming around the city of Midgaard are manufactured from
raw materials. There is a big conveyor belt present which makes a lot
of noise! It seems that the workers are making drunks today. Exits are
east to the secondary assembly line, north and south to the primary
assembly line and west to the inspection room.

name: The Northern Market Square
description:
You stand in one of the most heavily used parts of town. To the north lies
the Palace of New Thalos and the Casbah; east west and south of here the
busy market thrives with life.

name: Stairs
description:
You are still circling around on the stairs.  You are starting to
get dizzy from going around and around and around and around and
around.  The stairs continue up and down.

name: Walking the Silvery Strand
description:
You are standing atop a silvery strand of light that twists and turns
through the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The strand of light twists and turns out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7743, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbd8cf7ea8563e3ae", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd5095f9b98ea2faf"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You see the infinite expanse of the astral field.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7721, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbd8cf7ea8563e3ae", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7943358b792ef260"}

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads east and south.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}

name: Long Hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you
look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you.

name: Shortcut
description: The shortcut extends north.  There is a street to the east.

name: The Fading Trail
description:
The trail becomes nearly unpassable here. You can go north
as the forest is relatively light. To the south, you can see a path.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can see a trail this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3515, "room_id": "69f4d0cb88bfda3ee42d47b7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9fb8b8ca9707afed"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The trees are nearly trunk-to-trunk this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": -1, "room_id": "69f4d0cb88bfda3ee42d47b7", "to_room_id": null}

name: A back alley
description:
This alley leads to the rear of meat stand. The aroma of fresh and
char-broiled meat catches your sense of smell.  You wipe the drool
off your chin the instant you know it is there.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the back-side of the market place meat stand.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5317, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3ba39fb7a54d6886", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb58a494f0aadf3872"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5315, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3ba39fb7a54d6886", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbad29f80241e34673"}

name: The Electric Playground
description:
Though there is a seemingly carefree atmosphere here, you sense that
something much more important takes place near by.  There is an electric
path heading away south.  The playground extends north and west.

name: Entrance to Mage's Guild
description: The entrance hall is a small, poor lighted room.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see your favorite place, the Mage's Bar.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3018, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8408a2d51cc66734", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbde50efea36639b94"}

name: The Entrance of the Ancient Temple
description:
You have entered into this old temple, which was built originally for the gods
in Mount Olympia, but it is now deserted as someone took over this part of the
Universe.

name: The tunnel
description:
This tunnel, leading east-west, seems seldom used.  A thick layer of dust
covers the floor, making the air stuffy and dry.

name: The hills above the shoreline
description:
You stand on a rocky summit overlooking a rough shoreline below. The sea wind
blows hard across the rocks here and they have been worn smooth with time.
Looking around, you notice that you can safely climb down towards the shore.
The hills themselves stretch towards the north. The rough summit you stand
upon leads west along the shoreline.

name: A north-south area on the Plane of Nirvana
description: the plane continues to the north and south
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The plane continues endlessly to the north", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9028, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd3d50e506fb7d46a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb69030b3c6f14ef7f"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The plane continues endlessly to the south", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9013, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd3d50e506fb7d46a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf7c8a46073f5f950"}

name: Waterfall of mist
description:
River of hot mist pour down in a cascade from a hole in the cavern.  It
falls like water down from the heights like a waterfall and creates
beautiful swirls.  It causes a hot wind to flow west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "hole height waterfall cascade", "description": "The hole is much too high up for you to reach.", "valid": true}

name: A Link in the Ethereal Web
description:
This is another link in the ethereal web.  Various creatures
seem to get caught (or hypnotized) by its sticky strands.  A single
spider line lies to the north, while ghastly seemings are due
southward.  The grim entrance of Arachnos' Lair is downward.

name: The top of the mountain
description:
You are standing at the top of the mountain.  It feels more like the top of
the world.  To your north lies a huge platinum door.  You hear very pronounced
grumbling from behind the doors.  It sounds like something huge and hungry.
But if you don't have the key you don't have to worry because you can't get in.
If you do have the key I would suggest not going in.  Some believe the Five
Headed dragon Tiamat was imprisoned here by the gods.  But who believes in
fairy tales.  Well, if you're scared, you can always go down the mountain.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door platinum", "description": "A huge platinum door separates you from harm", "valid": true}

name: The Sands of Sorrow
description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around you.
You feel lost.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5027, "room_id": "69f4d0cb47e6538ea676626e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb30adb5b5df7cd98b"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5031, "room_id": "69f4d0cb47e6538ea676626e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6306924c55d35b54"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5024, "room_id": "69f4d0cb47e6538ea676626e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5d11bcd4a41d4ce8"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5032, "room_id": "69f4d0cb47e6538ea676626e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba728b9b7c3bfb432"}

name: A damp intersection
description:
You are in a damp intersection of what seems to be the basement of the
tower. The sound of running water can be heard coming from the south,
other than that, an almost tangible stillness fills the air.
Passages lead off in all directions, and a ladder leads up.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A faint light can be seen in the distance up the east passage.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1324, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4c75479d3e5de11c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4a168817c79693cf"}

name: Corner of Ed Hilldreth Mem. Prkwy and Threep Lane
description:
Threep Lane goes north from here while Ed Hilldreth Memorial Parkway goes
west.

name: The End of the Rainbow Bridge
description:
You have reached the end of the Rainbow Bridge.  Asgard stretches out above
you.  Looking around, you search for the legendary guardian of Asgard.  The
clouds are far below you and a sense of beauty and peacefulness surrounds you.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "Asgard is above you, spread out in all its glory.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1213, "room_id": "69f4d0cba42f179d6025d060", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5a77e50d443d4d51"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "Bifrost, the Rainbow Bridge leads down to the Temple of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1220, "room_id": "69f4d0cba42f179d6025d060", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb38f3553f4e08f484"}

name: A Dusty Path
description:
You are on a well traveled path that leads in many directions.  To the north
is a large house, and to the west is a fortress.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "fortress", "description": "The fortress is a large gnome stronghold to defend the city.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the gateway to a large fortress.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1527, "room_id": "69f4d0cb941e178a777ebe2b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb168c2ccffc429acf"}

name: On a small, grassy field
description:
You are in a small, grassy field somewhere in the forest.  The tall grass
nearly reaches your waist, and the surrounding oaks and beeches form an almost
wall-like thicket on all sides of the field.  A small path leads south through
the trees.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "grass", "description": "The tall grass makes a nice hiding place for animals.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The small path leads south in between the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6018, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1c74eb554d516968", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb1ecac065f68bc59"}

name: The Lower Chambers and Tombs of the Undead
description: The stench of death is heavy in these caverns.

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: Happy little cloud.
description:
You hear the cloud humming a little song to itself, but you can't
figure out the song.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "There is a pure white cloud north of you.  It is snowing!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9136, "room_id": "69f4d0cb870fd03ece10954c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf70845eebef03c2b"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see a cloud somewhere south of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9126, "room_id": "69f4d0cb870fd03ece10954c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9a43504556d5913a"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see an angry little cloud muttering and grumbling to itself.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9130, "room_id": "69f4d0cb870fd03ece10954c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcc41bb96759c6d32"}

name: Primary Assembly Line
description:
This is the primary assembly line of the mob factory. Here, all the
mobs seen roaming around the city of Midgaard are manufactured from
raw materials. There is a big conveyor belt present which makes a lot
of noise! It seems that the workers are making drunks today. Exits are
east to the secondary assembly line, north and south to the primary
assembly line and west to the entrance hallway.

name: The Northeastern Market Square
description:
Pandemonium. Chaos. Madness. A few other choice words come to mind as you
gaze into this corner of the market. The vegetable stand seems quiet enough
so you have to assume the noise comes from the Butchery. You have to
think for a while before you muster the will to enter this shop.
The market continues to the south and west.

name: Top of stairs
description:
You are at the top of the stairs in the castle.  There is an exit
to the east, and the stairs lead down.

name: Walking the Silvery Strand
description:
You are standing atop a silvery strand of light that twists and turns
through the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The strand of light twists and turns out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7742, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd5095f9b98ea2faf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbd8cf7ea8563e3ae"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see the infinite expanse of the astral field.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7726, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd5095f9b98ea2faf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc3f81a1ec7d8833b"}

name: Long Hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you
look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you.

name: The meat stand
description:
A large stand has been set up here with metal hooks and wooden racks
in the background.  Hanging on the hooks are huge slabs of meat
and other game.  This stand is packed with produce, and a sudden burst
of laughter catches you by surprise as little children play around
your ankles.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "This is a cart full of fresh vegetables and fruits.  You are almost\ntempted to take some.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5320, "room_id": "69f4d0cb58a494f0aadf3872", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6b5facbff922340c"}

name: The Electric Playground
description:
Though there is a seemingly carefree atmosphere here, you sense that
something much more important takes place near by.  The playground continues
south and east.

name: The Dark Path
description:
You are hemmed in by trees on either side of you.  The path
continues north and south, and while is much to thick to explore west,
you can head off into the woods to the east.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "There is a strong stench coming from this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3521, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdc09c5403193a33d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb639c9d9010e8d871"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The trees are nearly trunk-to-trunk this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": -1, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdc09c5403193a33d", "to_room_id": null}

name: Ice Dragon Way
description:
