The Way continues north and intersects with Yellow Dragon Avenue
to the south.  For some reason, you somehow realize that there is a
shortcut to the west that leads to Dracolich Plaza.

name: Mage's Bar
description:
The bar is one of the wierdest in the land.  Mystical images float around
the air.  Illusions of fine furniture appear all around the room.

name: Hercules' Mighty Throne
description:
You stand before the throne of a long-forgotten hero.  It is full of bounty
that he got from the Ten Labours.

name: The tunnel
description:
You are walking in a narrow tunnel. The walls are only roughly shaped,
sharp rocks protruding everywhere, even from the floor making you stumble in
the flickering light. To the south the tunnel narrows even more making it
almost impossible to pass. To the north it slowly widens into a cave. There
is a branch of the tunnel going west.

name: The rocky shore
description:
You are at the base of the rocky hills. Stretching to the south and east, you
see a rocky shore. To the southeast, you see a small altar of some sorts that
glows with an eerie blue light. It is possible to climb up into the hills here.

name: Well
description:
O
h
!

N
o
!

I warned you!  You have fallen into the bottomless pit.  You life flashes
right before your eyes.  Pretty pathetic isn't it?  Next time you'll know
to listen to the God of Laughs.

name: Huge multicolored tunnel
description:
The tunnel leads north and south.  To the south there is an odd
twinkling phenomenon.

name: Dead End
description: You stand at a dead end where the only exit appears to be west.

name: Entrance to the Donjonkeep
description:
A dark path at the end of the web strand, you see ahead
a torch lit chamber where the souls of unavenged adventurers
come and gnash their teeth.  The howls and screams of many echo
through the hall ways.  You see one definite path ahead.

name: A dark passage
description:
You are at the end of a dark passage which ends in a stout wooden door.
Other then through the door, the only apparent exit is back the way you
came.

name: Construction Site for the Brit-Cit One tunnel.
description:
Construction is under way for the Black Atlantic Tunnel to connect
Mega-City One and Brit-Cit One.

name: The Sands of Sorrow
description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around you.
You feel lost.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5028, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6306924c55d35b54", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb66246fea12fbe6d3"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5032, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6306924c55d35b54", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba728b9b7c3bfb432"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5063, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6306924c55d35b54", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba3e9f79713785ed4"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5030, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6306924c55d35b54", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb47e6538ea676626e"}

name: The Iron Gateway
description:
You stand at the entrance to the gnome fortress.  The place seems to be
well fortified.

name: Entrance to the Forbidden Catacombs
description:
You have entered the forbidden catacombs.  This cave system must have been
built long ago.  The air is dank and smells of something dead ...  or maybe
undead.  Enter here at your own risk ... something evil abides.

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads north and west.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow trail winding its way between the enormous, grey trunks.
The crowns of the trees must be very dense, as they leave the forest floor in
utter darkness.  The trail leads east and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow trail leads east to a somewhat lighter part of the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6004, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe8a8d0b60e494463", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7f65af2c1f5c6f18"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6101, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe8a8d0b60e494463", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb71d0a8f9969f27b6"}

name: Bashful little cloud.
description:
This cloud blushes and tries to avoid your glance as you look at
your surroundings.  You decide that overall it is a peaceful little
cloud.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A sleepy little cloud to the south yawns and rolls over.  You hear\nsnoring.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9129, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7bd26216b7a21716", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8accf766e967cddb"}

name: The Eastern Market Square
description:
You stand in the market of New Thalos, the gem of the desert. The
market is the hub of the city; all trade and commerce of any significance is
carried on here. The market spreads out in all directions save east; here
Main Street heads for the eastern gate.

name: Primary Assembly Line
description:
This is the primary assembly line of the mob factory. Here, all the
mobs seen roaming around the city of Midgaard are manufactured from
raw materials. There is a big conveyor belt present which makes a lot
of noise! It seems that the workers are making drunks today. Exits are
east to the secondary assembly line, north and south to the primary
assembly line.

name: Walking the Silvery Strand
description:
You are standing atop a silvery strand of light that twists and turns
through the astral field.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see the endless expanse of the astral field.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7727, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcaf74c0b1c636275", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe93b9dbddddb2a61"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see the infinite expanse of the astral field.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7722, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcaf74c0b1c636275", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2579408424ebbca7"}

name: Queen's waiting room
description:
This is the Queen's waiting room.  Here the men literally
'wait' for the queen.  You've heard that the queen really likes
to get to 'know' her people, in the biblical sense.  The queen's
bedroom is to the north, and you can see stairs to the west.

name: Long Hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you
look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you.
To the south is a door.

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow alley leads east to a wider street and west to one of
the city watchtowers.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5315, "room_id": "69f4d0cba3ef73c85fa5d882", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbad29f80241e34673"}

name: The Electric Playground
description:
Though there is a seemingly carefree atmosphere here, you sense that
something much more important takes place near by.  The playground is
south and west.  Something more important catches your eye to the east.

name: Courtyard South
description:
Once full of lush green plants, it is now barren of growth.  A set of
stairs used to extend up to a suite of rooms but the set is missing
stairs 3-15.  The courtyard extends north and there is a street to
the south.

name: The Dark Forest
description:
You stomp your way through the underbrush.  The dark forest of Miden'nir
get pretty thick here, and the branches high above your head are so thick that
they block out all direct sunlight.  While it is much too thick to go
further east, you might be able to make your way though the forest to the
south and west.

name: Mage's Laboratory
description:
This is the Magical Experiments Laboratory.  Dark smoke-stained stones
arch over numerous huge oaken tables, most of these cluttered with strange-
looking pipes and flasks.  The floor is covered with half-erased pentagrams
and even weirder symbols, and a blackboard in a dark corner has only been
partially cleaned, some painful-looking letters faintly visible.  A well in
the middle of the floor leads down into darkness.  Vile smells waft from the
depths.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You can't see what is down there, it is too dark.  Looks like it would be\nimpossible to climb back up.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7017, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc235ad2692b55537", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb991c03e53ad3d011"}

name: Eastern Side of the Temple
description:
You are still wandering around this temple.  You notice exits lie in all
directions except east.

name: The tunnel
description: You are in a corner tunnel leading west and north.

name: Dead End
description: You are at what appears to be a dead end.  The only exit is back east.

name: Desolate ruins
description:
Several mausoleums used to grace the way here but these have been
defiled. And most have been torn down and burned by looters. Some still
seem to be intact to the south.  To the northwest is a seeming field of
tombs of soldiers, now a battleground for the undead.

name: The rocky shoreline
description:
You are on a rocky shore that borders a vast sea. A stiff wind blows here and
whistles among the rocks. You see an altar of some sort built on the shore to
the south. The shore itself leads east and west. Looking up, you see foothills
and rocky crags.

name: A dark passage
description:
You are at the end of a dark passage. A half opened door is to the east,
shedding soft light around the edges. Faint snoring sounds can be heard
behind the door.
Exits lead east through the door, or back west.

name: The Guardian's Room
description:
A chair sits here for a tireless guardian who ensures that no
soul escapes.  The room is undecorated.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "chair", "description": "An ordinary chair, well used, glued to the ground by spiderweb.", "valid": true}

name: The Sands of Sorrow
description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around you.
You feel lost.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5029, "room_id": "69f4d0cba728b9b7c3bfb432", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb81856b58e50eeb9"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5030, "room_id": "69f4d0cba728b9b7c3bfb432", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb47e6538ea676626e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5031, "room_id": "69f4d0cba728b9b7c3bfb432", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6306924c55d35b54"}

name: Pustule Palace Cafe
description:
A scabrous hole.  Run by Ernie Ramirez, an ex-perp, it is a meeting place
for the low-life in the area.

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.

name: A Long Hallway
description:
You are now inside of the fortress; you must be lucky that the guards
haven't killed you.  As you glance around, you notice that the walls and
floors are spotlessly cleaned.  The barracks are to the north and a
storage room is to the south.

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way east-west between huge, ancient trees
whose grey trunks remind you of ancient pillars in a enormous, deserted hall.
To the south, a frail path leads away from the trail.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6100, "room_id": "69f4d0cb71d0a8f9969f27b6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe8a8d0b60e494463"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The path leads south - away from the trail.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6104, "room_id": "69f4d0cb71d0a8f9969f27b6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc440d4d81582cafd"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6102, "room_id": "69f4d0cb71d0a8f9969f27b6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbfc3ebd03483518a"}

name: Sneezing little cloud.
description:
The cloud is wracked with sneezes.  At first you thought you were
in an earthquake before you realize where you are!
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "This cloud is, like, totally lost, you know?", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9134, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8678dfda4532c64f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6995250a7d5aa483"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The cloud to the south blushes and tries to hide when you look at\nit.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9132, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8678dfda4532c64f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7bd26216b7a21716"}

name: Primary Assembly Line
description:
This is the primary assembly line of the mob factory. Here, all the
mobs seen roaming around the city of Midgaard are manufactured from
raw materials. There is a big conveyor belt present which makes a lot
of noise! It seems that the workers are making drunks today. Exits are
east to the secondary assembly line and north to the primary
assembly line.

name: Deep Within the Astral Plane
description:
You have travelled deep inside the astral field.  Here the fabric of the
field has become twisted and warped due to the proximity of another plane of
existence.  Some of the tendrils of light that line the astral field have been
warped and twisted into portals to other worlds.
Take care before you step through one -- you might never return.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The astral field leads on into the depths.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7746, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3732fa85b08b56ee", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbafc42ffaf4106573"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The astral field leads on into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7728, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3732fa85b08b56ee", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc760d17ba8185cb1"}

name: Sultan's Walk
description:
This cobblestone road aides your journey through town. Traveling north will
take you by the palace and the Dancing Daemon Inn, and south will put you on
the market square.

name: Bedroom
description:
This is the Queen's bedroom.  The bed is all ruffled, and there
is a stack of dirty sheets piled in the corner.

A note has been scrawled in lipstick on the mirror:

I'm out looking for my birth control pills.
Why don't you slip into something comfortable while you're waiting?

name: Warrior's Barracks
description:
The room is a complete mess. None of the beds are made, clothes and other
items have been left all about the room. Well drow warriors never were known
for neatness.

name: The guild house
description:
You are standing in this city's ONLY guild house.  Tables and chairs
are set about for the occupants' comfort.  Weapons are stacked neatly on the
weapons rack.  Each weapon looks polished, sharpened, and oiled.
Draped along the back wall is the proud banner of Thalos in all its glory.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A small side street runs past the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5313, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5989fb08871d07a3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc06ad2a349e6920c"}

name: Lightning Causeway
description:
Up a set of stairs carved into the hill you see intermittent flashes of
lightning.  A continuous hum also comes form that direction.  To the west
is the electric playground.

name: The Armoury
description:
The armoury with all kinds of armours on the walls and in the window.  You
see helmets, shields and chain mails.  To the north is the main street.
On the wall is a small note.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "note", "description": "You can use these commands for trading:

value <item>     To get the price of an item in your possession.
sell <item>      To sell something.
buy <item>       To buy something (provided that the shop has it in store).
list             Gives you a listing of the shop's inventory.

WE DON'T GIVE CREDIT; WE DON'T EXPECT TO RECEIVE CREDIT!
NO HAGGLING", "valid": true}

name: Carnage
description:
Here, you see a gruesome sight. Blood is everywhere... on the trees and
soaked into the ground. Two carcasses lie in front of you, seeming to look
up at you. The forest is impassible to the south, but the other directions
look ok.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "carcass body corpse carcasses bodies corpses", "description": "The corpses looked as if they have been pierced by a large, jagged
spear. The damage these people sustained is simply amazing. Worse, the
lips on the bodies are a light shade of blue, hinting at poison in
their systems.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Your light does not extend that far.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3523, "room_id": "69f4d0cb639c9d9010e8d871", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2539d0840f3d9d9e"}

name: Old Abandoned Warehouse
description:
Once the center of a lucrative storage business, it has fallen to
disrepair like everything else.  It is now the hideout of the
Dragon gang.  The gang leader runs his reign of terror from here.
There is a wooden door barely on the hinges to the east.

name: Perseus' Chamber
description:
It is the chamber of the prince, Perseus.  However, he seems not to be here.
Maybe he has gone to get Pegasus to save Andromeda?

name: A Tertain's lair
description:
You quite possibly have made a terrible mistake coming in here.
Exits lead east and west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The passage leads west where you can see a bright light ahead.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9020, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2654eae5248a2a43", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb16ace95b5226c1cf"}

name: The large cave
description:
You are in a large cave, the cave continues east and west, to the south
you notice a small tunnel.

name: Curators place
description:
The undertaker, the historian and the curator used to be here. Now they
too have joined the legions of the undead.  From the looks of the place
they seem to have starved to death.  Rickety stairs head down into a
sort of basement.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "stairs basement", "description": "Surprisingly the stairs look sturdy enough.", "valid": true}

name: The rocky shore
description:
You stand at the base of some rocky hills, where they meet a rocky shore. A
vast sea is to your south. Looking to the southwest, you see a small altar
that glows with a eerie blue light. The shore stretches out to the south and
west. It is possible to climb up into the hills here.

name: Rietzik's Shuggy Hall
description:
A sleazy dive and the meeting place of a lot of perps.  Shuggy is a
twenty-second Century version of pool, played on a hilly table, usually
with large side bets.

name: Realm of the Hopeless
description:
Here you see many misguided souls who think they still live.
They search for those who killed them without warrant, and seek the
free souls of living beings to inhabit and perhaps adventure once
more.

name: The stagnant pool
description:
You are at the edge of a stagnant pool of water. The smell here is quite
nauseating. This is apparently where the denizens of the tower dispose of
their garbage. Faint gurgling can be heard from beneath the surface of the
pool.
Exits lead back north, or perhaps for the very adventurous, down into the
pool.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "No light penetrates the gloom of the stagnant pool.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1329, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb84e2949cdbf39d3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd02bdb20ac0156c8"}

name: A nomad camp
description:
This small group of desert nomads has stopped for the day to rest
and refresh themselves beside this beautiful oasis. Three tents and some
camels make up the party. From within two of the tents you hear muffled
voices, obviously surprised at your visit.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see inside one of the tents a huddled mass of people, probably slaves.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5057, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1f04fd450b00a477", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc0e0cd08e34b3206"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5025, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1f04fd450b00a477", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbadfcd09baf4a3a51"}

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads south and west.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.

name: A Long Hallway
description:
You are now inside of the fortress; you must be lucky that the guards
haven't killed you.  As you glance around, you notice that the walls and
floors are spotlessly cleaned.  A mess hall is to the south.

name: Dopey little cloud.
description:
This cloud is too busy daydreaming to watch where its going.  It
doesn't even notice you landing on it.  It looks like it couldn't
figure its way out of an open box.

name: Secondary Assembly Line
description:
This is the secondary asembly line of the mob factory. You are
surprised to see cityguard heads come floating on the conveyor belt!
The very sight is sickening, but the workers seem to be quite
cheerful about their work. Exits are south to the secondary assembly
line and west to the primary assembly line.

name: Deep Within the Astral Plane
description:
You have travelled deep inside the astral field.  Here the fabric of the
field has become twisted and warped due to the proximity of another plane of
existence.  Some of the tendrils of light that line the astral field have been
warped and twisted into portals to other worlds.
Take care before you step through one -- you might never return.

{"direction": 5, "description": "The astral field leads on into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7731, "room_id": "69f4d0cbafc42ffaf4106573", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb03858da5cbc1690b"}

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way east-west between huge, ancient trees
that stand close on all sides.  Not a sound is to be heard - everything is
ominously quiet.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6101, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbfc3ebd03483518a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb71d0a8f9969f27b6"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6103, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbfc3ebd03483518a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3a844930e2659f2a"}

name: Sultan's Walk
description:
This part of the road travels between one of the sturdy walls of the
Palace and the Dancing Daemon. To the east you peer through a small
window into the Daemon, seeing many people dancing and drinking. After
you tend to your other chores you plan on visiting the Daemon.
The walk continues north and south from here.

name: Hospital
description:
You are inside the Dwarven Hospital.  It smells like rubbing
alcohol, and there is blood all over the walls.

name: Long Hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved
with pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you
look down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you.

name: The produce stand
description:
A large cart sits here carrying fresh fruit and vegetables.
Hungry children swarm all about the tasty treats the merchants are
giving out for free.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The market place is jammed packed with people scurrying about.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5307, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6b5facbff922340c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf534c05d6879a2b4"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A strong aromatic smell emanates from the meat stand next to you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5317, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6b5facbff922340c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb58a494f0aadf3872"}

name: Lightning Chamber
description:
There is some sort of control panel here. Apparently the Lightning Ruler
observes and controls electric forces from here.  A set of steps carved into
the hill lead down to a causeway.

name: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Swordsmen
description:
The entrance hall to the Guild of Swordsmen.  A place where one has to be
careful not to say something wrong (or right).  To the east is the bar and to
the north is the main street.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the swordsmen's bar, many noises comes from there.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3022, "room_id": "69f4d0cb025f2272d3495d35", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3404cd253983a792"}

name: Deep in the Forest of Miden'nir
description:
There is a sickening stench here. It smells of blood and death.
To the north, you catch glimpses of daylight. To the east, you
simply cannot see. The trees are close and stifling.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see daylight and a trail to follow.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3518, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc8920436849bfe63", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb88bfda3ee42d47b7"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The stench seems to becoming from this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3521, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc8920436849bfe63", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb639c9d9010e8d871"}

name: Bronze Dragon Street at Warehouse
description:
The street runs north and south.  There is an old wooden door leading
to a warehouse to the west.  The warehouse LOOKS abandoned. . .

name: On the Mystic Chains
description:
You are dangling on the chains.  You notice exits lie in all directions.
Up above you see the chains continue upwards.  But a forcefield prevents
you from going further upwards.

name: The large cave
description: You are in the east end of the large cave.

name: A Tertian's lair
description:
You might have made a terrible mistake coming into here.
Exits lead east and west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The passage continues eastward where you can see a bright light.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9020, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9638f96790b6fa32", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb16ace95b5226c1cf"}

name: The edge of the sea
description:
You walk along the water's edge. The vastness of the ocean is staggering as
you look out across it. You notice a small altar that glows with blue light
to the east. The shore itself extends north away from the water's edge.

name: Fresh graves
description:
Graves of recent casualties lie here.  Even the most recent don't seem to
have been left undisturbed.  You hear sounds of digging in progress
further to the south.

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: Bazza's Home for the Terminally Sarky
description:
This is an experimental psychiatric home.  Named after a 20th Century
vid-critic, the home attempts, by various methods, to readjust the
socially unacceptable attitudes of the inmates.

name: A dark passage
description:
You are in a dark passage, which comes to an abrupt stop at what appears
to be a cave-in to the west. It is certainly unpassable, and perhaps quite
dangerous just being this close.
The only exit leads back east.

name: Realm of the Hopeless
description:
Here you see many misguided souls who think they still live.
They search for those who killed them without warrant, and seek the
free souls of living beings to inhabit and perhaps adventure once
more.

name: Inside a small tent
description:
This is a small and simple tent with few possessions in sight. Lying
here and there are young-looking men and women, possibly slaves to the
leader of this band.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Waving in the heat over the sand you see a HUGE pyramid.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8700, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc0e0cd08e34b3206", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb55114fbd1499f0ba"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see the center of the nomad camp.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5056, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc0e0cd08e34b3206", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1f04fd450b00a477"}

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.

name: The Barracks
description:
You now stand in the sleeping quarters of the gnome guards.  Every bed is
made perfectly, and not single article of clothing is on the floor.  There
is a small storage room to the east.

name: Secondary Assembly Line
description:
This is the secondary asembly line of the mob factory. You are
surprised to see cityguard heads come floating on the conveyor belt!
The very sight is sickening, but the workers seem to be quite
cheerful about their work. Exits are north and south to the secondary
assembly line and west to the primary assembly line.

name: Doc-like little cloud.
description:
The cloud looks at you through its Lennon like specs and examines
you quite scientifically.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "There is a pure white cloud south of you.  It is snowing!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9136, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9da2e23e5f1f4d6d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf70845eebef03c2b"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "This cloud is, like, totally lost, you know?", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9134, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9da2e23e5f1f4d6d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6995250a7d5aa483"}

name: Deep Within the Astral Plane
description:
You have travelled deep inside the astral field.  Here the fabric of the
field has become twisted and warped due to the proximity of another plane of
existence.  Some of the tendrils of light that line the astral field have been
warped and twisted into portals to other worlds.
Take care before you step through one -- you might never return.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The astral field leads on into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7734, "room_id": "69f4d0cbeb018b5f8e2449b7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5fe0480d49c1099c"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The astral field leads on into the depths.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7746, "room_id": "69f4d0cbeb018b5f8e2449b7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbafc42ffaf4106573"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The astral field leads on into infinity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7728, "room_id": "69f4d0cbeb018b5f8e2449b7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc760d17ba8185cb1"}

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are where the dusty trail bends, as to avoid conflict with a colossal
trunk to the west.  Not a sound is to be heard - everything is ominously quiet.
The trail leads east and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6102, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3a844930e2659f2a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbfc3ebd03483518a"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads south through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6108, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3a844930e2659f2a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb5e8d55a4ac5b0c5"}

name: Sultan's Walk
description:
The road here between the palace and the Dancing Daemon Inn seems well
worn by the travel of horses, carts, and leather boots. From the west you
hear the faint sound of trumpets announcing the arrival of some duke or
duchess to the palace. Safe haven awaits you to the east in the halls
of the Daemon, and Sultan's Walk continues north and south.

name: Granite Head's Bakery
description:
The aroma coming from this room is sensuous.  You can almost taste
the pastries dissolving in your mouth.

name: The smithy
description:
In here you find tools and anvils used to make various weapons
and items. The walls are fully stocked with pieces of armor and weaponry.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A small side street runs past the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5312, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7efb2336b30895ef", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb5a4b0ed5dd8912e"}

name: Grand Stairway
description:
You are standing at the bottom of a giant obsidian and adamantite
stairway. The edges are trimmed with gold.

name: The Bar of Swordsmen
description:
The bar of swordsmen, once upon a time beautifully furnished.  But now the
furniture is all around you in small pieces.  To the south is the yard, and
to the west is the entrance hall.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the entrance hall to the thieves guild.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3021, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3404cd253983a792", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb025f2272d3495d35"}

name: Mesa West
description:
An electric path starts to the west.  The mesa continues to the east.
Or you can climb down to the canyon floor to the south.

name: The Dark Forest
description:
The branches above you block out all direct sunlight, making the forest
in this area rather dark.  The forest continues east, where it meets the
mountains. The air is still and stuffy - a stench comes from the west and an
ugly feeling causes the hair to rise on the back of your neck!
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "It appears to get much darker that direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3520, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2539d0840f3d9d9e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb01357acfa3d508c5"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The sky becomes lighter in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3521, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2539d0840f3d9d9e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb639c9d9010e8d871"}

name: Yellow Dragon Road
description:
Yellow Dragon Road is the southern boundary of Troll Territory.  The
road extends east.  You enter "no-man's land" to the south.

name: The cave
description:
You are in the south end of a cave, to the south you see a tunnel. You
notice a large pile of bones in the corner.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "pile bones", "description": "Some of the bones are human!", "valid": true}

name: The Lair of Primus
description:
You are in a large hall, with a massive pool of what appears to be pure energy
in the center of the room.  Exits lead in all the cardinal directions.  From
the pool rises the master of the Plane of Nirvana....
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A passage leads north into the unknown.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9024, "room_id": "69f4d0cb16ace95b5226c1cf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb286555076974f5ae"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "A passage leads east into the unknown.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9018, "room_id": "69f4d0cb16ace95b5226c1cf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2654eae5248a2a43"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A passage leads south into the unknown.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9021, "room_id": "69f4d0cb16ace95b5226c1cf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc83e17acfddf88a5"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A passage leads west into the unknown.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9019, "room_id": "69f4d0cb16ace95b5226c1cf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9638f96790b6fa32"}

name: The Blood Sea Portal
description:
You stand on a small pedestal like altar that has been built on the shore
here. Standing here, you can look out across the sea. You can almost imagine
that you see a far away island. Dominating the altar is a small blue portal of
light. It is possible to walk south into the portal. The shore itself extends
to the north, east, and west.
There are small inscriptions on the rock at the base of the portal.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "small inscriptions inscription", "description": "\"Enter all ye who wish to join the Brotherhood!\"", "valid": true}

name: On a Hill
description:
Suddenly you find yourself on a hillside.  As you look around, you notice
that Spring has descended upon you.

name: Twisty cavern
description:
The way twist this way and that and its all you can do to keep your head
from spinning.  The air is very cold here and layers of ice on the wall.
The sounds of metal on ice echo through the cavern. A side passage leads
east and the main passage goes north and south.

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads north and east.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}

name: A dark cell
description:
You are in a dark cell. Straw and dirt cover the floors here, it is
very dark. Someone, or something seems to be chained to the far wall.
The only exit is back south.

name: Nu Phisog Parlour
description:
Opened as a direct rival to the New You Face Parlour chain to offer quick
and cheap face-changing facilities to the general public.  However,
since the closure of Sump's Ugly clinics, the craze for face-changing has
died down.

name: Beside the camels
description:
Here stand about ten camels, all hitched to some stakes plugged into
the ground. To the east you see a small tent while to the north you see a
larger, fancier tent.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "This tent seems to be the temporary abode of the nomad leader. You make a\nmental note to visit it before you leave.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5060, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0e1b69facf9000c4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb94a33d65e8157351"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "In this tent there are very large men, all carrying weapons.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5059, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0e1b69facf9000c4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3712d0ccbad53b04"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see the center of the nomad camp.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5056, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0e1b69facf9000c4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1f04fd450b00a477"}

name: The Donjonkeep
description:
No souls have ever lived in this place.  The wails of slaves
and the howls of wolves are the only way you can describe the sounds
you hear.  The walls are thin and wispy.  The only light you receive
is the shimmering from the strand of the ethereal web you used to get
here.

name: Secondary Assembly Line
description:
This is the secondary asembly line of the mob factory. You are
surprised to see cityguard heads come floating on the conveyor belt!
The very sight is sickening, but the workers seem to be quite
cheerful about their work. Exits are north and south to the secondary
assembly line and west to the primary assembly line.

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.

name: A Small Storage Room
description:
This is where the gnomes store all their spare clothing and armor.
There is not much here, but you might come up with something.

name: Snowy, white cloud.
description:
You shiver as you stand here.  This beautiful, fluffy, pure white
cloud is snowing.  The snow is pure and sweet as it melts in your
mouth.  What a nifty cloud to be on.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A happy, peaceful little cloud humming to itself.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9131, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf70845eebef03c2b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb870fd03ece10954c"}

name: Sultan's Walk
description:
The main road north from the square continues here, surrounded by the walls
of the palace and the Daemon. To the north you see the heavily guarded gate
and can make out faint sounds of trade to the south.

name: Deep Within the Astral Plane
description:
You have travelled deep inside the astral field.  Here the fabric of the
field has become twisted and warped due to the proximity of another plane of
existence.  Some of the tendrils of light that line the astral field have been
warped and twisted into portals to other worlds.
Take care before you step through one -- you might never return.

name: A small path in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  You feel as if
the ancient trees observe you in watchful silence.  The path continues north
and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6101, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc440d4d81582cafd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb71d0a8f9969f27b6"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6105, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc440d4d81582cafd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbefd5789d1397bbcb"}

name: The tapestry stand
description:
Beautiful tapestries and rugs hang all over the walls.  Fancy
robes and various articles of clothing hang about for sale. You stare with
awe at how much work must have been put into these cloths.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A fine jewelry stand lies majestically next to you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5325, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf2124acb1cd72999", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb86ca20499bf3b0ab"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The market place is swarming with people scurrying about.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5308, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf2124acb1cd72999", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7f5dbed65513e5f7"}

name: Grand Hallway
description:
You are standing in the middle of a grand hallway. The walls are
of the purest adamantite with gold trim. Mosaics line the walls.

name: Dark path
description:
This path is very well worn, and there is an entrance to the mines to the
east, while the path continues to the north and west.

name: Mesa East
description:
A path starts to the north.  The mesa continues to the west.
Or you can climb down to the canyon floor to the south.

name: The Tournament and Practice Yard
description:
The practice yard of the fighters.  To the north is the bar.  A well leads
down into darkness.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You can't see what is down there, it is too dark.  Looks like it would be\nimpossible to climb back up.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7048, "room_id": "69f4d0cb30a667aed80ac8bf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba5f8272147cc927f"}

name: Along the Eastern Road
description:
You are walking along a well-travelled road between Midgaard and lands
east.  A northern road crosses this one to the west, towards Midgaard.  You
hear faint, happy singing to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a faint trail, covered with tiny footprints. The singing grows louder.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 101, "room_id": "69f4d0cb78230f7039845fd6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd2d43ac251809cd5"}

name: Yellow Dragon Road
description: The road runs east and west.  Ice Dragon Way leads north from here.

name: A Tertian's lair
description:
Maybe coming here wasn't such a hot idea.  You feel very unwelcome here.
Exits lead north and south
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The passage leads north where you can see a bright light.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9020, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc83e17acfddf88a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb16ace95b5226c1cf"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The passage leads south into the unknown.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9022, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc83e17acfddf88a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd50f179d0e1568c7"}

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: The tunnel
description: You are in a north-south leading tunnel.

name: Inside a Spanish Bull-Ring
description:
You are inside what used to be a ground for bull fighting.  But you notice
there are no Matadors around.  Maybe they are all dead?

name: The edge of the sea
description:
You walk along the water's edge. The tide appears to have risen. Very little
debris is washed up on shore. You slip and slide as you tread across the
slippery rocks that make up the shore. To the west you see a small altar that
radiates blue light. The shore extends north away from the water's edge.

name: The Jailor's office
description:
You are in the Jailor's office. It is rather messy here. Judging by the
sleeping form of the Jailor on duty, you can surmise that very few, if any
prisoners survive long enough to spend much time in these dank dungeons.
The only exit leads back west.

name: Striped tunnel
description:
The walls of the tunnels have many brilliant colors in them from the
various veins of crystals running in them.  An odd twinkling comes from
the east.

name: The Single Spider Line
description:
A single spider line supports you once more.  As you look
across the ether you seen a single shack up ahead with a light in
the window.  You sense a great evil coming from the east and feel
inclined to go back on the ethereal web and take your chances there.

name: The warrior's tent.
description:
This tent has a few furnishings, but mainly it holds the band's
protectors. They all stare at you coldly as you enter.

name: Ziggi Piggi's Home for the Semi-Stiff
description:
The only suspended animation parlour in the area.  It has a high turnover
rate.  It is rumored that the patrons are being used in body sharking and
organ legging activities.

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.

name: Secondary Assembly Line
description:
This is the secondary asembly line of the mob factory. You are
surprised to see cityguard heads come floating on the conveyor belt!
The very sight is sickening, but the workers seem to be quite
cheerful about their work. Exits are north and south to the secondary
assembly line and west to the primary assembly line.

name: A Small Storage Room
description:
This is where the gnomes store all their spare weapons.  A door leads off
to the east.

name: Cold, damp cloud.
description:
Your mood grows grumpy as you find yourself cold and wet from this
dismal cloud.  You notice a rock outcropping above you.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "There is a pure white cloud east of you.  It is snowing!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9136, "room_id": "69f4d0cba1b987e609f19d02", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf70845eebef03c2b"}

field has become twisted and warped due to the proximity of another plane of

warped and twisted into portals to other worlds.
Take care before you step through one -- you might never return.
