name: A small path in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient grey
trees loom all around you.  The path continues north and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6104, "room_id": "69f4d0cbefd5789d1397bbcb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc440d4d81582cafd"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6106, "room_id": "69f4d0cbefd5789d1397bbcb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcbde451fda8e8809"}

name: Inside the Northern Gate of New Thalos
description:
Two large stone towers rise up to greet you with a massive iron gate
swinging between on ornately crafted hinges and emblazend with the crest of
New Thalos. The makers of this city spared no costs in rebuilding the
defenses of their home. Sultan's Walk runs to the south and the Casbah
stretches out east and west. To the north lay wilderness of the desert.

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow alley leads north to one of the city watchtowers while
to the south there lies a market stand full of expensive clothes and rugs.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5324, "room_id": "69f4d0cb23bf7b11834dee8d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0039a40eb7f4cb4d"}

name: Mage's Barracks
description:
The mage's living quarters is rather clean with the exception of a few
used component containers. It is rather well decorated as well. Cots line the
floor for the mages to sleep on. the only door is to the west.

name: Mine entrance
description:
The little path here leads down toward the mines, while the worn path
continues to the west.

name: Floating in Air
description:
Last you knew, you were walking on the mesa.  Abruptly the path dropped
from beneath your feet much to quick for you to recover.  Instead of
plunging to your death, you seemingly miss the ground and begin walking
on air.  The space to the north and east seems just thin air, but you can
walk there.  The pathway you came from is to the south.

name: Eastern End of Poor Alley
description:
You are at the poor alley. South of here is the Grubby Inn and to the
east you see common square. Melancholy's map shop is north. The alley continues
further west.

name: Along the Eastern Road
description:
You are travelling down the eastern road between Midgaard and the eastern
lands.  The road back to Midgaard is west of you, and a heavily guarded
checkpoint is east.  A beautiful grove of trees is north, and a dirt path
wanders off to the south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a beautiful, shady grove -- it looks like a peaceful place to relax.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8950, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9272c968f7636ae5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcfa66de9a1d689f1"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The road continues west towards a guarded checkpoint.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3527, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9272c968f7636ae5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb73529ec62370d247"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A dirt path leads to the gnome village.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1501, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9272c968f7636ae5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc05c00eeac54b835"}

name: Yellow Dragon Road
description:
The roads continues east and west.  There is a courtyard to the north.
You enter "no man's land" to the south.

name: A Gravel Path on the Graveyard
description:
You are on a gravel path winding its way between dark evergreen trees on
the graveyard.  The path leads south and west.  An old tomb is here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb stone", "description": "It is a large rectangular slab of dark grey stone that has been placed face\nup in the ground.  The name has been erased by the ravages of time.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The gravel path continues westwards towards a gravel road.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3600, "room_id": "69f4d0cb80e3599568d87978", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba15557d97dd98d0c"}

name: The office of a Quinton
description:
You have stumbled upon the office of a page to Primus.
Scrolls lie about the room along with many strange objects...you can't imagine
what kind of creature would use them.  Exits lead in all the cardinal
directions.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The passage heads northward where you can see nothing.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9021, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd50f179d0e1568c7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc83e17acfddf88a5"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The passage goes east where you feel it might be bad to go.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9046, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd50f179d0e1568c7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8f9a5b6ec9b99c9e"}

name: The hole
description: You are by a hole in the floor, you can leave down, or north.

name: Inside a study
description:
This is a strange study. Besides the desks and chairs you also see a large
mirror in the middle.  So, you wonder, is this how you make a Gemini into
two Gemini?

name: Floating in blue light
description:
You seem to be floating in blue weightlessness. You tumble head over heels and
finally right yourself. Gaining your bearings, you notice that there are two
"windows" in the sea of blue here. One to the south shows an image of a snowy
plain. Another window the the north shows an image of a rocky shore.

name: Below the stagnant pool
description:
As you dive beneath the putrid waters, you feel a strong tug and a whirlpool
drags you under.  You are sucked into blackness.  You feel your lungs burst
from lack of oxygen.  Just as you feel your life fading, you notice a change in
direction ... and are sucked under by a rip tide.

name: Prism cave
description:
The roof of this cave peaks over a hundred feet high making it one of
the biggest in the catacombs.  Crystals of every color cast prismatic
sprays of light everywhere.  The light from your lamp causes almost a
blinding flare of brilliance as more light is added to the multi-colored
twinkling phenomenon that exists here.  This is also the lair of the
fabled and feared Prism Dragon.

name: The main tent
description:
This tent is as lavishly decorated on the inside as it is on the
outside. A fancy carpet lies on the sand and numerous baskets line the
walls.

name: The Single Spider Line
description:
A single spider line supports you once more.  The shack comes
closer into view and you are even more inclined to go back now.

name: Throt & Gleep's Megger Store
description:
This place promises to provide everything that the citizens don't need,
with the utmost discourtesy.  Of course, something as crazy as this was
bound to succeed.  There is a door to the north with a slot next to it.
There is also a sign next to the slot.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "To open insert card.", "valid": true}

name: Secondary Assembly Line
description:
This is the secondary asembly line of the mob factory. You are
surprised to see cityguard heads come floating on the conveyor belt!
The very sight is sickening, but the workers seem to be quite
cheerful about their work. Exits are north to the secondary
assembly line and west to the primary assembly line.

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.

name: A Small Storage Room
description:
This is yet another room for storing gnome stuff.  Maps and battle plans
are stored in neat stacks on the shelves.

name: Mysterious rock outcropping.
description:
This rock outcropping just seems to hang in midair.  To the north
you see a house and if you ease yourself down, you can land on a
rather damp, dismal cloud.  The door to the house is closed.

name: Inside the Githyanki Keep
description:
You are standing just inside a nexial portal that leads out onto the
Astral Plane.  It seems that you have found the lair of the Githyanki,
the once-human followers of Lord Gith.  Ahead of you stands a steel door
leading into the keep hewn from stone.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "steel", "description": "The door is made from a set of rusting steel plates set deep into the stone.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a rusty steel door which leads into the keep.", "keyword": "steel", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7751, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6f09c793382dd4f1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf4df398885f2d6c1"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "Below you is the nexial portal that leads into the astral plane.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7745, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6f09c793382dd4f1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3732fa85b08b56ee"}

name: A junction in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are by a junction where three paths meet.  Ancient grey trees tower above
you on all sides.  Paths lead east, south and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6105, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcbde451fda8e8809", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbefd5789d1397bbcb"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6117, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcbde451fda8e8809", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb27a0334bde46d728"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6107, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcbde451fda8e8809", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5469708187ac879f"}

name: Inside the West Gate of New Thalos
description:
Two large stone towers embedded in the wall loom over you. The massive
iron gate, emblazoned with the crest of New Thalos, swings easily on
four ornately crafted hinges. It is obvious the makers of this city
spared no expense to protect their home.  Main street heads towards
the market eastward and the eastern road passes through the Sands of
Sorrow to your west. To the south lies the entrance of the warrior's guild.

name: Village street
description:
You stand at the small village street in Ofcol.
From here you see small houses and only few people.
North of here the village street continues up to the small
square where some people are gathered as always.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You look up the village street noticing nothing special at all.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5551, "room_id": "69f4d0cb460511b61df59f1e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb29764cb2a09d924a"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The wide road leads south here towards the T-crossing.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 314, "room_id": "69f4d0cb460511b61df59f1e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe821adad42efcaa7"}

name: Grand Hallway
description:
You are walking down a grand hallway, heavily decorated with adamantite
and gold. To the north the hall goes down a flight of stairs while a door is
too the west.

name: Under the watchtower
description:
You stand under one of the city watchtowers built to protect
the city from invaders.  You know that you are safe from any danger.

name: Inside the mine
description:
There are holes everywhere from the places that the workers blew
away the rock to get to whatever they were looking for.  A path leads
down and up.

name: Floating in Air
description:
You look down and see the ground 100 feet below you.  The wind whispering
in your ear seems to reassure you that this is fine.  To the north aways
you spy a portal of sorts.  To the west is more thin air.

name: Yellow Dragon Road
description:
There is a barred window to the north.  There appears to be a light
coming from the cracks around it.  The road extends east and west
from here.  Or you can enter "no man's land" south from here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "window", "description": "Looking through the window, you see a gang leader plotting the demise of\nthe ogres.", "valid": true}

name: The Common Square
description:
The common square, people pass you, talking to each other.  To the west is
the poor alley and to the east is the dark alley.  To the north, this square
is connected to the market square.  From the south you notice a nasty smell.

name: The Checkpoint
description:
You are met by a group of heavily armored knights.  They check you over
for contraband, and then allow you to pass on.  One of the knights cautions to
not stray into the desert, lest you lose your way.

name: In a dusty Tomb
description:
You are in a dark burial chamber beneath a large tomb stone.
The only exit appears to be up.

name: A wide north-south passageway
description: you find yourself in a passage where the exits are north and south
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north, you spy an intersection of tunnels.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9022, "room_id": "69f4d0cbde15655d623383ba", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd50f179d0e1568c7"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can barely make out a junction of passageways.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9011, "room_id": "69f4d0cbde15655d623383ba", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8cfd2b2779b86fdc"}

name: Along the seashore
description:
You start to feel the heat of Summer.  Amongst the rocky beach you notice
hidden forms which could be camouflaged crabs.

name: The hole
description: A hole in the floor leads down here.

name: Ruined monument
description:
A monument to a famous king once stood here. Not much is left to even
signify that is was here at all.  A building of some sort can be entered
through a basement to the east.  The southern gate of the grounds is to
the south.

name: The swampy path
description:
This damp path seems to lead into a deep, dark swamp. The trees above block
out all light and stifle the wind. You smell swamp gas and hear damp squashing
sounds all around you. The path leads east deeper into the swamp. You also see
a dark forest to the west.

name: The hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: The Hermit's Corner
description:
Here you see evidence of a vagrant's abode.  The shack is to the
east, if you dare enter it.  You get the sneaking feeling you should
go back now.  The skies above you darken and roar with the laughter
of thunder.

name: The main tent
description:
This is where the leader of this band of nomads resides. He is
definitely rich as you inspect the tapestries, baskets, and a few
paintings as well.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the entrance to this tent.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5060, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcb950c2de66c4fb9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb94a33d65e8157351"}

name: Stockroom of Throt & Gleep's Megger Store
description:
Many useless items stock the shelves of this stockroom.  A door leads
south and large vault door is to the north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "vault door", "description": "This vault seems impervious to breaking.  There is a keyhole in the lock\nhowever.", "valid": true}

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.

name: West Main Street
description:
This is the main road traveling though the city. To the south you hear
the hammering of the repair shop and to the north is the grassy field
known as the temple square. Main street continues east and west.

name: The Mess Hall
description:
You are in the room where the guards come to get their grub.  The benches
and tables are neatly cleaned and straightened, while shiny plates line
the walls.

name: Foyer.
description:
Shadows play tricks on your eyes.  Everytime you think you see
something in a corner and turn to get a better look, nothing is
there.  The place is very dark.  Even with a torch, you have
trouble making out the room to the east.

name: A guard station
description:
This is a small building just inside the keep.  Doors lead out to the east
and west.  Some small weapons hang on hooks on the walls, for use in defense
of the keep.
Doors stand in all directions save north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "steel", "description": "The door is made from a set of rusting steel plates set deep into the stone.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see an iron door which leads out onto a grey stone road.", "keyword": "door iron", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7761, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf4df398885f2d6c1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb375dd9d928127602"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see a rusty steel door which leads out to the nexial link.", "keyword": "steel", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7750, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf4df398885f2d6c1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6f09c793382dd4f1"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see an iron door which leads out onto a grey stone road.", "keyword": "door iron", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7752, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf4df398885f2d6c1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb137f5dc8df91df55"}

name: A small path in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient grey
trees loom all around you.  The path continues north and east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6108, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5469708187ac879f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb5e8d55a4ac5b0c5"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6106, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5469708187ac879f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcbde451fda8e8809"}

name: Village street
description:
You are standing on the village street of Ofcol.
East from here is a small alley and north you enter the village
square. Towards the south you can leave Ofcol.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The village square is as usual not overcrowded.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5552, "room_id": "69f4d0cb29764cb2a09d924a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbaae8382c7ae79c3"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see the village street eventually becoming the wide road.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5550, "room_id": "69f4d0cb29764cb2a09d924a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb460511b61df59f1e"}

name: Cleric's Barracks
description:
The bed chamber is brightly decorated with spider shaped statues, murals
and the like. Large beds line the floor making this a comfortable room to live
in.

name: Path in the mine
description:
You are deep inside the mine, and you feel very uncomfortable.  The
path continues to the east, and leads to the mineshaft to the west.

name: The jewelery stand
description:
A table stands covered with fine jewelery and gems.  The jeweler
stands proudly over his collection as he polishes and cleans each one.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The market place is packed with people scurrying about doing their\nbusiness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5307, "room_id": "69f4d0cb86ca20499bf3b0ab", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf534c05d6879a2b4"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Next to you is a stand full of fine clothes and expensive rugs.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5322, "room_id": "69f4d0cb86ca20499bf3b0ab", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf2124acb1cd72999"}

name: Floating in Air
description:
You look down and see the ground 100 feet below you.  The wind whispering
in your ear seems to reassure you that this is fine.  To the east aways
you spy a portal of sorts.  To the south is more thin air.

name: The Dark Alley
description:
The dark alley, to the west is the common square and to the south is the
Guild of Thieves.  Grebe's Tavern, the famous sailor's dive, is north.
The alley continues east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "guild", "description": "It is the thieves guild, don't enter if you care about your health or money.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the entrance to the thieves guild.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3027, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd8c200a7bdb6b632", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb803aac4d953c0a5c"}

name: Along the Eastern Road
description:
You are walking along a well-travelled road, just east of a heavily
guarded checkpoint.  You have covered about half the distance between
the city of Midgaard and New Thalos.  The air is getting drier and the heat
more oppressive as you near the the barren wastes of the Sands of Sorrow.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The road continues ahead, growing more arid as you near the desert.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3529, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0ccae0263055885f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9b5091bc40892496"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a heavily guarded checkpoint to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3527, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0ccae0263055885f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb73529ec62370d247"}

name: Yellow Dragon Road
description:
Bronze Dragon Street intersects here and runs north.  Yellow Dragon ends
here but continues to the west.

name: Within the Deep Jungle
description:
Nearby you can hear the roar of an animal.  Peering through the dense
overgrowth you think you glimpse a pair of menacing eyes.

name: A Tertian's lair
description: You find yourself in a lair of a Tertian.  Exits lead north and south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north, you can make out a intersection of tunnels.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9025, "room_id": "69f4d0cb286555076974f5ae", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcdc7009a4ee8915b"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, you can see a bright light.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9020, "room_id": "69f4d0cb286555076974f5ae", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb16ace95b5226c1cf"}

name: The damp tunnel
description:
You are in a damp tunnel.  Your clothes feel wet.  The tunnel continues
to the north; to the west you see a hole in the floor; and to the east
there is a large cave.

name: Basement
description:
Its dark and it smells like. ...BATS down here!  All you see is a swirl
of the darkness and lots of scratching bats madly flailing around. A set
of stairs go up into the building and a broken window leads west.

name: The swampy path
description:
You tread lightly in a wet, swampy path. All around you, you see pools of
quicksand and rotting vegetation. Unlike the forest to the west, the swamp is
teeming with life. Some of it is harmless, some is not. The path leads east
and west into more swamp.

name: Strange Glowing Sand
description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around
you.  But this patch of desert looks different...the sand glows.  You see a
futuristic city to the south.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5029, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1b2da87cd53e1664", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb81856b58e50eeb9"}

name: A bend in the hallway
description:
You are at a bend in the hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by.

name: Mahatma's Inescapable Trap
description:
Mahatma, that silly thief, is here, and he steals everything you
have.  He says, 'Here, have a quick trip to the Temple of Midgaard.'
He plunges a black dagger into your back ...

name: Throt & Gleep's Vault
description: The vault is musty with a slight smell of ozone in the air.

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see unfathomable blackness to the south ...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3472, "room_id": "69f4d0cb20c3086e7c6c60fe", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb056e61fcb6dac21b"}

name: West Main Street
description:
A foreman stands stand here watching over two construction workers
fixing a pothole. The road here branches off north and south into
two alleys behind the stores of the market. The main street continues
east and west from here.

name: A Small Room
description: This is a small plain room.  Its only interesting feature is a ladder down.

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way between huge, ancient trees
standing close on all sides.  The trail leads north and west and to the south,
a frail path leads away from the trail.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads north through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6103, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb5e8d55a4ac5b0c5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3a844930e2659f2a"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The path leads south - away from the trail.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6107, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb5e8d55a4ac5b0c5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5469708187ac879f"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6109, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb5e8d55a4ac5b0c5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb01851ce0b594d9ed"}

name: Tower.
description:
You are in a musty old tower.  The smell of mold and mildew is
almost overpowering.  You hear strange creaks and groans ... is it
the wind or did someone (something?) make that noise.  To the west
is the house and there is a stairway leading up into the tower.

name: A grey road
description:
The ground beneath your feet is a uniformly grey cobblestone.  A dull red
sun hangs in an orange sky above your head; you hear none of the sounds you
would commonly associate with a normal city.
The cobblestone road turns to the north, ending to the east at an iron door.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door iron", "description": "The door is made from a set of iron plates set deep into the stone.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see an iron door which leads into a small stone building set into the wall\nof the keep.", "keyword": "door iron", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7751, "room_id": "69f4d0cb137f5dc8df91df55", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf4df398885f2d6c1"}

name: Grand Stairway
description:
You are climbing a set of obsidian stairs surrounded by adamantite walls.
To the north are a set of large golden doors.

name: Mine crossroad
description:
You are at a crossroad in the mine.  There is a door to the north,
and the path continues to the south, east, and west.

name: Village square
description:
The village square is a place where inhabitants of Ofcol gather
to talk, trade and sell items and just have a good time.
You see a small shop to the west and the local inn to the north.
If you leave south you go to village street.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a local inn called 'The Ofcol Local Inn'. Looks nice.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5556, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbaae8382c7ae79c3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf473989de78b12bd"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see the village street of Ofcol.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5551, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbaae8382c7ae79c3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb29764cb2a09d924a"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A small shop with the sign 'Luxan's Mixed goods' hanging in front of it.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5555, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbaae8382c7ae79c3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb692d7f5351ce355"}

name: A simple clay dwelling
description:
This is a very plain house with a few chairs and a bed.
A warmed and lit fireplace suggests that the dwelling is currently
occupied.  You should leave before the owner finds you here.

name: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Thieves
description:
The entrance hall to the thieves' and assassins' guild.  A place where you
can lose both your life and your money, if you are not careful.  To the north
is the dark alley and to the east is the thieves' bar.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the thieves bar, where everything disappears.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3028, "room_id": "69f4d0cb803aac4d953c0a5c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8a6ee9f7be1c2c61"}

name: NO MAN'S LAND
description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories.  This
is usually where the violence starts.  No Man's land continues south
and east; or there is a street to the north.

name: Along the Eastern Road
description:
The tempatures are climbing as you near the Sands of Sorrow, a barren
wasteland blasted by arcane powers.  Ahead of you, the road is partially
buried by the creeping sands, and the air grows even hotter.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the Sands of Sorrow spilling over the road.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3530, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9b5091bc40892496", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5c2c0c787bf94630"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The road continues to the west, towards distant Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3528, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9b5091bc40892496", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0ccae0263055885f"}

name: Floating in Air
description:
You look down and see the ground 100 feet below you.  The wind whispering
in your ear seems to reassure you that this is fine. There is a portal
hanging in midair here. It is to the east.  You can float south or west
if you'd like.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "portal", "description": "Through the portal you see a tunnel.", "valid": true}

name: The large cave
description:
You are in the western part of the large cave, to the south you see
a damp tunnel.

name: Inside a Luxurious Bedroom
description:
A peaceful feeling overtakes you.  You see a magnificent four-poster bed.
It's a double bed and there is only room for one more!  Well, what now ... ?

name: A north south tunnel
description: You are in a passage where the only exits are north and south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Far to the north you can see a door.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9026, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcdc7009a4ee8915b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb85623eb27497f3bb"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you stare into darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9024, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcdc7009a4ee8915b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb286555076974f5ae"}

name: Fresh graves
description:
The graves here seem very recent.  You notice many signs of digging and
defilement.  There are piles of fresh bodies here awaiting burial.  A
strange sense of evil magic from the south makes the hairs on the back
of your neck to stand on end!

name: The swampy path
description:
You weave your way through the treacherous swamp. Gas rises all around you and
a damp mist covers the ground, making it impossible to travel safely, without
carefully picking your way around obstacles. Large, gnarled trees rise above
you. Their moss covered branches block out all traces of the sun. The path
here leads east and west.

name: The wind-swept ledge
description:
Being very careful not to lose your balance, you look around and
find that this canyon is about a half a kilometer deep. To the west is
a dark cave leading under the desert sands.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Sand as far as the eye can see.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5031, "room_id": "69f4d0cba3e9f79713785ed4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6306924c55d35b54"}

name: A store room
description:
You are in a small store room. Assorted junk is piled on shelves or
leaning against walls.
The only apparent exit it back south.

name: The Entrance to the Arachnos' Lair
description:
All strands inevitably lead here, the center of the web, the
entrance to Arachnos' Lair.

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.

name: West Main Street
description:
You are strolling on the street between Nabil's Exotic Animals and the general
store. To the west you hear a roadcrew at work and to the East, the sounds of
commerce taking place.  The air is filled with the smell of gold and riches.
On the wall of the store is a poster.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "poster", "description": "A wealthy man in red robes is smiling at you.  The caption reads:\n\nTHE SULTAN REMINDS YOU TO PAY YOUR TAXES!", "valid": true}

name: Witches Tower
description:
Here you see strange things of arcane value.  There is a cauldron in the
corner bubbling madly, belching a foul brew that must have come from hell.
On shelves lie jars of strange creatures you have never seen before, or
hope to again.  A picture of a familiar temple hangs on the east wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "picture", "description": "The picture is in on the east wall.  It is very complex in detail, and you\nalmost see people walking around the temple in the picture.", "valid": true}

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way east-west between huge, ancient trees
that stand close on all sides.  Not a sound is to be heard - everything is
ominously quiet.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6108, "room_id": "69f4d0cb01851ce0b594d9ed", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb5e8d55a4ac5b0c5"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6110, "room_id": "69f4d0cb01851ce0b594d9ed", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe78ed7e72d5ed0a5"}

name: A Small Unused Room
description:
You stand in a small room in an unused section of the fortress.  The whole
room is coated with dust and cobwebs.  The ladder leads back up, and
a rusty door is to the east.

name: A stone dwelling
description:
This small house is the dwelling of a humble citizen of Thalos.
A few rafters stand with thatched straw blowing with the wind gusts
blowing through the city.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A small side street runs past the house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5311, "room_id": "69f4d0cb529c0f62bb04d6db", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb99f4950be0e8cc58"}

name: Main Chamber
description:
This is the south side of a large auditorium used for services by the
drow priestesses. In the center is a large sacrificial pit and beyond that is
an altar.

name: The small alley
description:
You are in a small, quiet alley.  From here you see the village street
to the west and a small room lies to the south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "It looks like the future site of a training room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5554, "room_id": "69f4d0cb180a21a11f9e9b88", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0ad3d0f91f3098f9"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You notice nothing but the village street.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5551, "room_id": "69f4d0cb180a21a11f9e9b88", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb29764cb2a09d924a"}

name: A grey road
description:
The ground beneath your feet is a uniformly grey cobblestone.  A dull red
sun hangs in an orange sky above your head; you hear none of the sounds you
would commonly associate with a normal city.
The cobblestone road continues to the north and south.  Doors to the east
and west lead into stone buildings.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door wooden", "description": "The door is thick, made from a knotted and twisted greyish wood.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a small stone building with a wooden door.", "keyword": "door wooden", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7762, "room_id": "69f4d0cb07b46cced2971003", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc256a1c22e9e7d51"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "An iron door blocks your entrance into a large stone building.", "keyword": "door iron", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7769, "room_id": "69f4d0cb07b46cced2971003", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb20a08c570944319a"}

name: Coal Room
description:
You are inside the storage area for the raw materials
that are found down here.  The room is very unsturdy as the
supports are very rickety.

name: NO MAN'S LAND
description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories.  This
is usually where the violence starts.  No Man's land continues south
east and west.

name: The Thieves Bar
description:
The bar of the thieves.  Once upon a time this place was beautifully
furnished, but now it seems almost empty.  To the south is the yard, and to
the west is the entrance hall.
(Maybe the furniture has been stolen?!)
extraDescription: {"keyword": "furniture", "description": "As you look at the furniture, the chair you sit on disappears.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the entrance hall to the thieves guild.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3027, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8a6ee9f7be1c2c61", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb803aac4d953c0a5c"}

name: Near the Sands of Sorrow
description:
The eastern road is losing ground to the creeping desert here.  You stagger
in the growing heat, and wonder if you have enough water.  The endless waste
of the Sands of Sorrows is south, and the road continues east and west.  The
sun paints illusions at the edge of your vision, one of them looks like a far
off city...
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The road ahead is almost lost in the desert.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3531, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5c2c0c787bf94630", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9058a0892b1175d7"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a clearer section of road.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3529, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5c2c0c787bf94630", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9b5091bc40892496"}

name: Windy Tunnel
description:
A tunnel leads east.  To the west you can enter a portal. The wind in
this tunnel is quite fierce, it seems as if it's forced.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "portal", "description": "Through the portal you see nothing but sky.", "valid": true}

name: The Supreme Court
description:
You are standing inside the dock of a court.  You feel an overwhelming
sense of guilt and you want to protest your innocence!  You fear retribution
and feel yourself exposed, just like the trees in Autumn.

name: Southern gate
description:
A rusty gate here no longer keeps anyone out or in.  You see a lonely
E/W passage to the south.  A little used trail winds east through a
crack in the wall.

name: An intersection of passages
description:
You stand at an intersection.  Exits lead off to the east and south.
A door lies to the north
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east, you spy a dark passage", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9032, "room_id": "69f4d0cb85623eb27497f3bb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb336679cda39c78d9"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you stare into oblivion.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9025, "room_id": "69f4d0cb85623eb27497f3bb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcdc7009a4ee8915b"}

name: The damp tunnel
description: You are in a corner of a damp tunnel.  You can go west or south.

name: The Sticky Chamber
description:
You can still bail out since your knees are shaking from the
anticipation (or is it fear?).  The sky is clear on this strand of
web, surprisingly unsticky.  The strand does not vibrate like the
others.  A few ballooning spiders pass by, cackling "You're gonna
die, you're gonna fry.  Good bye!"

name: The turn in the swampy path
description:
You come upon a bend in the swampy path. The ground here is fairly sturdy,
as this place is elevated above the rest of the swamp. Looking around, you see
a dark, mist filled swamp. Small paths lead south and west into the mist.

name: The cave mouth
description:
The air in here is MUCH cooler than outside. From the west you hear
strange sounds, but can see nothing. The cave slopes down into the
darkness.

name: A broom closet
description:
You are in a dark broom closet. Many straw brooms and other cleaning
instruments have been left here, apparently unused (perhaps the maid quit?).
The only exit leads back north to the hallway.

name: East Main Street
description:
Here on East Main, you smell the odor of freshly slaughtered meat and
hear the pounding of new metal from the armory.  The Square is to
the west and a junction is to the East.

name: Suspicious little raincloud.
description:
On second glance, this cloud doesn't seem much like a raincloud.
A balloon sticks out of the top and you think you hear it humming
something like, 'Tut, tut!  It looks like rain!'
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A bashful little cloud that tries to avoid your notice.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9132, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb5849e6aa22d7af9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7bd26216b7a21716"}

name: Den of the Vampire
description:
Your mind whirls in the hideous madness of this place.  The stench
is horrendous and dead bodies, sucked of life, lay all over.  One coffin
lies in the center of the room ... waiting for YOU!
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "A jet black coffin ... who knows what lurks beneath.", "keyword": "coffin", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 3419, "to_room_vnum": 3475, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc9c41d68084cae13", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf044e66bca25951d"}

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way between huge, ancient trees that stand
close on all sides.  The trail leads east and south.  To the north, a narrow
path leads away from the trail.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow path leads west between the giant trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6144, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe78ed7e72d5ed0a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3827ce18468c114e"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6109, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe78ed7e72d5ed0a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb01851ce0b594d9ed"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads south through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6111, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe78ed7e72d5ed0a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb64b94e88d149af7f"}

name: Dark Hallway
description:
You find yourself in a very old section of the fortress.  You must be the
first person to pass through here in years.  The hallway continues south
and a door leads off to the east.

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow alley leads east to one of the city watchtowers and west to
a small side street.

name: The future training room
description:
This is the future site of a training room.  The only exit is north
leading to the small alley.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You are able to see the small alley, really not very interesting.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5553, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0ad3d0f91f3098f9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb180a21a11f9e9b88"}

name: Eastern side of Chamber
description:
You are on the eastern side of the chamber overlooking the pit. To the east
is a door while to the north is an altar.

name: A grey road
description:
The ground beneath your feet is a uniformly grey cobblestone.  A dull red
sun hangs in an orange sky above your head; you hear none of the sounds you
would commonly associate with a normal city.
The cobblestone road turns to the south and continues on to the east.

name: Mine Maze
description:
You have entered the maze of the mines.  To the east you
can see some inscriptions, and you can exit to the south.

name: The Secret Yard
description:
The secret practice yard of thieves and assassins.  To the north is the
bar.  A well leads down into darkness.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You can't see what is down there, it is too dark.  Looks like it would be\nimpossible to climb back up.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7043, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcf211c84c10e226d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb57824f5a6ddbfcfd"}

name: NO MAN'S LAND
description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories.  This
is usually where the violence starts.  No Man's land continues south,
east and west; or there is a street to the north.

name: Near the Sands of Sorrow
description:
The road is almost completely swallowed by the desert here.  The heat is
sucking the life from your body, you wonder if it will ever end.  To your
south, the Sands of Sorrow stretch on for miles, and to the east you think
you see the towers of a magnificent city...or is it just a mirage?
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You can barely make out enough road to follow.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3532, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9058a0892b1175d7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1e5b1808a00e276e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The desert thins a little to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3530, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9058a0892b1175d7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5c2c0c787bf94630"}

name: Air Chamber
description:
Tiny tornadoes come and go and dance along the ground here.  At the back
of the chamber you notice a huge throne made of swirling clouds.
A tunnel leads west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "throne clouds", "description": "Although the cloud throne appears solid enough to sit on, I wouldn't try\nit if I were you!", "valid": true}

name: In the Dry Desert
description:
You are confused by the shifting sands around you.  Through the shimmering
heat you see the hazy outline of a giant scorpion ... is this a mirage?

name: Scene of ghastly horror
description:
An army of undead creatures of all types are lined up patiently. Their
leader is an evil demonoid necromancer.  His plans to use his army of
undead to take over the world seem about ready to get underway.

name: The cave
description: You are in the north end of a cave.  To the east you see many tunnels.

name: A change of direction
description: The plane curves from the south to west
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "looking south, you see the plane extending beyond view.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9014, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfae55f7693338ba5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7739176b282beb93"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "looking west, you can't fathom how far the plane extends.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9030, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfae55f7693338ba5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe5f3a4e8919e5f2c"}

name: The Great Door
description:
Before you you see a large, web-like door.  Various designs
of ancient runes and names of Midgaard heroes are etched into
the webwork.  Perhaps lists of victims?  You can't tell.

name: The swampy path
description:
You tread lightly through the mirky water and sludge that makes up the path
you follow. To the east, there is a thick wall of mist. You can see nothing
within it. Harder ground rises to the north.

name: East Main Street
description:
You are on East Main Street.  To the North is the beginning of
Guildsman's Row.  To the South is a dark alley.  The road also
continues to the East. There is a small sign on a wire hanging
across the junction.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "NO LOITERING!\n\n(by order of the Sultan of New Thalos)", "valid": true}

name: The mysterious lair.
description:
You have stumbled upon the home of something. From the treasure
haphazardly strewn about and the rotting carcasses, you would guess that
this is a dragon's lair. As to what type, you can't really say. The cave
narrows out into a tunnel to the west.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a
faint magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "walls wall", "description": "The walls shed a warm light", "valid": true}

name: Cirrus maximus cloud.
description: This cloud looks like it is of the cirrus maximus genre of clouds.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A suspicious little raincloud with a balloon.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9142, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfb81ba1beaa47346", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb5849e6aa22d7af9"}

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way north-south between huge, ancient
trees that loom ominously above you.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads north through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6110, "room_id": "69f4d0cb64b94e88d149af7f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe78ed7e72d5ed0a5"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads south through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6112, "room_id": "69f4d0cb64b94e88d149af7f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd5e6366a604d2ee0"}

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.

name: Torture Chamber
description:
This is a room that was once used to extract lies out of helpless victims.
The machines look unused, but could still work.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "machine", "description": "The machine consists of a large rack with winches on each end.  You can\nalmost feel them pulling your arms out of their sockets.", "valid": true}

name: A busy shop
description:
From the outside this place looks like an ordinary building,
but inside these cramped quarters you discover a shop filled with
armor, weapons, and various other goods. A small sign posted on the wall
flutters in the wind.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A small side street runs past the shop.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5314, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf3a06ea2ea38bcf3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb56c7aea0dc81b4d0"}

name: Luxan's mixed shop
description:
You are standing in a small shop, filled with all kinds of goods.
Here you might be able to find just the thing you're looking for.
The only exit is east to village square.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The village square is as usual not overcrowded.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5552, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb692d7f5351ce355", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbaae8382c7ae79c3"}

name: Sacrificial Pit
description:
A you climb down into the pit thousands of spiders cover you tearing your
body to shreds.

Lloth thanks you for your sacrifice.

You've fallen, and you can't get up!!!

name: Maze inscription
description: You are inside the maze, but not far enough in that you could get lost.

name: A grey road
description:
The ground beneath your feet is a uniformly grey cobblestone.  A dull red
sun hangs in an orange sky above your head; you hear none of the sounds you
would commonly associate with a normal city.
The cobblestone road continues to the east and west.  To the north you see a
massive building and a pair of large doors.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "doors metal", "description": "The doors are formed from a silvery substance that feels very hard yet almost\nslippery to the touch.  They are covered in images in bas-relief, depicting\nscenes of combat between humans and strange tentacle-mouthed humanoids.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Looming before you is a forbidding pair of metal doors.", "keyword": "doors metal", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7774, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc4fb44566858dd09", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb96edf43e92ee5ba7"}

name: The Dump
description:
The dump, where the people from the city drop their garbage.  Through the
garbage you can see a large junction of pipes, looks like the entrance to the
sewer system.  South of here you see the river and to the north is the common
square.  A rickety old bridge leads south to the promenade.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a river between northern and southern Midgaard.  A small bridge\nspans the flow.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3254, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb6137fe4ea8d7d9a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfe2d6e259f626524"}

name: NO MAN'S LAND
description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories.  This
is usually where the violence starts.  No Man's land continues south,
east, and west; or there is a street to the north.

name: On the Outskirts of New Thalos
description:
The sun is hot enough to melt your armor, but salvation is at hand.  To the
east, you see the mighty gates of New Thalos, one of the most prosperous cities
of all of Thera.  To the south, you see the endless wasteland of the Sands
of Sorrows, and to the west you can barely make out a faint, but well-used,
road leading to the City of Midgaard.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the west gate of New Thalos.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9669, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1e5b1808a00e276e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0ecd601c076f7549"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see the road to Midgaard, covered with sand.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3531, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1e5b1808a00e276e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9058a0892b1175d7"}

name: In the Woods
description:
You find yourself in the center of a Centaurion hunting party.  You'd better
hide yourself before you become the 'center attraction'!

name: Twisty passage
description:
The passage bends north and east here.  To the east your not certain
what lies ahead due to all the twists and turns you've made.  To the
north is seems cold.

name: A change of direction
description: Here, the plane takes a turm from the south to heading east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The plane heads east from here. You can't see the end of it.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9029, "room_id": "69f4d0cb69030b3c6f14ef7f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd1fa8ef0fab5b891"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Looking south, you view the plane extending for miles.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9015, "room_id": "69f4d0cb69030b3c6f14ef7f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd3d50e506fb7d46a"}

name: The many tunnels
description: You are at the intersection of many tunnels.

name: Lost in the Mist
description:
You wander, hopelessly lost. Swirling mist obscures your vision and clouds
your mind. You lose all concept of direction. Small, silent giggles can be
heard all around. You can wander in any direction.

name: The Lair of Arachnos
description:
This is the lair of the Empress Spider, Arachnos.  A lavishly
adorned rainbow web, her lair allows her to move to any universe
she wishes by using her magical strands to the Prime Material Plane.
Coffers upon coffers of gold, magical jewels and gems await.  Unfor-
tunately Arachnos is a baggy spider too, and webs all her treasures
to her beautiful silken body.

name: A wide tunnel
description:
This tunnel seems to go on forever into the darkness. You carefully
feel your way along the walls.

name: East Main Street
description:
As you walk by the mercenary guild a cold chill causes you to shiver
uncontrollably. You see some shady looking characters lurking about the
entrance to this house of 'helpful' people. Perhaps curiosity gets the
best of you, but you wonder what could be going on inside. To the north
you see the open doors of the apothecary shop where one may buy many
magical livations.
Main Street continues east and west from here.

name: Guardians chamber
description:
You are in the chamber of the tower guardians. It is rather sparsely
furnished, but then again the odd occupants don't look to need furniture.
Here and there a disembodied pair of hands or eyes flits about.

name: Raging hurricane.
description:
You are buffeted and knocked about by the almost godlike strength
of the raging hurricane.  It is hard to see and hear anything.
Your only thought is to seek refuge from the storm.

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way between huge, ancient trees
standing close on all sides.  The trail leads north and west and to the east,
a frail path leads away from the trail.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads north through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6111, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd5e6366a604d2ee0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb64b94e88d149af7f"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The path leads east - away from the trail.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6113, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd5e6366a604d2ee0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbaaa9ed1150448b94"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6127, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd5e6366a604d2ee0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbac15e15eb4d0206a"}

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.

name: Dark Hallway
description:
The hall continues in a north-south direction.  The floor is coated with
some kind of molded slime.  Doors lead east and west.

name: The Tavern of the Sun
description:
A glorious place, this tavern is second home for many citizens of
Thalos.  Tables and chairs are set in rows, bottles and glasses filled, and
a small performance stage teaming with dazzling entertainment. Musical
instruments and personal belongings lie in piles belonging to each member
of this room.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A small side street runs past the tavern.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5313, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe777614666677015", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc06ad2a349e6920c"}

name: Granny's Still Room
description:
You are in Granny Jenkins' still room.  The smell of whiskey is heady, and
the bottles of it on the floor make your mouth water and your mind swirl.  You
also see a very large still.  So THIS is why there are so many grain fields!
The exit is to the east.

name: Western side of Chamber
description:
You are on the western side of the main chamber overlooking a sacrificial
pit. To the north is an altar.

name: Maze
description: You are in a maze.

name: The Local Inn
description:
You are in the local inn, where the peaceful citizens of Ofcol
gather to have a drink or 5 if they have dry throats.
You can't help thinking that Ofcol is a dry city, when you see the
many people here.
The only exit is south to the village square.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The village square is as usual not overcrowded.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5552, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf473989de78b12bd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbaae8382c7ae79c3"}

name: A grey road
description:
The ground beneath your feet is a uniformly grey cobblestone.  A dull red
sun hangs in an orange sky above your head; you hear none of the sounds you
would commonly associate with a normal city.
The cobblestone road continues to the east and west.  A door to the south
leads into a tall stone building.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door wooden", "description": "The door is thick, made from a knotted and twisted greyish wood.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a tall stone building with a wooden door.", "keyword": "door wooden", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7764, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3d15bb12e964f7e7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5c408a08166ec967"}

name: The Pet Shop
description:
The Pet Shop is a small crowded store, full of cages and animals of
various sorts and sizes.  There is a sign on the wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign reads:

Use 'List' to see the available pets.
Use 'Buy <pet> <name>' to buy yourself a pet and name it.

You can use 'order <pet> <instructions>' to order your pets around.
If you abuse your pet, it will no longer regard you as its master.
If you have several pets you may use 'order all <instructions>'

Regards,

The Shopkeeper", "valid": true}

name: NO MAN'S LAND
description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories.  This
is usually where the violence starts.  No Man's land continues south
and west.

name: At The Foot of The Mountains
description:
You find yourself at the foot of the mountains, where it is much to steep
to continue north or east.  You see the lush, green forest of Miden'nir to the
south and west.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The forest of Miden'nir spreads out before you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3512, "room_id": "69f4d0cb50bd82bd44ac70d4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe974ed6ff8d3c6d7"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The forest of Miden'nir spreads out before you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3506, "room_id": "69f4d0cb50bd82bd44ac70d4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6a8b464f45945001"}

name: On a Mountain Peak
description:
You are on the highest peak of the Universe.  You look around and notice
clouds below you.  One of the clouds resembles a goat-like form.

name: Cross of caverns
description:
A little-used cavern enters from the south. A passage twists away to
the west.  An odd twinkling comes from the cave to the north.

name: An east-west route on the Plane of Nirvana
description: Exits lead east and west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "looking east, you spy a door far off in the distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9031, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd1fa8ef0fab5b891", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb356233e4b37f893a"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "looking west, in the distance you can spy a curve south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9028, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd1fa8ef0fab5b891", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb69030b3c6f14ef7f"}

name: The tunnel
description:
You are in a north-south leading tunnel, you also notice a tunnel to
the west. From the north you sense the fresh air!

name: Lost in the Mist
description:
You are in a thick misty area. The mist swirls around you, seeming to taunt
you and dare you to escape. You feel a slight electric charge in the mist. It
almost caresses your body as it floats about you. You can wander in any
direction.......

name: A narrower tunnel
description:
The tunnel becomes very narrow and you fight to squeeze your way through.
The floor seems to level off a little.

name: A guest bedroom
description:
You are in a small guest bedroom. A small cot is in one corner, and a
dusty mirror on one wall, other than that the room looks quite bare, and
unused.
The only apparent exit leads back west to the hallway.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mirror", "description": "Why, someone seems to be looking back at you from the other side!", "valid": true}

name: A small path in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient grey
trees loom in all directions.  The path continues south and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6114, "room_id": "69f4d0cbaaa9ed1150448b94", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0b194951ee4788f8"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6112, "room_id": "69f4d0cbaaa9ed1150448b94", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd5e6366a604d2ee0"}

name: East Main Street
description:
The Main street through eastern New Thalos begins here and heads westward
towards the marketplace. One of the main gates can be seen to the east, and
Braheem's Magic Shop awaits your business to the north.

name: Raging hurricane.
description:
You are buffeted and knocked about by the almost godlike strength
of the raging hurricane.  It is hard to see and hear anything.
Your only thought is to seek refuge from the storm.

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.

name: South wing of the city hall
description:
You stand in a large room attached to this end of the hallway which
leads back north to the reception area. Pedestals and columns stand
faithfully.  Valuable items hang from the walls each to be admired
by onlookers.  Chairs lie around, and a large curved desk. To the east
is a vine-covered archway leading out into a private courtyard.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The long hallway leads back to the main reception area of the city hall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5332, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3a941124a7f424bb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb81fe43cb3d39e332"}

name: Dark Hallway
description:
The hall continues in a north-south direction.  The floor is coated with
some kind of molded slime.  Doors lead east and west.

name: The Big Intersection
description:
You are in the big intersection between Raff Way and Impy Way.  Crowds
of people walk past you as they go on their daily tasks.  Raff Way continues
east and west, and Impy Way runs north and south.

name: The Altar
description:
You are standing in front of a highly and freshly bloodstained altar.
Engraved on the top of the altar is a giant spider with a human head. Looking
down from the altar you see a large sacrificial pit.

name: Maze
description: You are in a maze.

name: A grey road
description:
The ground beneath your feet is a uniformly grey cobblestone.  A dull red
sun hangs in an orange sky above your head; you hear none of the sounds you
would commonly associate with a normal city.
The cobblestone road turns to the west and continues to the south.  A door
to the north leads into a tall stone building.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door wooden", "description": "The door is thick, made from a knotted and twisted greyish wood.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a tall stone building with a wooden door.", "keyword": "door wooden", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7773, "room_id": "69f4d0cbea57efbdb9618f7e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb24c1e3f1a7425662"}

name: Ravan's hideout
description:
This place is a small, cosy place where no one disturbs you all
the time. The room has little decoration except for some pictures
on the wall.
You notice that there are no exits from this room.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "pictures picture decoration", "description": "These pictures show the friend's and foe's of Ravan.\nThey are easy to separate, as most of the foe's have the letters\nR.I.P. inscripted underneath them.", "valid": true}

name: Pet Shop Store
description:
This is the small dark room in which the Pet Shop Boy keeps his pets.
It is vital that this room be immediately after the pet shop.

name: NO MAN'S LAND
description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories.  This
is usually where the violence starts.  No Man's land continues north
and east; or there is a street to the south.

name: The Deep in the Forest of Miden'nir
description:
The branches above you block out all direct sunlight, making the forest
in this area very dark.  The forest continues west, but mountains block
further exploration in all other directions, except south, where you notice a
small tunnel dug into the mountainside.

name: Lonely tunnel
description:
Something indescribable makes you feel lonesome and sad here. Its just
a feeling you get from this tunnel.  The tunnel east and west.

name: An east-west route on The Plane of Nirvana
description: Exits lead east and west
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "looking east, you can see a bend in the distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9027, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe5f3a4e8919e5f2c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfae55f7693338ba5"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "glancing west, you can spy a door far off in the distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9031, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe5f3a4e8919e5f2c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb356233e4b37f893a"}

name: Inside a Waterfall
description:
The noise is deafening.  You are about to take a drink when you realize
that the water is being poured out of a vessel of mind-boggling proportions!

name: Lost in the Mist
description:
You try to peer through the mist......You see nothing. It swirls about you,
covering you in a damp sheen. There is no sound, all light is eagerly devoured
by the mist. You feel totally and hopelessly lost.

name: A guest bedroom
description:
You are in a comfortable looking bedroom. A small globe of magical energy
floats overhead, providing light. A small cot is in one corner looking
ever so comfortable, so comfortable in fact ...someone is sleeping in it.
The only apparent exit leads back west to the hallway.

name: A junction in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are by a junction where three paths meet.  Ancient grey trees tower above
you on all sides.  Paths lead north, east and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6113, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0b194951ee4788f8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbaaa9ed1150448b94"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6115, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0b194951ee4788f8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc08d9747e1595561"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6122, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0b194951ee4788f8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf43bda150317ff07"}

name: A narrow crack
description:
This part of the tunnel is the hardest to move through as the walls
move in to meet you.

name: The smelly tunnel
description:
You are in a north-south leading tunnel, you see a small light
to the north. You notice a strange smell from the north..

name: Raging hurricane.
description:
You are buffeted and knocked about by the almost godlike strength
of the raging hurricane.  It is hard to see and hear anything.
Your only thought is to seek refuge from the storm.

name: Inside the Eastern Gate of New Thalos
description:
Two large stone towers imbedded in the wall loom over you. The massive
iron gate, emblazened with the crest of New Thalos, swings easily on
four ornately crafted hinges. It is obvious the makers of this city spared no
expense in protecting their home.  Main street heads towards the market
westward and the wilderness beckons from the east. To the north lies the
entrance to the mages' guild.

name: The Catacombs
description: Stone walls, musty air ... the earth seems to moan softly.

name: Prison Cell
description:
You are in a dark and nasty prison cell.  Bodies lying on the floor give off
an unbearable stench.

name: The city hall
description:
This is the main reception area of Thalos' city hall. The walls have
been painted in pure white and thick lush carpet line the floor wall to wall.
A side door on the west wall allows you to go out to one of the city's side
streets.  Hallways lead south and east.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Main street runs past the city hall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5302, "room_id": "69f4d0cb81fe43cb3d39e332", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0da0cbb06a690587"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "A hallway leads to the east wing of the city hall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5333, "room_id": "69f4d0cb81fe43cb3d39e332", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb332636d3eafecf0e"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A hallway leads to the south wing of the city hall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5331, "room_id": "69f4d0cb81fe43cb3d39e332", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3a941124a7f424bb"}

name: Impy Way
description:
You are on Impy Way.  You can see a leather shop east and a blacksmith
west.  To the north you see a big intersection, and Impy Way continues south.

name: Slave Cells
description:
This is the main room to the cell chambers for the slaves to be
sacrificed. You notice there are no guards around.

name: Maze
description: You are in a maze.

name: The Magic Shop
description:
You are in a small room that smells of rare chemicals and spices.
Dividing the room in two is a large desk, and on the wall behind it are
numerous shelves crammed with jars, bottles, books and scrolls of all
sorts and sizes.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "jars bottles", "description": "Some of them are transparent enabling you to see that some contain colored\npowders while others contain body parts of various animals.", "valid": true}

name: A grey road
description:
The ground beneath your feet is a uniformly grey cobblestone.  A dull red
sun hangs in an orange sky above your head; you hear none of the sounds you
would commonly associate with a normal city.
The cobblestone road continues to the north and south.  To the east is a
door in a large stone building.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door iron", "description": "The door is made from many hammered iron plates, set deep into the stone wall.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "An iron door blocks your entrance into a large stone building.", "keyword": "door iron", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7767, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb591dcf0c87e7a17", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd61a849a98c7c972"}

name: NO MAN'S LAND
description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories.  This
is usually where the violence starts.  No Man's land continues north,
east and west.

name: A Tunnel in the Mountains
description:
The walls of this tunnel were carved out many years ago by the goblins of
this forest.  The floor is well worn, and continues south, into the
mountain, or back north out into the forest.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Outside, you see the forest of Miden'nir.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3551, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7baa728a41247e90", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd34e8944b6813481"}

description: The passages goes east and west, with a large door to the south.

name: Lonely tunnel
description:
Something indescribable makes you feel lonesome and sad here. You see a
gate to a burial ground to the north.  This lonesome tunnel sighs along
west and east.

name: Inside a Gigantic Clam
description:
You feel uneasy here as if some evil magic is being cast on you.
You suspect something fishy is going on in here.

name: Lost in the Mist
description:
You stumble through the marsh here. The swamp seems to have swallowed you up
and denied you exit. This mist is your jailor. You cannot tell where you are.
You hear quiet laughter all about you.

name: A small cavern.
description:
It is dark and damp and bats hang from the ceiling. A narrow crack is
in the east wall. The floor now slopes upwards.

name: A small path in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  You feel as
if the ancient trees observe you in watchful silence.  The path continues north
and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.", "valid": true}
