{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6114, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc08d9747e1595561", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0b194951ee4788f8"}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading from the south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
Stairs lead up to the next level and the hallway leads back south.

name: The cave
description:
You are in a cave that is filled with fresh air, you sense the
wind blowing from the north. To the south you see a small tunnel
continue into the mountain.

name: Cassandra's Catch of the Day
description:
Nothing in your life has prepared you for the odor which fills your lungs.
Not wanting to offend the beautiful shopkeeper you hold your tongue and
quietly look over her selection.

name: Raging hurricane.
description:
You are buffeted and knocked about by the almost godlike strength
of the raging hurricane.  It is hard to see and hear anything.
Your only thought is to seek refuge from the storm.

name: The Gilded Hallway
description:
Wow!  Although this hallway is quite filthy and dusty, it is noticeably
different than the rest of the catacombs ... but you don't feel safe yet.
The walls faintly show ancient detailed etchings in gold and silver of
ancient rituals ... not all of which seem pleasant.  The hallway continues
north into the catacombs and further south as long as you can see.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "etchings", "description": "Beautiful yet disturbing, they urge you to move onward.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The glow of your light reflects off the walls and you see the catacombs.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3464, "room_id": "69f4d0cb95d56a5109414fcf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb649d0f2d5fa0f524"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The glow of your light reflects off the walls ... the gilded hallway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3466, "room_id": "69f4d0cb95d56a5109414fcf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb05210c66a1293c6c"}

name: The Blacksmith
description:
You are in a black and smelly room.  Pieces of metal are strewn all over
the floor, and a wave of heat from a big furnace hits you.  An anvil sits on
one side of the room, and on the other side is a workbench.  The exit is east.

name: Prison Cell
description:
You are in a dark and nasty prison cell.  Bodies lying on the floor give off
an unbearable stench.

name: East wing of the city hall
description:
Here lies fancy office, possibly the mayor's. A few green plants
and pieces of furniture make this place breathtaking.  There is a large
glass cabinet along the wall. A long hallway leads west back to the
reception area and an ivy-covered archway leads south into a private
courtyard.

name: Slave Pen
description:
Rotten meat and breads lie about the floor while shackles hang from the
walls. The room wreaks of death. You almost become nauseous and decide to leave
the room since you were obviously too late to save the slave.

name: Mining equipment room
description:
This is the storage room for equipment used by the
Dwarven miners.  It is very small, and you can tell that
not many miners actually use any equipment.

name: The Jeweller's Shop
description:
You are in a small, beautifully furnished room.  The warm light emanating
from the small oil lamps on the walls is reflected in the hard, polished
surface of the big mahogany desk that stands in the centre of the room.
A small sign with golden letters stands on the desk.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "oil lamps", "description": "They are made from polished gold and looks as if they are securely fastened\nto the smooth stone walls.", "valid": true}

name: A grey road
description:
The ground beneath your feet is a uniformly grey cobblestone.  A dull red
sun hangs in an orange sky above your head; you hear none of the sounds you
would commonly associate with a normal city.
The cobblestone road continues to the north and south.

name: NO MAN'S LAND
description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories.  This
is usually where the violence starts.  No Man's land continues north,
east, and west; or there is a street to the south.

name: A Tunnel in the Mountains
description:
The tunnel gets lighter to the north, presumably leading out, while to
the south the passage gets smaller and smaller.  A small alcove has been
carved into the east wall.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The tunnel gets wider in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3552, "room_id": "69f4d0cb214b0d00066c1fcb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7baa728a41247e90"}

name: A Junction in the passage
description: Here, passages lead off in all cardinal directions.

name: Bend in the lonely tunnel
description:
Something indescribable makes you feel lonesome and sad here. The
tunnel bends west and south.

name: End of the Mystic Chains
description:
You have reached the end of the mystic chains.  Looking up, you notice a
small landing on which you can climb.  However, there seems to be another
forcefield blocking your way.

name: Lost in the Mist
description:
You wander, lost, for what seems an eternity. Then....From nowhere....You see
what appears to be trees and hills to the east. The mist itself thickens to
the west, while it grows thin to the east.

name: A small shaft
description:
From within this shaft you can see a narrow hole in the roof just
large enough for one person. Back south is the cavern.

name: The light cave
description:
You are in a light cave, through a hole large above you, you see
the sky. A small tunnel to the south is the only way out.

name: The burnt room
description:
You are in what looks to have once been a guest bed room. The walls are
blackened and burnt by what you could only imagine to be magical fire.
There is no sign of the previous occupant, undoubtedly he left in a hurry.
The only exit leads back west to the hallway.

name: West Ishtar Drive
description:
This is the warehouse district of New Thalos. Strong men walk back and
forth from the docks to the warehouse carrying large crates loading
and unloading the boats as they sail down the river. To the north is
one of the entrances of the warehouse and West Ishtar leads east.

name: A small path in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  Giant, grey
trees loom ominously on all sides.  The path continues east and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.", "valid": true}

You are buffeted and knocked about by the almost godlike strength
of the raging hurricane.  It is hard to see and hear anything.
Your only thought is to seek refuge from the storm.

description:
Ancient etchings and writing in intricate gold and silver designs fill these

flickers off the walls showing you exits north and south.

name: The Leather Shop
description:
You are in a brown and smelly room.  Pieces of leather are strewn all over
the floor.  The smell of burnt hide assaults your nose.  You can tell by the
looks that the tanning is done VERY CLOSE to here!   A table is near the
entrance.  The exit is west.

name: Prison Cell
description:
You are in a dark and nasty prison cell.  Bodies lying on the floor give off
an unbearable stench.

name: Dais
description:
You stand upon a dais behind the altar. Above you is a enormous illusion
of a female drow turning into a giant spider and back again. There is a door
to the west.

name: The private gardens and courtyard of Thalos
description:
You stare in awe as the beauty of this place takes you by
surprise.  Exotic flowers and trees are planted in neat rows and lawn
benches line the walk ways.  A large marble fountain in the center of the
courtyard stands. Above stands one of the four watchtowers. Archways
north and west lead back into the city hall.

name: Solved the Maze.
description:
You have solved the maze.  You can tell by the last few moves
that there is no way that a dumb worker could have figured that
out.  It seems pretty desolate here.  To the south is a bleak room.
To the north, you see the maze.  There is a sign above the south exit:

Those who enter, plan on a timely death.
Especially if you're loyal to the queen.

name: The Leather Shop
description:
An acrid smell fills this large room.  Along the walls are numerous
shelves containing all sorts of animal hide and in the crackling fireplace
hangs a big iron pot with boiling water.  In the middle of the room is a
large oak table.
A wooden sign is hanging above the fireplace.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "fireplace", "description": "It is a rather large fireplace made from heavy granite rocks.", "valid": true}

name: A grey road
description:
The ground beneath your feet is a uniformly grey cobblestone.  A dull red
sun hangs in an orange sky above your head; you hear none of the sounds you
would commonly associate with a normal city.
The cobblestone road turns to the north and continues on to the west.  To
the east is a door in a large stone building.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door iron", "description": "The door is made from many hammered iron plates, set deep into the stone wall.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "An iron door blocks your entrance into a large stone building.", "keyword": "door iron", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7765, "room_id": "69f4d0cbecdb80451c1e427e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb637f9968a44f8119"}

name: NO MAN'S LAND
description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories.  This
is usually where the violence starts.  No Man's land continues north,
east, and west.

name: A Small Alcove
description:
A small alcove has been carved out here.  There are a bunch of twigs
and leaves thrown into a pile here, probably serving as a bed.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "twigs leaves bead", "description": "The twigs and leaves have all been piled together as a makeshift bed for\nsome small humanoid.", "valid": true}

name: The office of the Octon
description: you are in a small room, the only exit is south.

name: Lonely tunnel
description:
Something indescribable makes you feel lonesome and sad here. The very
walls of the tunnel seems to groan.  to the north the tunnel bends and
east is an intersection.

name: On the Draco
description:
You realize you are standing on scaly ground.  As you wonder what the ground
is made of, you feel the ground move.

name: Lost in the Mist
description:
You wander through the thick mist. It swirls all about you and makes it hard
to breathe. The ground below you makes a soft squishing sound as you trudge
on, but this noise is absorbed by the mist and does not travel. You can wander
in any direction.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading west from here. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. Some faint moonlight
can be seen in the culdesac to the east.
The hallway continues west and stairs lead down to the level below.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Faint moonlight can be seen to the east", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1341, "room_id": "69f4d0cb46975babe7fff93e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf2432e8d66f522b4"}

name: The valley
description:
You are in a small valley, surrounded by hills and a mountain to
the south. In the mountain there is a cave.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "cave", "description": "Well it doesn't look nice, but it's the only way out.", "valid": true}

name: West Ishtar Drive
description:
A few men walk by almost pushing you out of the way as they go about
their business of loading and unloading the boats. An entrance to the
huge warehouses of New Thalos is to the north and the Ishtar River
quietly flows by to the south. Ishtar Drive continues east and west.

name: Impy Way
description:
You are on Impy Way.  To the east is a meat store, and to the west is a
pawn shop.  Impy Way continues north and south.  People are rushing around you
to go to these stores.

name: The Gilded Hallway
description:
Ancient etchings and writing in intricate gold and silver designs fill these
walls.  You are tempted to linger and examine them closely.  Your light source
flickers off the walls showing you exits north and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "etchings", "description": "Beautiful yet disturbing, they urge you to move onward.", "valid": true}

name: A junction in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are by a junction where three paths meet.  Ancient, grey trees seem to
observe you silently you from all sides.  Paths lead north, east and west.

name: Raging hurricane.
description:
You are buffeted and knocked about by the almost godlike strength
of the raging hurricane.  It is hard to see and hear anything.
Your only thought is to seek refuge from the storm.

name: Prison Cell
description:
You are in a dark and nasty prison cell.  Bodies lying on the floor give off
an unbearable stench.

name: The Treasury
description:
This is obviously only a temporary storage place for the collected
treasure being rather bare.

name: The Mazekeeper's Room
description:
You have entered the Mazekeeper's room.  There are pictures of
the Queen with darts thrown in it.  Spray-painted on the wall are
things like 'the queen shall suffer' and 'Catholics Rule'.

name: Inside the West Gate of Midgaard
description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city wall and
connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate.  Main Street leads
east and Wall Road leads both north and south from here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bridge footbridge", "description": "It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk across it\nfrom one tower to the other.", "valid": true}

name: A small guard house
description:
This is the barracks for Thalos' cityguards.  Guards populate this
shack ready, willing, and able to ward off any trouble.  This small
shack stands guarding both to the entrance to the city and to the city hall.

name: NO MAN'S LAND
description:
This is the section of town between the two gang's territories.  This
is usually where the violence starts.  No Man's land continues south
and west; or there is a street to the south.

name: A grey road
description:
The ground beneath your feet is a uniformly grey cobblestone.  A dull red
sun hangs in an orange sky above your head; you hear none of the sounds you
would commonly associate with a normal city.
The cobblestone road goes on to the east, ending to the west at an iron door.
A door to the north leads into a small stone building.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door wooden", "description": "The door is thick, made from a knotted and twisted greyish wood.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a small stone building with a wooden door.", "keyword": "door wooden", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7763, "room_id": "69f4d0cb375dd9d928127602", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb87eb5816bbf24970"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see an iron door which leads into a small stone building set into the wall\nof the keep.", "keyword": "door iron", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7751, "room_id": "69f4d0cb375dd9d928127602", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf4df398885f2d6c1"}

name: A Tunnel in the Mountains
description:
As you explore further into the mountainside, the tunnel gets smaller and
smaller to the south.  You almost have to hunch over to make your way thru
this area.  A small archway to the south leads into a large chamber.

name: Intersection
description:
To the north you enter the burial grounds.  a trail of blood leads that
direction.  Also you feel an ominous sense of evil magic from there.
The tunnel to the west creaks and sighs as if alive.  To the south you
smell a hint of fresh air.

name: A small room
description: The only exit is north

name: Tail of the Draco
description:
At last you realize that you are on a giant snake-like dragon called the
Draco, the guardian of the inner galaxy.  You realize that the Draco is
actually flying now!

name: Lost in the Mist
description:
You wander, lost hopelessly. The mist swirls all about you. You can discern no
direction. You stumble blindly through the mist, oblivious to your
surroundings.

name: A culdesac
description:
You are in a small culdesac. A window to the east is letting in moonlight
and a pleasant breeze. Through it, the surrounding country side can be seen.
The only apparent exit leads back west to the hallway.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "window east", "description": "Stretching out as far as the eye can see is a canopy of dark tree tops\nwhich can only be the Haon-Dor-Dark Forest. A faint light in the distance\nto the northeast marks what is probably the city of midgaard.", "valid": true}

name: West Ishtar Drive
description:
The cobblestone road is moist here, the trail of water heading down to
the boat ramp. Catching your balance as you start to slide on the slick
pavement you grab on to the handrail someone has conveniently placed here.
To the north is the Shipwright and Ishtar Drive continues east and west.

name: The foothills
description:
You are on a winding path that leads through the foothills on the
other side of the mountain.  The path continues north.

name: A small path in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient,
grey trees loom everywhere.  The path continues south and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.", "valid": true}

name: The Pawn Shop.
description:
You are in a little shop filled with a lot of knick knacks and semi-
valuable goods.  There is a display case full of little treasures that you are
sure that you or any other little kid would like to touch!  The exit is east.

name: The Gilded Hallway
description:
Ancient etchings and writing in intricate gold and silver designs fill these
walls.  You are tempted to linger and examine them closely.  Your light source
flickers off the walls showing you exits north and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "etchings", "description": "Beautiful yet disturbing, they urge you to move onward.", "valid": true}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Your light reveals more of the hallway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3469, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9bf018dcc91ced00", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf5e5784efb52dc99"}

name: End of the Dark Hallway
description:
You have reached the end of the dark hallway and maybe the end of your puny
life.  Something lumbers its way out of the shadows.

name: Raging hurricane.
description:
You are buffeted and knocked about by the almost godlike strength
of the raging hurricane.  It is hard to see and hear anything.
Your only thought is to seek refuge from the storm.

name: Weaponsmaster's Chamber
description:
This one person bedchamber is very elegant. The owner must be held in high
to get this kind of treatment.

name: Bottom of mineshaft
description:
You are at the bottom of the mineshaft.  The air here is very sooty, and
it is very hard to breath.  The mineshaft leads up and east.

name: Inside the East Gate of Midgaard
description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city wall and
connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate.  Main Street leads
west from here.  Wall road crosses the street, heading north and south along
the city wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bridge footbridge", "description": "It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk across it\nfrom one tower to the other.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Wall road heads north along the city wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3267, "room_id": "69f4d0cb008c96301e4d9696", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba7bcdca97eb19da1"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Wall road heads south towards the poor section of town.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3250, "room_id": "69f4d0cb008c96301e4d9696", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba0922b40c0853786"}

name: Bend in Hector Street
description:
Hector street bends to the east and the south here.  "No Man's Land"
entrance is to the north.

name: An impressive house
description:
This house houses the Defender of Thalos.  He represents all that
is good and right in this city.  As the most skilled fighting machine,
he is the commander of the guard.

name: A small building
description:
You have stepped inside a dimly lit building, which apparently serves as
living quarters for several githyanki gish.  The walls are heavy stone blocks,
covered with panels of strangely knotted and twisted wood.  A couple of candles
burn dimly in sconces here and there.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door wooden", "description": "The door is thick, made from a knotted and twisted greyish wood.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The wooden door leads back out onto the grey cobblestone road.", "keyword": "door wooden", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7753, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc256a1c22e9e7d51", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb07b46cced2971003"}

name: The Goblin Headquarters
description:
The tunnel widens into a large (well, large for goblins) cavern that
serves as the living quarters for the goblins of Miden'nir.  The bones of
numbers woodland creatures are strewn about the room, the remanents of a
recent meal.

name: Tunnel
description:
The tunnel heads north and south.  North you see an intersection and
far to the south you sense light and smell a fresh breeze.

name: A passageway
description: Exits lead in all cardinal directions.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Looking north you spy a average sized room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9036, "room_id": "69f4d0cbba5a0239b93ef311", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb970eb8df987fe6d"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Looking east, you can make out a large room", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9038, "room_id": "69f4d0cbba5a0239b93ef311", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb503bd2a2381c68dc"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Looking south, you can see an average room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9037, "room_id": "69f4d0cbba5a0239b93ef311", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb13833b95d3df7175"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Looking west, you can see an intersection ahead.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9032, "room_id": "69f4d0cbba5a0239b93ef311", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb336679cda39c78d9"}

name: Path of the Draco
description:
As you struggle along this scaly creature you realize that the only way
you can reach to the inner galaxy is by going all the way to the head.

name: West Ishtar Drive
description:
A cool breeze blows up off the river chilling the sweat otherwise present
on you skin. Orders and sometimes curses can be heard from the west
in the direction of the warehouses. The common square opens up to the east
and Ishtar Drive continues west.

name: The Apprentice's Barracks
description:
You are in the barracks of the apprentice magic users. Here and there, a
young apprentice sits engrossed in magical study, or practicing a feeble
cantrip. Cots line the walls, and the room continues west.

name: The solid path
description:
A solid path rises out of the misty swamp. It leads north, into what appears
to be a forested area. The trees, above, allow light and air to penetrate and
you can see the sky above. A thick bank of mist is to your west.

name: Mountain
description:
You are climbing a large mountain which towers over Ofcol.  The path
continues up the mountain, but part of it is gone.  There is no way to
continue by land.

name: A small path in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  Huge, ancient
trees are on all sides.  The path continues north and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "You feel as if they are watching you.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6118, "room_id": "69f4d0cb43bec67716adc45e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb81a6a6df4c009811"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6120, "room_id": "69f4d0cb43bec67716adc45e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb81bd3f3a794daeea"}

name: The intersection in the foothills
description:
The small path you are following splits here.  The path continues
north and south or you can follow a trail east into the mountains.

name: The Meat Store
description:
You are in a meat store.  Hanging on hooks are meats of many kinds of
animals.  In the background, you can hear the sound of blade against flesh.
It smells like meat here (which is not a good smell).  The exit is west.

name: The Gilded Hallway
description:
Ancient etchings and writing in intricate gold and silver designs fill these
walls.  You are tempted to linger and examine them closely.  Your light source
flickers off the walls showing you exits north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "etchings", "description": "Beautiful yet disturbing, they urge you to move onward.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Your light reveals more of the hallway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3468, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf5e5784efb52dc99", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9bf018dcc91ced00"}

name: A Ladder
description: You have come into a vertical tunnel with a ladder.

name: Raging hurricane.
description:
You are buffeted and knocked about by the almost godlike strength
of the raging hurricane.  It is hard to see and hear anything.
Your only thought is to seek refuge from the storm.

name: The mountains of the dwarven kingdom
description:
You are standing at the foot of the mountains of the dwarven kingdom, where
dwarves and giants toil endlessly to pry gems and mithril from the mother
earth.  Here lies the palace of the dwarven queen, and untold riches.
But beware, for the mines are said to be haunted by demon and spirit alike.
The dwarven kingdom lies to the east.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the foothills of this mighty mountain range.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 4000, "room_id": "69f4d0cbeb5da1f0fe942fc5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0a2e5d219d316314"}

name: Wall Road
description:
You are walking next to the western city wall.  The road continues further
south and the city gate is just north of here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "wall", "description": "It is built from large grey rocks that have been fastened to each other with\nsome kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.", "valid": true}

name: Hector Street at Bakery
description:
Hector street runs east and west.  The Bakery used to be to the south
but the entrance is sealed off.  Probably just a bunch of stale pies in
there anyways.

name: A small building
description:
You have stepped inside a dimly lit building, which apparently serves as
living quarters for several githyanki gish.  The walls are heavy stone blocks,
covered with panels of strangely knotted and twisted wood.  A couple of candles
burn dimly in sconces here and there.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door wooden", "description": "The door is thick, made from a knotted and twisted greyish wood.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The wooden door leads back out onto the grey cobblestone road.", "keyword": "door wooden", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7761, "room_id": "69f4d0cb87eb5816bbf24970", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb375dd9d928127602"}

name: A Public Library
description:
This seems to be the tallest structure in the city.  Rows and rows of books
line the 20 foot tall bookcases, and a quiet serenity can be felt by all here.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Another room in the library is here.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5338, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd3ed7ec8a1a2c4e8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbba6534247de36fa5"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A small side street winds past this building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5311, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd3ed7ec8a1a2c4e8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb99f4950be0e8cc58"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "You see a second floor to the library.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5345, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd3ed7ec8a1a2c4e8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7e9ce460b82e6905"}

name: The Front of the Inn
description:
You are standing on a well-worn path which opens into a clearing.
An old, wooden building is here with smoke billowing from its
chimney. A painted sign is visible on the porch to the west. You
could go north or south around the building or leave this place and
return to the forest.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign reads:\nThe Woodsman", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can go north around the inn.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3571, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb1123a63c4ea7203", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf2fa538aef263554"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Back through the trees to the Miden'nir.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3505, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb1123a63c4ea7203", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb09c66241aac00b33"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You can go south around the inn.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3572, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb1123a63c4ea7203", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb45bdd29f1d9f222b"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The front door of the inn beckons.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3574, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb1123a63c4ea7203", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd22b82bbaf22e045"}

name: Tunnel
description:
The tunnel slopes noticeably down to the north and you sense the surface
could be reached to the south.

name: Lair of a Hexton
description:
You are in a room that is in complete disrepair.  Items are thrown throughout
the room making them worthless piles of junk.
The only exit is back south
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "Looking south, you can make out a passage.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9035, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb970eb8df987fe6d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbba5a0239b93ef311"}

name: Near the Legs of Draco
description:
You are approaching the leg part of this creature.  You look around and see
that the surrounding is all dark except for some faint lights from the
distant stars.

name: A forested path
description:
The path here leads north through a thick forest. High bushes and forest
undergrowth line both sides of the trail. Looking north, you see a thin line
of smoke rising up above the tree line. You also notice a crude wooden gate
farther north on the trail. The trail itself leads south into murky territory.

name: East Ishtar Drive
description:
Loud hammering and the sound of red hot iron cooling in water reaches
your ears as you stand in front of the blacksmith. A small boy runs up
to you with big eyes and as you return his gaze runs off down the road.
The common square can be seen to the west and Ishtar Drive continues
to the east.

name: Mountain
description:
You are making your way up the mountain.  The rigorous climb has left you
tired, and you are ready to take a break.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
There is a door to the north, and the hallway continues west or back east.

name: Impy Way
description:
You are on Impy Way.  To the east is Farmer's Market, and to the west is
Nyles' House of Ale.  Impy Way runs north and ends south of here.  You can hear
the sound of housewives gossiping at the market.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the end of Impy Way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 611, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0c1f91b31ebe6b3e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb96a616d127d4efc6"}

name: The grassy area of the foothills
description:
The grass here is unusually high.  You notice several areas where
someone or something large has crushed spots of the grass down.  Several very
large rocks litter this area.  You can go north, west or south.

name: On the river bank in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  To the south a
fast river is flowing westwards through the forest.  Ancient grey trees loom on
both banks.  The path continues north and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "river", "description": "The river flows fast and strong.  It is black or looks so in the gloom.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6119, "room_id": "69f4d0cb81bd3f3a794daeea", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb43bec67716adc45e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6121, "room_id": "69f4d0cb81bd3f3a794daeea", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6b80a3a0f8a8cdd2"}

name: A Secret Passageway
description: A secret passage!  You wonder where it may lead!
extraDescription: {"keyword": "east secret door", "description": "The door closed on you so softly that you didn't even notice!", "valid": true}

name: Lair
description:
You have entered a new lair in the fortress.  Anything could be lurking
around the corner.

name: Raging hurricane.
description:
You are buffeted and knocked about by the almost godlike strength
of the raging hurricane.  It is hard to see and hear anything.
Your only thought is to seek refuge from the storm.

name: Wall Road
description:
You are walking next to the western city wall.  Wall Road continues further
north and south.  A small, poor alley leads east.
Some letters have been written on the wall here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "letters", "description": "It says 'Who watches the watchmen?'", "valid": true}

name: Another corner of Hector and Achilles streets
description:
Achilles street heads to the south and Hector runs east and west.
There is an entrance to "No Man's Land" to the north.  On the
southwest corner of this intersection, it looks like a building
was recently burned down.

name: A large dwelling
description:
You have stepped inside a dimly lit building with vaulted ceilings and high
windows.  The walls are heavy stone blocks that rise tens of feet above your
head, covered with panels of strangely knotted and twisted wood.  On the floor
are charcoal stencils of pentagrams and various other ominous sigils.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door wooden", "description": "The door is thick, made from a knotted and twisted greyish wood.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The wooden door leads back out onto the grey cobblestone road.", "keyword": "door wooden", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7756, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5c408a08166ec967", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3d15bb12e964f7e7"}

name: The Library Addition
description:
There are more shelves and tables here.  Vials of strange potions line a
section of the wall, and books and other items of power line another.  The exit
is to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The main room of the library is there.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5337, "room_id": "69f4d0cbba6534247de36fa5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd3ed7ec8a1a2c4e8"}

name: North of the Inn
description:
You are standing north of the inn. Things don't look much different
from this angle.  The air here is filled with smells of smoke and cooking.
South, the front porch is waiting for you... or you can see if there is
a back door.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the front of the Inn.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3570, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf2fa538aef263554", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb1123a63c4ea7203"}

name: Office of a Hexton
description: A makeshift desk forms the center of this room.  The only exit is north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Looking north, you can make out a hallway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9035, "room_id": "69f4d0cb13833b95d3df7175", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbba5a0239b93ef311"}

name: Southern entrance to the catacombs
description:
Through a trapdoor above you streams light.  Through a doorway to
the south streams darkness.  A message has been scrawled upon the wall
here.  The message reads:
Adventure for the strong yet calculating
Death for the weak and shallow
Treasure for the smart and lucky
Death for the stupid and accursed
An ancient Glyph above the entrance keeps monsters from wandering up
from the catacombs.

name: On the Back of Draco
description:
At last you are half way through this long, weary journey. You can see
the wings are to the east but it seems that another forcefield is in the way.

name: East Ishtar Drive
description:
The wide road bordering the south of town continues to the east and
west here, bordered only by the hay-loft to the north and the Ishtar
River to the south.

name: The gate before the Ogre Village
description:
You stand before a huge pair of crude, wooden gates. They are thrown open.
Looking inside the gates, you see a crude village. Large humanoid creatures
are milling to and fro.......Ogres! You can head north through the gate or
south into the forest.

name: The Apprentice's barracks
description:
You are in the barracks of the apprentice magic users. Here and there, a
young apprentice sits engrossed in magical study, or practicing a feeble
cantrip. Cots line the walls, and the room continues east.

name: Mountain
description:
You have finally reached the top of the mountain.  The air here is so thin
that you must gasp for breath.  To the north, you see what seems to be the
entrance to a city.

name: Nyles' House of Ale
description:
This is a very busy bar, with everyone holding homemade bottles of
ale.  You see even the more gentile persons here, laughing along with
Nyles, who offers you a quart of ale too.

name: A dead end path on the river bank in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  The ancient
trees stand so close that the path disappears between the dusty roots.  To the
south a dark river flows from east to west.  The only exit appears to be east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "river", "description": "The river flows fast and strong.  It is black or looks so in the gloom.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6120, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6b80a3a0f8a8cdd2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb81bd3f3a794daeea"}

name: The foothills end
description:
At this point you are leaving the foothills.  You see a plains area
to the north of here.  You can spot a small city in the distance from
here.

name: A Secret Passageway
description: A secret passage!  You wonder where it may lead!

name: A Damp Hallway
description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway.  The temperature
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

name: Calm cloud.
description:
This cloud is just outside the hurricane.  It looks like it might
get sucked in, but you feel safe for the moment.

name: Hector Street at Jeweler
description:
Once a bright spot in the town, it now looks like one of the
hardest hit by the violence.  The building could collapse at any
moment.  The street continues east and west.

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow back alley goes south to main street and north towards
a watchtower.  People quietly pass you by.

name: The Githyanki Weaponry
description:
A large chamber, full of weapons in various states of completion.  Strange
glowing blocks of silvery metal are being pounded and rolled out into deadly
razor-sharp knives, daggers, and swords.
Sounds of hammering and blasts of heat and strange smells come from the open
doorway to the north.  An iron door stands to the west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door iron", "description": "The door is made from many hammered iron plates, set deep into the stone wall.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a massive forgeroom, lit by a white-hot furnace.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7766, "room_id": "69f4d0cb637f9968a44f8119", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb54a963fd11435b03"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The iron door leads back out onto the grey cobblestone road.", "keyword": "door iron", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7760, "room_id": "69f4d0cb637f9968a44f8119", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbecdb80451c1e427e"}

name: Poor Alley
description:
You are in narrow and dirty alley leading east and west.  The leather shop
is to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The leather shop is to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3035, "room_id": "69f4d0cbda1080393a61a281", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8ed99a48f745e9c2"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "There is an ornate doorway to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3170, "room_id": "69f4d0cbda1080393a61a281", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb23412aa2e7663b7d"}

name: South of the Inn
description:
You are standing south of the inn.  You could easily go north and enter
through the front door, or west and to the rear of the establishment.  You
here some muffled cries from a tiny trail leading south of here.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "This way leads to the front of the inn.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3570, "room_id": "69f4d0cb45bdd29f1d9f222b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb1123a63c4ea7203"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "This way leads to the back of the inn.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3573, "room_id": "69f4d0cb45bdd29f1d9f222b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5caeb14f4774f50b"}

name: Office of a Secundus
description:
You are standing in a office of one of the Viceroys of the Plane of Nirvana.
The occupant doesn't look real thrilled with your presence.  The only exits is
west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "Looking west you can see a long hallway", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9035, "room_id": "69f4d0cb503bd2a2381c68dc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbba5a0239b93ef311"}

name: Unknown passage
description:
Oh dear you seem to have lost your way.  You look back from whence you
came but there's no exit there anymore.  There are exits in other
directions but you have a feeling that you are hopelessly lost.

name: Between the Wings of Draco
description:
You hear some giant flapping sounds nearby.  You desperately try to get hold
of something as the forceful gusts sweep you away.

name: East Ishtar Drive
description:
Small clumps of hay strewn about the ground alerts you to the fact that
you have reached the stables. Arabian stallions as well as many other
fine breeds of horses can be purchased for a price. Ishtar road continues
east and west.

name: Entrance
description:
You are at the entrance to a huge city.  As you look around, you realize
that the inhabitants of this city must be very wealthy indeed - you have never
seen a city with such beautiful buildings.

name: Among the crude huts
description:
You walk among the huts of the ogre village. The village appears to be cut
from the heart of the forest itself. The swamp, nearby, provides the ogres
with a prime hunting ground. Small paths lead north and east.

name: Farmer's Market
description:
You see many carts filled with fruits and vegetables.  Many farmers are
all trying to sell you their produce, each saying their's is better.  The exit
is west.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. Flashes of light can
be seen under the doorway to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A flash of blue light momentarily lights up the doors outline", "keyword": "door oak", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1346, "room_id": "69f4d0cb88b31bcfc8cd1e25", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb802add97739e959a"}

name: A small path in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  Giant, grey
trees loom ominously all around.  The path continues east and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6114, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf43bda150317ff07", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0b194951ee4788f8"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6123, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf43bda150317ff07", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2f0c2a221d3fe202"}

name: Mountainside.
description:
You find yourself on the side of a huge granite mountain.  The air
is quite thin so you know you are at a very high altitude.  There
is no plant life beyond moss and lichen in this lonely, barren
place.

name: The plains
description: The plains.  Exits are south.

name: The Short Way to Hell ...
description:
You fall ...
hmm .... it's getting really HOT!
You fall ...
you fall ...
Slowly you are cooking as you fall further ... your skin is burning and
your hair evaporates ...

you fall ...

and fall ...

and STOP...!!

Welcome to HELL!

But even in Hell we give you another chance.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The fires of hell grow hotter to the north...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 10401, "room_id": "69f4d0cb056e61fcb6dac21b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb99182f0b7f36c8b0"}

name: A Damp Hallway
description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway.  The temperature
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

name: Corner of Ajax and Hector
description:
There is a grand fountain to the east but the water doesn't
look good to drink.  Ajax street heads south and Hector
goes back west.  "No Man's Land" is to the north.

name: The Forge
description:
In the center of the room is a massive furnace which emits great gouts of
heat and a strange smell which comes from the melting of the silvery metal used
by the githyanki.  A large trough of icy water stands to the west, used for
quenching hot metal.
Doorways stand to the north and south.  The furnace door lies to the east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door furnace", "description": "The entire furnace is glowing white-hot to the touch.\nThe furnace door looks too hot to even attempt to open.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Through the grille in the furnace door you see only flames.", "keyword": "door furnace", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7768, "room_id": "69f4d0cb54a963fd11435b03", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd010c2ffe0c7b5e3"}

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow back alley leads north to one of the city watchtowers
and south towards main street.  The shade cast by the watchtower is very
refreshing.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5341, "room_id": "69f4d0cb06f9e88480b0da0d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7a68412452021ac4"}

name: Alley at Levee
description:
You are standing in the alley which continues east and west.  South of
here you see the levee.  North is the Pet Shop.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see, hear, and smell the pet shop.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3031, "room_id": "69f4d0cb30bde645c890ec47", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb8ddbb95fff33179"}

name: Behind the Inn
description:
You now stand behind the inn. The smell here is not so pleasant as
the keeper and his help throw a good deal of garbage here. A couple of
piles of rubbish are to the west, but you will smell the worse for
meddling there. As a clean alternative, you can go north or east around
the inn.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You can go around the inn this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3572, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5caeb14f4774f50b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb45bdd29f1d9f222b"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Only rats and fool adventurers play in garbage.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3578, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5caeb14f4774f50b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb43950b49eb687273"}

name: A Junction in the hallway
description: Your are standing in a junction, exits lead in all the cardinal directions.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north, you spy a small room", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9040, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdf0f25997c741a0b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbf2f7715698e732b"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "To the east, you see a quadruple junction", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9025, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdf0f25997c741a0b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcdc7009a4ee8915b"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you see a small room", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9041, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdf0f25997c741a0b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7fef87e78fcb569f"}

name: Near the Arms of Draco
description:
From above you can faintly make out the gigantic arms which extend far
beyond into the darkness.

name: Unknown passage
description:
Oh dear you seem to have lost your way.  You look back from whence you
came but there's no exit there anymore.  There are exits in other
directions but you have a feeling that you are hopelessly lost.

name: Zeus Street
description:
You are walking down a huge street.  You notice that there are not many
people in this town.  On a corner, you see a sign marked 'Zeus Street'.
To the west, you see a small store.

name: The apprentice's workshop
description:
You are in a small workshop. Writing implements and parchment are strewn
about on a few worktables. In the far corner several young mages have a
small kitten cornered and seem to be testing spells upon it.
The only apparent exit leads back south to the hallway.

name: Inside the gates
description:
You stand just north of the gates to the village. Looking around, you see many
crude huts and cooking fires. To the north, you see a huge fire pit. Behind
it, there appears to be a hut of sorts. Small paths lead east and west among
the crude huts. The gates to the south provide an exit from the village.

name: The End of Impy Way
description:
You are at the end of Impy and of the city part of Ofcol.  To the east is
a dirt road leading toward the farm animals.  West from here are fields.  Impy
Way continues north.

name: East Ishtar Drive
description:
Even in broad daylight, you can hardly see into the back alley that begins
here and heads north. Sounds of loud drunken folk and the occasional
screaming cat emenate from the direction. Luckily you have the choice of
going east or west down the drive as well.

name: A junction on the river bank in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are by a junction where three paths meet.  Ancient, grey trees seem to
observe you silently you from all around.  To the south a dark river flows from
east to west through the forest.  Paths lead north, east and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "river", "description": "The river flows fast and strong.  It is black or looks so in the gloom.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6122, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2f0c2a221d3fe202", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf43bda150317ff07"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6125, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2f0c2a221d3fe202", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcead7d047c0956d5"}

name: Mountainside.
description:
You find yourself on the side of a huge granite mountain.  The air
is quite thin so you know you are at a very high altitude.  There
is no plant life beyond moss and lichen in this lonely, barren
place.

name: Inside the coffin
description:
You are inside a coffin.  It seems rather cramped in here.  You can climb
up out of the coffin, or you can wait for here the real occupant to join you.

name: The foothills path
description: Exits are east and west.

name: Hector Street
description:
The street is full of garbage here.  An odd building lies to the west,
but you don't seem to be able to find a way into it.  The street
runs north and south here.

name: A Damp Hallway
description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway.  The temperature
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

name: Under a watchtower
description:
You stand under a tall watchtower. Narrow back alleys lead west and
south and a sturdy ladder leads up into the tower.

name: The Githyanki Armoury
description:
A large chamber, full of suits of armor in various states of completion.  In
this chamber the hard steels of the githyanki are shaped into ornately fashioned
suits of mail.
Sounds of hammering and blasts of heat and strange smells come from the open
doorway to the south.  An iron door stands to the west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door iron", "description": "The door is made from many hammered iron plates, set deep into the stone wall.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a massive forgeroom, lit by a white-hot furnace.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7766, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd61a849a98c7c972", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb54a963fd11435b03"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The iron door leads back out onto the grey cobblestone road.", "keyword": "door iron", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7758, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd61a849a98c7c972", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb591dcf0c87e7a17"}

name: Eastern end of Alley
description:
You are standing at the eastern end of the alley,  near the city walls.
Wall road loops around the city to your east, and you can see an old
three-story warehouse to the south.  The Fountain of Youth Apothecary is
north.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see wall road, running a north-south loop around the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3251, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5aa7dbbd6801f6ab", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6cf75e18d4545b99"}

name: The Woodsman Inn
description:
You are in the common room of the Woodsman Inn. A thin haze of smoke sits
in the air here. The Inn is often empty, as the forest has become overrun by
goblins as of late, and it is no longer safe in these parts. The bar is just
north of here. If you'd rather have your own table, one is empty to the
south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The bar is here, manned by the innkeeper.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3576, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd22b82bbaf22e045", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb38747da342f667c1"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You can leave now and return to fresher air.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3570, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd22b82bbaf22e045", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb1123a63c4ea7203"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "An empty table is a rare commodity.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3579, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd22b82bbaf22e045", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8001ccc782a6799c"}

name: Office of an Octon
description:
You see a messy room with papers scattered everywhere.
The only exit leads back to the south
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can make out a junction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9039, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbf2f7715698e732b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdf0f25997c741a0b"}

name: On the Neck of Draco
description:
Your journey is now approaching the end.  However, this neck seems to be
endless.

name: Unknown passage
description:
Oh dear you seem to have lost your way.  You look back from whence you
came but there's no exit there anymore.  There are exits in other
directions but you have a feeling that you are hopelessly lost.

name: A bend in the hallway
description:
You are at a bend in the hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by.
The hallway continues south and back east.

name: Zeus Street
description:
You are walking down what appears to be the main street of this city.
You see large residences to the east and west, while the street continues
to the north and south.

name: Among the crude huts
description:
You walk through the crude village. Small huts made of wood and thatch
surround you. Every so often, you can hear grunts and snarls inside the huts.
The smell here is unbearable. You wonder what type of creature could possibly
live in such squalor. Small paths lead west and north here.

name: Fields
description:
You are in a corn field.  You can't see far, since the corn stalks are
taller than you are.  You remember that the end of Impy Way is east of here,
and you think you see a building to the north.  The field continues south and
west.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You think you see a building north of here.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 616, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd045fc4fb6cc447d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5b14a420914af756"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You remember that the end of Impy Way is east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 611, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd045fc4fb6cc447d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb96a616d127d4efc6"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You can make a path to the fields south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 613, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd045fc4fb6cc447d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb97c98571fa3b91af"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can make a path to the fields west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 615, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd045fc4fb6cc447d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb038cc80cec65fb4b"}

name: East Ishtar Drive
description:
Your highly acute sense of smell reports you have reached the entrance
to the fish market. Although renowned for it fresh catches and
wide selection of aquarian delicacies you wonder how much longer you
can endure the smell! The Ishtar River flows alongside to the south
with the drive running alongside it east to west.

name: A dead end path in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  The ancient
trees stand so close that the path disappears between the dusty roots.  To the
south a dark river flows from east to west.  The only exit appears to be west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "river", "description": "The river flows fast and strong.  It is black or looks so in the gloom.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6123, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb8dfce3ef55e903c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2f0c2a221d3fe202"}

name: Roc's Nest.
description:
You are standing in a nest.  It is huge, at least two spear-lengths
wide.  You see three eggs in the center.  They are knee high, brown
and look almost leathery.  Better hope mom isn't around!

name: Base of the mountain
description: Exits are east and west.

name: A Damp Hallway
description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway.  The temperature
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

name: Achilles Avenue
description:
The town bards sang of the victory parades that used to pass along this
route.  It was once a major way through the center of town.  The street
goes south to a bend and north to an intersection.

name: A bath house
description:
This is the bath house for the commoners of the city. Hot steamy water
wells up from a hole in the floor. Obviously there is a hot spring located
under the city (making the decision to put a city here seem much more
reasonable). To the west is another room.

name: Inside the furnace
description:
You gasp for breath and choke on toxic sulphur and brimstone.  The sweat
on your forehead is instantly vaporized by the flames that surround you.  You
begin to feel faint and dizzy from the heat...

... you'd better leave before you pass out and burn to a cinder!
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The flames blind you and obscure your vision.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7768, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd010c2ffe0c7b5e3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd010c2ffe0c7b5e3"}
