{"direction": 3, "description": "The flames blind you and obscure your vision.", "keyword": "door furnace", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7766, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd010c2ffe0c7b5e3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb54a963fd11435b03"}

name: Wall Road
description:
You are standing on the road next to the western city wall which
continues north.  South of here is a bridge across the river.  To the east,
you see an odd looking building painted bright orange with purple trim...
it must be the Mob Factory!
extraDescription: {"keyword": "wall", "description": "It is built from large grey rocks that have been fastened to each other with\nsome kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the purple-and-orange Mob Factory.  Someone has no taste.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9400, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7b11424acc63914d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb19401582ccf468c6"}

name: Approaching the Head of Draco
description:
You have come to the end of Draco, but you can't find the head!
You see a forcefield to the south, some distance away, beyond reach.
If only the head were here ...

name: The Ambush Point
description:
This is a overgrown foot-trail south of the inn. It leads west, but you
would be hard pressed to follow it far. A number of bushes are trampled on
and some medium sized branches have been knocked down.  Obviously there has
been a battle here rather recently.

name: Office of a Septon
description:
A neat and tidy room, it appear to be inhabited my a neatenss freak.  The only
exit lies to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you see a junction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9039, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7fef87e78fcb569f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdf0f25997c741a0b"}

name: Unknown passage
description:
Oh dear you seem to have lost your way.  You look back from whence you
came but there's no exit there anymore.  There are exits in other
directions but you have a feeling that you are hopelessly lost.

name: The hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
There is a closed metal door to the west.

name: Zeus Street
description:
You are on the main street of this town, called Zeus street. There is some
sort of store to the west.

name: Fields
description:
You are among fruit trees in a field.  You see many apple and orange
trees.  You can make out the corn fields north and some vegetable patches west.
The sight of the fruit makes your mouth water.

name: The gathering place
description:
This appears to be the clearing the ogres use to assemble. It is quite large
and has a raised mound in the center that contains a crude throne. The ground
in front of the throne is quite worn, as if it is sat on quite often. You get
the impression that this place is a crude sort of auditorium. Small paths lead
east and south.

name: East Ishtar Drive
description:
The sound of squawking gulls and the smell of rotting fish gives you a hint
of your location. The Ishtar River flows south of you, but looks crystal
clear, so it cannot be the source of this putrid smell. Looking north you
notice a small sign hanging over the dump.

name: A small path on the river bank in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient grey
trees loom everywhere.  To the south you smell marsh gas.  The path continues
north and east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "river", "description": "The river flows fast and strong.  It is black or looks so in the gloom.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6126, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcead7d047c0956d5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb47c861aa0dd3d503"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6123, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcead7d047c0956d5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2f0c2a221d3fe202"}

name: Cumulative nimbus cloud.
description: This cloud looks like it belongs to the phylum of cumulative nimbus clouds.

name: A trail up the mountain
description: Exits are east and west.

name: A Damp Hallway
description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway.  The temperature
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

name: A small ruined chapel
description:
This was a small temple built to honor the minor gods and goddesses.
It is now desecrated by graffiti and vandalism.  Perhaps its worst
defilement is that it is the hangout of the Ogre gang.  There is a street to
the east through a rusty metal door.

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow back alley leads west to a small side street and east to one
of the city watchtowers. Great amounts of steam issue forth from the
building to the south.  It looks very inviting.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5341, "room_id": "69f4d0cba77919892325d17b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7a68412452021ac4"}

name: A guard station
description:
You are standing in a small, fairly empty building that serves as the prison
for the keep.  The building is small because the githyanki do not make a habit
of taking prisoners, and those that they do capture do not last long.
The cellblock lies to the west and the grey stone road is to the east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door iron", "description": "The door is fashioned from many iron plates and set deep into the stone wall.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see an iron door which leads back out onto the grey cobblestone road.", "keyword": "door iron", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7753, "room_id": "69f4d0cb20a08c570944319a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb07b46cced2971003"}

name: Grubby Inn
description:
You are inside the old Grubby Inn.  This place has not been cleaned for
several decades, vile smells make you dizzy.

name: At the Entrance of the Great Dipper
description:
Now you are in the innermost part of the galaxy.  What you are walking on now
is the path of the Great Dipper or the Plough.  You notice that there are
seven rooms in this zone, representing the seven stars of the Dipper.

name: The Bar
description:
This is where people use to come and enjoy the food, drink and hospitality
of the innkeeper, but as of late, he only serves the few adventurers that
manage to survive a trip thru the forest. You can leave south and return to the
common room.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You may retreat south back to the common room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3574, "room_id": "69f4d0cb38747da342f667c1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd22b82bbaf22e045"}

name: An east-west passage
description: In east west passage is here with exits in all of the cardinal directions.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can see a room to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9043, "room_id": "69f4d0cba09dd0ed6b698ea7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb76b7b5abd56d9947"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you can see a junction", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9039, "room_id": "69f4d0cba09dd0ed6b698ea7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdf0f25997c741a0b"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can make out a averaged sized room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9044, "room_id": "69f4d0cba09dd0ed6b698ea7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6ddc3741187c4665"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west you can see what appears to be a cavernous room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9045, "room_id": "69f4d0cba09dd0ed6b698ea7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1582752c816bb088"}

name: A classroom
description:
You are in a large classroom filled with bored looking students of the
art. The instructor stops in his lecture on the fine uses of magic missile
at your entry and lunges to attack you.
The only apparent exit is back east to the hallway.

name: Zeus Street
description:
You are still on the main thoroughfare of this town.  To the north, you see
a large castle.  To the east there is a smaller road.

name: Fields
description:
You are among the vegetable fields.  You see many cabbage and lettuce
patches, along with tomato bushes and potato plants.  To the east are some
fruit trees, and north are some wheat fields.

name: The firepit before the lodge
description:
You stand at the edge of a huge firepit. The heat from the burning embers
makes you sweat as you stand here. Large spits above the pit are empty but
they appear to be quite large enough to hold hapless adventurers. A large
lodge is towards the north, while paths lead east, west, and south into the
village itself.

name: Boat Ramp
description:
This sloped slab of stone allows easy passage to and from the Ishtar.
Boats are moored to the docks here awaiting their masters to return from
the warehouses and the pubs. The waters of the Ishtar lap at your feet
to the south and Ishtar Drive is to the north.

name: Dark hidden cloud.
description: This cloud looks like the perfect place to hide.

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way between huge, ancient trees standing
close on all sides.  The trail leads north and west, and to the south a frail
path leads away from the trail.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads north through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6127, "room_id": "69f4d0cb47c861aa0dd3d503", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbac15e15eb4d0206a"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The path leads south - away from the trail.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6125, "room_id": "69f4d0cb47c861aa0dd3d503", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcead7d047c0956d5"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6128, "room_id": "69f4d0cb47c861aa0dd3d503", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb55fe04f183f8b74"}

name: The mountain top.
description: Exits are north, east, and west.

name: A Damp Hallway
description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway.  The temperature
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

name: A Resting Room
description:
You are in a resting room.  Soft mats line the floor, and you see many
people just relaxing on them.  The comfort of this place is so inviting, you
want to join them.  Great amounts of steam issue forth from the hole in the
east wall.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A small side street runs past the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5310, "room_id": "69f4d0cbaffe19586a30dda5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb489fa9764f82f314"}

name: Ajax Avenue at chapel
description:
The temple to honor the minor gods is through a rusty metal door
to the west.  The street continues north and south.  You hear the
muffled sounds of screams coming from the chapel.

name: The cellblock
description:
A torch flickers in the western wall, providing some illumination for this
dim corridor.  Some whips, manacles, and chains hang on the walls -- they seem
to have been used recently.
Cell doors stand to the north and south.  The guard station is to the east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door cell", "description": "The cell door is wooden and about 4' high, with a slot in the bottom to pass\nfood underneath to the prisoner.", "valid": true}

name: Levee
description:
You are at the levee.  South of here you see the river gently flowing west.
The river bank is very low making it possible to enter the river.  Directly
across the river you can see a small boat landing built off of Kate's Diner.

name: The Bard's Table
description:
You are in a darker corner in the Inn.  A large round table with a few
wooden chairs sits here.  There is a large stain on the table, the remnants
of a spilled drink.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the main floor of the Inn to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3574, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9e9b1c82f19d50c0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd22b82bbaf22e045"}

name: The Barracks
description:
A dusty room, with a almost untolerable odor, the barracks are being inspected
by a Hexton and his personal enterage.
The only exit lies to the south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can see junction", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9042, "room_id": "69f4d0cb76b7b5abd56d9947", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba09dd0ed6b698ea7"}

name: Cassiopeia's Throne
description:
This is the Throne room of the Queen of the Universe.  From here you can see
every star and constellation in the Universe.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: Fields
description:
You are among the wheat fields.  The gentle caress of the wheat and the
cool shadow from the tall stalks and scarecrow lulls you to sleep and dream
of a little girl and little dog from a faraway place.  To the east are the corn
stalks, and south of you are the vegetable patches.

name: Castle Entryway
description:
You are in the entryway of a large castle.  It is very beautiful, with
large paintings and a lovely carpet.  You hear jovial laughter to the north,
while smaller corridors branch off to the east and west.

name: The village dump
description:
The smell here overpowers you. All around you are the rotting remains of the
village's refuse. Partially eaten corpses, rotting food, and other truly
disgusting things have been discarded here. Paths lead south and west towards
fresher air.

name: Yet another cloud
description:
You find yourself in yet another cloud.  Will the madness never
end?  There is a rope ladder leading up.

name: West Casbah
description:
The air takes on a somber note as you stand before the entrance to the
jailhouse of New Thalos. Hopefully you won't ever see this structure from
the inside. The northwest tower stands here with a spiral staircase
leading up. The avenue ends here, only exiting to the east.

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way between huge, ancient trees
standing close on all sides.  The trail leads east and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6112, "room_id": "69f4d0cbac15e15eb4d0206a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd5e6366a604d2ee0"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads south through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6126, "room_id": "69f4d0cbac15e15eb4d0206a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb47c861aa0dd3d503"}

name: The lion's den
description: Exits are south.

name: A Damp Hallway
description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway.  The temperature
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

name: On the second floor of the library
description:
You see more books here.  Through windows, you have a glorious view of
a nearby bay.  Birds fly by your window.

name: First intersection of Hector and Achilles
description:
There is a large statue here depicting a battle between two
great warriors.  You think it's odd that it has not been defiled,
but then you sense a aura protecting it.  Achilles runs east
and south, while Hector heads out to the north.

name: A cramped cell
description:
You are in a tiny, cold, dank cell.
The only exit is back through the door to the south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door cell", "description": "The cell door is wooden and about 4' high, with a slot in the bottom to pass\nfood underneath to the prisoner.", "valid": true}

name: Abandoned Warehouse
description:
You are inside the only room in the old warehouse.  The place is very dusty
and appears to have been unused for many years.  The skylight spills
violet-tinged light.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see machine dreams and taste violet phosphor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8604, "room_id": "69f4d0cb589a825f87965450", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc9cca07d558933a7"}

name: The Commander's Post
description:
You have stumbled on to the office of the Commander of the forces in the Plane
Of Nirvana.  The room is well furnished and a sense of courage and bravery
overtakes you as you enter the room.  The only exit lies to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can visualize a junction of passages.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9042, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6ddc3741187c4665", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba09dd0ed6b698ea7"}

name: Garbage dump
description:
You stand knee deep in garbage.  YECCH!!! It smells terrible and who knows
what vermin live in these piles of filth ...
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You can return to cleaner lands this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3573, "room_id": "69f4d0cb43950b49eb687273", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5caeb14f4774f50b"}

name: Along the Path of the Dipper
description: You see stars around you but nothing of special interest.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: The Shed
description:
You are in the storage shed.  Bales of wheat, corn and hay are piled
against the wall, and some vegetables are in carts.  You see a small door
to the west.  The main exit is south.

name: Throne Room
description:
You stop dead in your tracks as you enter this room.  Before you is Zeus,
in all his glory, sitting on a huge golden throne.  You had thought him to be
just a myth, but here he is ... you wonder who else lives in this castle.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "throne", "description": "This huge golden throne looks as if it has been here for ages.  As you study it\ncarefully, you notice that it is not firmly attached to the floor ... perhaps\nyou could slide it?", "valid": true}

name: The entryway to the lodge
description:
You are at the entry hall to a large lodge. Animal pelts and other trophies
line the walls here. Large chests on either side of the door appear to be
locked. The lodge stretches north, while the doors to the south provide an
exit into the village.

name: Front gate
description:
There is a gate here.  It is huge, towering over you.  It creaks
as it sways in the breeze.  To the south you see a huge lawn.
There is a rope ladder leading down.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "There is a rope ladder leading down.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9159, "room_id": "69f4d0cbab549ce0b3406b27", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf54ba77ef55f8706"}

name: West Casbah
description:
You have almost reached the end of the avenue in this direction, the
number of guards in this part of town is nearly doubled. To the north
the familiar city wall protects you from the wilderness. Looking south
marble stairs rise towards the entrance of city hall surrounded by
massive white pillars. The avenue continues west and south from here.

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way east-west between huge, ancient trees
that stand close on all sides.  Not a sound is to be heard - everything is
ominously quiet.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6126, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb55fe04f183f8b74", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb47c861aa0dd3d503"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6129, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb55fe04f183f8b74", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1d724d8483e1d701"}

name: The north-west watchtower
description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent
from here and you can see all the way to the western mountains.  You are
confident nothing can touch this tower.

name: The level foothills
description: Exits are east and west.

name: Achilles Avenue
description:
A large open space, possibly a cemetery, lies to the south.
There is a large wrought-iron fence with spikes on top
which prevents you from entering the area.  The street
continues east and west.

name: A tiny cell
description:
You are in a cold, dank, cramped cell.
The only exit is back through the door to the north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door cell", "description": "The cell door is wooden and about 4' high, with a slot in the bottom to pass\nfood underneath to the prisoner.", "valid": true}

name: A Damp Hallway
description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway.  The temperature
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

name: On the Bridge
description:
You are standing on the stone bridge crosses the river.  The bridge is
built out from the western city wall and the river flows west through an
opening in the wall ten feet below the bridge.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bridge", "description": "It is built from large grey rocks that have been fastened to each other with\nsome kind of mortar, just like the wall.", "valid": true}

name: A Quieter Section of the Inn
description:
There seems to be no one in this end of the Woodsman, probably a safe place
to rest and lick your wounds ...

name: The chamber of the second Secundus
description:
This huge room is furnished with the finest, and a personal legion guards the
Secundus. the only exit is to the east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you can see a junction", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9042, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1582752c816bb088", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba09dd0ed6b698ea7"}

name: Cepheus' Throne
description:
This is the Throne room of the King of the Universe.  From here you can see
every star and constellation in the Universe.

name: An empty classroom
description:
You are in an empty classroom. Some strange sigils are written on a
blackboard which is floating in the air here. Other than a few desks,
it is bare of furnishings.
The only apparent exit leads back east to the hallway.

name: Western Wing
description:
You are in the western wing of the castle.  You see the entrance to the
east, while this hallway continues to the west.

name: Slaughterhouse
description:
You are in the slaughterhouse, where all the animals are slaughtered so
that they can be sold or their skins be tanned.  The scream of dying animals
makes your stomach churn.  The exit is to the west.

name: The throne room
description:
You stand in a large, crudely decorated throne room. A huge throne adorned
with humanoid skulls sits against the west wall. A crude, blood stained altar
is against the east wall. A doorway is directly to the north, long strands of
beads blocking the view of the other side. Crude torches light the hall and
smoke clings to the ceiling.

name: Lawn
description:
The lawn seems to stretch and stretch to the south and to the west.
North of you is a gate.  The grass is emerald green and luscious,
obviously well cared for.

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way east-west between huge, ancient trees
that stand close on all sides.  Not a sound is to be heard - everything is
ominously quiet.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6128, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1d724d8483e1d701", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb55fe04f183f8b74"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6135, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1d724d8483e1d701", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7966625f1a081771"}

name: The Casbah
description:
The wall of the palace curves south from here, a darkened alley runs along
it in that direction. West of here you see the steps of the city hall
and notice the increase in the number of guards. To the east the avenue
continues.

name: The south-west watchtower
description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent
from here and you can see all the way to the western mountains. To the
south bay stretches to the horizon.  You are confident nothing can touch this
tower.

name: The End of the Hallway
description:
You make your way out of the hallway, just to find yourself in greater
danger.  Before you looms the source of the great heat.

name: The cave entrance
description: Exits are east and west.

name: A bend in the road
description:
Achilles Avenue bends to the north and west here.  There
is also a narrow alley to the south.

name: A large dwelling
description:
You have stepped inside a dimly lit building with vaulted ceilings and high
windows.  The walls are heavy stone blocks that rise tens of feet above your
head, covered with panels of strangely knotted and twisted wood.  On the floor
are charcoal stencils of pentagrams and various other ominous sigils.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door wooden", "description": "The door is thick, made from a knotted and twisted greyish wood.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The wooden door leads back out onto the grey cobblestone road.", "keyword": "door wooden", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7757, "room_id": "69f4d0cb24c1e3f1a7425662", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbea57efbdb9618f7e"}

name: Outside the West Gate of Midgaard
description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city wall and
connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate.  To the west you
can see the edge of a big forest. A small dusty trail leads north along the
wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bridge footbridge", "description": "It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk across it\nfrom one tower to the other.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The trail continues around the City of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3900, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd67a94ec11b8c2fb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba73a38951a935f03"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The city gate is to the east.", "keyword": "gate", "exit_flags": 1, "key": 3133, "to_room_vnum": 3040, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd67a94ec11b8c2fb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb752550123ef7321f"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The forest edge is to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6000, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd67a94ec11b8c2fb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8ee3d7875764ab6c"}

name: A bend in the hallway
description:
You are at a bend in the hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by.
The hallway continues east and north.

name: A Passageway
description:
You are in a well lit passage.  A sense of forboding danger envelopes you.
Exits lead in all cardinal directions.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can see a small chamber", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9047, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8f9a5b6ec9b99c9e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5c7fcbeca053d672"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, a chamber can be seen", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9048, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8f9a5b6ec9b99c9e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5606f0135acc3de1"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west, a large tunnel can be found.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9022, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8f9a5b6ec9b99c9e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd50f179d0e1568c7"}

name: Along the path of the Dipper
description: You see stars around you but nothing of special interest.

name: On the Trail of the Horsemen
description:
The path continues east and west of here.  You notice fresh tracks in
the soft ground that show the horsemen fled to the west.

name: Western Wing
description:
You are in the western wing of the castle.  The hallway continues to the
north, while there are private rooms to the west and south.

name: A narrow trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail winding its way westwards just below huge sticky
wires suspended like ropes between the trees.  To the west the path seems to
be completely covered in a giant web made from huge threads covered with glue.
This place gives you the creeps.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "trail", "description": "The dark and dusty trail seems fragile compared to the massive trunks, and in\nsome places, giant grey roots have broken up through its surface.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest, away from the web.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6144, "room_id": "69f4d0cb524c32a59015a47c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3827ce18468c114e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The structure to the west looks most of all like an immense spider web.\nIt does not look as if you can go further without getting caught in it.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6131, "room_id": "69f4d0cb524c32a59015a47c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb686031db1d1acf55"}

name: The Casbah
description:
As you travel down the road towards towards the city hall you look up
at the guards walking along the wall keeping watch. South of you stands
the great walls of the palace and the avenue goes east and west.

name: Croquet game
description:
A croquet game has been set up and carelessly left out.  Who ever
was playing blue was in the lead before they quit.  Benches have
been set up for spectators and players to enjoy themselves.

name: The north-east watchtower
description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent
from here.  Green fields stretch to the horizon.  You are confident nothing
can touch this tower.

name: The chieftain's room
description:
This appears to be the ogre chieftain's private quarters. A huge pile of furs
is in the far corner. Large chests fill the room. All of them have heavy pad
locks. The room is filled with trophies of dead enemies. It is quite lavishly
decorated for such a crude inhabitant as an ogre. A beaded doorway is to the
south.

name: Dirt Road
description:
You are on a dirt road.  To the east is a barn, and you see a big chicken
coop south of you.  The dirt road continues north and west.

name: The Altar
description:
You finally reach the end of the maze.  There is a great altar here in the
shape of a bat.  A passageway leads off to the west.

name: The hill giant cave
description: Exits are east.

name: What is left of the weaponshop
description:
It doesn't even look like those punks gave the weaponsmith a
proper burial.  But what a going away present he seems to have
received!  Blood is splattered and dried all over the walls here.
It looks like a great deal of carnage happened here.  The way
out to the east leads out onto a street.

name: South End of the Hall
description:
This is a massive stone hall, lit by flaming blue stones set into the walls.
Massive suits of armor line the walls, holding weapons fashioned from a strange
silvery metal.
The great hall continues to the north and ends in a pair of huge metal doors
to the south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "armor suits", "description": "The suits of armor are very intricately and ornately fashioned splint mail.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The great hall continues to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7775, "room_id": "69f4d0cb96edf43e92ee5ba7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4e05d7672938d974"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The metal doors lead out onto the grey cobblestone road.", "keyword": "doors metal", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7755, "room_id": "69f4d0cb96edf43e92ee5ba7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc4fb44566858dd09"}

name: Path in the plains
description:
You are walking on a path situated in the rough plains.
You feel the strong winds blow through your hair as you study
the beautiful landscaping here. The path continues east, north
and west leads to plains and you see the path towards the north
gate of midgaard to the south.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You notice nothing special, except that the path in the plains continues.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 301, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5a759092a9dee6ee", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb02af323f5dd0eac1"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Towards the south you notice the north gate of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3904, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5a759092a9dee6ee", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb17c6a5a4a5e661d4"}

name: Outside the East Gate of Midgaard
description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city wall and
connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate.  To the east the
plains stretch out in the distance. To the north a small dusty trail follow
the city wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bridge footbridge", "description": "It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk across it\nfrom one tower to the other.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The trail continues around the City of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3908, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6aa2f8999708dda0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba38ce67f3924cfcd"}

name: Chamber of the Octon
description:
A small room, sparsely furnished, it leaves you with a sense of fear.  The
only exit is to the south
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can see a passage.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9046, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5c7fcbeca053d672", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8f9a5b6ec9b99c9e"}

name: Along the path of the Dipper
description: You see stars around you but nothing of special interest.

name: An empty classroom
description:
You are in an apparently empty classroom. A strange feeling of being
watched comes over you, and you hear the faint rustle of robes.
The only apparent exit is back east to the hallway.

name: Western Wing
description:
You are in the western wing of the castle.  This hallway continues to the
south, and you hear pots and pans rattling to the north.

name: On the Trail of the Horsemen
description:
The path continues east and south.  You notice fresh tracks in
the soft ground that show the horsemen turned, and fled south.

name: The spider web
description:
You are walking along the narrow path, ducking under the sticky ropes as you
advance...

>
A huge, poisonous spider drops from above!
A huge, poisonous spider drops from above!
A huge, poisonous spider drops from above!

>
The huge, poisonous spider stings you!  You resist the poison!
The huge, poisonous spider stings you!  You are poisoned!
The huge, poisonous spider stings you!  You are poisoned!

>
You've fallen, and you can't get up!!!!!

name: The Casbah
description:
The cobblestone pavement runs along the north wall here. South of you
stand the great walls of the palace and the avenue goes east and west.

name: The Temple of Thalos
description:
You stand within one of the most holy places in the realm. This stunning
domed temple houses the city's worshipers en masse. Long benches line the
aisles and the altar glistens with the gold and platinum inlay.The walls and
roof are all made of ceramic, making this place reflect the sun well.
The greenery around the temple itself makes this place a great blend of
nature and man's works of art.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A side street leads to the northern half of the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5305, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc680d534e21008f9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb424293a818745bc1"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Main street leads out to the main gate of the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5303, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc680d534e21008f9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb908d2ac682ef666f"}

name: Huge, gorgeous fountain.
description:
An enormous golden fountain is here.  You see swans, angels,
gryphons and a host of other creatures in the fountain.  The
fountain empties into a huge pool that looks quite inviting.

name: The frigid wastelands
description:
You wander through the frigid wastelands. Your breath is a cloud before you.
The cold cuts to the bone. Swirling snow and wind make impossible for you to
discern any directions.

name: Chicken Coop
description:
You are in the chicken coop.  The smell of chickens and chicken droppings
makes you gasp.  The exit is north.

name: The tunnel
description: The tunnel turns here, continuing to the east and south.

name: The Chief's House
description:
You enter into a large and luxurious house.  The floor is coated with carpets
and the walls are covered in paintings.  You feel privileged just for stepping
inside.

name: North End of the Hall
description:
This is a massive stone hall, lit by flaming blue stones set into the walls.
Massive suits of armor line the walls, holding weapons fashioned from a strange
silvery metal.
The great hall continues to the south.  An archway leads into a dimly lit
room to the north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "armor suits", "description": "The suits of armor are very intricately and ornately fashioned splint mail.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You think you can see some steps leading up to an altar...", "keyword": "mist door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7776, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4e05d7672938d974", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc1d811866d156d19"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The great hall continues to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7774, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4e05d7672938d974", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb96edf43e92ee5ba7"}

name: Ajax street at Weaponshop (or whats left of it)
description:
The street goes north and south.  The stables used to be to the
east, but I bet all the horses are dead or gone.

name: Path in the plains
description:
You are walking on a path situated in the rough plains.
You feel the strong winds blow through your hair as you study
the beautiful landscaping here. The path continues east and west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You notice nothing special, except that the path in the plains continues.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 302, "room_id": "69f4d0cb02af323f5dd0eac1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb215df3c4d235237f"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You notice nothing special, except that the path in the plains continues.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 300, "room_id": "69f4d0cb02af323f5dd0eac1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5a759092a9dee6ee"}

name: By the Temple Altar
description:
You are by the temple altar in the northern end of the Temple of Mota.
A huge altar made from white polished marble is standing in front of you and
behind it is a ten foot tall sitting statue of Odin, the King of the Gods.
The back of the altar opens into a a beautiful atrium, above which can be
seen a rainbow.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "altar", "description": "Even though the altar is more than ten feet long it appears to be made from a\nsingle block of white virgin marble.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the southern end of the temple.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3001, "room_id": "69f4d0cb611c25622176521c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0ce695cd67b76c67"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "Bifrost, the Rainbow Bridge, hangs in the sky above you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1215, "room_id": "69f4d0cb611c25622176521c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1d89d233d56bd8ae"}

name: Chamber of the Nonaton
description:
You have entered the chamber of the principal law and order overseers.  The
only exit lies to the north
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can see a passageway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9046, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5606f0135acc3de1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8f9a5b6ec9b99c9e"}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A sturdy iron door can be seen to the south.

name: Kitchen
description:
You have entered the kitchen of this castle, and it is a hotbed of
activity.  Servants are bustling about, preparing food for the Gods themselves.

name: End of the Dipper
description:
You have finished the path of the Dipper.  Here, the most prominent feature
is a set of claw-marks.  You also notice a room to the south; it looks as
if Polaris could lie here.

name: The Casbah
description:
The activity here is only slightly less than chaotic. Young boys run to
and fro with stern intent, and older gentleman swagger down the street
towards the library. To the west you can see the tall towers of the
northern gate, and the avenue continues east.

name: On the Trail of the Horsemen
description:
The trail of the horsemen continues east and north along this path through
the forest.  The tracks are still fresh, so they must be near.

name: Up in the tree
description:
You are hanging on the outside of a huge tree trunk covered in a sticky
substance.  Directly to the west is an immense spider web suspended between
numerous of the giant trees including the one you are hanging on.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "web", "description": "The spider web stretches out to the west.  It looks as if it is possible to\nwalk on it.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "To the west is the immense spider web.  It seems to move softly.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6133, "room_id": "69f4d0cbab4eca2f7584653f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5ea7524da43a736e"}

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow alley leads east to a wider street and west to one of
the city watchtowers.  Little kids play tag around you.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5352, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1ce99f7a8895ef71", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7ffab1ac8ae7f78b"}

name: Patio.
description:
A huge patio overlooks the lawn area.  There are enough tables and
chairs for a party of 100.  The tables and chairs are ornate and
expensive, tasteful and elegant.  Stairs lead up to the main
house.

name: The tunnel
description: You are in a narrow east-west tunnel.

name: Barn
description:
You are in a barn.  There are some cows here, munching on mounds of hay.
Milk is milked and bottled here.  You see the exit west.

name: The frigid wastelands
description:
You wander through the frigid wastelands. Your breath is a cloud before you.
The cold cuts to the bone. Swirling snow and wind make it impossible to
discern any directions.

name: The Unused Path
description:
You are now on a fairly unused path that leads east out of the village.
You wonder what could be out this way.

name: The Altar Chamber
description:
Your eyes have trouble adjusting to the dim lighting.  All around you are
columnar statues of githyanki turned towards the altar standing at the top
of a series of steps.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "arch archway door", "description": "The archway is shrouded in a strange black mist that obscures your vision.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The steps lead north and up to a massive sacrificial altar.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7777, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc1d811866d156d19", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdf642ecc4184eaca"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You think you can see the hall.", "keyword": "mist door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7775, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc1d811866d156d19", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4e05d7672938d974"}

name: Khan Park
description:
Not really a "park" as you and i would think of it but
it seems queerly peaceful here in comparison to the rest of
the area.  There seems to be some kind of memorial to the
great Mongol warrior Khan being crudely constructed here.
There is a street to the east and another to the south.

name: Path in the plains
description:
You are walking on a path situated in the rough plains.
You feel the strong winds blow through your hair as you study
the beautiful landscaping here. The path continues north and west.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You notice nothing special, except that the path in the plains continues.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 303, "room_id": "69f4d0cb215df3c4d235237f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd8582025365e6a43"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You notice nothing special, except that the path in the plains continues.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 301, "room_id": "69f4d0cb215df3c4d235237f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb02af323f5dd0eac1"}

name: The Fountain of Youth Apothecary
description:
An old man putters around behind the counter, making strange love potions
and curative philtres.  He turns as you enter, and looks on with avarice.
Judging from the furnishings, he's been made very wealthy by his trade.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the eastern end of alley.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3046, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf701da703a34b678", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5aa7dbbd6801f6ab"}

name: End of the passageway
description:
You have reached the end of a long east-west passage.  The passage contiues to
the west, and rooms lie to the north, south, and east.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can see a room", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9050, "room_id": "69f4d0cb64648c16d94ae51b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4e6e4fb1f2cda0d5"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you can make out a large chamber", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9052, "room_id": "69f4d0cb64648c16d94ae51b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbf2de9454e913ac7"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, a room can be seen.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9051, "room_id": "69f4d0cb64648c16d94ae51b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5e15be40ac88b520"}

name: Eastern Wing
description:
You are in the eastern wing of the castle.  The hall continues to the
east, while the entrance is back to the west.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
There is a large oaken door to the south.

name: The Polar Star
description:
You have entered the private chamber of Polaris.  This is a room of great
significance.  You can see a powerful telescope pointing down towards the
Universe (SNOOPING!).  It is from here that Polaris commands the Universe.
You feel you have come to end of your search in this galaxy ...

name: The Casbah
description:
Walking along the cobblestone path you feel secure with the walls of the
city towering over you. You hear the scraping sounds of metal on stone
and look up to see a large, strong guard looking out to the north. To the
east lies the intersection on Guildsman's Row and the northern gate is
a short walk to the west.

name: On the spider web
description:
You are balancing carefully on the giant sticky threads that holds the giant
web in place.  To the east is a giant tree trunk and to the west is an entrance
to a cave-like structure made from many layers of spider web.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "web", "description": "The immense spider web moves softly.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east is the giant tree trunk.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6132, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5ea7524da43a736e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbab4eca2f7584653f"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west is the entrance to the cave-like structure.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6134, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5ea7524da43a736e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2a29635b1f578b50"}

name: A Dead End Trail
description:
The path comes to an abrupt end here, as the trees close around you and
make any further exploration impossible.  Fresh tracks cover the ground, and
end right here.  The horsemen must be nearby.

name: Under a watchtower
description:
You stand at the base of a tall watchtower built to protect the city
from invaders.  From the looks of things, its doing a great job.

name: Long stairway.
description:
This stairway is suspended on clouds.  It leads from the house to
the front lawn.  The banisters are made of ornate gold and silver
inlays.

name: The tunnel
description: You are at a turn, the tunnel continues south and west.

name: Dirt Road
description:
You are on a dirt road.  To the north and south, you see some grass
fields.  There is a pigsty west, and the dirt road continues east.

name: The Glacier Temple
description:
You are in a small temple. It appears to be built entirely from ice. The ice
walls are frosted and are opaque. There is a small blue portal here. You can
go north, to enter the portal. Looking south, you see a world of white outside
the open doorway. Swirling snow and bright light obscure your view.

name: The Overgrown Path
description:
As the path continues on, the grass grows higher.  You can't imagine
what could possibly be out this way.

name: Before the Altar
description:
You have climbed the mighty steps of the altar chamber and stand before a
huge altar use to pay tribute to Lord Gish, long-dead ruler of the githyanki.
The altar is covered in blood and radiates unspeakable power that is absorbed
by the horrible presence which stands before you.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "altar", "description": "The altar is a huge sacrificial altar covered in bloodstains.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The steps lie to the south, leading back down to the altar chamber floor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7776, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdf642ecc4184eaca", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc1d811866d156d19"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The floor of the altar is pockmarked with small holes, draining blood.", "keyword": "hole", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7778, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdf642ecc4184eaca", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb38c608b940a0375f"}

name: Achilles avenue at entrance to park
description:
A ... park?! lies to the west.  The street runs south to an
intersection and curves to the north.

name: Path in the plains
description:
You are walking on a path situated in the rough plains.
You feel the strong winds blow through your hair as you study
the beautiful landscaping here. The path leads north and south.
To the east and the west you have the grassy plains.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You notice nothing special, except that the path in the plains continues.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 304, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd8582025365e6a43", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbad938435a7c6f5d5"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you notice the grassy plains.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 317, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd8582025365e6a43", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3ebf9c388ecf363c"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You notice nothing special, except that the path in the plains continues.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 302, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd8582025365e6a43", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb215df3c4d235237f"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west you can see more of the beautiful grassy plains.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 315, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd8582025365e6a43", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe0838a779e47594e"}

name: In the air...
description: WOW you can fly!  You are floating in the air above Temple Square of Midgaard.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "Back down on the earth where you should be!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3005, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2a9dfa55ef2ad340", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd8ae997a2d9beb57"}

name: Chamber of a Hexton
description:
You have entered the chamber of a Hexton.  Trophies adorn the walls, some of
which are human. the only exit is to the south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can see a passageway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9049, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4e6e4fb1f2cda0d5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb64648c16d94ae51b"}

name: Eastern Wing
description:
You are in the eastern wing of the castle.  The hall turns to the north
here, while there are private rooms to the east and the south.

name: The Amphitheater
description:
You are in a small amphitheater. Rows of comfortable looking chairs circle
a large podium. The echos of your footsteps seem very loud here.
The only apparent exit leads north to the hallway.

name: The Casbah
description:
The din of the guilds assaults your senses as you reach this intersection;
the sound of hammering, the smell of tanned leather, and the smoke rising
from the smithy all rush up to greet you. The avenue continues east and
west form here and the row leads south.

name: The Den of the Queen Spider
description:
You are inside a cave-like structure that seems to be made entirely from
countless layers of spider web.  Temperature and humidity is very high making
it hard to breathe the foul air that lingers here.  The walls are covered with
open cocoons.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "web wall walls", "description": "The sticky walls are covered with open cocoons.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Compared to this place the east exit looks inviting.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6133, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2a29635b1f578b50", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5ea7524da43a736e"}

name: The tunnel
description: You are at a turn, the tunnel continues north and east.

name: A back alley
description: A narrow alley leads south to one of the city watchtowers.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5352, "room_id": "69f4d0cb90bd8711be2b11a0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7ffab1ac8ae7f78b"}

name: Front door
description:
You stand at the front door of an immense, sprawling mansion made
of granite and marble.  The door is at least 10 feet high and is
made of oak.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see an ornate oak door.", "keyword": "oak door", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9177, "room_id": "69f4d0cb64745beb0967532d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8f2504457ef37710"}

name: Grass Field
description:
You are in a grass field.  Fences block the way north, east, and west.
The dirt road is to the south.

name: The frigid wastelands
description:
You wander through the frigid wastelands. Your breath is a cloud before you.
The cold cuts to the bone. Swirling snow and wind make it impossible for you
to discern any directions.

name: The Clearing
description:
Your progress is suddenly stopped by mountains on all sides.  The path leads
back to the west, and there appears to be an old mine shaft to the north.

name: A bend in Ajax
description:
The roads bends south and east here.  You barely notice
a small alley leading north.  Some kind of tunnel entrance
is to the west but it has been crushed under its own weight.

name: A Gateway to the Underworld
description:
You step through the tiny hole in the altar, and stand before a swirling
field of blackness.  Through the field you can hear the howls of lost souls
and long-dead beings.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "blood", "description": "The blood drips from above your head and falls through the field...", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You look down into the field of blackness, and feel a tangible wave of evil wash\nover you.  Stepping into the field would be a bad idea.", "keyword": "gateway", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 7724, "to_room_vnum": 7779, "room_id": "69f4d0cb38c608b940a0375f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba332675b015ab6d6"}

name: Path in the plains
description:
You are walking on a path situated in the rough plains.
You feel the strong winds blow through your hair as you study
the beautiful landscaping here. The Path leads north and south.

name: Northwest end of Concourse
description:
You are at the concourse, the city wall is just west.  A small promenade
goes east, and the bridge is just north of here.  The concourse continues
south along the city wall.

name: Eastern Wing
description:
You are in the eastern wing of the castle.  You hear animals to the north,
while the hallway continues to the south.

name: Chamber of a Hexton
description:
You have entered a room where you are not very popular. The only exit lies
northbound.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can see a passage.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9049, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5e15be40ac88b520", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb64648c16d94ae51b"}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow providing enough light to see by.
A small door can be seen to the south.

name: The Casbah
description:
You walk between the solid stone wall of the city and that of the Mason's
guild. Young children and their nannys walk around enjoying the safety
of the city. The avenue runs east and west from here.

name: A dusty trail in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient grey
trees loom all around you.  The trail continues north and east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The dusty trail leads north through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6136, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7966625f1a081771", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb25344589e862e323"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The dusty trail leads east through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6129, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7966625f1a081771", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1d724d8483e1d701"}

name: The light cave
description:
You are in a cave, to south from you there is a large fire that lights
the entire cave, to the east and west tunnels leads off.

name: The south-east watchtower
description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent
from here and you can see all the way to the western mountains. To the
south the you see the bay.  You're confident nothing can touch this tower.

name: Lawn northwest of house.
description:
You stand just outside the northwest corner of the house.  You try
to peek in a window, but it is a little too high to see anything.

name: Entrance to the Mine Shaft
description:
As you enter the mine shaft, you get a sudden fear of the walls closing
in on you.  You are surprised to notice that you don't need a light.

name: The frigid wastelands
description:
You wander through the frigid wastelands. Your breath is a cloud before you.
The cold cuts to the bone. Swirling snow and wind make it impossible for you
to discern any directions.

name: Grass Field
description:
You are in a grass field.  Fences block the way south, east, and west.
The dirt road is to the north.

name: Ajax street
description:
A once prideful guildhouse was on the northeast corner of
this intersection.  Most of the walls and ceiling have long since
been demolished.  An inn/pub is to the south.  The street bends
to the east or west.

name: Path in the plains
description:
You are walking on a path situated in the rough plains.
You feel the strong winds blow through your hair as you watch the
beautiful landscaping here. To the east and west you see the grassy plains.
The path extends into small foothills to the north and also continues south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The path continues into the small foothills.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 306, "room_id": "69f4d0cb08323c3a794b7841", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6f661d9430d45228"}

name: Utter darkness and despair
description:
It is pitch black...

You are overwhelmed by the sensation of death and horrible pain as a shape
begins to coalesce before you.

name: Promenade
description:
The river gently flows west just north of here.  The promenade continues
further east and to the west you see the city wall.  Park Road leads south
from here.

name: Dungeon
description:
You are in Zeus's Dungeon.  You wonder what creatures are so terrible that
even mighty Zeus fears them enough to imprison them.

name: Chamber of the Secudus
description:
A large canvernous room, this chamber serves as the sleeping quarters for the
third Secudus, Viceroy to Primus. The only exit lies to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "To the west you can see a passageway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9049, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbf2de9454e913ac7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb64648c16d94ae51b"}

name: The Casbah
description:
You have almost reached the end of the avenue in this direction. Walking
towards the north-east corner of the city you notice the population density
here is much less then the rest of the town. A few old men hobbling on
canes and young men intent on studies are the only travelers of the path
to the library on a regular basis. The avenue continues east and west from
here

name: A dusty trail in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient,
grey trees loom everywhere.  The trail continues south and west.  A broad
irregular path leads eastwards away from the trail.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "To the east the ancient grey giants have many marks as if something with huge\nclaws has been tearing at them in rage.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The trees standing on the sides of the path have scratch marks on them.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6142, "room_id": "69f4d0cb25344589e862e323", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba6452537947d10bb"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The dusty trail leads south through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6135, "room_id": "69f4d0cb25344589e862e323", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7966625f1a081771"}

name: The training room
description:
You are in a large training room. It is filled with battle scared manikins
, and many other devices used in the practice of fighting.

name: The maze
description: You are in a maze of small damp tunnels.  The only exit is west.

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow alley leads north to the main street, and south toward a tall
watchtower.  A building is to the west.

name: Lawn west of house.
description:
You stand just outside the west corner of the house.  You try to
peek in a window, but it is a little too high to see anything.

name: The frigid wastelands
description:
You wander through the frigid wastelands. Your breath is a cloud before you.
The cold cuts to the bone. Swirling snow and wind make it impossible for you
to discern any directions.

name: Mine Shaft
description:
This mine shaft looks stable, at least in this area.  The wooden supports are
thick and strong.  Torches line the walls.  Exits lead in all directions.

name: Pig Sty
description:
For some reason, you are in a pig sty.  You wonder why you are standing in
muck.  To realize your senses and notice the dirt road is to the east.

name: Curve in the road
description:
The street goes north or west from here.  A narrow street once
headed southeast from here.

name: Path in the foothills
description:
You are on the path leading through the small foothills.
The wind blow through your hair as you study the beautiful
landscaping here. From the north you sense a certain freshness.
The path continues east and south. You smell freshness from north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see grassy plains and perhaps some crystal clear water.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 326, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6f661d9430d45228", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb34e35ccb9cc4176a"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The path in the plains wind through the small foothills.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 305, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6f661d9430d45228", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb08323c3a794b7841"}

name: Promenade
description:
The river gently flows west just north of here.  The promenade continues
both east and west.  A rickety bridge crosses the river to the north, towards
the city dump (fortunately, the wind is blowing towards the dump today).
South of here you see the entrance to the park, and a small building seems
to be just west of the entrance.  Austral Square, home of Kate's Diner, lies
to your east.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A rickety old bridge crosses the river, heading towards the city dump.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3254, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0230fde58686d3d7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfe2d6e259f626524"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You see people moving in and out of Kate's Diner.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3103, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0230fde58686d3d7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbae62a65c333a40da"}

name: Dungeon
description:
You are in Zeus's Dungeon.  There are cells to the north, west, and east.
From the east and west, you hear guttural noises.  From the north, nothing ...

name: The Casbah
description:
The avenue ends here, turning south to become Kali Row. Traveling in that
direction will take you to the library and the grand dance hall of the city.
The Northeast Tower of the wall is accessible here up a spiral staircase.

name: A passageway
description: You are in a passagway where you may go in any cardinal direction.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north lies a small chamber", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9054, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf98a7a43feeabb7d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb0ad7bcc463b956e"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, you can spot a small room", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9055, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf98a7a43feeabb7d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf13ab16d983e73c0"}

name: At the end of the trail through the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient grey
trees loom all around you.  You see a dark grove north of you.
The only other exit is east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees trunk trunks", "description": "The ancient grey giants seem to observe you silently.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The dusty trail leads east through the trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6136, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc43347c6c2a9b673", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb25344589e862e323"}

name: A bend in the hallway
description:
You are at a bend in the hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by.
The hallway continues north and west.

name: A trail at the end of the dwarf forest
description:
The trail ends here, with tall, leafy, green trees all around you.
To the west, you can see a huge beautiful and radiant city.  Something
about it gives you a relaxed feeling.  To the east is your way back home.

name: The light cave
description:
You are in a light cave, a large fire in front of you lights the room.
The cave continues to the north and south.

name: Lawn southwest of house.
description:
You stand just outside the southwest corner of the house.  You try
to peek in a window, but it is a little too high to see anything.

name: The frigid wastelands
description:
You wander through the frigid wastelands. Your breath is a cloud before you.
The cold cuts to the bone. Swirling snow and wind make it impossible for you
to discern any directions.

name: Mine Shaft
description:
This mine shaft looks stable, at least in this area.  The wooden supports are
thick and strong.  Torches line the walls.  Exits lead in all directions.

name: Impy Way
description:
You are on Impy Way.  East and west of you are big houses.  Impy Way
continues north and reaches a big intersection south.  Children are running to
from home to home.

name: A wide alleyway
description:
The sides of the alleyway have been vandalized many times.
One patch of graffiti actually looks readable:
This section has been designed for levels 5 through 10
If you are above level 10 please don't expect much.
If you are below level 5 enter at your own risk.
In another spot it says "now entering Ogre territory..."
A street lies to the west and a major road to the east.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the end of Elm street. Looks much safer.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3144, "room_id": "69f4d0cb116162932357909d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba6ff1f2166a167a1"}

name: Path in the foothills
description:
You are walking on a path situated in the small foothills.
The winds are more than average here but it feels nice. You can follow
the path east or west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "To the west the path takes a bend southwards.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 306, "room_id": "69f4d0cb73467e653ac7b1a8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6f661d9430d45228"}

name: Austral Square
description:
The Promenade opens here onto Austral Square, on the south bank of the
Midgaard River.  All around you is the bustle of Southern Midgaard--
shopkeepers on break, a town gossip or two prattling away.  You hear the
river lapping at the pilings of the dock by Kate's Diner, which is to your
north.  Emerald Avenue begins to the south, the Promenade continues west,
and the concourse ends to your east.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You smell the heavenly scents of Kate's Diner.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3150, "room_id": "69f4d0cbae62a65c333a40da", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb44aedd9e65c926f4"}

name: Cell
description: You are in a small, cramped, dirty cell.  It is a horrid place.

name: Outside a cave in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are at the end of a broad, irregular path.  To the north is a very large
ominous-looking cave opening.  The trees here have many marks as if something
with huge claws has been tearing at them in rage.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tree trees", "description": "The ancient grey giants have many marks as if something with huge claws has\nbeen tearing at them in rage.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The disgusting smell of a large reptile emanates from the cave opening.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6143, "room_id": "69f4d0cba6452537947d10bb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb822fd5592ec855b7"}

name: A small chamber
description: You are in a small cramped chamber.  The only exit lies to the south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can see a passage", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9053, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb0ad7bcc463b956e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf98a7a43feeabb7d"}

name: A dueling room
description:
You are in a large room used for duals arcane. The walls, ceiling and
floor all bare the scars of many fiery spells, but still look quite strong
and hold fast.
The only exit leads north to the hallway.

name: A trail at the end of the dwarf forest
description:
A side trail here leads from the dwarf forest.  It is definitely milder
here.  The trail continues to the east from here.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the bend ahead of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5358, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdbe468d32e2f0952", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9be1cfb79fda71b7"}

name: Kali Row
description:
This is a small, newly added section of the town. The city's library
can be entered through the door to the west and The Casbah
begins it's journey a little ways north of here. The row and the
entrance to the dance hall is to the south.

name: The maze
description: You are in a maze of small damp tunnels.

name: Lawn south of house.
description:
You stand just outside the south corner of the house.  You try to
peek in a window, but it is a little too high to see anything.

name: The frigid wastelands
description:
You wander through the frigid wastelands. Your breath is a cloud before you.
The cold cuts to the bone. Swirling snow and wind make it impossible for you
to discern any direction.

name: Alexander Road
description:
You see many gang members walking around looking for
fights to pick and things to break.  It seems as if all of the
other citizens have been run out of town.  All the former
homes are boarded up and uninhabitable.  The road continues
east and west.

name: Big House
description:
You are in a big house.  Evidently, the owners of this house are richer
than the average citizen, since there is more than one room to this house.  A
door leads to the kitchen east, and a bedroom is upstairs.  The exit is to the
west.

name: Mine Shaft
description:
This mine shaft looks stable, at least in this area.  The wooden supports are
thick and strong.  Torches line the walls.  Exits lead in all directions
except north.

name: Path in the foothills
description:
You are walking on a narrow path in the foothills.
You feel the strong winds blow through your hair as you study
the beautiful landscaping here. The path goes north and west.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The narrow path through the foothills turns left here.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 309, "room_id": "69f4d0cb53b944d95808799a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7ebcf0a2eb051874"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west you can see the path continues.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 307, "room_id": "69f4d0cb53b944d95808799a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb73467e653ac7b1a8"}

name: Northeast end of Concourse
description:
You are at the Concourse.  The city wall is just east and Austral Square,
home of Kate's Diner, is west.  Looking across the river you see an old
warehouse.  A strong stone bridge crosses the river to the north, where the
concourse becomes wall road.  The Concourse continues south along the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "wall", "description": "It is built from large grey rocks that have been fastened to each other with\nsome kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A strong stone bridge crosses the river.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3253, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf90113adf5d9579c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9a50abe8761f1055"}

name: Cell
description: You are in a small, cramped, dirty cell.  It is a horrid place.

name: A cramped room
description: You are in a small, crowded room.  The only exit appears to lie to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north, you can see a passageway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9053, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf13ab16d983e73c0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf98a7a43feeabb7d"}

name: The cave of the Green Dragon
description:
You are in a big natural cave.  The floor is littered with bones of all sorts
and the stench is so massive that you could cut it with a knife.  The only exit
is to the south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bone bones floor", "description": "Most of the bones on the floor appear to be of human origin.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The exit leads out into the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6142, "room_id": "69f4d0cb822fd5592ec855b7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba6452537947d10bb"}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A doorway can be seen to the east.

name: The dwarf forest
description:
You see tall, healthy green trees here.  The trail bends north to
west from here.

name: Lawn southeast of house.
description:
You stand just outside the southeast corner of the house.  You try
to peek in a window, but it is a little too high to see anything.

name: The maze
description: You are in a maze of small damp tunnels.

name: Kali Row
description:
The short row ends abruptly here at the entrance to the dance hall of
New Thalos. The entrance to the hall is to the west and the row continues
northward.

name: The frigid wastelands
description:
You wander through the frigid wastelands. Your breath is a cloud before you.
The cold cuts to the bone. Swirling snow and wind make it impossible for you
to discern any directions.

name: Alexander Street at park entrance
description:
A park-looking area lies to the north and a passage between
two buildings leads to another street to the south.

name: Walkway
description:
You are on a well built path in the middle of a mountain.  You sense something
great up ahead, considering the hard work that must have gone into creating
this passage.

name: Bedroom
description:
You are in the bedroom.  There isn't much of interest except for a bed and
a closet.  The stairs lead back down.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see the main room of the house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 626, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdc06586334684fe1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb68404b9c86787870"}

name: Path in the foothills
description:
You are walking on a path situated in foothills.
To the west you sense a certain freshness and the path continues
south and east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the path continues in the foothills.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 310, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7ebcf0a2eb051874", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb03f7f23d8f61aadb"}
