name: Park Entrance
description:
You are standing just inside the small park of Midgaard.  To the north is
the promenade and a small path leads south into the park.  To your east is
the famous Park Cafe.

name: Cell
description: You are in a small, cramped, dirty cell.  It is a horrid place.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A wooden door can been seen to the east.

name: A large room
description:
You have entered a room where you are not wanted.  The only exit lies to the
south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can visualize a east-west passage.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9059, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc47a797f365ac7dd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb07f2578e32f71706"}

name: A small path in the deep, dark forest
description:
You are on a narrow path leading through the deep, dark forest.  Ancient,
grey trees loom everywhere.  The tree trunks here seem to be covered in some
sticky substance.  The path continues south and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "substance rope ropes thread threads", "description": "The substance reminds you of giant threads covered with glue.  If it had not\nbeen for the size you could have sworn it was part of a spider web.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6110, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3827ce18468c114e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe78ed7e72d5ed0a5"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6130, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3827ce18468c114e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb524c32a59015a47c"}

name: Lawn east of house.
description:
You stand just outside the east corner of the house.  You try to
peek in a window, but it is a little too high to see anything.

name: The dwarf forest
description:
You see more big green trees here.  It looks almost as if this place was
blessed by a god to be green and mild.  The trail leads north and south.

name: The tunnel
description:
You are in a tunnel, only exit is to the east. You sense that the
tunnel leads slightly down.

name: Underground
description: The small passage continues north and south.

name: The edge of the frigid wastes
description:
You stand at the base of a steep rocky cliff. To the north, a vast arctic
wasteland stretches out. The snow falls lightly here and the wind is not
very fierce. You can climb up the rocky cliff or head north into the arctic
wastes.

name: Kitchen
description:
You are in a kitchen.  There isn't much of interest here.  The main room
is west of here.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the main room of the house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 626, "room_id": "69f4d0cb880bad2ec77f0b3b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb68404b9c86787870"}

name: Achilles Avenue
description:
The Avenue Runs north and south.  You sense you are deep within
Ogre gang territory, and a chill goes up your spine.

name: Walkway
description:
You are on a well built path in the middle of a mountain.  You sense something
great up ahead, considering the hard work that must have gone into creating
this passage.

name: Path in the foothills
description:
You are walking on a long path in the east-west direction.
The surroundings are green, vegetated foothills.
You are able to force your way through some dense plants to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can't really see much through the vegetation on the foothills.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 327, "room_id": "69f4d0cb03f7f23d8f61aadb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd5aefddfacab4c50"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you notice that the path continues towards a T-intersection.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 311, "room_id": "69f4d0cb03f7f23d8f61aadb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb75736ab456f8ad37"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You just see the path through the foothills.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 309, "room_id": "69f4d0cb03f7f23d8f61aadb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7ebcf0a2eb051874"}

name: Park Cafe
description:
You are inside Park Cafe, a very well lighted, cosy place. The cafe
is built from large logs. Through the windows in the northern wall you
see the river, and through the southern window you see many vigorous
colorful plants.

name: Stairway
description:
You have come to a large stairway leading up.  To the south, you see the
throne room of Zeus.

name: The narrow trail.
description:
This trail looks much spookier than any other thats you have seen.  The usual
animal claw marks and bites on the trees are getting far and few between. The
trail continues north.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "the trail intersects the main forest path.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6103, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2e5e39f2f58ad7e8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3a844930e2659f2a"}

name: The spellmaster's lounge
description:
You are in a large comfortable looking lounge. Off duty spell teachers
are here relaxing in their idle time. A large coffee machine is against
the far wall.
The only apparent exit leads back west to the hallway.

name: A room
description:
You have entered a room where there was obviously a hurried move going on.
The only exit lies to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can make out a passageway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9059, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd3b66d5646c2351b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb07f2578e32f71706"}

name: The dwarf forest
description:
You see more big green trees here.  It looks almost as if this place was
blessed by a god to be green and mild.  The trail leads north and south.

name: Lawn northeast of house.
description:
You stand just outside the northeast corner of the house.  You try
to peek in a window, but it is a little too high to see anything.

name: Alley
description:
This is a dark alley running between the palace and city hall. Not a lot
here, unless you're partial to spiders and rats.

name: The tunnel
description:
You are in a small tunnel, to the west the tunnel continues and
to the east you see some light.

name: On the cliffside
description:
You cling to the side of the cliff. Looking down, you are terrified by the
sheer distance to the ground below. You can climb up higher into the cliffs,
but the area above is obscured by clouds and you cannot tell what lies waiting
above.

name: Big House
description:
You are in a big house.  Evidently, the owners of this house are richer
than the average citizen, since there is more than one room to this house.  A
door leads to the kitchen west, and a bedroom is upstairs.  The exit is to the
east.

name: The Grand Hall
description:
You have stepped into the Grand Hall of the hobgoblin kingdom; your luck
must be running low by now.  Golden pillars span the hallway, and you
notice a red carpet beneath your feet.

name: Ajax Street
description:
You can see a sinister black wrought-iron fence to the west.
You wonder if it's keeping you out, or the ghouls in?

name: Path in the foothills
description:
You are walking on the long, narrow path through the foothills.
To your east you see a T-intersection and to the west the path
continues far.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You can go to the T-intersection this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 312, "room_id": "69f4d0cb75736ab456f8ad37", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba3fb9df7dd0f6577"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can see the long path through the plains.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 310, "room_id": "69f4d0cb75736ab456f8ad37", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb03f7f23d8f61aadb"}

name: Small path through the park
description:
You are walking along a small path through the park.  The path continues
south and east.

name: Bakery
description:
You are in the small store which supplies the residents of this town with
their food.  It smells wonderful in here!

name: The narrow trail.
description:
This area of the trail is also very peculiar.  You can see no signs of animal
life what so ever.  The structure of the surrounding trees forces the path to
make a sharp turn to the east.

name: Chamber of The First Secundus
description:
You have disturbed the rest of the First Viceroy to Primus the Prime, The
Secundus.  He does not look like a happy camper. The only exit lies to the
east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you can spot a hallway", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9059, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe2006f90ab505023", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb07f2578e32f71706"}

name: A bedroom
description:
You are in a large, plush bedroom. The owner is obviously someone of high
standing in the magical community here. An ice mirror is on one wall, and
a scrying globe sit on a stand in the middle of the room. An enormous bed
can be seen floating about a meter above the floor.
The only exit leads back west to the hallway.

name: The dwarf forest
description:
You see many big green trees here.  You see many leaves on these huge
trees.  Grass layer the ground with 2 inches of padding.

name: Dirty, dusty tunnel.
description: This dirty dusty tunnel must lead somewhere.

name: Alley
description: The alley ends here.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see a manhole covering an opening in the road.", "keyword": "manhole hole man", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9575, "room_id": "69f4d0cb555bc848fe97ab23", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc347f204a16b6164"}

name: The light cave
description: You are in the south end of a light cave.

name: Bedroom
description:
You are in the bedroom.  There isn't much of interest except for a bed and
a closet.  The stairs lead back down.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see the main room of the house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 629, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf020faf503e3ccc9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb007cd2d96ba5ba8e"}

name: Before the gates of Mahn-Tor
description:
You stand at the edge of a high cliff. Directly south, set back off the
cliff's edge, you see a huge pair of gates. These gates appear to be carved
almost completely out of ice. A huge city and keep appear to be on the other
side of these gates. There is also a possibility of climbing down the cliff
face.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "gate gates ice huge", "description": "The gates to the city are made almost completely of ice. Looking closely, you\ncan see intricate carvings in the gates. They appear to be of creatures that\nare half man and half bull.", "valid": true}

name: The Throne Room
description:
This is large bright room filled with Hobgoblins.  To the south there is
a large golden throne against the wall.

name: The inn/pub
description:
The inn actually looks fairly functional despite its lack
of repair.  The boys come here to hoot it up and drink them selves
into oblivion sometimes.  It looks as if the beer is still on tap!!!
A hallway leads south and you spy a street through the doorway
to the north.

name: The path intersection
description:
You are standing on an intersection between 3 paths.
To the west you can follow a long, narrow path through the foothills.
To the north a wide path leads to the Village of Ofcol and an
ancient path leads towards the south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The wide road to Ofcol runs here.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 313, "room_id": "69f4d0cba3fb9df7dd0f6577", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba174fc966da1e61d"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Here is a partially hidden, ancient looking path.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 332, "room_id": "69f4d0cba3fb9df7dd0f6577", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb05c9b527cc5394a8"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can see the long narrow path running through the foothills.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 311, "room_id": "69f4d0cba3fb9df7dd0f6577", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb75736ab456f8ad37"}

name: Small path in the park
description:
You are standing on a small path inside the park.  The park entrance is
just north of here, and Park Cafe is just east of the entrance.  The path
leads further east and west.

name: Residence
description:
You are in the residence of one of the inhabitants of this town.  She
looks vaguely familiar, but you can't place her name ...

name: The circle of trees.
description:
The trees here seem to form a circle around a HUGE tree that is in the center
of them.  You notice a wooden door carved into the huge tree to the east.  The
trail that you followed to get here seems to end at the base of the tree.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow providing enough light to see by.
A glass door can be seen to the east.

name: Junction in the hallway
description: Exits lead off in all of the cardinal directions
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north lies a large chamber", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9056, "room_id": "69f4d0cb07f2578e32f71706", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc47a797f365ac7dd"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, a small chamber can be found.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9057, "room_id": "69f4d0cb07f2578e32f71706", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd3b66d5646c2351b"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west, lies a monstrous room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9058, "room_id": "69f4d0cb07f2578e32f71706", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe2006f90ab505023"}

name: Basement.
description:
This seems like your average basement.  Old Christmas decorations,
suitcases, bicycles litter your way.  You hear the squeaking of
rats in the corners.

name: The Cross Roads
description:
The roads cross here.  Midgaard is to the west.  To the east, you see the
stately oaks and poplars of the holy grove.  A wide path leads south through
the dwarven forest.  To the north is a very desolate trail.

name: Guildsman's Row
description:
This row is a hive of activity second only to the actual market
square itself. Along this row stands all the guilds of the working
class citizens of New Thalos;  here all the items sold in the square
are made. Along this particular stretch of the row lie the Bowyer/
Fletcher to the west and the Mason's to the east. The row leads
off to the south and East Casbah is to the north.

name: The maze
description: You are in a maze of small damp tunnels.

name: Kitchen
description:
You are in a kitchen.  There isn't much of interest here.  The main room
is east of here.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the main room of the house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 629, "room_id": "69f4d0cb449fa60f4915a505", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb007cd2d96ba5ba8e"}

name: The city streets of Mahn-Tor
description:
You walk among the ice and snow covered shops and homes. Most of the doors are
closed and only the light from the windows betrays the presence of inhabitants.
A cold wind blows through here, scattering fine clouds of snow all about. Small
streets lead south and east.

name: Solomon Street
description:
This street forms the southern boundary of Ogre territory.  The
street extends far to the east.  There is also a pathway between
buildings which leads to another street to the north.

name: The Treasury
description:
You are inside the hobgoblin's treasury.  Your eyes are almost blinded by the
gold, silver and copper coins.

name: Road to Ofcol
description:
You are walking on a wide road with trail marks on it.  To the north
you see the village of Ofcol and to the south there is the T intersection.
You can enter the foothills west.  The foothills to your east are too
steep to climb.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You can see the T-intersection in the souther direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 312, "room_id": "69f4d0cba174fc966da1e61d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba3fb9df7dd0f6577"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You think you can climb these foothills.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 327, "room_id": "69f4d0cba174fc966da1e61d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd5aefddfacab4c50"}

name: Residence
description:
You are in the residence of one of the inhabitants of this town.  He looks
vaguely familiar, but you can't place his name ...

name: Small path in the park
description:
You are on a small path running through the park.  It continues west and
south and just north of here you see the southern wall of Park Cafe.

name: Inside the great tree.
description:
You have stepped inside of this hollowed tree.  From here steps lead down into
darkness or you can exit the tree by going west.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "The steps look appear like they will hold your weight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6154, "room_id": "69f4d0cb17d7eb53181a808e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbab1346549bb32568"}

name: The study
description:
You are in a small, well kept study. Ancient tomes are on shelves on the
walls, A huge table sits in the middle of the room, with maps weighted
down upon it. The only light source here comes from an interestingly non-
magical oil lamp.
The only apparent exit leads back west to the hallway.

name: The Lane
description:
You are strolling along a pleasant, shady lane. The road is lined on both
sides by tall, stately trees which lend the scene with a sense of quiet
serenity. You can follow the road north or south.

name: The maze
description: You are in a maze of small damp tunnels.

name: Guildsman's Row
description:
The guilds continue here, to the west is the Weaver's guild, and to the
east stands the Craftsman's Guild. The row of guilds continues north
and south from here.

name: Inside the gates of Mahn-Tor
description:
You stand just inside the gates to the city of Mahn-Tor. The city itself
spreads out in front of you. The buildings are sturdy, as they appear to be
made from the very rock of this mountain. Snow falls all around and a fine
sheet of ice can be seen covering all but the most used walk ways. Small city
streets lead east and west, while a main road appears to lead south.

name: Impy Way
description:
You are on Impy Way.  Houses are to the east and west of here.  Impy Way
continues north and south.  There are many people walking along the streets.

name: Bottom of the stairs.
description:
You stand at the bottom of a long staircase leading up to the main
house.  To the south you can barely make out the accumulated
clutter gathered throughout the years.

name: Intersection of Achilles and Solomon
description:
Solomon street is to the east and west.  The other part of the
T is Achilles Avenue, starting here and winding to the north.

name: Guarded Room
description:
You are inside a well guarded room.  The place is slightly better built than
the mine shafts, and is lit by lanterns.

name: Outside Ofcol
description:
You are standing outside the village of Ofcol.
The village looks very small, but still a nice and safe place to stay.
You may enter the city to the north or journey towards the
T-intersection in the southern direction.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You notice a sign saying : Stranger we welcome you to the\npeaceful city of Ofcol.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5550, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe821adad42efcaa7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb460511b61df59f1e"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Here you see the road go towards the intersection.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 313, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe821adad42efcaa7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba174fc966da1e61d"}

name: The underground hallway.
description:
This hallway is apparently one of the roots of the tree hollowed out.  The hall
leads south to a room where you hear strange noises or you can go up the steps.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "the steps appear like they will hold your weight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6153, "room_id": "69f4d0cbab1346549bb32568", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb17d7eb53181a808e"}

name: Mystic Shop
description:
You are in the store which provides the citizens here with whichever
arcane objects they may need.

name: Cityguard Head Quarters
description:
You are inside a tidy office.  A big desk made from dark wood is standing
in the centre of the room.

name: Below the stairs
description:
You are at the end of a long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by. A lesser guardian is here keeping
silent watch on the entrance to the levels above.
Stairs lead up and the hallway continues back south.

name: City Entrance
description:
You stand on the outskirts of a construction site - Midgaard; the capital
of this land. The road leads east into the peace and quiet - and dangers -
of the forest; and to the west it becomes the main street of the town;
surrounded by building foundations of unfinished shops, houses, and temple.

name: The city streets of Mahn-Tor
description:
You trudge among the icy streets of Mahn-Tor. The streets themselves are made
of cobblestone and are quite treacherous. Small homes and businesses along
the street are closed tight and light from their windows throws eerie shadows
across the dark street. Small streets lead west and south here.

name: The tunnel
description: You are at the eastern end of a tunnel.

name: Guildsman's Row
description:
Only one guild offers its door to this stretch of the row; the Tanner's
Guild, to the west. To the east is a beautifully sculpted marble door
allowing entrance to the Museum of the Greater Gods. The row of
Guilds leads north and south.

name: House
description:
You are in a house.  The living room and kitchen are all bundled into
this room.  There is a bedroom south of here.  The exit is west.

name: Foyer.
description:
"Magnificent" does not even begin to describe the foyer.  Lavishly
decorated, yet elegant, it gives an impression of indescribable
wealth.  Paintings and tapestries line the walls depicting scenes
from throughout history.  Antiques furnitures and oriental rugs are
tastefully placed in ideal spots.  The door is at least 10 feet
high and is made of oak.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see an ornate oak door.", "keyword": "oak door", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9166, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8f2504457ef37710", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb64745beb0967532d"}

name: Solomon Street
description:
A wrought-iron fence blocks off what used to be an entrance to the
cemetery here to the north.  The evil just seems too strong to
to consider entering.  You feel you should stick with the "lesser"
evils along the road to the east and west.

name: Guarded Room
description:
You are inside a well guarded room.  The place is slightly better built than
the mine shafts, and is lit by lanterns.

name: The cultist temple.
description:
This temple is built to some god that you don't worship.  It is a nice place
to visit but you feel very uncomfortable about spending much time here.
The wooden altar seems almost to glow as you enter the room.  The only exit is
the way you came in.

name: Gallow hill
description:
You walk in the grassy plains. On this little hill you can see
two gallows, with rotting human tissue hanging from the ropes.
There is a sign here.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign says:

Loyal citizens of Midgaard.  These are the earthly remains of the
two heretics 'Dim' and 'Gamma' of this world. Having forged them-
selves to immortality, they called upon themselves the anger of the
implementators.  Let this be a lesson too all .....

-- the Powers that Be.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The plains extend far to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 320, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe0838a779e47594e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7f1c784f456b9c4d"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you can see a small path in the plains.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 303, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe0838a779e47594e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd8582025365e6a43"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can see a small path in the plains.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 300, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe0838a779e47594e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5a759092a9dee6ee"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The plains extend far to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 318, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe0838a779e47594e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb040d42de03a9d76f"}

name: Ares Street
description:
You are on a smaller road which branches off from the main street.  On a
sign, you notice that the name of this road is Ares Street.

name: Park Road
description:
The road continues north and south.  A building is just west of here, you
notice a sign on the door.  The park entrance is to the east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "building door sign", "description": "The sign on the door says:-\n\nCityguard Head Quarters", "valid": true}

name: Atop the stairway
description:
You are atop a stairway. The halls here look quite a bit less used than
those below. Obviously access to these magic filled corridors is limited
to those of the upper echelon of mages. The walls here emit a faint blue
magical aura which provides some light.
The hallway leads west from here and the stairs go down.

name: The city streets of Mahn-Tor
description:
You trudge through the snow covered streets. The street itself is made of
cobblestones and the footing is quite treacherous. To the south, you see what
appears to be a small tavern. Bright lights shine through the windows. Small
streets also lead north and east.
A small sign hangs outside the tavern.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign small", "description": "[]=============[]
|   The Inn   |
|    of the   |
|    Broken   |
|     Horn    |
[]=============[]", "valid": true}

name: The Plains
description:
You are standing on the plains. This is a vast desolate place where the
wind can howl undisturbed since nothing but you bars its way. However you
are not the first to wander here. Before you somebody has left footprints.
The footprints make a path that looks rather bewildered and is not the kind
of path to lead to anywhere significant or important but it seems to have
made up its mind to enter the hills far away north.  A little distance
further, you lose the trail and decide not to get lost.

name: The maze
description: You are in a maze of small damp tunnels.

name: Guildsman's Row
description:
After the guilds were built the people of the city used some of the extra
space to erect a shrine to their patron saints. The result of this labor
became the Museum of the greater gods. You may enter the sacred hall to
the east.

name: Elegant hallway.
description:
You are in a long, sprawling hallway connecting the eastern and
western wings of the house.  There are several chairs and sofas in
the hallway and some gorgeous, handwoven drapes.

name: Intersection of Ajax and Solomon
description:
The two roads meet at a corner here.  Ajax runs north and
Solomon heads west.  An inn/pub is through a back doorway
to the east.

name: Bedroom
description:
You are in a bedroom.  There isn't much of interest here except for a bed
and a dresser.  The main room of the house is north of here.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the main room of the house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 633, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe9d9ac05a320712b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb11c0f2a92ad40435"}

name: Hobgoblin Armory
description:
The guards store their spare weapons and armor here.  There are rusty swords
on rotting shelves, and armor hanging from hooks or laying on the floor.

name: Grassy plains
description:
You walk in the grassy plains among the herbs which grow here. The wind is
strong and rough. Far to the north you can see the foothills and further on
mountain peaks are visible.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The plains extend far to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 318, "room_id": "69f4d0cb66674f46a19a31c9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb040d42de03a9d76f"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "When you look to the east you notice at small path.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 300, "room_id": "69f4d0cb66674f46a19a31c9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5a759092a9dee6ee"}

name: Guest Quarters
description:
You have entered private quarters which are reserved for visitors to the
castle.  You nearly faint as you recognize the occupant of this chamber as Odin
himself, patron God of Midgaard.  He must be visiting Zeus.

name: Western Park Entrance
description:
You are standing at the western end of the park.  A small path leads east
into the park and going west through the entrance you will reach Park Road.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway stretching east and west. The walls here emit
a faint magical energy providing enough light to see by.
There is a thick looking wooden door to the north.

name: The Square of Mahn-Tor
description:
This appears to be the main square of Mahn-Tor. A huge fountain graces the
center of the square, but the extreme cold has turned it into an ice
sculpture. The water has frozen in arcs through the air. Snow and ice covers
the square and small streets lead east and west. To the north, you see
the gates to the city. You also notice a small store to the south.
A small sign hangs outside the store.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "[]=========[]
|  Equip  |
|   Shop  |
[]=========[]", "valid": true}

name: The holy grove
description:
You are standing amidst the ancient oaks and poplars in the holy grove. You
can feel a strange sensation of contentedness and relief seeping through You,
as if great burdens have been lifted from Your shoulders. From here, friendly-
looking paths lead east and south.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The path wind its way through the tall trees, disappearing out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5367, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2d3f213bece96dd4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb85246d5ccb8d8cf4"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The path wind its way through the tall trees, disappearing out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5369, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2d3f213bece96dd4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb805a195bce0b5e56"}

name: Guildsman's Row
description:
This small cramped road is worn with travel as apprentices to the guilds
run merchandise from the guildhouses to the shops on market square. The
guildhouses lie to the north and Main street is to the south.

name: Library
description:
You are overwhelmed by the sheer volumes of books here.  The
shelves stretch all the way to the ceiling and are on every wall,
even above the doorway.  There are chairs for sitting and reading
and a desk for more intense studies.

name: The maze
description: You are in a maze of small damp tunnels.

name: Hallway
description:
The hallway heads back north to the main part of the inn/pub.
The stairs leading up to the guest rooms here do not seem
advisable to climb.  A doorway empties out into Solomon
street to the west.

name: House
description:
You are in a house.  The living room and kitchen are all bundled into
this room.  There is a bedroom south of here.  The exit is east.

name: Mine Shaft
description:
You enter a part of the mine shaft where the torches have grown dim
and are almost ready to go out.  From what you can see, there are plenty
of cobwebs on the walls and rats at your feet.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a dark and nasty room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1575, "room_id": "69f4d0cbefe1d9dcd9d42dba", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbe31bd681c27ce86"}

name: Grassy plains
description:
You walk in the grassy plains among the herbs which grow here. The wind is
strong and rough. Far to the north you can see the foothills and further on
mountain peaks are visible. City of Midgaard is to the south but so are some
VERY steep slopes.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The plains extend far to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 338, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3ebf9c388ecf363c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9cc5589d64726f91"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Some VERY steep slopes prevent you from going this way, it might kill you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 345, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3ebf9c388ecf363c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0b484fddc2681cc0"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A small path is running through the plains.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 303, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3ebf9c388ecf363c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd8582025365e6a43"}

name: Storage Room
description:
You are in a storage room of the castle.  There isn't much here, just a
few boxes filled with old junk.

name: A path in the park
description:
You are in the park.  The paths lead north and west.  Westwards is the
park entrance and to the east you see a small pond.

name: A small office
description:
You are in a small office. It looks like a calligrapher's study, there
are quills, inkpots and parchments all about on desks and worktables.
A section to the west seems to be curtained off, but the flicker of a
candle can be seen through the curtain.

name: The streets of Mahn-Tor
description:
You walk among the small stores and homes of Mahn-Tor. The cobblestone streets
are covered with ice and snow. Small snow drifts have formed at the edges of
the streets. The wind blows fiercely. Small streets lead in all directions.
There appears to be a large building to the east, but the snow obscures your
view.

name: Arboretum.
description:
A small indoor garden so that the residents don't have to go
outside to enjoy plants and commune with nature.  There are several
trees, a small pond and flowers of every kind.

name: Alley
description:
Even with your light you cannot seem to penetrate the magical cloak of
darkness covering this alley.

name: The holy grove
description:
You are standing amidst the ancient oaks and poplars in the holy grove. You
feel unusually happy here, as if great burdens have been lifted from Your
shoulders. From here, pleasant-looking paths lead east, west and south.

description: You are in a maze of small damp tunnels.

name: Bedroom
description:
You are in a bedroom.  There isn't much of interest here except for a bed
and a dresser.  The main room of the house is north of here.

name: Entrance to a Dungeon
description:
The floor dips slightly as you walk into this dark and nasty place.  Your
skin crawls as you look at the filth on the walls and see it move.  Most
of the exits lead into jail cells.

name: Grassy plains
description:
You walk in the beautiful grassy plains. The wind is strong and rough.
Far to the north you can see the foothills and further on mountain peaks
are visible.

name: Guest Quarters
description:
You have entered a room reserved for visitors to this castle.  You are
amazed as you recognize the occupant - Ra, the Egyptian Sun God.  He must be
visiting Zeus.

name: The Pond
description:
You are swimming around in the pond, feeling rather stupid.  You can get
back on the path from the eastern and western end of the pond.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: The Inn of the Broken Horn
description:
You enter a warm tavern. The room is lit mainly by two huge fireplaces at each
end of the room. Small tables and a large bar furnish the room. The
inhabitants of the inn are all minotaurs of varying size and disposition. Most
seem to regard you with suspicion. Few approach you. A large door leads
north, out of the bar and back out into the cold.

name: A clearing in the woods
description:
You are standing in a clearing in the light woods. Somehow, this place
seems powerfully DIFFERENT from the rest of the forest, as if something is
severely strained in the fabric of reality here.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A small, narrow path winds north, and is quickly lost in the bushes. It\nlooks quite a wilderness there!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5375, "room_id": "69f4d0cbddd3ce8bbc38e5f3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb9d622182e8df71f"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "There is a path winding its way south through the tall poplars, disappearing\nout of sight some 100 yds. away.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5371, "room_id": "69f4d0cbddd3ce8bbc38e5f3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb94a0540650fb7ddb"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "There is a friendly-looking path leading west through the tall trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5367, "room_id": "69f4d0cbddd3ce8bbc38e5f3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb85246d5ccb8d8cf4"}

name: Western tower.
description:
You are in the bottom part of a tower.  A draft brings a chill to
your spine and causes creaks and groans.  Curtains flutter in the
wind, causing quite a distraction.  When you go to shut the window,
you see that the window is closed.  An old, wooden staircase leads
up into darkness.

name: Alley
description:
Even with your light you cannot seem to penetrate the magical cloak of
darkness covering this alley.

name: The large cave
description: You are in the northwest end of a large cave.

name: Impy Way
description:
You are on Impy Way.  Houses are to the east and west of here.  Impy Way
continues south.  To the north is a big intersection.  There are many people
walking along the streets.

name: A Dungeon
description:
You are in the deepest and darkest part of the mine shafts.  The light from
the torches barely reaches to where you are.  Most directions from here
lead to jail cells.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a dark and nasty room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1575, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9f4d823513643f5e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbe31bd681c27ce86"}

name: The Great Eastern Desert
description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sands constantly shifting around you.
Rising out of the sand to the east you see a mighty pyramid.

You walk in the grassy plains among the herbs which grow here. The wind is
strong and rough. To the north you can see the foothills and just behind
mountain peaks are visible.

name: Storage Room
description:
You are in a storage room of the castle.  There isn't much here, just a lot
of dust.

name: The Mahn-Tor Equipment Shop
description:
You are in a crude equipment shop. The store is filled with racks of various
items that adventurers could use. Large fireplaces light and heat the room.
A large desk occupies the back of the room. The door to the shop lies to the
north.

name: A path in the park
description:
You are in the park.  The paths lead north and east.  Eastwards is the
park entrance and to the west you see a small pond.

name: The master scribe's workshop
description:
You are in the workshop of the tower's master scribe. Many half finished
scrolls lay on the writing table in the center of the room. A giant candle
flickering with soft blue flames provides the only light here.
The only apparent exit is the way you came in.

name: The holy grove
description:
You are standing amidst the ancient oaks and poplars in the holy grove. You
feel calm and relaxed here, as if great burdens have been lifted from Your
shoulders. From here, pleasant-looking paths lead east, north and south. To
the west, through the trees, You can see the road to Midgaard's construction
site.

name: Western tower.
description:
The tower creaks and groans, almost as if it were muttering to
itself.  There are windows displaying a full moon, reigning over
the night sky.  The room is dark and there is almost a musty odor
to it.  You are surprised that you can't detect any dust or dirt,
although there are a couple of cobwebs in the corner.

name: Alley
description:
Even with your light you cannot seem to penetrate the magical cloak of
darkness covering this alley.

name: The large cave
description:
You are in the northeast end of a large cave. To the north the
is a small damp tunnel.

name: House
description:
You are in a house.  The living room and kitchen are all bundled into
this room.  There is a bedroom south of here.  The exit is west.

name: A Jail Cell
description:
You are in a musty, dark jail cell.  Wet and dirty straw covers the floor.
The walls glisten with slime.  You see something stir in the straw.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see a dark and nasty room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1575, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2bf9fefc833b2de3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbe31bd681c27ce86"}

name: At the Base of the Pyramid
description:
The mighty pyramid towers above you out of the hot desert sands, made from
huge blocks of stone that have been coated over with a rough sandy plaster-like
substance.  The face of the pyramid is steep, but you think you might be able
to climb it.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "pyramid", "description": "You wonder how anyone could have built such a massive thing out in this heat.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "To the east you see the hot sands of the Great Eastern Desert.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8700, "room_id": "69f4d0cb684350c83635500a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb55114fbd1499f0ba"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "The steep slope of the pyramid rises up before you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8702, "room_id": "69f4d0cb684350c83635500a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb109806ac589c853"}

name: Grassy plains
description:
You walk in some grassy plains. The wind is strong and rough. To the
north you can see the foothills and further on mountain peaks are visible.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The plains extend into small foothills to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 322, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7f1c784f456b9c4d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1ceba868e290cb4e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The plains extend far to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 319, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7f1c784f456b9c4d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb85fd47f8724ff88e"}

name: Stable
description:
You are in the stable of the castle.  Rather than the horses which you
expected to find, it is filled with a wide variety of creatures which you
thought were mythical.  Obviously, you were wrong.

name: Eastern Park Entrance
description:
You are standing at the eastern end of the park.  A small path leads west
into the park.  Going east through the entrance you will reach Emerald
Avenue.

name: The Mahn-Tor General Store
description:
You enter a small store that is dark and cold. Old empty shelves line the
walls and snow blows across the dirty stone floor. It is evident that this
store was once used, but it is no more. A small doorway leads north out into
the chilling snow and wind.

name: Quifael's monster pen
description:
You are in a big, subterranean room with heavy massive stone walls and no
windows whatsoever.  A virtual ladder leads upwards.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A half closed door can be seen to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A dark room can be seen through the half opened door", "keyword": "door wooden", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1375, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd2648490e7be3826", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb771b2fb892398179"}

name: The sacred glade
description:
You are standing in the middle of the sacred glades, where the citizens of
Thalos come to celebrate the spring, where farmers give thanks for bountiful
harvest in the fall, and where lovers stroll in summer. You feel seasons of
remembered happiness and joy taking Your sorrows and worries away from You,
leaving You calm and invigorate, ready for the world. Paths lead into the
holy grove to the east, north and west, while to the south a wide, sunny field
slopes down to a sparkling lake.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The path wind its way north, disappearing through the tall trees.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5367, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd7bf4c7514b885b9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb85246d5ccb8d8cf4"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The path wind its way through the tall trees, disappearing out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5371, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd7bf4c7514b885b9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb94a0540650fb7ddb"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, a wide, sunny field stretch out, sloping down towards a brightly\nglittering lake.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5373, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd7bf4c7514b885b9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc0aad2ebc3335b1a"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The path wind its way west between stately poplars and oaks.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5369, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd7bf4c7514b885b9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb805a195bce0b5e56"}

name: Elegant hallway.
description:
You are in a long, sprawling hallway connecting the eastern and
western wings of the house.  There are several chairs and sofas in
the hallway and some gorgeous, handwoven drapes.

name: The large cave
description: You are in the southwest end of a large cave.

name: Alley
description:
Even with your light you cannot seem to penetrate the magical cloak of
darkness covering this alley.

name: Bedroom
description:
You are in a bedroom.  There isn't much of interest here except for a bed
and a dresser.  The main room of the house is north of here.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the main room of the house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 638, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe28e1825b642867c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb87fa5b4bf75c0539"}

name: The Jail Cell
description:
You are in a musty, dark jail cell.  Wet and dirty straw covers the floor.
The walls glisten with slime.  You see something stir in the straw.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see a dark and nasty room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1576, "room_id": "69f4d0cbacfa474194c208f7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9f4d823513643f5e"}

name: Climbing the Great Pyramid
description:
Hot air rises off the sides of the pyramid, and the wind chokes you with a
flurry of sand and dust.  So far you have made it halfway up the side.  The
walls of the pyramid are quite steep.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "pyramid", "description": "You wonder how anyone could have built such a massive thing out in this heat.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "If you are daring you could try to skirt around to the northern side.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8703, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb109806ac589c853", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb513402a70669a5af"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "If you are daring you could try to skirt around to the southern side.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8704, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb109806ac589c853", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0fb1e1e78f7ed98b"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "Far below you are the burning sands of the desert.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8701, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb109806ac589c853", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb684350c83635500a"}

name: Grassy plains
description: You walk in the grassy plains. The wind is fairly strong.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The plains extend far to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 338, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe6788e2f09faf073", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9cc5589d64726f91"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A small path is running through the plains.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 305, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe6788e2f09faf073", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb08323c3a794b7841"}

name: Ares Street
description:
You have reached the end of Ares Street.  To the south you see an armoury,
while there is a weapons shop to the east.  To the north, you hear the sounds
of a blacksmith.

name: Emerald Avenue
description:
You are at Emerald Avenue which continues north and south.  To the west is
the park entrance and to the east is the not very big Town Hall of Midgaard.

name: Gorak's Training Room
description:
This room is full of all sorts of weapons and armours. Pieces of old targets
and practice dummies lie all around. The walls are chipped and scored from
weapon blows. This is obviously the room of an avid warrior. A red door leads
east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "red", "description": "It looks like it leads back to the hall.", "valid": true}

name: Quifael's study
description:
You are in a small, comfortable study room.  The walls are lined with
bookcases filled with dusty volumes of all sizes.  In the fireplace burns a
crackling fire that makes the room warm and cosy, and in front of an oakwood
reading desk is a large old-fashioned chair.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "bookcase bookcases volume volumes book books", "description": "Most of the books are heavy, leatherbound and covered in a thin layer of dust.
There are many titles on necromancy, conjuring and other spheres of Magick,
but also some on computer science (although these seem to be VERY dusty
indeed) and a fair collection of horror literature, ranging from Bram Stoker
and H. P. Lovecraft to Anne Rice and Stephen King.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The corridor leads south to the hall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6904, "room_id": "69f4d0cb347a0769fd941db3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd87bba2320379502"}

name: A store room
description:
You are in a small dark store room. A few common items are stacked upon
the shelves here, but very little looks interesting.

name: The holy grove
description:
You are standing amidst the ancient oaks and poplars in the holy grove. You
can feel a strange sensation of joy and calm seeping through You, as if great
burdens have been lifted from Your shoulders. To the south, You glimpse an open
area through the trees, while paths lead away north and west.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "foundation", "description": "The foundation looks like it is for a sprawling, two-story affair with three
wings.  On the ground is some building material, marble would do, if marble
changed color slowly, continuously, through the entire spectrum.  There are
also large panes of glass stacked over near one of the corners of the
foundation.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The path wind its way through the tall trees, disappearing out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5368, "room_id": "69f4d0cb94a0540650fb7ddb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbddd3ce8bbc38e5f3"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, just beyond the trees, you can see a wide green lawn, and past\nthe lawn, a softly shimmering, rainbow-colored dome covering the foundation\nfor a structure.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5374, "room_id": "69f4d0cb94a0540650fb7ddb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb606de0385a34e9bc"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The path wind its way through the tall trees, disappearing out of sight.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5370, "room_id": "69f4d0cb94a0540650fb7ddb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd7bf4c7514b885b9"}

name: The large cave
description:
You are in the southeast end of a large cave. To the east you
notice a small tunnel.

name: Conservatory
description:
Here was the rehearsal and recital room for the residents of the
estate.  There is a Steinway piano in the corner and various gilded
instruments are on display in a glass cabinet.

name: House
description:
You are in a house.  The living room and kitchen are all bundled into
this room.  There is a bedroom south of here.  The exit is east.

name: Alley
description:
This is a tiny corner in the alley.  The temple walls are North and West.
You notice a fair amount of footprints to the east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "footprint", "description": "Kind of looks like a yeti has been here....  Hmmmm.", "valid": true}

name: The Jail Cell
description:
You are in a musty, dark jail cell.  Wet and dirty straw covers the floor.
The walls glisten with slime.  You see something stir in the straw.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a dark and nasty room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1576, "room_id": "69f4d0cb26f1b6a04e7fbc8d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9f4d823513643f5e"}

name: Climbing the Great Pyramid
description:
Hot air rises off the sides of the pyramid, and the wind chokes you with a
flurry of sand and dust.  The walls of the pyramid are quite steep, and you
are having trouble keeping from sliding down into the sands below.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "pyramid", "description": "You wonder how anyone could have built such a massive thing out in this heat.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "If you are daring you could try to skirt around to the eastern side.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8705, "room_id": "69f4d0cb513402a70669a5af", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7ec7349c75a592b1"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "If you are daring you could try to skirt around to the western side.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8702, "room_id": "69f4d0cb513402a70669a5af", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb109806ac589c853"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "It looks too dangerous to try to climb any higher.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8707, "room_id": "69f4d0cb513402a70669a5af", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb061cf18a10223f2a"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "This side of the pyramid has a dangerous drop before the sandy floor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8707, "room_id": "69f4d0cb513402a70669a5af", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb061cf18a10223f2a"}

name: Grassy foothills
description:
You walk in the grassy foothills north of the plains. The wind is rough.
To the north you can see foothills and just behind them mountain peaks
are visible.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The small foothills extend into foothills far to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 324, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1ceba868e290cb4e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd6e18e3289f479f0"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The small foothills extend into plains far to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 320, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1ceba868e290cb4e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7f1c784f456b9c4d"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The small foothills extend far to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 330, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1ceba868e290cb4e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb333079bd4df3bdeb"}

name: Armoury
description:
This small store is almost empty.  It seems as if there is not much here,
but the shopkeeper doesn't want to do business with you anyways.

name: Park Road
description: You are on Park Road which leads north and south.

name: Darkoth's Dark Study
description:
This room is dark. It reeks of death and evil. Arcane symbols and a small
altar fill the room. Blood runs from the altar. It is evident that this room
is used for unholy purposes. A black door leads east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "black", "description": "It looks like it leads back to the hall.", "valid": true}

name: Quifael's laboratory
description:
You are in a room filled with shelves containing all sorts of weird equipment.
The walls are lined with numerous shelves and a massive working desk is by
the north wall.  The air smells of rare chemicals and spices.
A virtual ladder leads downwards.
A magical portal is hovering in the air just in front of the east wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "shelves", "description": "The shelves contain a mass of bottles, jars and boxes of different shapes and
sizes, of which some contain powders and liquids in various colours.  Others
contain dragon's claws, giant's eyes, rabbit's ears and other body parts of
different monsters.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east is the magical portal.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6903, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdd73adca91f1d5b6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5a4fe6116f052700"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The virtual ladder leads down to the monster pen.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6900, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdd73adca91f1d5b6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba8b9768cee0b5c17"}

name: A bend in the hallway
description:
You are at a bend in the long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical
glow which provides enough light to see by.
The hallway continues south and east from here.

name: The tunnel
description:
You are in a narrow tunnel, which leads both to the east and the
south. There is also an exit towards the west, where you see a large
cave.

name: The holy grove
description:
You are standing amidst the tall, majestic trees in the southern end of the
holy grove. Paths lead north and east. To the east, You can see a wide, open
field, sloping gently down towards a bright, glittering lake. Somehow, here
you feel an inexplicable happiness, as if the world's troubles no longer
really matter to you.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "foundation construction", "description": "The foundation looks like it is for a sprawling, two-story affair with three
wings.  On the ground is some building material, marble would do, if marble
changed color slowly, continuously, through the entire spectrum.  There are
also large panes of glass stacked over near one of the corners of the
foundation.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The path leading north is soon lost out of sight amongst the ancient oaks and\npoplars.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5369, "room_id": "69f4d0cbec306d840d19e113", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb805a195bce0b5e56"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "To the east, the path leads out into a wide, sunny summer's field, sloping
south towards a beautiful lake. Past the field You can see the construction
of a large foundation for a structure shimmering gently in all the rainbow's
colours.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5373, "room_id": "69f4d0cbec306d840d19e113", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc0aad2ebc3335b1a"}

name: Office
description:
You find yourself in a lavish office.  The desk is absolutely huge,
at least ten feet by five feet and made of ebony and inlaid with
mother of pearl.  A grandfather clock towers over the room,
mechanically ticking and tocking the hours away.

name: Bedroom
description:
You are in a bedroom.  There isn't much of interest here except for a bed
and a dresser.  The main room of the house is north of here.

name: Alley
description:
This is a dead end to the tiny alley.  There is an unusual amount of wear
appearent on the ground.

name: The steep foothills
description:
You walk in the steep foothills. It is rather hard to move here.
To the north you can see a grassy valley with wildflowers.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a path toward the valley.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7800, "room_id": "69f4d0cb79dc6245ec76bc6e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd77fbe5e9ca76ee4"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The foothills extend far to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 324, "room_id": "69f4d0cb79dc6245ec76bc6e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd6e18e3289f479f0"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "On the horizon you can see the City of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 330, "room_id": "69f4d0cb79dc6245ec76bc6e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb333079bd4df3bdeb"}

name: Weapon Shop
description:
You have entered a small store with a modest selection of weapons.  You
get the feeling that there is not a very wide selection here, but the
shopkeeper doesn't want to do business with you anyways.

name: Emerald Avenue
description:
You are standing at a bend on Emerald Avenue.  The road leads north and west.
To the east, you see some run-down slums...it looks like the bad part of
town.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see some dangerous looking slums...just the right place for a gang.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 2101, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0d5f0b72ec026f20", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8be9ad4d96ec2245"}

name: Tyrgoth's Inner Sanctum
description:
Idols to the gods of good fill the room. White furniture and decorations give
the room a holy appearance. It is evident that some being of supreme goodness
lives here. A white door leads east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "white", "description": "It looks like it leads out to the hall.", "valid": true}

name: Outside Redferne's residence
description:
A huge cloud forms the plateau on which you are now standing. The wind here
is absolutely quiet and the sun is shining warmly upon you. From under the
cloud you can hear the faint sounds of Midgaard. Right before you to the
north lies the grand Mansion of Naris, the residence of the Greater God
Redferne.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a HUGE arched gate leading into this magnificent building.", "keyword": "gate door huge arched", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7901, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8ce7e6b53ce8e1d9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3a241c8861141e5c"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see a Huge Chain that anchors the Mansion of Naris to the ground.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7918, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8ce7e6b53ce8e1d9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb78be7ac4bdf2c396"}

name: End of tunnel
description: The tunnel stops here.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
An iron bound door can be seen to the west.

name: Quifael's virtual balcony
description:
You are on a transparent balcony hanging in mid-air.  You notice a faint blue
glow surrounding everything, even yourself, making it seem as transparent as
the balcony itself.  From here, you have a terrific view of the whole Forest
of Haon-Dor.
A transparent bronze plate has been bolted to the balcony railing.
A magical portal is hovering in the air to the west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "balcony railing", "description": "Quite transparent, but visible anyway, because of the blue glow that surrounds\nthe whole place.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The magical portal is to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6902, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5a4fe6116f052700", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdd73adca91f1d5b6"}

name: The sunny field
description:
You are standing in the middle of a wide, summery, sunlit field. There is a
fragrance of spring in the air, a sound of summer and a feeling of eternal
Saturday afternoon. To the south is a clear, sparkling lake, and to the north
and west is the holy grove. In the wood's edge, to the east, is construction,
shimmering softly through the colors of the rainbow. You feel as if You
could spend the rest of your life here, lying on your back and looking at the
patterns of the clouds as they gently drift across the sky.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "dome construction structure east e", "description": "The foundation looks like it is for a sprawling, two-story affair with three
wings.  On the ground is some building material, marble would do, if marble
changed color slowly, continuously, through the entire spectrum.  There are
also large panes of glass stacked over near one of the corners of the
foundation.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "There is a path leading north towards the sacred glade.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5370, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc0aad2ebc3335b1a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd7bf4c7514b885b9"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "There is a small path leading into the woods to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5372, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc0aad2ebc3335b1a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbec306d840d19e113"}

name: Eastern tower.
description:
You are in the bottom part of a tower.  A draft brings a chill to
your spine and causes creaks and groans.  Curtains flutter in the
wind, causing quite a distraction.  When you go to shut the window,
you see that the window is closed.  An old, wooden staircase leads
up into darkness.

name: The Big Intersection
description:
You are on the intersection of Impy Way and Swiftest Way.  To the north of
you is a big house.  Swiftest Way runs east and west, and Impy way continues
south.  There are quite a few people on this intersection.

name: The Jail Cell
description:
You are in a musty, dark jail cell.  Wet and dirty straw covers the floor.
The walls glisten with slime.  You see something stir in the straw.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a dark and nasty room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1575, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8774e6ec08ad1cc0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbe31bd681c27ce86"}

name: Alley
description:
You are in a tiny ally between the temple and Nabil's Exotic Animals. You hear
some shouting and general roadwork to the south.  The ground is rough and
in need of repair.  In the road is a small pothole.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "pothole", "description": "Why are you looking in a pothole??????\nYou poor or something?", "valid": true}

name: Climbing the Great Pyramid
description:
Here on the eastern side of the pyramid there is a little more shelter
from the heat and wind.  The stone side is not nearly so slippery smooth
from the ravages of time, and you think you may be able to even reach the
top from here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "pyramid", "description": "You wonder how anyone could have built such a massive thing out in this heat.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "If you are daring you could try to skirt around to the northern side.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8703, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7ec7349c75a592b1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb513402a70669a5af"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "If you are daring you could try to skirt around to the southern side.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8704, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7ec7349c75a592b1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0fb1e1e78f7ed98b"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "You see the apex of the pyramid many yards above you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8706, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7ec7349c75a592b1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9ef24830df0673cc"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "This side of the pyramid has a dangerous drop before the sandy floor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8707, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7ec7349c75a592b1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb061cf18a10223f2a"}

name: The steep foothills
description:
You are walking in the steep foothills. It is rather hard to move here.
To the north you can see the mountains towering over you.  Pine trees
grow here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mountains", "description": "The mountains seems dark and all most alive, as they contrast against\nthe sky.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The foothills extend far to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 325, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd6e18e3289f479f0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf9ad9e24b07dcc25"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The foothills extend downwards to the south. In the horizon you can\nsee the City Of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 322, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd6e18e3289f479f0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1ceba868e290cb4e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The foothills extend far to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 323, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd6e18e3289f479f0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb79dc6245ec76bc6e"}

name: Smithy
description:
This large room is so noisy, you can barely hear yourself think.  All the
occupants are hard at work, crafting high quality weapons and armor.  Something
is strange about the west wall, although you can't quite tell what it is.

name: Road Crossing
description:
You are in the middle of the road cross.  Roads lead in all directions.
A huge black iron chain as thick as a tree trunk is fastened into the ground
at the centre of the road cross.  Its other end leads directly upwards towards
the sky.
A road sign is here.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign points in all directions:

North - Emerald Avenue.
East  - Park Road.
South - Emerald Avenue.
West  - Park Road.

Someone has added the following with red paint:

Up    - Redferne's Flying Citadel.", "valid": true}

name: The croquet lawn
description:
You are standing on a immaculately manicured green lawn, the kind you only
get after 200 years of meticulous work. There is a winding stone path leading
from the wood's edge to the north, to the softly shimmering, rainbow-colored
dome covering construction to the south. This place enjoys a perpetual cool,
sunny summers after-noon.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "dome construction south s", "description": "The foundation looks like it is for a sprawling, two-story affair with three
wings.  On the ground is some building material, marble would do, if marble
changed color slowly, continuously, through the entire spectrum.  There are
also large panes of glass stacked over near one of the corners of the
foundation.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north, the winding stone path leads into the holy grove.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5371, "room_id": "69f4d0cb606de0385a34e9bc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb94a0540650fb7ddb"}

name: The road to the Keep of Mahn-Tor
description:
You walk up a steep rocky road. It leads up a steep grade to the east. At the
end of this steep road, you see a huge keep. Snow swirls all about you and you
feel your breath freeze as it leaves your lungs. Blurry lights to the east and
west are all you can see from here.

name: The hole
description:
You are at a small hole in the floor, you can either leave north
or try your luck and leave down into the unknown!

name: The Southern end of the hall
description:
You are standing in a vast hall that is dimly lit, but wherefrom the
light comes, is a mystery. The walls seem to radiate warmth and give
the pleasant feeling of being welcome here. A large portrait is hanging
on one of the walls. A large wooden staircase leads up into the tower.
To the east there is a high passage away from the hall. This ends
shortly after by a tall oak door. The enormous hall extends further
north from here. To the south you can see a huge, and VERY heavy-
looking iron-wrought door. It looks like this is the only exit from
this magnificent old house. To the west you can see a large ashen door.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "runes", "description": "These runes are utterly strange to you, but you are in luck today: Under\nthe runes you can just make out a sentence in Common. It goes : \" Stay out,\nif you treasure your life. That is if you are mortal.\".", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The hallway continues that way. You can see more doorways under the\nwooden staircase in that direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7904, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3a241c8861141e5c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb78bbbf82481ae785"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You see there a tall oak door. It looks quite tightly closed to you.\nOn it little runes are chiselled into the wood.", "keyword": "oak tall east oakdoor talldoor eastdoor", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7910, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3a241c8861141e5c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbca1c74d630504004"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Here you see a REAL door. It would be more proper to call this a\n\"GATE\", rather than a \"door\". It's really HUGE! On it hangs a large\nsign with very large letters spelling : \"EMERGENCY EXIT\".", "keyword": "gate", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7900, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3a241c8861141e5c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8ce7e6b53ce8e1d9"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "This looks like a \"door\" in the meaning of the word. The ashen wood\nis painted in a peculiar yellow colour. Small letters are written\nwith black on it.", "keyword": "ashen ash door west yellow", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7902, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3a241c8861141e5c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4f5d63127c950583"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "You see the staircase extending upwards into the very high tower.\nIt ends in what seems like a large bedroom up there.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7909, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3a241c8861141e5c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb31d9edc0c6b35de"}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
The sharp sound of metal on metal can be heard to the west.

name: Quifael's hall
description:
You are in sparsely decorated and quite dusty hall.  Old wooden doors lead
north, east and south and to the west is the front door.
An old mirror hangs on the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mirror", "description": "You see yourself looking back at you.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The front door leads to Park Road.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 3301, "to_room_vnum": 3126, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd87bba2320379502", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2eb78526cedd603e"}

name: Eastern tower.
description:
The tower creaks and groans, almost as if it were muttering to
itself.  There are windows displaying a full moon, reigning over
the night sky.  The room is dark and there is almost a musty odor
to it.  You are surprised that you can't detect any dust or dirt,
although there are a couple of cobwebs in the corner.

name: Big House
description:
You are in a big house.  Evidently, the owners of this house are richer
than the average citizen, since there is more than one room to this house.  A
door leads to the kitchen north, and a bedroom is upstairs.  The exit is to
the south.

name: Small Mine Shaft
description:
You are in a small extension of the mine shaft.  The dust on the floor is
undisturbed by footprints.

name: Alley
description:
You are on a small alley between the repair shop and the general store.
Nothing much here but small rodents and dust.

name: The Apex of the Great Pyramid
description:
Bathed in sweat, you have managed to reach the summit of the great pyramid.
The four sides of the pyramid slope sharply down into the hot sands in all four
cardinal directions.
A plaque has been set into the sandy stones beneath your feet.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "stones", "description": "As you look closer you can make out a crack in the center of the stones\nbeneath your feet.  With some effort you might be able to lift that\nsection up and get inside!", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The north side of the pyramid slopes down into the sands.\nIt looks really dangerous.  I wouldn't go that way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8707, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9ef24830df0673cc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb061cf18a10223f2a"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The east side of the pyramid slopes down into the sands.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8705, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9ef24830df0673cc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7ec7349c75a592b1"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The south side of the pyramid slopes down into the sands.\nIt looks really dangerous.  I wouldn't go that way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8707, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9ef24830df0673cc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb061cf18a10223f2a"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The west side of the pyramid slopes down into the sands.\nIt looks really dangerous.  I wouldn't go that way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8707, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9ef24830df0673cc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb061cf18a10223f2a"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see some sandy stones pressed closely together to form a hard surface.", "keyword": "stones", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8708, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9ef24830df0673cc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb95086a9370ec6f1b"}

name: The Planning Room
description:
You have entered a large room dominated by a huge table with a large map
on it.  Several men are gathered around the table, studying the map carefully.
You hear the barking of dogs to the north.

name: The steep foothills
description:
You are walking in the steep foothills. It is rather hard to move here.
Further to the north you can see the mountains towering over you.
Several pinetrees grow here.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The foothills extend into smaller hills far to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 326, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf9ad9e24b07dcc25", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb34e35ccb9cc4176a"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The foothills extend far to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 324, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf9ad9e24b07dcc25", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd6e18e3289f479f0"}

name: Emerald Avenue
description:
You are standing at a bend on Emerald Avenue.  The road leads south and
east.

name: A small guard house
description:
You enter a small guard house. A huge fireplace lights and warms the room.
Looking around, you see that the room is fairly well furnished. Thick rugs
and curtains help insulate the room and the beds themselves look quite warm.
A table in the center of the room has the remnants of a card game strewn
across it. A small door leads south.

name: The Void
description:
You are standing in the middle of something you cannot explain.  You see
stars yet you cannot see what you are standing on.  You are not standing
on any sort of physical 'ground' as you can see yet you are not floating
either.  Occasionally, the starry 'sky' fades into a fuzzy, yet bright,
rainbow then back to its normal state.  In the middle of this room is
a ladder standing vertical.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a fuzzy portal of some sort and a little green.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5368, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb9d622182e8df71f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbddd3ce8bbc38e5f3"}

name: Redferne's Library
description:
This is truly a magnificent place! Books and scrolls lie together on every
shelf. A large globe, with the map of the Mud-world upon it, stands in the
dimly lit north-western corner of the room. Two large and comfortable-
looking leather arm-chairs adorn the center of the library together with
a huge oak desk. Dim light radiates from an enormous crystal chandelier
hanging down from the ceiling approximately 10 feet off the floor. To the
east there is a great old ashen door. A large glass window is set in the
west wall.
extraDescription:
