{"keyword": "globe world map", "description": "You see a large world map stretch out on the enormous globe. It has towns
drawn in every spot available for such. In the middle of the map you can
spot a large town with the name 'MIDGAARD' written over it. The rest is
mountains, woods, plains and water.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You can see an old ashen door, painted in a peculiar yellow colour.", "keyword": "door ash ashen east", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7901, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4f5d63127c950583", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3a241c8861141e5c"}

name: The tunnel
description: Suddenly you feel that the tunnel leads slightly down.

name: Mid-Air.
description:
You slide down the moisture covered rock, gaining speed as you
approach the cliff.  Realizing your foolish error, you madly claw
at the rock, vainly trying to get a precious hold and save your
worthless hide.  Next time, heed your conscience.

You've fallen, and you can't get up!!!

name: A store room
description:
You are in a large store room. Bins of ores, minerals and other rare
materials are here along with many neatly stacked piles of precious metals.
A large cabinet with sigils of warding is bolted to one wall.
The ring of metal on metal can be heard to the south.

name: Quifael's kitchen
description: You are in an old-fashioned kitchen.

name: Bedroom
description:
You are in the bedroom.  There isn't much of interest except for a bed
and a closet.  The stairs lead back down.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see the main room of the house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 643, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb99bcf428e8be45d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6aa8b06d311dfe63"}

name: Hobgoblin Barracks
description:
You are suddenly surrounded by a small army of hobgoblin guards.  The room
itself is a mess with clothes and armor everywhere.  The beds are unmade and
stained.

name: Alley
description:
This is a small corner in the alley behind the warehouses and the guild
of warrior's. You notice  some small scrapings to the west.

name: Climbing the Great Pyramid
description:
Here the elements have carved away at the sides of the pyramid quite a
bit.  You aren't so sure of your footing anymore...

Suddenly the wind picks up, and you lose your balance!
You tumble down the side of the pyramid, and fall to your death!

SPLAT.

name: Second Floor
description:
You are on the second floor of this castle.  You are numb from your
discoveries on the first floor, and wonder what secrets the upper floor of this
castle holds.  Hallways extend in all directions, and you see a small, closed
hatch above you.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see a sign on the hatch.  It reads 'Private Property. No trespassing!'", "keyword": "hatch", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 948, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2e5aa2ff0803a76f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0cc6bb4f29707d37"}

name: The pool in the foothills
description:
You are standing by a pool in the small foothills. It is clear and cold.
A steep slope rises up into the foothills to the north. Behind them ...
the mountains.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "pool", "description": "The pool is crystal clear, but as you look into it you notice that\nyou can't see the bottom of it ... it must be pretty deep.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you notice a small path in the foothills.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 309, "room_id": "69f4d0cb34e35ccb9cc4176a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7ebcf0a2eb051874"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south a path winds its way south into the plains.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 306, "room_id": "69f4d0cb34e35ccb9cc4176a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6f661d9430d45228"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The foothills extend far to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 325, "room_id": "69f4d0cb34e35ccb9cc4176a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf9ad9e24b07dcc25"}

name: The Void
description:
You are standing in the middle of something you cannot explain.  You see
stars yet you cannot see what you are standing on.  You are not standing
on any sort of physical 'ground' as you can see yet you are not floating
either.  Occasionally, the starry 'sky' fades into a fuzzy, yet bright,
rainbow then back to its normal state.

name: Park Road
description:
You are on Park Road which leads south and north.  Elm Street is east of
here.

name: Before the Keep of Mahn-Tor
description:
You stand before a huge keep that has been carved into the side of the
mountain. Huge wooden gates before you provide entrance to the keep. It
appears as though the cold here has convinced the guards to seek warmth
inside. You see the lights of the city to the west. You also notice small
guard houses to the north and south.

name: The Artifact room of Naris
description:
This is gloomy and dark room with only a faint light radiating from the
walls. A bunch of funny-looking items fill the center of the room. There are
no furniture here what-so-ever. The only way out seems to be west, through
the low steel door.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see only the back of a safe's steel door.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": -1, "room_id": "69f4d0cbac1aeed290a53c51", "to_room_id": null}

name: The long tunnel
description:
You are in a long east-west leading tunnel. The tunnel is quite
wide at this point.

name: Kitchen
description:
You are in a kitchen.  There isn't much of interest here.  The main room
is east of here.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the main room of the house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 643, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7984ff57b05d369b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6aa8b06d311dfe63"}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: Hobgoblin Barracks
description:
Yech!  As you continue forward, the smell just keeps getting worse.
What are you DOING here?

name: A Ladder
description:
You are climbing an ancient ladder that leads down into the depths of
the pyramid.  The air around is thick with layers of dust and a strange
musty smell.  Above you you see tiny beams of light coming through the
stones of the ceiling.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "stones", "description": "As you look closer you can make out a crack in the center of the stones\nabove your head.  With some effort you might be able to lift that\nsection up and get outside!", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see the sandy stones of the ceiling.", "keyword": "stones", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8706, "room_id": "69f4d0cb95086a9370ec6f1b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9ef24830df0673cc"}

name: Alley
description: The alley ends here as do the footprints you had noticed earlier.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see a small round iron plate set in the ground.", "keyword": "manhole man hole", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9581, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6a51d69cf94e213f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb61de6c12ef42a8bf"}

name: Northern Hall
description:
You are in the northern hallway.  There is a private room to the north,
and the stairs leading down are to the south.

name: The Void
description:
You are standing in the middle of something you cannot explain.  You see
stars yet you cannot see what you are standing on.  You are not standing
on any sort of physical 'ground' as you can see yet you are not floating
either.  Occasionally, the starry 'sky' fades into a fuzzy, yet bright,
rainbow then back to its normal state.

name: The foothills
description:
You are walking in some foothills. It is rather hard to move here.
Further to the north you can see the mountains towering over you.
Several pinetrees grow here.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you notice a small path in the foothills.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 313, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd5aefddfacab4c50", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba174fc966da1e61d"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south a steep slope runs down to a small path in the foothills.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 310, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd5aefddfacab4c50", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb03f7f23d8f61aadb"}

name: A small guard house
description:
You enter a small, but warm, guard house. Deep rugs and thick curtains
insulate the room. A huge fireplace lights and warms the room. Outside, you
hear the roar of the freezing wind. A small door leads north out into the cold.

name: Elm Street
description:
You are on Elm street.  Park Road is to the west and Elm Street continues
in eastward direction.

name: The Northern end of the hall
description:
You are standing in the northern end of the huge hall. This part is under
the grand wooden staircase so the light seems a little less bright here,
but this doesn't bother your sight at all. To the north lies the kitchen.
To the south lies the Southern end of the hall. To the east there is a huge
metal door. To the west there is a large aspenwood door.
exits:
{"direction": 1, "description": "You see a huge metal door. From it a foul stench emanates. The smell is the
most awful experience in your entire life. A thought seeps through this
terrible stench and into your mind : "Monsters", you feel BAD about opening
that door.", "keyword": "steel metal huge", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7913, "room_id": "69f4d0cb78bbbf82481ae785", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb11f9a2e8e5aadcb3"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The rest of the hall lies in that direction, and so does the exit.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7901, "room_id": "69f4d0cb78bbbf82481ae785", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3a241c8861141e5c"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The door has \"SITTING ROOM\" written on it. It is made from Aspenwood and\nis beautifully carven with small elves as main issue of sculpture.", "keyword": "aspen asp", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7905, "room_id": "69f4d0cb78bbbf82481ae785", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb199fda938105f413"}

name: The long tunnel
description:
You are in a long east-west leading tunnel. The tunnel becomes
narrow to the west.

name: Swiftest Way
description:
You are on Swiftest Way, the commoner's residential area.  Small houses
are north and south of you.  Swiftest Way continues east, and west is a big
intersection.

name: A very hot room
description:
You are in a very hot room. Against one wall is a large forge, magical
fires crackle within and heavy blue smoke pours into a vent in the ceiling.
A rune-encrusted mithril anvil is in the center of the room, looking well
used. Other tools of metallurgy hang on a rack which floats about three
meters in the air of its own force.

name: Mess Hall
description:
You stand in the hobgoblin eating area.  There are a few rotting tables
and many broken dishes scattered around the room.  You almost slip on a
rotten piece of meat, but catch yourself just in time.

name: A Musty Chamber
description:
You are standing in a dank, musty chamber just inside the pyramid.
Footprints and other strange marks are set into the dusty floor here.
It would seem that some of the tenants of this monument are still alive.
Exits lead in all directions.   The door to the west is covered with
inscriptions.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door stone", "description": "The stone door is covered in strange inscriptions and hieroglyphs that warn\nyou not to proceed any further.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a tiny crawlway raised about three feet off the ground.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8712, "room_id": "69f4d0cb36312bb129ba7346", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb92fe6da02f44f46"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "A dust-covered hallway leads off to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8739, "room_id": "69f4d0cb36312bb129ba7346", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcdfa0ac9dcc8903b"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see a small crack in the wall through which you might be able to slide.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8724, "room_id": "69f4d0cb36312bb129ba7346", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3c36dd25a6b00313"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a large stone door, covered in sigils and hieroglyphs.", "keyword": "door stone", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8710, "room_id": "69f4d0cb36312bb129ba7346", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe85bdce9f58df8d5"}

name: Underground
description:
You are in a small underground passage beneath the city. You see a small
glint of light from above and the passage continues south.

name: The Void
description:
You are standing in the middle of something you cannot explain.  You see
stars yet you cannot see what you are standing on.  You are not standing
on any sort of physical 'ground' as you can see yet you are not floating
either.  Occasionally, the starry 'sky' fades into a fuzzy, yet bright,
rainbow then back to its normal state.  In the middle of this room is
a ladder standing vertical.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a fuzzy portal of some sort and a little green.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 8903, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf8228d2aa47f704b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb022161cb2e66d2a0"}

name: In front of hut in foothills
description:
You are standing in the foothills. To the west, well hidden among the small
foothills and pines, you see a small hut. To the north you can see
the foothills, and some pineforrest. Further on mountain peaks are visible.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The steep foothills seems hard to climb", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 323, "room_id": "69f4d0cb333079bd4df3bdeb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb79dc6245ec76bc6e"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The foothills extend far to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 322, "room_id": "69f4d0cb333079bd4df3bdeb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1ceba868e290cb4e"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south the foothills extend into plains far to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 319, "room_id": "69f4d0cb333079bd4df3bdeb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb85fd47f8724ff88e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a small crumbled hut here, must be a hermit living here.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 331, "room_id": "69f4d0cb333079bd4df3bdeb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb19c33e35d293a5e3"}

name: Elm Street
description:
You near the end of Elm Street.  An old elm tree grows here.  A heavy
iron grating is south, surrounding the city's graveyard.  You can see a sign
hanging on the grate.  The concourse joins Elm Street to the east, and the
street ends to the north near a run-down neighborhood.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "grate grating", "description": "Looks heavy.  A small sign is hanging on it.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the beginnings of Midgaard's bad neighborhoods.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3144, "room_id": "69f4d0cb44838b9ec4f5aadb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba6ff1f2166a167a1"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Through the solid iron bars you see the graveyard.", "keyword": "grate", "exit_flags": 1, "key": 3121, "to_room_vnum": 3600, "room_id": "69f4d0cb44838b9ec4f5aadb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba15557d97dd98d0c"}

name: Southern Hall
description:
You are in the southern hallway.  There is a private room to the south,
and the stairs leading down are to the north.

name: The entryway to the Keep of Mahn-Tor
description:
You are at the entry hall to the huge keep. The high vaulted ceiling is carved
from solid stone. Huge stone pillars rise up from the floor to meet the
ceiling far above. The architecture appears to be dwarven. A huge pair of
gates stand to the west, protecting the keep from the harsh cold outside. A
large hall leads east, deeper into the keep.

name: The Sitting room of Naris
description:
You are standing in the middle of a really comfortable place. The walls are
decorated with paintings of smiling Kings and Queens. The most attractive
picture is one of a Prince in shiny armour. By one of the walls there is an
old arm-chair. The only exit is through the aspenwood door to the east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "chair arm-chair", "description": "This is truly a wonderful relic of the past. In it is a large cushion.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The door seems to be a very HEAVY door, carved completely from the trunk of\nan Aspen tree.", "keyword": "asp aspen door heavy", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7904, "room_id": "69f4d0cb199fda938105f413", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb78bbbf82481ae785"}

name: The long tunnel
description:
You are in a long east-west leading tunnel. The tunnel is quite
narrow at this point. You notice a small hole leading south.

name: Swiftest Way
description:
You are on Swiftest Way, the commoner's residential area.  Small houses
are north and south of you.  Swiftest Way continues east and west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the end of Swiftest Way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 648, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4646a20770608414", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8c2d169ad9949714"}

name: The master Enchanter's chamber
description:
You have entered the master enchanter's chamber. Upon all the walls here
are racks of finely crafted weapons. A huge chest with a glowing lock is
set to one side. Several unfinished looking blades rest atop a small work
table.

name: A Store Room
description: You stand in a small room filled with flour, grain, fruit, and bat droppings.

name: The Fire Pool
description:
This room is dominated by a massive raised pool that is filled with
not water but flames of intense heat.  The multicoloured flames lick out
at you, searching for things to burn.
The pool proceeds to the west into a small chamber.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a large stone door.", "keyword": "door stone", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8709, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe85bdce9f58df8d5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb36312bb129ba7346"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a small chamber filled with fire.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8711, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe85bdce9f58df8d5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf0eb9020ada158a0"}

name: Underground
description: The passage continues north and south.

name: Hermit's hut
description:
You are inside the hermit's hut. It is rather old, but serves it purpose.
It keeps its habitant from the rough winds and dangerous beasts of the
plains and foothills. There is a small fireplace here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "fireplace", "description": "The hermit cooks here.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Through the door you can see the foothills.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 330, "room_id": "69f4d0cb19c33e35d293a5e3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb333079bd4df3bdeb"}

name: The Temple Of Midgaard
description:
You are in the southern end of the temple hall in the Temple of Midgaard.
The temple has been constructed from giant marble blocks, eternal in
appearance, and most of the walls are covered by ancient wall paintings
picturing Gods, Giants and peasants.
Large steps lead down through the grand temple gate, descending the huge
mound upon which the temple is built and ends on the temple square below.
You notice that this building is quite new.  A small plaque is on this wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "plaque", "description": "This entire world has been integrated, modified, debugged, and enhanced by\nHatchet, Kahn, and Furey of MERC Industries to be run by any MERC Mud.\n1992 December 17", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "At the northern end of the temple hall is a statue and a huge altar.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5386, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbf2a777c8fc8bead", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdb56f224c780a8fe"}

name: Western Hall
description:
You are in the western hallway.  There is a private room to the west, and
the stairs leading down are to the east.

name: Emerald Avenue
description:
You are on Emerald Avenue which continues north.
The Concourse is south of here.

name: The long tunnel
description:
You are in a long east-west leading tunnel. The tunnel starts sloping
down towards the west.

name: The Hall
description:
You are in a huge hall. Large tapestries line the walls and huge statues of
various make and appearance are spread about. The ceiling above supports huge
candelabras, which light the room. To the east, you see a bright light and
hear sounds of inhabitation. Looking west, you see the entry gates to the keep.

name: The Kitchen of Naris
description:
This must be the place of food and drink. You can hear the faint noise of
rats feasting on meat and bread from somewhere undeterminable. The sound
makes you feel the agony of HUNGER. The only visible exit is south to the
Northern end of the hall. To the north there is a larder, and to the east
stands a fridge.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "It's dark in there,  but the sounds from there are unmistakably from rats.", "keyword": "larder wooden cupboard", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7907, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe44915cebf40e6c4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4247631ed2f9c54c"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You can see the fridge from here. In it are drinks all over.", "keyword": "fridge", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7908, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe44915cebf40e6c4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb88d1bc1191d423eb"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You can see the northern end of the hall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7904, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe44915cebf40e6c4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb78bbbf82481ae785"}

name: End of Swiftest Way
description:
You are on Swiftest Way, the commoner's residential area.  Small houses
are north, south, and east of you.  Swiftest Way continues west.

name: A bend in the hallway
description:
You are at a bend in a long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by.
The hallway continues north and east.

name: The Kitchen
description:
This kitchen hasn't been cleaned since the creation of humans.  The trash and
spoiled food laying on the floor reach up to your knees.  Off to the side a
pot is boiling over.  A human hand floats in it.

name: The Chamber of the Efreet
description:
You make your way across the fire pool, and into a small stone chamber.
Here the flames are nearly as high as your head, singeing your face and
evaporating your sweat instantaneously.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The pool of fire ends to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8710, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf0eb9020ada158a0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe85bdce9f58df8d5"}

name: Underground
description: The tunnel branches here going north, east, and west.

name: The ancient path
description:
You are moving on an ancient path. The path is slightly covered with
leaves and twitches.
To the north you can see the T-crossing and the path continues south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "As you look to the north you see a T-intersection.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 312, "room_id": "69f4d0cb05c9b527cc5394a8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba3fb9df7dd0f6577"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The ancient path continues through the plains.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 333, "room_id": "69f4d0cb05c9b527cc5394a8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5fe9824301edaf8f"}

name: The Temple Square
description:
You are standing on the temple square.  Huge marble steps lead up to the
temple gate.  The ground is just dirt but there are plans to make the road
cobble stone.  Just south of here you see a blooming market square, the
center of Midgaard.

name: Park Road
description: You are on Park Road which continues north.  The Concourse is south of here.

name: The golden cave
description:
You are in a giant cave, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. The cave continues to the south and west.

name: Eastern Hall
description:
You are in the eastern hallway.  There is a private room to the east, and
the stairs leading down are to the west.

name: The Grand Hall
description:
You are in the main hall of the Keep of Mahn-Tor. This hall is huge. The wide
floor of the hall is an expanse of marble. It shimmers in the light thrown
off by the torches that line the walls. To the east, you see what appears to
be a huge golden throne. The hall itself stretches south and a smaller hall
leads to the west.

name: The Larder
description:
You can see food all over. Among the heaps of food you notice HUGE rats
scuttering around, nibbling pieces off the heaps here and there.

name: Swiftest Way
description:
You are on Swiftest Way, the commoner's residential area.  Small houses
are north and south of you.  Swiftest Way continues west, and to the east you
see a big intersection.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A steel door can be seen to the south.

name: A Small Mine Shaft
description:
You come to a place in the mine shaft where a tunnel leads down.  The
small passage continues north and south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see an almost caved in area.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1589, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc0437b920f5b5fbc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb18217fefca665544"}

name: A Tiny Crawlway
description:
You have to go down onto your hands and knees to fit inside this tiny
space.  The crawlway is thick with sand and dust, and markings of the
passage of other creatures.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The crawlway ends to the south in a musty chamber.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8709, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb92fe6da02f44f46", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb36312bb129ba7346"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "A small hole above your head leads into a dank chamber.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8737, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb92fe6da02f44f46", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6c7f221ca0e96e55"}

name: Underground
description:
The alley turns again here and heads south and west. You notice a small
glint of light from above.

name: The ancient path
description:
You are standing on the ancient path which runs north and south.
The path is hardly visible here.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You trace the path carefully and see no immediate dangers.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 334, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5fe9824301edaf8f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7f39b99ae070b5d0"}

name: Market Square
description:
You are standing on the market square, the Square of Midgaard.  It seems
that a large, peculiar looking statue is being built here in the middle of
the square.  Roads lead to the north and east, north to the temple square,
east is the main street.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "statue", "description": "What you see is an uncompleted statue of what you think is the Midgaard\nmascot.", "valid": true}

name: On the Concourse
description:
You are at the southwest corner of the city wall.  The Concourse leads
both north and east.

name: The golden cave
description:
You are in a giant cave, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. The cave continues to the south and east, to the north is a narrow
tunnel.

name: Bed Room
description: You are in the bed room of a God!  This one seems to be empty.

name: The Fridge
description: This place is LOADED with drink, water and booze.

name: The Great Hall
description:
You stand in the great hall of the keep. Huge pillars rise up to the vaulted
ceiling and torch light glimmers off the marble floor here. You are amazed at
the sheer size of the hall. The hall itself leads north and east. You notice a
smaller hall leading south, deeper into the keep.

name: Entrance to Mud School
description:
This is the entrance to the Merc Mud School.  Go north to go through mud
school.  If you have been here before and want to go directly to the arena,
go south.

A sign warns 'You may not pass these doors once you have passed level 5.'
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the doorway into the Mud School Building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3757, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9f43475fa9ee8c91", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb16cce7434bdff9a4"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see the one way door into the Arena of Mud School.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3744, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9f43475fa9ee8c91", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcf81aae9067cfd84"}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: Swiftest Way
description:
You are on Swiftest Way, the commoner's residential area.  Small houses
are north and south of you.  Swiftest Way continues east and west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the end of Swiftest Way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 651, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3387e9d0008b4d7a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb5ce90e54e85b6d0"}

name: Hermit's Lair
description:
You are in a small section where the mine wall has collapsed to reveal a
tiny one-room cave.  The area is barely lit, but you can make out something
moving towards you.

name: A Tiny Crawlway
description:
You are on your hands and knees, inside a small crawlway that winds
through the inside of the pyramid.  The crawlway is thick with sand, dust,
and markings of the passage of other creatures.

name: Underground
description:
The passage ends here and you hear some low chanting from the west.
You also notice the clearing of dust on the ground but can't seem to
find any door in that direction.

name: The ancient path
description:
You are standing on the ancient path which runs north and south.
The path is hardly visible here.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You trace the path carefully and see no immediate dangers.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 335, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7f39b99ae070b5d0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb94d93552e9dc18aa"}

name: The Main Street
description:
You are on Main Street crossing through this booming town.  The main
street continues east.  To the west you see and hear a small market place.

name: On the Concourse
description:
You are walking around the scenic concourse as it continues its path around
the city of Midgaard.  The south gate of the city lies to your east, and the
southwestern corner of the city wall is west.  Emerald Avenue stretches out
to the north.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You can see the heavily guarded southern gate of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3255, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4f7dfc688c068277", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfdf4947389d8673f"}

name: The passage
description:
You are in a small passage, it leads south, to the west is a golden
cave.

name: On the stairs
description:
You can see up and down the stairway. It seems to take forever, either going
up OR down. It's just a seemingly insurmountable climb, either way. Up is the
bedroom of Redferne, and Down leads to the Southern end of the hall.

name: Bed Room
description: You are in the bed room of a God!

name: A Room in Mud School
description:
You are in a square white room.  The walls are all blank, with no windows.
Light fluoresces off the ceiling in soft white tones.  Of course, there is a
sign on the wall.  The exits are west and south.  A small plaque is on the
wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "plaque", "description": "This zone (Mud School) is created by Hatchet for any Merc Mud.\nCopyright 1992, 1993.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a path into another room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3757, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe34e5416cbf862a4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb16cce7434bdff9a4"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a path into another room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3702, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe34e5416cbf862a4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb67927011f4673e79"}

name: Standing before the throne
description:
You stand before the throne of Mahn-Tor. This golden throne is so huge that it
takes up almost the entire wall, stretching far above the floor. Sitting upon
it, you feel small and feeble. It is evident that this throne is more of a
decoration than anything else. Only the largest of kings could sit upon it.
The hall leads south and west into other parts of the keep.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "throne huge gold golden", "description": "The golden throne is huge. It takes up the whole wall.........", "valid": true}

name: A Hole
description: You are in a hole.

name: A Tiny Crawlway
description:
You are on your hands and knees, inside a small crawlway that winds
through the inside of the pyramid.  The crawlway is thick with sand, dust,
and markings of the passage of other creatures.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The crawlway gets a little tighter to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8715, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf39b4d4bac60d520", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb613105d0383c3570"}

name: A laboratory
description:
You are in a small laboratory. Many strange instruments, vials, bottles
and some scrawled notes are piled about a workbench. This room is very
untidy, looking almost abandoned, or used by a madman.
The only apparent exits are east and north.

name: The end of Swiftest Way
description:
You are on Swiftest Way, the commoner's residential area.  Small houses
are north, south, and west of you.  Swiftest Way continues east.

name: Underground
description: The small passage continues north and south from here.

name: The ancient path
description:
The path runs north and east from here.  You notice some markers placed
along the side of the path.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "markers", "description": "The markers seems like normal stones, but the way they are\narranged makes you think there is something special about them.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the ancient path winding its way north from here. Looks safe.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 334, "room_id": "69f4d0cb94d93552e9dc18aa", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7f39b99ae070b5d0"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Further ahead you see a bridge over a small creak.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 336, "room_id": "69f4d0cb94d93552e9dc18aa", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1dea9de248ba415f"}

name: The Main Street
description:
The main street, to the east you leave town and to the west the street
leads to the market square.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the main street leading to the market square.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5382, "room_id": "69f4d0cb482f83513e2f7145", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8b957cecfc312410"}

name: On the Concourse
description:
The concourse continues its path around the city.  The southern gates of the
city are west of here, and park road lies north.  The northeastern corner of
the city wall is east.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the south gate of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3255, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3b76a562b4efdcda", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfdf4947389d8673f"}

name: The golden cave
description:
You are in a giant cave, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. The cave continues to the north and west, east from you there is
a small passage.

name: The Treasure room
description: This place is gloomy.  The only visible exit is west, through the oak door.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see a tall oak door.", "keyword": "door oak tall", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7901, "room_id": "69f4d0cbca1c74d630504004", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3a241c8861141e5c"}

name: Bed Room
description: You are in the bed room of a God!

name: The Great Hall
description:
You are in a great hall. Huge torches light the room and their light shimmers
off the marble floor below you. To the north, you see a huge golden throne.
Looking up, you grow dizzy at the height to which the vaulted ceiling rises.
The hall itself leads north and west.

name: The Center Room
description:
You are in a square white room.  The walls are all blank, with no windows.
Light fluoresces off the ceiling in soft white tones.  Of course, there is a
sign on the wall.  Exits lead in ALL directions.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "This is the direction practicing room.  The directions you can go in any
room are: north, south, east, west, up, or down.  Of course, not all rooms
have all exits available.

To see the obvious exits in a room, type 'EXITS'.

Sometimes doors are closed, or locked, or secret.  Then you have to notice
clues in the room description, or try going into that direction and seeing
if you bump into a door.

Try going into each direction from here.  When you are done, go NORTH.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the room north that will lead you to the next section.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3703, "room_id": "69f4d0cb67927011f4673e79", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd992c1688e4995b9"}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
You can see a steel door to the south.

name: A Tightening in the Crawlway
description:
Here you are forced to slide on your belly through a particularly tight
section of the crawlway, as the stones of the pyramid close together
about you.  Below you is a small, slippery-looking hole that plummets into
blackness.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The crawlway gets a little larger to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8714, "room_id": "69f4d0cb613105d0383c3570", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf39b4d4bac60d520"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The crawlway continues to diminish in size to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8716, "room_id": "69f4d0cb613105d0383c3570", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6877ff664a286698"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The hole looks very slippery and very dark.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8717, "room_id": "69f4d0cb613105d0383c3570", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb84759573d2bf8d00"}

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the south.

name: Underground
description:
The small passage heads north and east from here. You here the sounds
of the city above you.

name: The wooden bridge
description:
You have stepped upon a wooden bridge. It looks old but safe to cross.
It is made of a wood you haven't seen before.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "rock formation formations", "description": "The rock formations are made of 7 huge, monolith like stones, placed\nin a symbolic circle.\nYou notice it's possible to enter the ring.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The path continues, further ahead you notice some rock formations.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 337, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1dea9de248ba415f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb61d74d63a702bd99"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The ancient path leads west and turns north further ahead.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 335, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1dea9de248ba415f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb94d93552e9dc18aa"}

name: Inside the East Gate of Midgaard
description:
You are by two small newly built towers that have been built into the
city wall and connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate.
Main Street leads west from here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bridge footbridge", "description": "It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk across it\nfrom one tower to the other.", "valid": true}

name: The golden cave
description:
You are in a giant cave, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. The cave continues to the south, east and north.

name: On the Concourse
description:
You are at the southeast corner of the city wall.  The Concourse leads
both north and west.

name: Bed Room
description: You are in the bed room of a God!

name: Redferne's Bedroom
description:
This is a snugly set bedroom with all the necessities for a romantic evening.
A large fireplace adorns the east wall, and sizzling away is the wood that
is ablaze within.  The bed is enormous, covering at least HALF of this great
room.  This stretches at least 300 square feet, so can you imagine the BED?
A large staircase leads down to the hall.  A couple of doors open up to a
broad balcony to the south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The sun seems to shine out there, warmly and comforting.", "keyword": "doors", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7912, "room_id": "69f4d0cb05fcb477e5c2b7e2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb48f769ca63ac7979"}

name: The secret hallway
description:
You are in a small, torch lit hall. It leads from east to west. A large gold
door is to the west. To the east, you see a heavy stone door.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "gold", "description": "Looks like the back of a secret door of sorts.", "valid": true}

name: A Room in Mud School
description:
You are in a square white room.  The walls are all blank, with no windows.
Light fluoresces off the ceiling in soft white tones.  Of course, there is a
sign on the wall.  Exits lead north and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "Since you are here, let us have another lesson.  You can see the statistics on\nyourself by typing 'SCORE'.  Do that right now.  At higher levels, 'SCORE'\ngives you more information.", "valid": true}

name: The Mad Alchemist's workroom
description:
You are in the workroom of The Mad Alchemist. Bubbling braziers, long
glass tubes and scores of oddly shaped vials and bottles are everywhere.
It is incredibly messy here, crushed glass and other trash litter the floor.
The only apparent exit is the one you entered by.

name: The Crawlway's End
description:
The crawlway shrinks away to nothing as the sandy stones of the pyramid
close together into a space through which only a snake could fit.   There is
barely enough space to turn around and make your way back through the tiny
crawlway to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The crawlway gets a little larger to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8715, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6877ff664a286698", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb613105d0383c3570"}

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the north.

name: Underground
description:
The tunnel continues you west and east. Hopefully you have a good sense
of direction.

name: The ancient path
description:
You find yourself located between the bridge and the rock formations.
As you approach the formations you begin to realize the true size of
them, about 15 feet tall and almost perfect rectangular shape.
You feel impressed with the awesome sight.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "rock formation formations", "description": "The rock formations are made of seven huge monolith placed in a circle.\nYou notice it's possible to enter the ring.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you enter the ring of stones. You wonder if it's safe.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 339, "room_id": "69f4d0cb61d74d63a702bd99", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf6894fdf3e906a68"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west the ancient path leads across the wooden bridge.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 336, "room_id": "69f4d0cb61d74d63a702bd99", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1dea9de248ba415f"}

name: Outside the East Gate of Midgaard
description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city wall and
connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate.  To the east the
plains stretch out in the distance.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bridge footbridge", "description": "It is too high up to reach but it looks as if one easily could walk across it\nfrom one tower to the other.", "valid": true}

name: The tunnel
description: You are at the end of the tunnel.

name: Park Road
description: You are at Park Road which continues north and south.

name: Hall of Gods
description:
You have entered the most sacred of places, the hall of true Gods.  If you
are a mortal, it would probably be a good idea to leave NOW!  Exits leave in
all directions.

name: The Balcony of Redferne's Residence
description:
You see a splendid view of the most of this world. The valleys stretch as far
as the eye can see to the south. Down below you can see the entrance
of this magnificent building. To the north are the doors to Redferne's Bedroom.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the comfortable bedroom of Naris, the mansion of Redferne the Greater\nGod.", "keyword": "doors", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7911, "room_id": "69f4d0cb48f769ca63ac7979", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb05fcb477e5c2b7e2"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see the ground on which this castle is set. Funnily it seems to you that\nit's no more than clouds.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": -1, "room_id": "69f4d0cb48f769ca63ac7979", "to_room_id": null}

name: Entry to the Royal Chambers
description:
You are at the entrance to the royal chambers of the keep. A plush shag rug
covers the stone floor. Large candelabras hang from the ceiling, lighting the
room. A huge fireplace warms the room. Beaded doorways lead south and east. A
huge stone door stands in the west wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "door huge stone", "description": "A huge stone door.......", "valid": true}

name: A Room in Mud School
description:
You are in a square white room.  The walls are all blank, with no windows.
Light fluoresces off the ceiling in soft white tones.  Of course, there is a
sign on the wall.  The only exit is east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "Just go east to the central room.", "valid": true}

name: A bend in the hallway
description:
You are at a bend in a long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by.
The hallway continues north and west.

name: A Slippery Hole
description:
The sides of this hole are slippery-smooth.  You lower yourself in, and
proceed to move downward... when suddenly you lose your purchase!

You fall for what seems like an eternity, and smash into the stones below...

Under the Hole
You are in a small chamber underneath the slippery hole, far below
the pyramid now.   The floor is strewn with bones.  To the south is a
small rocky crevasse.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "u up", "description": "The hole looks far too slippery to climb back up.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a rocky crevasse that proceeds deep under the pyramid.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8719, "room_id": "69f4d0cb84759573d2bf8d00", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd2b78da057280e21"}

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the south.

name: Ishtar River
description:
High above you on the top of the city wall guards look down to see if you
wish to exit the city via water. To do so they must open the iron grating
in front of you from above. The horrid smell of the dump wafts down from
the shore.

name: Grassy plains
description:
You walk in the grassy plains among the herbs which grow here. The wind is
strong and rough. Far to the north you can see the foothills and further on
mountain peaks are visible.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The plains extend far to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 321, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9cc5589d64726f91", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe6788e2f09faf073"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The plains extend far to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 317, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9cc5589d64726f91", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3ebf9c388ecf363c"}

name: By the Temple Altar
description:
You are by the temple altar in the northern end of the Temple of Midgaard.
A huge altar made from white polished marble is standing in front of you and
behind it is a ten foot tall sitting statue of Odin, the King of the Gods.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "altar", "description": "Even though the altar is more than ten feet long it appears to be made from a\nsingle block of white virgin marble.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the southern end of the temple.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5379, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdb56f224c780a8fe", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbf2a777c8fc8bead"}

name: The tunnel
description: You are in a small tunnel, it leads from east to the west.

name: Emerald Avenue
description:
You are standing on the north end of Emerald Avenue.  To the north is
Austral Square and Kate's Diner, to the east is the small street Penny Lane.

name: The Portal
description: A sign reads: Beware of the unexpected and don't expect too much.

name: The Monster Pen
description:
This looks like the cage in which a large carnivore is being kept. Judging by
the state the walls are in, this could very well be a large AGGRESSIVE animal.
This makes you pretty insecure, this stating your feeling about the place,
quite mildly.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "This looks like the only exit from here.", "keyword": "door cage metal pen", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7904, "room_id": "69f4d0cb11f9a2e8e5aadcb3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb78bbbf82481ae785"}

name: A Room in Mud School
description:
You are in a square white room.  The walls are all blank, with no windows.
Light fluoresces off the ceiling in soft white tones.  Of course, there is a
sign on the wall.  The only exit is north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "Just go north to the central room.", "valid": true}

name: The Guard Post
description:
The hall here has been built into a guard post of sorts. It appears as though
it would be quite easy to defend in times of emergency. Obviously, something
important lies beyond. A small hall leads south, while the main hall can be
seen to the north.

name: The pentagram chamber
description:
You are in a large room with a five pointed star etched into the floor.
A crackling energy field can be seen to the south, it looks quite dangerous.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The energy field crackles and glows, nothing seems to be beyond.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1392, "room_id": "69f4d0cb855e48acf3b29cac", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc200573ae43d3f0b"}

name: Under the Hole
description:
You are in a small chamber underneath the slippery hole, far below
the pyramid now.   The floor is strewn with bones.  To the south is a
small rocky crevasse.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "u up", "description": "The hole looks far too slippery to climb back up.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a rocky crevasse that proceeds deep under the pyramid.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8719, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfa30792b90294a97", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd2b78da057280e21"}

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the north.

name: The Stones of G'harne
description:
You are in the center of 7, 15 ft tall monolith like black stones.
In the center of the ring formed by the monolith you can't help
noticing a big sacrifice altar. The ground is covered with dirt, but the
altar shows no sign of such. West of here is the ancient path.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "stones g'harne monolith", "description": "The stones of G'harne tower fifteen feet over you.\nThe giant stones are made of a material you haven't seen before.\nIt resembles black marble, but somehow feels different.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the ancient path and the wooden bridge here.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 337, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf6894fdf3e906a68", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb61d74d63a702bd99"}

name: Ishtar River
description:
The gentle flow of the river carries you eastward;  looking up you see
couples strolling along the road. To the west you see the southern
bridge and to the east you see the iron grating protecting the city from
unwanted guests.

name: The tunnel
description: You are in a larger tunnel, it leads from west to east.

name: Emerald Avenue
description:
You are standing at a bend on Emerald Avenue.  To the east the road goes on
and to the south is the Road Crossing.

name: The Believer
description: A voice whispers, 'before the time has passed, enjoy your life.'

name: On the Huge Chain
description:
This place has quite a good view over Midgaard. Your possibilities of movement
seems to extend only to up and down. Unless you want to let go of the secure
and seemingly unmoveable chain, then those are the directions you should take
from here.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "Up the way you see the chain disappearing into the clouds above.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7916, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5dee6b2fd71d582f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb07ae069b7ab611df"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "Down below you see the huge chain anchored to the ground in the Road Crossing.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3120, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5dee6b2fd71d582f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3c46eeaaf2037e43"}

name: A Room in Mud School
description:
You are in a square white room.  The walls are all blank, with no windows.
Light fluoresces off the ceiling in soft white tones.  Of course, there is a
sign on the wall.  The only exit is up.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "Just go up to the central room.", "valid": true}

name: The guarded hall
description:
You walk down a torch lit hallway. It has been carved out of pure stone. It is
very quiet in this hall. You notice rows of colored doors on each wall. To
your east, you see a yellow door. To your west, you see a red door. The hall
itself leads south and north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "red", "description": "You see a red door. It has the name \"Gorak\" written on it.", "valid": true}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A bronze door can be seen to the east.

name: A Rough Crevasse
description:
You are now exploring deep within a strange rocky crevasse that plunges
down into the rock on which the pyramid was constructed.  To the south you
see the flickering light of a fire, and the crevasse proceeds downward.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "rough", "description": "As you look through the rough terrain, your eyes catch a small glint of light!", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a small stone chamber littered with bones.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8718, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd2b78da057280e21", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfa30792b90294a97"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see the flickering light of a small fire.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8720, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd2b78da057280e21", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5c1ad70c20b3b3cb"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The crevasse continues downward into total darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8721, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd2b78da057280e21", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbad84300226140edf"}

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the end of Swiftest Way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 648, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4d728e6dc5eca49f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8c2d169ad9949714"}

name: Dark smelly tunnels
description:
You are standing in a gloomy tunnel leading south and west, right under
the altar of G'harne.  The walls are covered with a smelly slime and small
rotting pieces of a meat like substance, fills the air with an unbearable
stench.  You might be able to force your way up into fresh air from here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "meat rotting slime substance", "description": "You try to examine the substance closer, but must refrain from this\nas all you really want to do is puke.\nYou puke.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You welcome the sight of fresh air.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 339, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3e2a6ce83d7d7225", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf6894fdf3e906a68"}

name: Ishtar River
description:
You hear your voice echo as you float under the bridge above. The city
construction crews have just recently finished the small ladder giving
common-folk easy access to the river.  From here, the river flows east and
west.

name: The passage
description:
You are in a passage that leads towards the south. To the east
you see a tunnel.

name: Emerald Avenue
description:
You are standing at a bend on Emerald Avenue.  To the west the road goes on
and to the north is the Road Crossing.

name: On the Great Chain of Naris
description:
You are approximately on the middle of the treacherous Chain. One false step
and death will come and collect you quickly. The chain leads upwards and down.
No way are you going to descend now ... you've only just begun your climb.
Besides it could cost you your life.  Look down and you'll see why.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "There seems to be only one way from here and that's up.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7918, "room_id": "69f4d0cb07ae069b7ab611df", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb78be7ac4bdf2c396"}

name: A Room in Mud School
description:
You are in a square white room.  The walls are all blank, with no windows.
Light fluoresces off the ceiling in soft white tones.  Of course, there is a
sign on the wall.  The only exit is down.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "Just go down to the central room.", "valid": true}

name: The guarded hall
description:
You walk down a small, quiet, torch lit hallway. Doors of different colors are
in each wall. To your east, you see a maroon door. To your west, you see a
black door. The hall itself leads north and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "black", "description": "You see a black door. It has the name \"Darkoth\" inscribed on it.", "valid": true}

name: A Small Fire
description:
Here a small fire burns in a nook in the rocks, providing some warmth and
comforting light in the cold, dark, dry air.

Standing here is a strange-looking old man, who stares at you balefully.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "man old", "description": "The old man looks like he has been trapped down here far too long, and
has begun to lose his mind.  He moves about slowly, cackling to himself.

He turns to you and shouts, 'nope measse!  nope measse!', then turns
back and stares into the fire.

'What a strange person,' you think to yourself.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a massive crevasse that plunges into darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8719, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5c1ad70c20b3b3cb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd2b78da057280e21"}

name: Inside the Energy Field
description:
You feel a stomach twisting sensation as you enter the energy field.
Nice going!  You might as well wait here until the wizard who built this
trap comes back to imprison your soul as well as your body.

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the end of Swiftest Way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 648, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe4bdeef9e84a8830", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8c2d169ad9949714"}

name: Dead end of tunnel
description:
The tunnel comes to an abrupt end here. It simply looks like it
hasn't been excavated further.  North of here the tunnel makes a turn east.

name: Ishtar River
description:
This part of the river seems alive with activity. Boats moored to the
docks near the ramp north of here make navigation a bit more trying.
As the river flows eastward you can see the southern bridge in that
direction.

name: The golden cave
description:
You are in a giant cave, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. The cave continues to the north, to the west you see a dark
passage.

name: Park Road
description:
You are at a bend on Park Road.  To the north the road goes on and to the
east is the Road Crossing.  To the south, the ancient cliffs rise from deep
under the ground, forming a wall.

name: The Mighty Chain of Naris
description:
This place offers a splendid view of the WHOLE COUNTRY SIDE!!! A magnificent
light shines upon you and the way up through the clouds is opened. Up there
you can now see the Mansion of Naris, Residence of the Greater God Redferne.
The chain beneath you seems to evaporate in the mustering clouds that
surround you by now.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see the sunny top of the clouds. Beyond these, the Mansion towers before\nyour eyes. Beautiful!!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7900, "room_id": "69f4d0cb78be7ac4bdf2c396", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8ce7e6b53ce8e1d9"}

name: A Room in Mud School
description:
You are in a square white room.  The walls are all blank, with no windows.
Light fluoresces off the ceiling in soft white tones.  Of course, there is a
sign on the wall.  Exits reach west and down.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "Welcome to combat training.

The first lesson is knowing whom to fight.  Use the command 'CONSIDER' to
consider killing a monster.  Avoid fighting monsters that will kill you
easily.

The second lesson is running away.  There is a monster in the room down.
He is too strong for you to kill, but he won't kill you.  So go 'DOWN' from
here, then 'CONSIDER' him, then 'KILL' him.  After a while, type 'FLEE' to
escape from him.

You can also set your character to flee automatically with the 'WIMPY' command.
Type 'HELP WIMPY' to find out more about 'WIMPY'.

After you flee, you will be back in this room.  When you are ready to go on
to the next station, go 'WEST'.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the next station of Mud School.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3711, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbe253a7521b9ef46", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8c5efd3731c333c3"}

name: Sumaron's Sanctum
description:
You enter a temple of sorts. A small altar is here and relics of many
religions lie around. It is evident that this is the room of a studying cleric.
A yellow door leads west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "yellow", "description": "It looks like it leads back to the hall.", "valid": true}

name: Down the Crevasse
description:
The crevasse proceeds downward into the dark depths of the earth.
The air about you is now cold and quite dry, and your light source
gutters in a cool breeze that wafts up from below.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "It is too dark for you to see any further along the crevasse.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8719, "room_id": "69f4d0cbad84300226140edf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd2b78da057280e21"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "It is too dark for you to see any further along the crevasse.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8722, "room_id": "69f4d0cbad84300226140edf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc46978983e575432"}

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the end of Swiftest Way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 648, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2c1d84772b7ba151", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8c2d169ad9949714"}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A bronze door can be seen to the east.

name: Dark smelly tunnels
description:
You are standing in a gloomy tunnel leading east and west.
The walls are covered with a smelly slime and small rotting pieces of a
meat like substance, fills the air with an unbearable stench.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "meat rotting slime substance", "description": "You try to examine the substance closer, but must refrain from this\nas all you really want to do is puke.\nYou puke.", "valid": true}

name: Ishtar River
description:
The river flows through a huge iron grating from the wilderness through
the city. Strong guards above await word to open the portal
should any citizen require exit or entry.

name: The dark passage.
description:
You are in a dark passage, that leads east. In the ceiling you notice
a small hole, just big enough to pass through.

name: Park Road
description:
You are at a bend on Park Road.  To the south the road goes on and to the
west is the Road Crossing.

name: The Blob Cage
description:
You are in a smelly cage.  Strangely, the walls are still clean!
You see a sign here.  The only exit is up.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "Remember, don't fight the blob to the finish!  Just type 'KILL BLOB', then\nwhen you are fighting, type 'FLEE', until you flee and are out of here.", "valid": true}

name: Amyrok's Arcane Study
description:
This room is full of shelves which hold various spell components. The center
of the room is occupied by a huge pentagram. The entire room smells of smoke
and incense. The room is obviously used extensively by a practicing mage. A
maroon door leads west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "maroon", "description": "It looks like it leads back to the hall.", "valid": true}

name: At the Crevasse's End
description:
Here the crevasse comes to an abrupt end.  A chilling wind howls
at your face from a black shape to the south, but the light from your
source is too dim to see exactly what it is.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "black shape", "description": "Wind howls about your ears like the roar of a tiger.  As your eyes\nadjust to the light the shape to the south almost seems to take the\nform of a massive animal head.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "It is too dark for you to see anything along the crevasse.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8721, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc46978983e575432", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbad84300226140edf"}

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the south.

name: An empty room
description:
You are in an empty room. It is both quiet and comfortable here, it looks
like a safe place to rest.

name: Dark smelly tunnels
description:
You are standing in a small smelly tunnel under the plains.
The smell is growing stronger to the west, so is the density of the
slime and other undeterminable substances ...
extraDescription: {"keyword": "slime substance", "description": "BWADR! ...", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The unbearable stench is less intensive in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 342, "room_id": "69f4d0cb62d06f8f0aab53f1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5b675670e48f25c5"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The tunnel seems to extend into some kind of cave.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 344, "room_id": "69f4d0cb62d06f8f0aab53f1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb862673f60816c4a"}

name: Dark Passage
description:
You seem to have stumbled into a small hand made passage. The wall to
the west  doesn't look quite right but searching it reveals no secret
doors. The only exit it seems is east.

name: The passage
description:
You are in a passage that leads north-south. You notice a small
light to the south.

name: The Waiting Room
description:
You are standing in the waiting room at the town hall.  Wooden chairs stand
along the walls and a long desk is placed in the middle of the room.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "It looks like some kind of office.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3138, "room_id": "69f4d0cb42da85a5800bb68c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb13995f2a8dd43b65"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The exit west leads to Emerald Avenue.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3117, "room_id": "69f4d0cb42da85a5800bb68c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbae2e634fb097f30c"}

name: A Room in Mud School
description:
You are in a square white room.  The walls are all blank, with no windows.
Light fluoresces off the ceiling in soft white tones.  Of course, there is a
sign on the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "Welcome to the next station.  Here, you will actually fight real monsters,\nwithout fleeing!  Kill every mob, since they hold some equipment you need.\nTo start, go down.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the next station of Mud School.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3709, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8c5efd3731c333c3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbe253a7521b9ef46"}

name: The guarded hall
description:
You walk down a quiet hall. The stone walls here are wet with moisture.
Colored doors can be seen in the walls here. To your east, you see a green
door. To your west, you see a white door. The hall itself leads north and
south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "white", "description": "You see a white door here. It has the name \"Tyrgoth\" inscribed on it.", "valid": true}

name: The Vault of the Lamp
description:
The jaws of the massive stone tiger part wide to reveal a great vault.
An arched ceiling lies far above your head... and all about you is a low
guttural rumbling noise and a chill wind.

Giant heaps of ancient treasure, gold coins, and valuables surround you
on all sides.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "treasure gold coins valuables", "description": "You reach for some of the tasty goodies, when you hear a loud rumbling
sound and see a bright flash of light...

Then the words: 'TAKE ONLY THE LAMP... TOUCH NOTHING ELSE.'

... All is silent once again.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Through the jaws of the tiger you see the blackness of the crevasse.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 8723, "to_room_vnum": 8722, "room_id": "69f4d0cb319de805b0d375b3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc46978983e575432"}

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the north.

name: The charm master's chamber
description:
You are in the chambers of the tower's master of charm. Some straw and
dirt litters the floor here, it looks to have been recently used by wild
animals.
Strange sounds can be heard through the bars to the north.

name: Dark Passage
description:
The small passage continues east and west from here. Again you notice
something peculiar about the wall, this time to the north, but you
fail to find any secret doors. Voices can be faintly heard from the north.

name: The Hall of G'harne
description:
You stand in the hall of G'harne. The walls are dressed with strange
carving, symbolizing human sacrifice and people worshipping giant worms.
Disgusting slime and gore are also very dominant in your view of this room.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "slime gore", "description": "You puke.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "It looks like a good idea just to run in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 343, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb862673f60816c4a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb62d06f8f0aab53f1"}

name: The secret chamber
description: You are in a secret chamber.

name: The Mayor's Office
description:
You are in the not very big office of the Mayor of Midgaard.  A large and
polished but completely empty desk is standing in front of an armchair that
looks so comfortable that it most of all resembles a bed with the head end
raised slightly.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "chair armchair", "description": "This chair is really a masterpiece.  A chair where one can sit as comfortably\nas in a bed.  All lecture halls should be equipped with these things.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The waiting room is to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3137, "room_id": "69f4d0cb13995f2a8dd43b65", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb42da85a5800bb68c"}

name: The Cage Room
description:
You are in the cage room.  All around are 4 cages.  Light fluoresces off the
ceiling in soft white tones.  Of course, there is a big sign on the wall.
Exits lead into the cardinal directions plus down.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "Welcome to the cage room.  The adepts of mud school have captured some
monsters for you to kill.  In the four cages are four monsters of various
types.  Kill them all!

After you kill each monster, get all of the equipment from their corpses
with the command 'GET ALL CORPSE'.  You can then use the command 'WEAR ALL'
to wear your newly won equipment.

When you are done with the corpse, 'SACRIFICE CORPSE' to give it to your God.
God will reward you for this.

Between combat, you may need to rest or sleep to regenerate hit points.
You can 'REST' to regenerate hit points, or you can 'SLEEP'.  'SLEEP' will
refresh you faster than 'REST', but you will be less aware of your
surroundings.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the aggressive wimpy monster inside!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3714, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd7579a5ebc0832e3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5e0dead932bd5ae8"}

name: A Crack in the Wall
description:
You exhale, and squeeze yourself into the narrow crack in the wall.
Dust fills your eyes as you disturb it, and chunks of mortar and stone
mixed with a touch of sand fall on you as you scrape your way through.

name: The Harem Room
description:
This appears to be the harem room of the Keep. Huge piles of furs and beds
fill the room. The lighting is dim, but the room is very warm. You can hear
music playing quietly from somewhere. Beaded doorways lead north and east.

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the south.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: Dark Passage
description: The small passage continues west and east from here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "boulder", "description": "A huge boulder stands here. In its center someone has carved out a\nperfect round hole.", "valid": true}

name: The cave
description:
You are in a light cave, from torches several feet above your
head fire lights the room. The cave continues to the west and south.
To the north a small hole leads to a tunnel.

name: Steep slope
description:
You try to climb down the slope.
>
You slip!
You fall and tumble.
You hit your head HARD.
You die.

You've fallen, and you can't get up!

name: A Cage
description:
You are in a cage.  Blood and gore are everywhere.  The keepers must be lax
in the upkeep here!  There is a sign on the wall.  The only exit is south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "There is an aggressive monster in this room.  Kill him and get out of here\nfast!  Remember to loot and sacrifice the corpse.", "valid": true}

name: Penny Lane
description:
You are on Penny Lane.  Emerald Avenue is to the west and Penny Lane
continues in eastward direction.

name: A Looted Tomb
description:
The floor of this small tomb is littered with the lids of
smashed sarcophagi, bits of treasure dropped by thieves and
looters, and corpses pulled from their resting places.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a small crack in the wall through which you might be able to slide.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8724, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8e8c5ba444303b81", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3c36dd25a6b00313"}

name: Nasturn's Humble Abode
description:
This room is filled with all types of natural items. Trees and plants have
been lovingly cultivated and grown by hand, in large pots. The room is like an
indoor garden. A green door leads west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "green", "description": "It looks like it leads back to the hall.", "valid": true}

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the north.

name: The animal pens
description:
You are in the animal pens. Many caged animals are here looking unhappy.
Obviously they are destined to be enslaved, or used in some cruel magical
experimentation.

name: Dark Passage
description:
The small passage ends here for no apparent reason. Looking around you
find a small ladder half buried in the dirt. setting it up you find a
trap door in the ceiling. The passage continues west from here.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "fire", "description": "Moving closer you see this fire is actually FROZEN in place. The
flames still radiate heat, but are not actually burning. Looking
around you notice a small hole about the size of a piece of charcoal
at the base of the flames.", "valid": true}

name: The cave
description:
You are in a light cave, from torches several feet above your
head fire lights the room. The cave continues to the east and south.

name: Penny Lane
description:
You are on Penny Lane.  The narrow road continues north and west, and
the concourse intersects this street to the east.

name: A Cage
description:
You are in a cage.  Blood and gore are everywhere.  The keepers must be lax
in the upkeep here!  There is a sign on the wall.  The only exit is east.
