extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "There is a wimpy, aggressive monster in this room.  Kill him and get out of\nhere fast!  Remember to loot and sacrifice the corpse.", "valid": true}

name: A Demolished Tomb
description:
This tomb has been utterly destroyed by thieves and looters in search of
the treasures of the pharoahs.  Nothing of interest remains in this room,
except a large stone coffin that leans against the western wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "coffin lid", "description": "The coffin is sculpted into the form of a man, standing several heads above
you, and clad in the garments of pharoahs.  It has apparently been untouched
by the ravages of time and the activities of looters.  Several markings on the
side indicate spots where unsuccessful attempts were made to open the coffin.

You can't see any way to open it.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see a large stone coffin.", "keyword": "coffin lid", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 8712, "to_room_vnum": 8727, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf59e3a9da3a82779", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb43c251da4479a513"}

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the end of Swiftest Way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 651, "room_id": "69f4d0cb440487dc9b8ddc4f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb5ce90e54e85b6d0"}

name: The main living room
description:
This room is decorated with sturdy stone furniture that is carved and gilded.
Large candles light the room. A thick rug covers the floor. Thick furs and
tapestries decorate the walls. Beaded doorways lead south and west.

name: The end of the hallway
description:
You are at the end of a long north-south hallway. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
Stairs here lead up to the next level, and the hallway continues south.

name: Underground
description: The small passage continues west and east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "cloud", "description": "Peering into the misty cloud the form a huge conch shell seems to fade\nin and out. Perhaps this is somehow the entrance to the next challenge", "valid": true}

name: The passage
description: You are in a north-south leading passage. To the south you see light.

name: A Cage
description:
You are in a cage.  Blood and gore are everywhere.  The keepers must be lax
in the upkeep here!  There is a sign on the wall.  The only exit is north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "There is a wimpy monster in this room.  Kill him and get out of here fast!\nRemember to loot and sacrifice the corpse.", "valid": true}

name: The end of Penny Lane
description: You are at the end of Penny Lane.  The only exit appears to be south.

name: A Stairway
description:
You stand now at the head of a stairway that goes down into darkness.
The steps and walls are smooth sandy stone, covered with a thick layer
of dust.  Some inscriptions are carved into the wall here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "inscriptions", "description": "You blow dust away from the inscriptions to read:\n'Beware the curse of the mummy.'", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the backside of the coffin lid, featureless stone.", "keyword": "coffin lid", "exit_flags": 2, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8726, "room_id": "69f4d0cb43c251da4479a513", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf59e3a9da3a82779"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "It is too dark to see down the stairway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8728, "room_id": "69f4d0cb43c251da4479a513", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba5490390763c811a"}

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the end of Swiftest Way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 651, "room_id": "69f4d0cbff98831bc534b6c9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb5ce90e54e85b6d0"}

name: The Master Bedroom
description:
This appears to be the master bedroom. A huge bed fills the rooms. Piles of
furs and other rich furnishings adorn the room. Candles are everywhere and
they help a huge fireplace light the room. The lavishness of the room
overwhelms you. Beaded doorways lead north and west.

name: Atop the stairway
description:
You are atop the stairway to the upper levels of the high tower. The walls
emit a faint magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A hallway leads west from here, and the stairs lead down.

name: Underground
description: The small passage continues west and east.

name: The secret tunnel
description:
You are in a secret tunnel that leads west, you feel evilness
approaching you as you continue west.

name: A Cage
description:
You are in a cage.  Blood and gore are everywhere.  The keepers must be lax
in the upkeep here!  There is a sign on the wall.  The only exit is west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "There is a monster in this room.  Kill him and get out of here fast!\nRemember to loot and sacrifice the corpse.", "valid": true}

name: Captain's Office
description:
You are in the Office of the Captain of the Guard.  The Midgaard Coat of
Arms is hanging on the north wall and a heavy steel door is to the south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "arms", "description": "Although a bit dusty the Coat of Arms is an excellent piece of work.", "valid": true}

name: A Stairway
description:
You are on a stairway that disappears into darkness in both directions.
The smooth, uneven steps of the stairway have not been travelled in what
appears to be centuries.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "It is too dark to see up the stairway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8727, "room_id": "69f4d0cba5490390763c811a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb43c251da4479a513"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "It is too dark to see down the stairway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8729, "room_id": "69f4d0cba5490390763c811a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdbe4639c6075c8f8"}

name: Small House
description:
You are in a small house, owned by a commoner of Ofcol.  There isn't much
of value here to you, but you'd bet that the owner really cherishes the pile
of stuff here.  The exit is to the east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the end of Swiftest Way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 651, "room_id": "69f4d0cb347b456cafc6c518", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb5ce90e54e85b6d0"}

name: The end of the guarded hall
description:
You are at the end of the hall. Colored doors line the walls to the north. To
your west, you see a brown door. To your east, you see a grey door. The hall
itself leads north back along the rows of doors.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "brown", "description": "You see a brown door here. It has the name \"Belrak\" written on it.", "valid": true}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A silver door can be seen to the north.

name: The secret chamber
description:
You are in a secret chamber, the room is filled with an evil
feeling.

name: Common Room of the Clan MacCleod
description:
You have entered a large hall with passages leading off in all directions.
A large table dominates the center of this hall with many chairs were
the clan gathers for feasting, merriment, and meetings. On the walls
hang large tapestries paying homage to their leader Conner MacCleod.

name: A Room in Mud School
description:
You are in a square white room.  The walls are all blank, with no windows.
Light fluoresces off the ceiling in soft white tones.  Of course, there is a
sign on the wall.  Find your own exit here.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "By now, you must be hungry and thirsty.  Time to buy groceries!
To the south is a store.  Inside the store, you can use these commands:

BUY    Buy an item
LIST   List what is for sale

After buying some food and drink, you can 'EAT' and 'DRINK' it.

After that, find the next exit yourself.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the next station of Mud School.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3719, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2b2223b39ebb0626", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd04ba826fcacb7da"}

name: The Jail
description:
You are in a dark and humid jail.  The dark stone walls are hard and cold
to the touch.  A heavy steel door is to the north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "wall walls", "description": "The walls are marked with lots of scratches.  Some of them spell sentences\nlike \"JAIL IS BETTER THAN SQL\" and \"BIGFOOTDAMOOSE IS ALIVE\".", "valid": true}

name: A Stairway
description:
You stand now at the base of the uneven stairway.  The walls, floor,
and ceiling of this small landing are covered with strange hieroglyphics.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "walls floor ceiling hieroglyphics", "description": "The hieroglyphics are covered with a thick layer of dust.  You clear the\ndust away with your hand, and find that you cannot comprehend them.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a seam in the stone wall.", "keyword": "stone", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8730, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdbe4639c6075c8f8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb23b474613045bc9a"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "It is too dark to see up the stairway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8728, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdbe4639c6075c8f8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba5490390763c811a"}

name: Raff Way
description:
You are on Raff Way.  To the west, you can see a big intersection.  To
the east, you see Raff Way continue toward the Golden Citadel.  There are
beautiful flowers growing along the road here, making this more of a garden
than a road.

name: Dorgar's Dismal Domicile
description:
This room is dirty and unkempt. Odds and ends of different items lie all over.
It is apparent that some type of pack-rat lives here. It appears as though
nothing has ever entered this room and ever left again. A grey door leads west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "grey", "description": "It looks like it leads back to the hall.", "valid": true}

name: A store room
description:
You are in a large store room. Raw materials are neatly bundled and piled
here and here. Many freshly cut staves rods and wands of different sizes
are here.
You can see a silver door to the west.

name: The cave
description:
You are in a light cave, from torches several feet above your
head fire lights the room. The cave continues to the north and west.

name: Zippoii's Room
description:
Climbing up the staircase you enter the hovel of a curious mage. A small
uncomfortable looking bed rests in the corner, surrounded by ancient
tomes. On the worn desk next to the window candles burn low, casting
strange shadows on the walls. The only noticeable decor is the mounted
head of the Demi-Lich.

name: The Store in Mud School
description:
You are in a cramped room.  Stacked neatly on shelves everywhere are items
and packages.  Light fluoresces off the ceiling in soft white tones.  Of
course, there is a sign on the wall.  The only exit is north.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign reads:

Buy   - Buy something from the storekeeper.
List  - The storekeeper will tell you what's for sale.
Value - The storekeeper will tell you how much he will give to you for
that item.
Sell  - Sell that item to the storekeeper.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the only exit out of here.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3717, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd455f4da94af5cee", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2b2223b39ebb0626"}

name: The end of Elm Street
description:
Elm street ends here, next to a dangerous-looking run down neighborhood.
You can enter the slums to the east, or head towards the graveyard to the
south.  It occurs to you that this isn't the happiest section of town.

name: Raff Way
description:
You are on Raff Way.  Raff Way continues west to the city of Ofcol.  To
the east, you see Raff Way continue toward the Golden Citadel.  There are
beautiful flowers growing along the road here, making this more of a garden
than a road.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the entrance of the Golden Citadel.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 699, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2957c4755516d9bb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb20f6db70bae40314"}

name: The Ancient Hall
description:
Here the air is deathly still, motes of dust thickly obscuring your
vision.  Several stone statues line the walls of the hall, depicting the
gods of an ancient society.  Strange glyphs and sigils cover the walls, a
peculiar pictorial form of written language that you don't understand.
Some steps lead to a raised dais to the south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "writings glyphs sigils hieroglyphics symbols", "description": "You don't understand the meaning of these symbols.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a seam in the stone wall.", "keyword": "stone", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8729, "room_id": "69f4d0cb23b474613045bc9a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdbe4639c6075c8f8"}

name: Belrak's Green Room
description:
This room is full of green. The furniture and all other items show the color
of nature. The room smells of pine and forest odors. From the items here, it
appears as though a woodsman of some sorts lives here. A brown door leads east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "brown", "description": "It looks like it leads to the hall.", "valid": true}

name: The master spellbinder's chamber
description:
You are in the chambers of the master spell binder. Unlike other work
shops of similar nature, this one is without furnishings or tools. The
spell binder obviously needs none for the working of his art.
A silver door can be seen to the west.

name: The cave
description:
You are in a light cave, from torches several feet above your
head fire lights the room. The cave continues to the east and north.
To the west a passage leads north.

name: Ice's Room
description:
Brrrrrr, it's COLD in here. Must be 30 below. It would seem the cleric
Ice lives up to his name. Healing herbs and other such things line
the walls in racks, holy symbols and pictures cover the walls, and
the smiley face button stuck on his bedpost tells you he'll probably
help you out all he can. As you turn to leave the room the mounted head
of Kalas stares past you into emptiness.

name: A Room in Mud School
description:
You are in a square white room.  The walls are all blank, with no windows.
Light fluoresces off the ceiling in soft white tones.  Of course, there is a
sign on the wall.  The exits are north and west, with a door to the east.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "North of you is a dark room.  I hope you still have the lantern!  If not,
you have to back to the store and buy one.

In the room is a monster with a key that you need.  After killing the
monster and getting the key, come back here, UNLOCK EAST, OPEN EAST,
and continue east.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the next station of Mud School.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 3714, "to_room_vnum": 3721, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd04ba826fcacb7da", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb64425baa309e3e29"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see the room you just came from.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3717, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd04ba826fcacb7da", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2b2223b39ebb0626"}

name: Kate's Diner
description:
The smells of baking bread and simmering stew lead you dancing through
the doorway of the diner.  No greasy spoons to be seen here-- the
booth walls are covered in casual paisleys; the chairs are carved wood,
rescued from garage sales.  Most tables have chess or backgammon boards
carved and painted on their fingertip-smooth tops.  The refrain of some
musical or other from the 1930's blends with the dusty golden light and the
wonderful smells to put you completely at ease.  A huge picture window
looks out over the Midgaard River, and a doorway leads north onto the dock
and the South Bank river landing, while the main entrance to the south
returns you to Austral Square.
On most days you will find Kate here, testing a batch of stew or brewing
a special pot of cinnamon coffee, eerily just in time for your arrival
Pull up a chair, perhaps play a game, and take time out to talk.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "window landing", "description": "You can see a rickety bridge to your northwest, leading back into
Central Midgaard.  A rustic dock connects the Diner with the Midgaard
River, and a boat or two floats lazily past.  Across the river you can see
the Levee and the Guild of Thieves, but they seem very far away from all
of this...", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A small boat landing lets boats land at the diner.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3203, "room_id": "69f4d0cb44aedd9e65c926f4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0f67cb31afa629d9"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "You see the far-off halls of Valhalla.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1219, "room_id": "69f4d0cb44aedd9e65c926f4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5cd774422d1ff90b"}

name: Dirt Road
description:
You are on a dirt road.  To the east is a large building with a bad smell
emanating from it.  To the west is the end of Impy Way, and this road continues
south.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the large building with the bad smell.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 617, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2e788bc48aa0793d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb31883c660f3dd3e3"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see the end of Impy Way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 611, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2e788bc48aa0793d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb96a616d127d4efc6"}

name: The spellbinder's cache
description:
You have discovered the cache of the master spell binder. There are two
very large silver chased cabinets here, other than that, the room is bare.
A silver door can be seen to the south.

name: A Raised Dais
description:
You are at the southern end of the ancient hall, the dust and darkness
absorbing your light so that you cannot see past the steps of the dais.
A low pedestal rests here.  You see something written into the face of it.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "pedestal writings", "description": "The writings are covered in sand and worn nearly away by the passage
of time: 'I am Ramses the Damned, once counselor and aide to the mightiest
of pharoahs and queens of this land.  Much time has passed since I last
walked the earth.  Disturb my rest at your peril.'", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You cannot see past the steps of the dais.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8730, "room_id": "69f4d0cb90d88216b22daac2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb23b474613045bc9a"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see a seam in the stone floor.", "keyword": "tomb", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8732, "room_id": "69f4d0cb90d88216b22daac2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb53ac7c07fd9cd23d"}

name: The passage
description:
You are in a passage, to the east you see a cave. Light from the
cave lights up the passage. To the north the passage leads into
the darkness.

name: Naazgul's Room
description:
Three Rings for the Elven-kings under the sky,
Seven for the Dwarf-lords in their halls of stone,
Nine for Mortal Men doomed to die,
One for the Dark Lord on his Dark Throne
In the Land of Mordor where Shadows lie.
One ring to rule them all, One ring to find them,
One ring to bring them all and in the darkness bind them
In the Land of Mordor where the Shadows lie.

If I have to explain, you wouldn't understand.

name: The Darkened Room
description:
This room was purposefully darkened so that you would need to hold on to a
light source to go through.  The walls are, of course, blank, and white.
The only exit is south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the room that you have come from.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3719, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf5a02cbd8de1e491", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd04ba826fcacb7da"}

name: Melancholy's Maps
description:
As you walk in, a sudden gust of wind enters the shop and sends several
scraps of paper fly around the room.  You blink as the dust you've stirred
up stings your eyes, and take a look around the shop.  This shop is cluttered
with old pieces of parchment, stacks of books, and odd scraps.  A desk with
slightly less clutter than the rest of the shop is in front of you.  A scroll
case full of scrolls is behind the desk.  A bookcase is to the right of you,
and to the left is a window overlooking the Common Square.  A small door,
half hidden by a stack of books, leads to a room in the back of the shop.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bookcase", "description": "You see many cartographer journals and topographical studies.  You also see\nquite a few tomes written by someone named \"Anson MacDonald\".", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A sign on the door says, \"Unauthorized Personel Prohibited\".", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 3161, "to_room_vnum": 3161, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf4e325484e1ec8fb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd236df73e7aeed28"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south is the Poor Alley.  Across the alley, you see the Grubby Inn.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3024, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf4e325484e1ec8fb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb94ae60847e3e6ea9"}

name: The Temple of Ofcol
description:
You are in the Temple of Ofcol.  Golden tiles cover the floor, and solid
gold columns reach the twelve foot ceiling of this vast chamber.  Servants in
golden livery wander this place, making even the raggiest messenger boy look
richer than you are.  Exits lead to the anterooms in the cardinal directions.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: The dark hole
description:
You are standing at a hole, a small passage leads south. You see
some inscriptions on the wall, most of 'em the usual stuff, like:
'Super Snude was here' and 'Why does the mayor likes secretaries with
small hands?' - But one inscription gets your attention, it says:
The Balrog is ALIVE ...

name: The Tomb of Ramses
description: You stand in an empty tomb, a cubicle no more then ten feet to a side.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "That leads back the way you came.", "keyword": "tomb", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8731, "room_id": "69f4d0cb53ac7c07fd9cd23d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb90d88216b22daac2"}

name: Tank's Room
description:
Now here's a room that is easy to understand. A bed, a dresser, and a
rack for weapons and armor are all that occupy it. Some posters adorn
the walls, to add color, proclaiming things such as Live fast, Die Young,
and a homemade one in the corner with a picture of Ice and under it the
inscription, "I LOVE the resurrection spell". The only thing out of
place in this happy-go-lucky room is mounted head of Crimson Death.

name: The End of Mud School!
description:
This is a very bright room, with a marble pedestal in the center.  Behind
the pedestal stands a person cloaked in Silver.  Tapestries flow from every
wall, and you feel very happy to be here right now.  There is a big sign here.
The only exit is on the other side of the gate north of you.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "You have graduated from Mud School!  Take your diploma...if you can.
Go 'NORTH' from here to visit our arena.  There are plenty of low-level
monsters, but DON'T attack other players.

If you want to go directly back to the temple at any time, type 'RECALL'.

Don't forget to type save to protect your character.  You won't be saved after
quitting until you reach level 2, so also type save before you type quit.

If you need more help during the game, type 'HELP'.  If you see something
wrong or have comments, use 'BUG', 'IDEA', or 'TYPO' to report them.

May your visit here be ... mercenary.", "valid": true}

name: Melancholy's Room
description:
A faint smell of incense teases your nose as you enter this room.  You
step onto a soft bearskin rug and look around.  A simple bed lies against
the far wall.  At the foot of it is a sturdy, ironbound chest, most likely
full of Melancholy's trappings from her adventuring days.  On a small table
under a window to the east is a vase with a single white rose.  Other than
that, the room is quite bare.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "chest", "description": "This chest is firmly locked, and the device by which it opens is beyond your\nreckoning.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A small door to the south leads out into the map shop.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 3161, "to_room_vnum": 3160, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd236df73e7aeed28", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf4e325484e1ec8fb"}

name: The Anteroom to the Temple of Ofcol
description:
You are in an anteroom to the Temple of Ofcol.  Gold tiles cover the
floor, and servants in golden livery pass you by peaceably.  The temple is to
the south, and to the north is a hallway.  A stairways leads up.

name: The muddy sewer
description:
You are standing in mud to your knees. This is not the kind of place
for a picnic. The muddy sewer stretches further into the south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the muddy sewer continuing into the darkness to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7002, "room_id": "69f4d0cb26c65c5f9593c815", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6887a4dda93daf8d"}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A silver door can be seen to the north.

name: The small passage
description:
You are in a small passage, to the north you see a hole, and to
the south you see a large tunnel. The air is damp in this area.

name: A Ransacked Tomb
description:
This tomb has been completely ransacked and destroyed by the actions
of pyramid thieves and looters.  The floor is littered with junk.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east is a low-ceilinged tunnel.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8734, "room_id": "69f4d0cb97c36fb3b13d61b3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5770c16cd43dc756"}

name: Inside the Castle of Clan MacCleod
description:
You have entered the grand hall of the castle. A huge throne dominates a
raised area in the northern part of then room. In front of this stands a
drafting table.

name: Temple Of Stupid
description:
As you enter the abandoned warehouse your eyes blink violently to
adjust to the almost total darkness.  You wonder where the windows are
as you step into a mud puddle in the middle of the floor.  As your eyes
adjust, you realize that there are mud puddles all around the room, and
this is some weird version of windows.  In a flash of revelation, you
realize that you've entered the Temple of Stupid.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "puddle puddles", "description": "The puddles on the floor are filthy and exude a foul stench.", "valid": true}

name: South Wall of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: The Anteroom to the Temple of Ofcol
description:
You are in an anteroom to the Temple of Ofcol.  Gold tiles cover the
floor, and servants in golden livery pass you by peaceably.  The temple is to
the east, and to the west is a hallway.  A stairways leads up.

name: The muddy sewer junction
description:
The muddy sewer stretches into the dark to the south. It looks as if
no person has ever sat his foot here before. It's too muddy for that
anyway. The sewer leads north, south and east from here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The muddy sewer stretches into the dark to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7001, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6887a4dda93daf8d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb26c65c5f9593c815"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "East. The muddy sewer leads into a bend that goes south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7007, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6887a4dda93daf8d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfd48790b6e82bb89"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "South. The muddy sewer ends in a mudhole that way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7003, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6887a4dda93daf8d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc34ba1ce709f9c60"}

name: The tunnel
description: You suddenly feel that the tunnel leads down.

name: A bend in the hallway
description:
You are at a bend in the long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical
glow which provides enough light to see by.
The hallway continues east and south.

name: A Tunnel
description: The low-ceilinged tunnel runs east-west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You cannot see into the darkness of the low tunnel.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8735, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5770c16cd43dc756", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3472050646c82e66"}

name: Underground
description: The small passage continues west and east.

name: Under the Bridge
description:
The arch under the bridge is covered by seaweed for one foot above the
surface of the river.  The water gently flows through an opening in the lower
part of the city wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "wall", "description": "It is built from large grey rocks that have been fastened to each other with\nsome kind of mortar.  Looks pretty solid.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the river flowing west into the Forest of Haon-Dor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9772, "room_id": "69f4d0cba4cce3913cb40605", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb500051c8f87e7b00"}

name: South Wall of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: The mudhole
description:
You stand in mud all the way up to your thighs and it's not too
comfortable since you are used to a somewhat different environment.
The sewer leads to the north of here. In the middle you can just make
out an enormous drainpipe leading down.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "North. The muddy junction lies in that direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7002, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc34ba1ce709f9c60", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6887a4dda93daf8d"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The muddy drainpipe leads down through the mud, otherwise it is utterly dark.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7101, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc34ba1ce709f9c60", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc57663c8194d3af4"}

name: The Anteroom to the Temple of Ofcol
description:
You are in an anteroom to the Temple of Ofcol.  Gold tiles cover the
floor, and servants in golden livery pass you by peaceably.  The temple is to
the west, and to the east is a hallway.  A stairways leads up.

name: The large tunnel
description:
You are in a large tunnel leading from the south to the east. The
air is damp in the area.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: A Fork in the Tunnel
description:
Here the tunnel forks off through a gaping hole down in the
southern wall, continuing onward to the east and west as well.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "s south hole", "description": "The hole is low, at the floor of the southern wall.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You cannot see into the darkness of the low tunnel.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8736, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3472050646c82e66", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb326364dee5621245"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You cannot see into the darkness of the low tunnel.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8734, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3472050646c82e66", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5770c16cd43dc756"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "Through the hole you see rubble and sand.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8746, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3472050646c82e66", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2d4d1d57a8ab0ad2"}

name: Underground
description: The small passage continues west and east.

name: On the River
description:
North of here you see the miserable buildings of the poor alley.  The
river flows west towards the bridge.  The riverbanks are too steep to climb.

name: South West Corner of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: The Dark Pit
description:
You are standing by the edge of a dark pit that leads down into even
deeper darkness. >BWWAAADDRR< - The smell from down there is unbearable.
The sewer stretches into the darkness to the east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "East. The sewer leads into the sewer junction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7009, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdec58e9b70c60239", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3fed5cf9de196abb"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The Dark Pit leads down and down and down ... well you can't see the\nbottom anyway. There are bars that function as a ladder on the side.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7102, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdec58e9b70c60239", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6bd2efa0207fe790"}

name: The Anteroom to the Temple of Ofcol
description:
You are in an anteroom to the Temple of Ofcol.  Gold tiles cover the
floor, and servants in golden livery pass you by peaceably.  The temple is to
the north, and to the south is a hallway.  A stairways leads up.

name: The large tunnel
description:
You are in a large east-west leading tunnel, the air is damp and
the floor is wet.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A rusty old door can be seen to the west.

name: A Tunnel
description:
The low-ceilinged tunnel makes a turn to the west and ends
to the north as it spills out into a dusty hallway.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The mouth of the tunnel is stone that has been torn away by looters.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8742, "room_id": "69f4d0cb326364dee5621245", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdfe55df80564412b"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You cannot see into the darkness of the low tunnel.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8735, "room_id": "69f4d0cb326364dee5621245", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3472050646c82e66"}

name: Underground
description: The small passage continues west and east.

name: On the River
description:
North of here you see the dump.  The river flows from east to west.  The
riverbanks are too steep to climb.  A bridge passes overhead, connecting the
dump to the promenade.

name: South Wall of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: The muddy sewer
description:
You are standing in the middle of a bend of the sewer pipe. It is very
dark around here and the mud is sticking to your legs, not very pleasant.
The pipe leads east and south from here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "East. The mud stretches on into the darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7011, "room_id": "69f4d0cb185cb8978a5bafc5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb61954ad6d3bb6707"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "South. There is even more mud in that direction than where you are now.\nIncredible.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7006, "room_id": "69f4d0cb185cb8978a5bafc5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb29b74f400c388148"}

name: A Hallway of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in a hallway of the Golden Citadel.  Gold tiles cover the floors,
and rich golden tapestries drape the walls.  Servants in golden livery pass you
by peaceably.  Exits lead east and south.

name: The golem master's workshop
description:
You are in the golem master's workshop. A few unfinished looking humanoid
forms of different make are here, some moving, some not. The animated forms
lunge to attack you.

name: The large tunnel
description:
You are in a large tunnel, the tunnel leads west, and to the east
you notice a long tunnel. The air is damp in this area.

name: Cleric's Sanctum
description:
You walk down the staircase into the silent inner sanctum. Here sits
your guildmaster ready to assist you when the time is right. The room
is completely silent. The only obvious exit is back up the staircase
into the the Nectar.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You notice the floor at the base of the eastern wall has some faint\nscratches in it.", "keyword": "secret door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9579, "room_id": "69f4d0cb64c8aa70c64e5bf1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb00cb0ceb43729528"}

name: A Dank Chamber
description:
This chamber has a dank, dusty, musty smell to it.  Small footprints
in the dust betray the recent passage of some sort of creatures.  A hole
in the floor lies to the west and a stairway is to the east.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see only blackness through the hole in the floor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8712, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6c7f221ca0e96e55", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb92fe6da02f44f46"}

name: On the River
description:
The levee is directly north of here, and a small boat landing for Kate's
Diner is to the south.  The river flows in an east west direction.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the landing in the back of Kate's Diner.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3150, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0f67cb31afa629d9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb44aedd9e65c926f4"}

name: South East Corner of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: The muddy sewer
description:
You are standing in something that reminds you very much of porridge, this
has the advantage that it's not hot, it's rather cold actually. The pipe
bends to the north and east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The muddy sewer pipe leads into a bend that goes east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7005, "room_id": "69f4d0cb29b74f400c388148", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb185cb8978a5bafc5"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The pipe leads into a bend that goes south. Interesting, there's mud on the\nfloor there.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7012, "room_id": "69f4d0cb29b74f400c388148", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba0775c118edc385e"}

name: A Hallway of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in a hallway of the Golden Citadel.  Gold tiles cover the floors,
and rich golden tapestries drape the walls.  Servants in golden livery pass you
by peaceably.  Exits lead east, west, and south.

name: A store room
description:
You are in a small store room. Large chunks of clay, stone, wood and many
other raw materials are here.

name: The long tunnel
description: You are standing in a long north-south tunnel.

name: A dimly lit path
description:
You tread through the deep, dark forest on a dimly lit path.  Up ahead you
can hear the faint sounds of a village.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The dimly lit path leads north through the dense forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1101, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6980987736a562ec", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba1e9fe6ba037f468"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The dimly lit path leads south through the light forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 6000, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6980987736a562ec", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8ee3d7875764ab6c"}

name: Chamber of the High Priest
description:
You have entered the chamber of the most holy man in New Thalos. The
High Priest advises the Sultan on all matters in the world of the sacred.
From what you have heard however, this holy man has a bit of a temper,
and he doesn't look very happy that you've disturbed his prayers.
The only obvious exit is south.

name: A Spiral Stairway
description:
Some dusty, broken stone stairs here spiral slowly in a constricted
space down towards a dusty hallway.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "The stairs spiral up into a dank chamber.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8737, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdef0f222b0fd1789", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6c7f221ca0e96e55"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The stairs spiral down into a dusty hallway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8741, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdef0f222b0fd1789", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb906d0baf4310cebd"}

name: On the River
description:
You see the warehouse on the northern riverbank.  East of here the river
passes under the eastern bridge and through the city wall. The banks of the
levee are west, in the direction of the current.

name: West Wall of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: The muddy sewer bend
description:
This isn't your idea of a place to stay too long. You're in up to your
knees in something that resembles mud, but you're not quite sure. The
bend in which you stand leads west and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The pipe leads into a intersection that goes south and east. The floor here\nis still covered in mud.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7008, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfd48790b6e82bb89", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe30354fe6933229e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The pipe (still filled with mud) leads into a intersection that goes north\nand south. Interesting.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7002, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfd48790b6e82bb89", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6887a4dda93daf8d"}

name: A Hallway of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in a hallway of the Golden Citadel.  Gold tiles cover the floors,
and rich golden tapestries drape the walls.  Servants in golden livery pass you
by peaceably.  Exits lead west and south.

name: The golem chamber
description:
You are in the golem chamber. Golems made of every imaginable material
are here, ranging in size from a hand-span to nearly the ceiling. They all
seem to be sleeping.

name: The wet tunnel
description:
You are in a wet, north-south leading tunnel, the floor is
partly covered by water.

name: A dimly lit path
description:
You tread through the deep, dark forest on a dimly lit path.  Up ahead you
can hear the faint sounds of a village.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The dimly lit path leads north through the dense forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1102, "room_id": "69f4d0cba1e9fe6ba037f468", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0c9fb8f2c1d17a9f"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The dimly lit path leads south through the dense forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1100, "room_id": "69f4d0cba1e9fe6ba037f468", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6980987736a562ec"}

name: By the Altar
description:
You are by the temple altar in the northern end of Temple of New
Thalos. A huge altar made of highly polished black onyx is standing
in front of you. Behind this altar sits a twelve foot tall statue of
Loki, the highest god in all the lands.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "statue", "description": "Looking up the huge statue you see Loki calmly gazing out across his\nlands.  He seems pleased.", "valid": true}

name: A Dust-Covered Hallway
description:
This hallway is covered with dust that has accumulated over the
centuries that the pyramid has stood.  Small markings and footprints
in the dust betray the recent passage of others -- perhaps thieves?
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The hallway proceeds to the east towards a strange smell.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8740, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcdfa0ac9dcc8903b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4029e558f4bc1c96"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The hallway proceeds towards the west towards a musty smell.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8709, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcdfa0ac9dcc8903b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb36312bb129ba7346"}

name: On the River
description:
The river enters from a hole in the eastern city wall.  The hole has been
blocked by several vertically positioned iron bars set into the wall. Overhead
you can see the stone buttresses of the eastern bridge.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The iron bars are broken, allowing passage through the hole in the wall.\nBeyond the bars you see a dark tunnel.\nbars", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5001, "room_id": "69f4d0cb08ee8a1e393ba5d0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc1ea97f0dd118004"}

name: Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: A muddy intersection
description:
You have both your feet safely stuck in mud. It isn't the mud that's wrong
it's the smell, the sounds, the total darkness that surrounds you. Everything
here is so depressing. The pipe leads on with a trail of thick mud to the
north, east and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "North. The pipe goes into a bend with a load of mud all the way up the walls.\nThe bend leads west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7007, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe30354fe6933229e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfd48790b6e82bb89"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "East. This way like a place for the annual mud festival, although the stench\nwouldn't allow any happiness at all. The pipe leads into a bend that leads\nnorth.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7014, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe30354fe6933229e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb636e3b699e1d543"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "South. There's less mud in that direction. *smile*. Your light doesn't\ncover enough space for you to see much more than that it leads into some\nsort of junction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7009, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe30354fe6933229e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3fed5cf9de196abb"}

name: A Hallway of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in a hallway of the Golden Citadel.  Gold tiles cover the floors,
and rich golden tapestries drape the walls.  Servants in golden livery pass you
by peaceably.  Exits lead north and south.

name: It is very dark here...
description: It is very dark here...

name: The small maze
description:
You are in a small maze, exits leads off to the east,  south
and west. The floor is partly covered by water.

name: A dimly lit path
description:
You tread through the deep, dark forest on a dimly lit path.  The forest
here seems less dense than to the south.  Northward you see the faint outline
of a village.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The dimly lit path leads to a village.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1103, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0c9fb8f2c1d17a9f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2b933c713491c251"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The dimly lit path leads south through the dense forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1101, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0c9fb8f2c1d17a9f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba1e9fe6ba037f468"}

name: The Weaver's Guild
description:
Rows and rows of uncut cloth lie about waiting to be hemmed up into
tailored clothes. Cotton is brought in from the countryside and
spun up into cloth and dyed different colors. A young boy walks
in, grabs a pile of clothing and leaves.

name: A Smelly Chamber
description:
This small chamber has a sickly putrescent smell to it, the
smell of formaldehyde and other ointments used to preserve the
corpses of those who died ages ago.

name: Wall Road
description:
Wall road extends north and south along the eastern walls of the city.
The east gate is north of you, south is an intersection with a dark alley. You
check to make sure you still have your wallet.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The eastern gate of the city is north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3041, "room_id": "69f4d0cba0922b40c0853786", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb008c96301e4d9696"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see an intersection with a dark alley.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3251, "room_id": "69f4d0cba0922b40c0853786", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6cf75e18d4545b99"}

name: Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: The Sewer Junction
description:
You stand in the middle of a huge junction of sewer pipes right under
what you'd think was an air shaft. The sewer pipes lead to the north,
south, east and west. It look quite impossible to force your way up.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "North. Mud is the floor basis in that direction. Yummy.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7008, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3fed5cf9de196abb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe30354fe6933229e"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "YYEEUUCH! BOOH! THAT looks like a nice place for creepy crawlies.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7017, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3fed5cf9de196abb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb991c03e53ad3d011"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "North. This direction looks quite nice actually. The pipe leads into\na bend that goes east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7010, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3fed5cf9de196abb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5de094df68971d9b"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A few yards ahead - away from this junction - there is a pit leading down,\nbut the smell from there...>PHEWW<.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7004, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3fed5cf9de196abb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdec58e9b70c60239"}

name: A Hallway of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in a hallway of the Golden Citadel.  Gold tiles cover the floors,
and rich golden tapestries drape the walls.  Servants in golden livery pass you
by peaceably.  Exits lead north and south.

name: The small maze
description:
You are in a small maze, exits leads off only to the south
and west. The air is damp in this maze.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: Entrance to the Shire
description:
You stand at the entrance to the Shire.  You see halflings, no more than
wee tall, every which way you look. Bywater Road leads east and west.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you see a dimly lit path which leads to a dense forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1102, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2b933c713491c251", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0c9fb8f2c1d17a9f"}

name: The Craftsman's Guild
description:
You have entered a busy workshop filled with people running amok
with various tools and materials.  The air is tense with the rush to
complete various projects and creations.

name: A Dust-Covered Hallway
description:
This hallway is covered with a thick, choking dust that rises
up to obscure your light source and sting your eyes.  Small marks
and footprints in the dust betray the recent passage of others.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "A tightly spiralling stone stairway leads up.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8738, "room_id": "69f4d0cb906d0baf4310cebd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdef0f222b0fd1789"}

name: Wall Road
description:
You are walking along the eastern wall of the city, on a road extending
between the east gate and a bridge to the south.  A dark, dirty alley lies west
of here.  You step carefully around a pool of liquid...who knows what it could
be in a place this foul...
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Wall road continues to the north, heading towards the gate.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3250, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6cf75e18d4545b99", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba0922b40c0853786"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Wall road continues to the south, towards a bridge over the Midgaard river.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3252, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6cf75e18d4545b99", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8c6e85c4e26f79ba"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A dirty, unlight alley lies to the west...it looks like a perfect spot for a\nmugging.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3046, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6cf75e18d4545b99", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5aa7dbbd6801f6ab"}

name: Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: A bend in sewer pipe
description:
You are in a bend in the sewer pipe. A strong smell seeps in from the north.
The sewer goes north and east.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "North. You are staring into a huge junction with exits in all directions.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7009, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5de094df68971d9b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3fed5cf9de196abb"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "East. The Pipe leads into utter darkness that way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7018, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5de094df68971d9b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe7a37664093a0b0f"}

name: In the tunnel at the inscription
description:
You are in a north-south leading tunnel, the air is damp. On
the wall there is an inscription.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "inscription", "description": "It says:

Year 631 after the destruction of the dwarven realm.

We found the sword of the dwarven king, but it was guarded
by a large green dragon. All but two died immediately as the
dragon breathed poison gas; we are also going to die soon.

Trather and Oralane", "valid": true}

name: A bend in the hallway
description:
You are at a bend in the long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical
glow which provides enough light to see by.
The hallway continues north and east from here.

name: Bywater Road
description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the east and west while to the north lies the general store.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The general store lies to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1105, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf8c73353e39f1a85", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc5d6b02aead6052d"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west you see the entrance to the Shire.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1103, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf8c73353e39f1a85", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2b933c713491c251"}

name: A Hallway of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in a hallway of the Golden Citadel.  Gold tiles cover the floors,
and rich golden tapestries drape the walls.  Servants in golden livery pass you
by peaceably.  Exits lead to the cardinal directions, with the east leading
toward the Temple of Ofcol, and west leading toward the City of Ofcol.

name: Inside the Temple
description:
The temple continues here, but not on such a grand scale. The place
still looks immaculate. To the north you see the chamber of the High
Priest and a sign on the door in BIG letters thats says DO NOT DISTURB.
To the south is the entrance to the Cleric's Guild.

name: A Turn in the Hallway
description:
You are standing in an elbow turn in a dust-covered stone hallway,
that dead ends to the north and continues on to the west.  To the south
the stones of the pyramid have been torn asunder by thieves, making
a low-ceilinged tunnel.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The dust-covered hallway continues to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8741, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdfe55df80564412b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb906d0baf4310cebd"}

name: Wall Road
description:
The walls of Midgaard tower above you to the east, keeping the city safe
from its enemies...you hope.  An intersection with a dark alley lies north,
and a bridge over the Midgaard river is south.  Beyond the bridge wall road
turns in the concourse.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see an intersection with a dark alley.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3251, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8c6e85c4e26f79ba", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6cf75e18d4545b99"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The eastern bridge crosses the river to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3253, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8c6e85c4e26f79ba", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9a50abe8761f1055"}

name: Dimly Lit Path
description:
This path is made of crushed granite with curious blue streaks in it.
The path continues north to a village, or south to the eastern road.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The path heads back toward the eastern road.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3525, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd2d43ac251809cd5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb78230f7039845fd6"}

name: East Wall of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: The wet tunnel
description:
You are in a north-south leading tunnel.  The floor is fully
covered by water.

name: The muddy sewer pipe
description:
You have entered a kind of tube intersection that leads south, west and east.
Your legs are covered in mud up to the knees. REAL yucky!
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "East. There's less mud in that direction, or that's your impression.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7024, "room_id": "69f4d0cb61954ad6d3bb6707", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc9275b39a6911d81"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "That way is lost in darkness, though you sense less mud in that direction,\nperhaps even a complete end to this sludge that surrounds you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7021, "room_id": "69f4d0cb61954ad6d3bb6707", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3daa51966c88d9ff"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "West. The mud reaches that way too, all the way up the walls.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7005, "room_id": "69f4d0cb61954ad6d3bb6707", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb185cb8978a5bafc5"}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: A Hallway of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in a hallway of the Golden Citadel.  Gold tiles cover the floors,
and rich golden tapestries drape the walls.  Servants in golden livery pass you
by peaceably.  Exits lead west, north and south.

name: The General Store
description:
You are inside the general store.  All sorts of goodies are stacked on the
many shelves.  Your local friendly shopkeeper is smiling patiently, waiting to
serve you to the best of his abilities.  The only exit is to the south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The only exit lies to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1104, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc5d6b02aead6052d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf8c73353e39f1a85"}

name: Inside the Temple
description:
Huge marble pillars rise on either side of you and grab hold of the ceiling.
Between each of these, fine softstone frescoes have been carved depicting
scenes from the religous history of New Thalos. Rows of pews face forward
giving their full attention to the pulpit rising high  above the ground. The
deep red carpeting underfoot shows not a speck of wear or dirt. It's obvious
that New Thalonians take religion seriously.

name: A Dead End
description:
The dust-covered hallway has come to an abrupt end at a stony,
featureless wall.  Here and there are signs of the recent passage
of others in the dust.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "cracks", "description": "The cracks look like you might be able to pull away some pieces of\nthe floor, perhaps even fit your body through the space you make.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The dusty hall continues to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8742, "room_id": "69f4d0cba15362bc562f793d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdfe55df80564412b"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The floor is quite dusty, and made of stone.  You see some cracks.", "keyword": "floor", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8744, "room_id": "69f4d0cba15362bc562f793d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3943db700ceadf79"}

name: On the Bridge
description:
You are crossing a strong stone bridge, which spans the Midgaard river.
Below you, the river flows into an opening in the city wall, sealed with
strong metal bars.  North of you is wall road, south of here the concourse
loops around the inside of the city walls.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "opening bars river", "description": "Hmm...some of the bars have been ripped out of the wall.  Enough to pass a\ngood sized raft or canoe, or perhaps even a barge.  You wonder what sort of\nbeast had the strength to do this.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The concourse stretches around the southern parts of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3104, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9a50abe8761f1055", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf90113adf5d9579c"}

name: West Wall of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: Dimly Lit Path
description:
This section of the road is badly worn and frequently traversed.  There is
faint singing to the north.  The path back to the road lies to the south.

name: The small maze
description:
You are in a small maze. The floor is mainly covered by
water, exits leads north, east and south.

name: The bend in the Muddy sewer
description:
This is not your idea of a holiday. You stand in mud up to your knees.
It's absolutely inconceivable how all this mud could have been placed
here. The pipe leads to the west and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "South. There's even more mud that way, incredible! Although it looks\nlike an intersection in the sewer system that leads east and south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7013, "room_id": "69f4d0cba0775c118edc385e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcb5cb2ec6e8ce3fb"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "West. All you can see, is that the pipe leads into a bend that goes\nnorth. But there's less mud in that direction, however odd that sounds.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7006, "room_id": "69f4d0cba0775c118edc385e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb29b74f400c388148"}

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
An emerald door can be seen to the south.

name: A Hallway of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in a hallway of the Golden Citadel.  Gold tiles cover the floors,
and rich golden tapestries drape the walls.  Servants in golden livery pass you
by peaceably.  Exits lead north and south.

name: Bywater Road
description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the east and west.  To the north, steps lead to a friendly looking
weaponry/armory while a nursery lies to the south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Steps lead to a friendly looking weaponry and armory.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1107, "room_id": "69f4d0cb77c900a42c185417", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4e5bc0e5cf40a460"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south lies Kid'n Keep, the local nursery.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1108, "room_id": "69f4d0cb77c900a42c185417", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4522c9bb4221e226"}

name: Donation Room
description:
This room is new to the temple.  It was created during the hard times
that have struck the city in recent decades.  Luckily for them the sultan
had been hoarding some of the basic necessities for just such an occasion.
These days the donation room depends on the generosity of wealthy
adventureres, and a curse on any that walk in to get all.

name: The Grand Gate of Thalos
description:
You stand in the archway of a gigantic stone archway. The two
steel gates have been forced open and have rusted in place. A hollow
gust of wind blows by you into the deserted, and seemingly destroyed,
city.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a trail out of this blasted place.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5256, "room_id": "69f4d0cbaa13edeeef6ec7db", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb07c226d19d7fe91b"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see devastation everywhere. Houses lie in ruin and skeletons litter\nthe streets. You see strange beasts stalking the shadows.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5201, "room_id": "69f4d0cbaa13edeeef6ec7db", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba11eb4f49ad6882e"}

name: The Tomb Entrance
description:
You are in a small, dark chamber that has stood undisturbed for
many years.  To the north stands a massive stone tomb, which is
covered in hieroglyphics and gold-lined carvings that mark it as the
final resting place of the mighty pharoahs of this land.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "tomb", "description": "The tomb looks like it has stood for many years, much like the pyramid\nwhich encloses it.  It is covered in small hieroglyphics.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the tomb of the pharoahs.", "keyword": "tomb", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8745, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3943db700ceadf79", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb785a2ac5d22559bb"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "The stone ceiling has some cracks in it, through which a dim light streams.", "keyword": "ceiling", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8743, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3943db700ceadf79", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba15362bc562f793d"}

name: The South Bridge
description:
You are standing on a small, rickety bridge leading from the Midgaard
City Dump to the much more attractive promenade of the southern parts of
Midgaard.  You can smell the stench of the dump to the north, the fresher
air of the promenade seems preferable.  Below you are the swift-moving
currents of the Midgaard river.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can see the clutter of the City Dump.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3030, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfe2d6e259f626524", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb6137fe4ea8d7d9a"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The beautiful promenade lies along the river.  What a romantic place to visit!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3102, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfe2d6e259f626524", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0230fde58686d3d7"}

name: Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: Dimly Lit Path
description:
This section of the road is badly worn and frequently traversed.  Singing is
getting stronger to the north.  The path back to the road lies to the south.

name: The small maze
description:
You are in a small maze, where the air is damp. Exits
leads to the north and east.

name: A MUDDY intersection
description:
You wouldn't want to know the true feeling of standing in this mud up to
your hips. >BWAADR<. All that fills your mind right now is the dream of
a hot bath. This is NOT very clean mud you know, remember you're in the
sewer! The pipes leads north, south and east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "North. Sludge and sediment fills this corridor of the sewer that leads\ninto a bend going west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7012, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcb5cb2ec6e8ce3fb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba0775c118edc385e"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "East. You can see absolutely nothing of interest in that direction (Maybe\nthat's why it's so damn interesting.??) There's no mud in that direction\neither, GREAT!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7026, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcb5cb2ec6e8ce3fb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbeec659edfd2269ef"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "South. All you can see is more mud! Although the pipe goes into a bend\nleading west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7014, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcb5cb2ec6e8ce3fb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb636e3b699e1d543"}

name: The master of illusion's chamber
description:
You are in the chamber of the master of illusions. The walls here are
ever-changing in color and texture, as if they were reforming before your
very eyes. Many splendorous treasures lie all around in heaps and piles, or
at least they seem to be treasures...

name: A Hallway of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in a hallway of the Golden Citadel.  Gold tiles cover the floors,
and rich golden tapestries drape the walls.  Servants in golden livery pass you
by peaceably.  Exits lead north and south.

name: The Museum of the Greater Gods
description:
Four large stone statues reside in the museum. They were constructed by
the people of New Thalos to pay homage to the saints they believe to
have saved all their lives.

name: The House of Arms
description:
You are inside the finest weapons and armour shop in all of Shiredom.  The
shopkeeper proudly displays his fine wares and humbly offers the best daggers
that you have ever laid eyes on.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The only exit lies to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1106, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4e5bc0e5cf40a460", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb77c900a42c185417"}

name: Main Street
description:
This was once a magnificent street, but now is in total ruin. The
streets are barren and windswept and the silence is unending.  A dark alley
leads north and south.  Howls and screams echo through the deserted city.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The entrance to the city lies this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5200, "room_id": "69f4d0cba11eb4f49ad6882e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbaa13edeeef6ec7db"}

name: The Tomb of the Pharoahs
description:
Great golden sarcophogai line the walls of this massive tomb.  It has
withstood the passage of time intact, untouched by the hands of thieves
and looters.  The treasures taken by the pharoahs to their graves still
lie before your feet.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "treasures", "description": "The treasures are dusty and fragile, but still seem quite valuable.\nYou decide not to take them out of respect for the ancient dead.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "That way leads back out of the tomb.", "keyword": "tomb", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8744, "room_id": "69f4d0cb785a2ac5d22559bb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3943db700ceadf79"}

name: Inside the South Gate of Midgaard
description:
Two strong stone towers surround a heavy wooden gate set into the city wall,
to guard against the goblins that lurk in the southern forests.  You can exit
the city to the south, if you dare, or walk down the concourse to the east
or west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The concourse heads east along the inside of the city wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3129, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfdf4947389d8673f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3b76a562b4efdcda"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The concourse heads west along the inside of the city wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3128, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfdf4947389d8673f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4f7dfc688c068277"}

name: Entrance to Smurf Village
description:
You stand at the entrance to a tiny village.  You can see across the whole
village easily.  Little blue creatures with white hats and boots and little
fluffy tails scamper about.  They sing continuously.  The singing is getting
on your nerves and you have the urge to squash them.

name: Center of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.  There is a BIG SIGN here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "Those with high bravery or low senses of cautiousness might wish to go below\nto the Dungeon.  However, know that there are aggressive monsters down there,\nand there is no quick escape back out of here when you are in the dungeon.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see a dark murky dungeon below.", "keyword": "grate", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3748, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfdb790023e14b6ed", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb6b170580c563ac4"}

name: The entrance to the small maze
description:
You are in a north-south leading tunnel, and the air is damp.
To the west you see a small maze.

name: Muddy sewer
description:
You stand in a bend of the pipe system of the sewer with mud up to your
thighs. Contemplating a higher level of existence here would be utterly
inappropriate, as the smell would keep any intelligent creature from even
thinking of anything but getting away from this foul end of the WORLD.
The bend goes from north to west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "North. Filled with mud, that place looks like an impassable intersection\nwith pipes leading north and east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7013, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb636e3b699e1d543", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcb5cb2ec6e8ce3fb"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "West. There's less mud that way, maybe you're on your way out of this foul\nplace.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7008, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb636e3b699e1d543", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe30354fe6933229e"}

name: A bedroom
description:
You are in the bedroom of the master of illusions. Strange looking items
and artifacts float here and there in the air. The ripples of strong magic
can be felt everywhere.
The room seems much larger than it looks...

name: A Hallway of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in a hallway of the Golden Citadel.  Gold tiles cover the floors,
and rich golden tapestries drape the walls.  Servants in golden livery pass you
by peaceably.  Exits lead north and east.

name: Kid'n Keep
description:
You are inside Kid'n Keep, the convenient one-stop nursery that maintains
the youth of the Shire.  Toddlers run every which way while their nursemaids
sigh in exasperation.  The only exit lies to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The only exit lies to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1106, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4522c9bb4221e226", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb77c900a42c185417"}

name: Entrance to the Guild of Clerics
description:
This hall pales in comparison to that of the main hall, but is beautiful
in its own right. Shaven heads and brown robes can be seen milling about
quitely talking to each other. North is back inside the temple proper,
and south is the entrance to the cleric's bar.

name: Main Street
description:
This was once a magnificent street, but now is in total ruin. The
streets are barren and windswept and the silence is unending. On one
side is a collapsed house while on the other is the entrance to a large
ruined mansion. Eerie sounds echo within the mansion. Near the center of
town you see a large domed building, relatively intact.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The remnants of a store lie this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5236, "room_id": "69f4d0cb801c888fa7fe755f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd119d2f23a12626e"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "It looks like what used to be the main building in the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5232, "room_id": "69f4d0cb801c888fa7fe755f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf34b4120c62228f7"}
