{"direction": 3, "description": "A withered garden path lies this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5203, "room_id": "69f4d0cb801c888fa7fe755f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb31f3fa6b2a3f6d03"}

name: A Rubble-Strewn Hallway
description:
This hallway formerly had a beautiful arch to the ceiling, now
collapsed under the weight of the slowly settling stones of the
pyramid.  Now, a massive pile of rubble leads up into a hole high
in the northern portion of the hallway.  To the south, through the
rubble and fallen stones you see a sandstone crypt.

name: Outside the South Gate of Midgaard
description:
You are standing outside the strong wooden gate on the southern walls of
Midgaard.  Guards eye you suspiciously from the two towers on either side of
the gate, as they stand watch to protect the city from the goblins of this
forest.  The trees and goblins of the Miden'nir are south, the gate back to
Migaard lies north.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The green forests of the Miden'nir are south, hiding countless goblin warriors.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3505, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4b730fc746bbe7d6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb09c66241aac00b33"}

name: The old well
description:
You are standing by an old and worn well from before this century. The sewer
leads to the east from here and the well leads down into darkness. Metal
bars implanted in the side of the well lead down as a ladder.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bars", "description": "These look like they're pretty slippery, and not very safe, but perhaps safe\nenough for you to climb down, WITH both hands on them.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "East. You see, because of the utter darkness that surround you, absolutely\nnothing. Your light isn't of much use for that kind of distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7028, "room_id": "69f4d0cb33d6196b2a8621a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe6e8d9d7f93af092"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "Down the well there's even less light than up here, so ... sorry, you can't\nsee a thing. There are metal bars in the side leading down into the darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7105, "room_id": "69f4d0cb33d6196b2a8621a5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd2590f766965847e"}

name: In the water
description:
You are standing in water, the tunnel continues both to the
north and south.

name: Smurfy Road
description:
You are way too big to be using this road.  But who cares.  Who's gonna stop
you?  These little blue smurfs?  The singing is growing intense.  Your ears
are starting to ring.  Smurfy Road continues to the north, west, and east.
There is still time to turn back and go south.

name: Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A glass door can be seen to the south.

name: A Hallway of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in a hallway of the Golden Citadel.  Gold tiles cover the floors,
and rich golden tapestries drape the walls.  Servants in golden livery pass you
by peaceably.  Exits lead east, west, and north.

name: A bend in the road
description:
Bywater Road continues west and south.  A large, imposing building lies
to the east.  Farther to the south, you can see an Inn of some sort.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A large, imposing building lies to the east.  A sign reads 'Shiriff Post'.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1110, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0928a1538e4c86a4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdb417a143cea17be"}

name: The Temple Gates
description:
You stand before the entrance way to the Temple of New Thalos. Two large
wrought iron gates lie open before you. Although they might not ever be
used, the priests in the temple are ready to defend themselves, should
their city ever come under siege again.

name: A Garden Path
description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of
the city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare.
Vines and ivy snake up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves
around your feet. A sudden volley of howls pierces the air.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The garden path continues around the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5204, "room_id": "69f4d0cb31f3fa6b2a3f6d03", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd22db436798e1582"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "This is the main street leading to the city's entrance", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5202, "room_id": "69f4d0cb31f3fa6b2a3f6d03", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb801c888fa7fe755f"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The garden path continues around the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5206, "room_id": "69f4d0cb31f3fa6b2a3f6d03", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb252c7cc0f6df77b9"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Inside the temple, small patches of light shoot through each doorway as\nwell as a few holes in the ceiling.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5250, "room_id": "69f4d0cb31f3fa6b2a3f6d03", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb653b5ea7ff596215"}

name: Stone Archway
description:
This is a ancient stone archway. Various faces of demons and other grim
pictures are painted onto it. Stone gargoyles and demons glare down at
you from atop the arch.
There is a bronze plaque above the archway.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "plaque", "description": "***************
Descent to Hell
***************

You just GO TO HELL!!!!
*chuckle*

Made for levels 30-50

Brought to you by Strahd", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The air seems cleaner to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3472, "room_id": "69f4d0cb99182f0b7f36c8b0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb056e61fcb6dac21b"}

name: A Sandstone Crypt
description:
This small crypt is lit by a hole in the wall to the south, through
which sand pours from the desert outside.  A hot wind blows in from the
desert, drying your skin instantly.  To the east and north the arched
hallway continues.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The arched hallway collapses into rubble shortly to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8746, "room_id": "69f4d0cb64546145f1f37161", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2d4d1d57a8ab0ad2"}

name: Wall Road
description:
You are walking along wall road, just north of the west gate of Midgaard.
The road continues along the western wall to the north, towards an intersection
with a busy Clan street.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see an intersection between wall road and a busy Clan street.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3258, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe4e3515429d6bbf4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9a323d7eee7cfbaf"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The west gate of the city lies south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3040, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe4e3515429d6bbf4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb752550123ef7321f"}

name: The ordinary bend
description:
You are in the middle of a bend in the pipe system of the sewer system,
WHAT a place!!! The pipe leads to the south and the east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "East. What a quiet place you've found there. It's an intersection that have\npipeways going north and east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7021, "room_id": "69f4d0cb78da844e4a081402", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3daa51966c88d9ff"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "South. You see nothing at all in that direction it's too dark anyway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7017, "room_id": "69f4d0cb78da844e4a081402", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb991c03e53ad3d011"}

name: The wet maze
description:
You are in a part of the maze where the floor is fully covered
by water. The maze continues to the north, east and south.

name: Smurfy Road
description:
You continue to travel down Smurfy Road.  Isn't it just smurfy?  Smurfy road
continues its smurfy path to the smurfy north, smurfy west, and smurfy south.
A smurfy home lies to the smurfy east.

name: East Wall of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: The meditation chamber
description:
You are in a meditation chamber. It is very silent here, in fact you
can not even hear your own footsteps.
You feel very peaceful.

name: A Hallway of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in a hallway of the Golden Citadel.  Gold tiles cover the floors,
and rich golden tapestries drape the walls.  Servants in golden livery pass you
by peaceably.  Exits lead west and north.

name: Shiriff Post of the Eastern Shire
description:
You are in the Shiriff Post which acts as the nucleus for the three shiriffs
of the Eastern Shire.  As you examine the shiriffs on duty, you come to realize
that the halflings of the Shire are not to be reckoned with.  You cower with
awe.  A door offers passage to the east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A door offers passage to the office of the Thain.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1111, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdb417a143cea17be", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba51dc5d35e087edd"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west you can see Bywater Road.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1109, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdb417a143cea17be", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0928a1538e4c86a4"}

name: Ahkeem's Stuff
description:
You step into a shop swirling with smoke.  Ahkeem seems to have a liking for
things not of this world...very strange stuff indeed.  There is a large sign on
the wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "note sign", "description": "LIST : gives you a list of items for sale.
VALUE : tells you how much an item is worth to Ahkeem
SELL : sells an item to Akheem for a generous sum
BUY : Akheem's FAVORITE command lets you have an item for his low low price.", "valid": true}

name: A Garden Path
description:
A circular path surrounds a magnificent domed temple in the center of
the city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare.
Vines and ivy snake up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves
around your feet. A sudden volley of howls pierces the air.

name: Ancient Room
description:
You are standing in a large stone room - feels like a crypt.  Ancient murals
of Hell and punishment cover the walls.  In the middle of the room are stairs
that lead down into the darkness.  From the stairway you can smell brimstone
and sulfur.
To the west, there appears to be a shrine.

name: An Arched Hall
description:
This hallway has a beautiful arch to it, formed painstakingly and
exquisitely out of the sandy stones of the pyramid.  The dust that
covers most of the rest of the pyramid interior is not present here,
scoured away by the blowing of the desert winds that howl about
your ears.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The arched hall proceeds to the east, making a sharp southward turn.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8749, "room_id": "69f4d0cbac00012734bde315", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc591995e3854b132"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The arched hall proceeds into a sandstone crypt.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8747, "room_id": "69f4d0cbac00012734bde315", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb64546145f1f37161"}

name: Wall Road
description:
Wall road intersects with a crowded Clan Road here, filled with shops and
artisans.  The street stretches off to the east, towards the far wall of the
city.  Wall road continues to the north and south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Wall road continues to the north, towards the northwestern corner of the wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3259, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9a323d7eee7cfbaf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb52fde275a3d73da6"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You see the shops and clan halls of Clan Road.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3301, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9a323d7eee7cfbaf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc1265c5431fc8f6c"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Wall road continues alongside the western wall, heading towards the west gate.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3257, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9a323d7eee7cfbaf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe4e3515429d6bbf4"}

name: The sewer junction
description: You are in a junction that leads north, west and south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "South. It looks like a pipe junction just like this one. Only that one\nleads east and west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7018, "room_id": "69f4d0cb991c03e53ad3d011", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe7a37664093a0b0f"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "West. There's a junction with four pipelines in that direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7009, "room_id": "69f4d0cb991c03e53ad3d011", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3fed5cf9de196abb"}

name: The wet maze
description:
You are in a small maze, the floor is covered by water, the
maze continues east, west and south.

name: West Wall of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: Smurfy Road
description:
Oh boy, another smurfy road!  Smurfy Road goes north and south here.  There
is a smurfy, mushroom home to the west.  A beautiful smurfberry patch is to
the east.

name: A bend in the hallway
description:
You are at a bend in the long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical
glow which provides enough light to see by.
The hallway continues north and west from here.

name: An Upper Chamber of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in one of the upper chambers of the Golden Citadel.  The decora-
tions of this place surpass even those of the first floor.  Gold tiles etched
with platinum cover the floor, walls and the ceiling.  The lights from numerous
torches reflect from these shimmering planes, giving the illusion that you are
standing in a gem.  Stairways lead up and down, and the hall leads south.

name: Thain's Office
description:
You stand inside the office of the Thain, the police protectorate of the
great Shire.  The Thain has sworn to protect the Shire from all thieves and
murderers with his life, and so eyes you suspiciously.  A door to the west
leads to the Shiriff Post.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A door offers passage to the Shiriff Post.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1110, "room_id": "69f4d0cba51dc5d35e087edd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdb417a143cea17be"}

name: Vera's Veggies
description:
This is a busy place.  Customers shuffle around, bartering for lower prices
on the wide selection of vegetables.  You can still hear your mother telling
you 'Eat your Veggies'.  That's probably why you're mudding right now and
not hanging out with mom.  But wait...Vera looks just like your mother!
There is a large poster, behind the counter, taped to the wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "note poster", "description": "LIST : gives you a list of items for sale.
VALUE : tells you how much an item is worth to Vera
SELL : sells an item to Vera for a generous sum
BUY : Vera's FAVORITE command lets you have an item for her low low price.

NEWBEE INTRUCTOR COMITEE", "valid": true}

name: Dark Stairway
description:
You are standing at the bottom of long dark stairway.  The smells of brimstone
and sulfur choke you.  Screams of pain and terror fill the air.
Stone faces carved into the walls seem to laugh at you.
Maybe this is not such a good idea after all....

the city. Flowers have withered away and the once lush trees are bare.
Vines and ivy snake up the sides of the temple and entangle themselves
around your feet. A sudden volley of howls pierces the air.

exquisitely out of the sandy stones of the pyramid.  To the east is
a small, golden-coloured crypt, and the hall proceeds to the south
and north.

name: Wall Road
description:
You are walking along wall road, which extends along the inside of the western
wall of Midgaard.  To the south, you can see an intersection with a crowded
Clan street.  The northwestern corner of the city wall lies ahead to the
north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the northwestern corner of the city wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3260, "room_id": "69f4d0cb52fde275a3d73da6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcd30f98c892aa378"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south, wall road intersects with a crowded Clan street.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3258, "room_id": "69f4d0cb52fde275a3d73da6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9a323d7eee7cfbaf"}

name: The ordinary junction
description:
This looks like an ordinary junction, actually it seems very quiet
here. The pipelines lead west, east and north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can see a junction like this one, leading north and west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7017, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe7a37664093a0b0f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb991c03e53ad3d011"}

name: Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: The end of the tunnel
description:
The tunnel suddenly stops here, only exit is to the west.
The air is damp here.

name: Smurfy Road
description:
Smurfy Road continues to smurf here.  It smurfs to the south and smurfs to
an end to the north.  A smurfberry patch is to the east.  A stone path lies
to the west.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.
A blackened door can be seen to the east.

name: An Upper Chamber of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in one of the upper chambers of the Golden Citadel.  The decora-
tions of this place surpass even those of the first floor.  Gold tiles etched
with platinum cover the floor, walls and the ceiling.  The lights from numerous
torches reflect from these shimmering planes, giving the illusion that you are
standing in a gem.  Stairways lead up and down, and the hall leads east.

name: Bywater Road
description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the north and south.  To the east you spy the training grounds for
shiriffs in training.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The Shiriff Training Grounds lies to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1117, "room_id": "69f4d0cba5d9a2e0d91b4eea", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf276dec76b51d6ab"}

name: The Museum of the Greater Gods
description:
This room is identical to the one north of it, but contains four differnt
statues.

name: Landing
description:
This landing has been scorched as if a large brushfire had swept through it.
Bits of ash and burnt vegetation cover everything.  The walls and floor are
flawlessly smooth, and the ceiling is covered with carved faces and ancient
symbols and runes.
Large, black iron gates tower over you to the west.
You see a large gateway to the west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "gates", "description": "These black iron gates are covered with grotesque faces and other\ncreatures in various poses and acts of violence and lust. The gates\nmake your blood run cold...", "valid": true}

name: The Northwest Corner
description:
You are standing beneath the northwestern corner of the city wall, on a turn
in wall road.  You can head south, towards the west gate, or east, to the
north gate.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Wall road continues along the northern wall of the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3261, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcd30f98c892aa378", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbd249856e4ff119a"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Wall road continues along the western wall of the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3259, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcd30f98c892aa378", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb52fde275a3d73da6"}

name: A Golden Crypt
description:
You stand inside a small crypt with walls and ceiling made of
golden bricks that obscure the large sandy stones of the pyramid.
Small rugs and tapestries are scattered about the floor here, and
they appear to have been used recently.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "rug rugs tapestry tapestries", "description": "The rugs and tapestries are very fine and worn with age, their colors\nnow faded.  They depict scenes of life in an ancient desert city.", "valid": true}

name: A quiet pipe junction
description:
This is the kind of place to rest, though the smell could be a LOT better
than this. The sewer goes east, north and west from here.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "In that direction, you can't see anything. It's just too dark.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7011, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3daa51966c88d9ff", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb61954ad6d3bb6707"}

name: Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: In the water
description: You are standing in the water, exits leads both north and east.

name: Smurfy Road
description:
A smurfy well lies here in the middle of Smurfy Road.  A fence separates
the smurfs from harm to the north.  A berry patch is to the east.  Smurfy
Road continues to to the south and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "smurfy well", "description": "A small well is here.  Just the right size if you're a smurf.  But big\nenough for you to get some water from.  I'm sure the smurfs wont mind.", "valid": true}

name: A dark room
description:
You are in a large dark room. The air here seems quite stale, and a sense
of extreme dread comes over you. The stench of rotten flesh seems to be
wafting in from the open doorway to the north.

name: Bywater Road
description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the north.  The private residences of Shire inhabitants are to
the east and west while to the south lies the Ivy Bush, second only to the
Green Dragon for its hospitality and service.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You spy the private dwelling of a Shire folk to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1115, "room_id": "69f4d0cb226cc479a64f49fa", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb399bf954d9fd5c70"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you see the Ivy Bush, a favorite haunt of Shire urbanites and\nseasoned travelers.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1116, "room_id": "69f4d0cb226cc479a64f49fa", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdbfb7a4a0b38dacf"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You spy the private dwelling of a Shire folk to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1114, "room_id": "69f4d0cb226cc479a64f49fa", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb89c76e4f1b8ff2aa"}

name: The Hall of the DragonLords
description:
You are in a vast hall, filled with the commanders of the Golden Citadel.
Golden tiles etched with platinum cover the floors, and weapons of all types
are mounted on the walls of this meeting hall.  Surrounding a solid gold table
are four sons of the Keeper of the Golden Citadel.  They smile at you and ask
you to join them in lunch.  Exits lead to the cardinal directions.

name: Base of the Tower
description:
You walk into a cold room whose only feature is an old wooden staircase
spirling up along the wall to a higher level. Up these stairs, you are
told, lies the old mage who may be able to help you advance in your
studies.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see some small scratches on the floor near the base of the wall.", "keyword": "secret door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9624, "room_id": "69f4d0cbae65d0cc9f11533f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbeb29a36509b270a6"}

name: Gateway to Hell
description:
You stand next to the very gateway of Hell. You are surrounded by
the sounds of torture and pain. Screams pierce the air and rattle your
nerves. Displays of the treats of Hell are in all directions.
A large black iron gates tower over you to the east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "gates", "description": "These black iron gates are covered with grotesque faces and other\ncreatures in various poses and acts of violence and lust. The gates\nseem to make your blood run cold...", "valid": true}

name: The market place
description:
You stand in the middle of a large square lined on each side with
baskets, carts, and stands of all shapes and sizes. Abandoned, these
little shops still contain some of their goods once sold to a demanding
public.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A small table has been toppled over, spilling fine jewelery and gems\nonto the ground.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5225, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe492743f21902252", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb92889e14d46115c2"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Rotted remains of fruits and vegetables lie strewn about.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5220, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe492743f21902252", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5ebb1b317f6b32cf"}

name: An Arched Hall
description:
This hallway has a beautiful arch to it, formed painstakingly and
exquisitely out of the sandy stones of the pyramid.  The arched
hall proceeds to the north and ends to the south in a small vault.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The arched hall continues to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8749, "room_id": "69f4d0cb371a4bcba31bd1a4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc591995e3854b132"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see a small vault from which a shining light issues.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8752, "room_id": "69f4d0cb371a4bcba31bd1a4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2b97df54a592fb97"}

name: The odd room with smooth walls
description:
As you enter you hear a loud click from one of the walls ... and you fall
and fall and fall ...
.
.
.
.
... And come to an abrupt end. THIS is strange indeed. There's an arched
entryway leading down.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "Down. It's utterly dark that way, though you can make out an intersection\nof sewer pipes leading west, north and east.", "keyword": "entryway", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7112, "room_id": "69f4d0cb99d7d140a4be2ebd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb899fe270ddbf7aeb"}

name: Wall Road
description:
The city walls tower over you as walk down wall road, between the northwestern
corner of the wall to the west, and the northern gate of Midgaard to the east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Wall road continues to the east, towards the northern gate of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3262, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbd249856e4ff119a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbed31ef17a53ae2c2"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can see the northwest corner of the city wall to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3260, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbd249856e4ff119a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcd30f98c892aa378"}

name: Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: In the water
description: You are standing in the water, it continues east and west.

name: Smurfy Road
description:
A corner of smurfy road is where you stand.  A smurfy fence blocks passage
to the east or south.  A smurfy home is to the north.  Smurfy Road goes back
to the west.

name: A dark room
description:
You are in a large dark room. The stench here makes you gag and wretch.
There are body parts and half rotted corpses strewn about with complete
abandon. Several operating tables with still forms that resemble nothing
you've ever seen alive are here.
Tortured screams can be heard from the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Upon gazing northwards, you are filled with deep dread", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1425, "room_id": "69f4d0cb859966dfbb5b5159", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb2068a85196e14ed"}

name: An Upper Chamber of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in one of the upper chambers of the Golden Citadel.  The decora-
tions of this place surpass even those of the first floor.  Gold tiles etched
with platinum cover the floor, walls and the ceiling.  The lights from numerous
torches reflect from these shimmering planes, giving the illusion that you are
standing in a gem.  Stairways lead up and down, and the hall leads west.

name: A smial
description:
You are inside a smial, a hole in the ground which serves as the proper
dwelling place for halflings.  As you look around this private abode, you feel
as if you were intruding and so quickly cover your eyes.  The only exit lies
to the east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The only exit lies to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1113, "room_id": "69f4d0cb89c76e4f1b8ff2aa", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb226cc479a64f49fa"}

name: Hall of the Damned
description:
This hallway is a monument to the millions of damned souls in Hell.
The walls are made up of various body parts and other, unidentifiable
things. Many of the faces that make up the wall scream out to you for
help. Their arms desperately grasp at your clothing as you pass.

name: The Mage's Courtyard
description:
You enter a small tiled courtyard with a small fountain in the middle.
Around the sides are four wrought iron benches with cushions where the
mages of the land sit and exchange ideas. To the west stands a two-story
tower where the leader of the mage's guild performs his experiments.

name: The market place
description:
You stand at the end of the market square. Stands and carts line
each side, filled with remnants of fine foods and exquisite goods.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Tattered carpets and ruined bales of silk sit idly by a run down stand.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5222, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4eca78cfaabef33c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4a09a29879ae0954"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The center of the market lies this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5207, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4eca78cfaabef33c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe492743f21902252"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "From the massive stench, this must have been a meat and poultry stand.\nIt lies totally bare.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5217, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4eca78cfaabef33c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbac751c63d5eda361"}

name: A Shining Vault
description:
The stones of the pyramid here take on a strange, twinkling quality,
almost seeming to shine with an internal light.  As you look closer you
see tiny glass-like glittery particles within the stones, that reflect
the light from your light source so perfectly that they seem to shine.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "particles glass", "description": "The glassy particles reflect and refract your light source in a myriad\nof dazzling colours that dance across your eyes and make you giggle.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a hall with a beautifully arched ceiling.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8751, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2b97df54a592fb97", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb371a4bcba31bd1a4"}

name: The sewer
description:
You are standing in mud up to your ankles. This is an intersection with
sewer pipes leading east, south and west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east there's a peculiar looking round room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7037, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc9275b39a6911d81", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9e27179fc210f215"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south there's another intersection with pipes going south and east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7025, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc9275b39a6911d81", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb71c523514c803f80"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west there's another intersection like this one, with sewer pipes\nleading south and west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7011, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc9275b39a6911d81", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb61954ad6d3bb6707"}

name: Inside the North Gate of Midgaard
description:
Two small towers surround a strong wooden gate, connected by a small stone
bridge set with murder holes.  This gate is not as heavily guarded as the
others, as the plains outside are safe to travel.  You can leave midgaard to
the north, or continues along wall road to the west and east.  A teeming clan
street is visible to the south, and beyond that the graceful spires of the
Temple of Mota, but there is no way to reach them from here.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The northern plains are visible through the gate.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 1, "key": 3133, "to_room_vnum": 3268, "room_id": "69f4d0cbed31ef17a53ae2c2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0b2d97945d803202"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Wall road continues to the east, alongside the northern wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3263, "room_id": "69f4d0cbed31ef17a53ae2c2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdf5cdd0546ae1bc4"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Wall road continues to the west, alongside the northern wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3261, "room_id": "69f4d0cbed31ef17a53ae2c2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbd249856e4ff119a"}

name: East Wall of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: End of maze
description:
You are at the end of the small maze which continues north.
Above you a hole leads up.

name: Smurfy Road
description:
Western corner of Smurfy Road.  You can continue to smurf down the road
to the east and north.  You can also smurf into a smurfy home to the south.

name: The Necromancer's Lair
description:
You are in the lair of the evil Necromancer. Undead minions of all types,
human and otherwise stand here waiting to do their master's bidding. Some
glowing arcane sigils have been etched into walls and floor, no doubt to
protect the evil master from his own ungodly creations.

name: A smial
description:
You are inside a smial, a hole in the ground which serves as the proper
dwelling place for halflings.  As you look around this private abode, you feel
as if you were intruding and so quickly cover your eyes.  The only exit lies
to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The only exit lies to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1113, "room_id": "69f4d0cb399bf954d9fd5c70", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb226cc479a64f49fa"}

name: Hall of the Damned
description:
This hallway is a monument to the millions of damned souls in Hell.
The walls are made up of various body parts and other, unidentifiable
things. Many of the faces that make up the wall scream out to you for
help. Their arms desperately grasp at your clothing as you pass.

name: An Upper Chamber of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in one of the upper chambers of the Golden Citadel.  The decora-
tions of this place surpass even those of the first floor.  Gold tiles etched
with platinum cover the floor, walls and the ceiling.  The lights from numerous
torches reflect from these shimmering planes, giving the illusion that you are
standing in a gem.  Stairways lead up and down, and the hall leads north.

name: A Side Street
description:
This small side street leads east and west into back alleys while
to the south you see the temple. The incessant howling tears at your mind.

name: Nectar of the Gods
description:
You are startled by the lavishness of this place. From what you know of
clerics they are supposed to be humble people, giving all their
material goods to their cause. Perhaps because only clerics are
allowed to enter this bar they have condoned making it as comfortable
as possible. In the corner stands a staircase leading down to the
meditaion chambers.

name: Another intersection
description:
You have never seen anything so BORING...This is an intersection with pipes
leading north, south and east.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north there's an intersection, where the pipes are leading west and\neast. You notice that the floor to the west is covered in mud.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7024, "room_id": "69f4d0cb71c523514c803f80", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc9275b39a6911d81"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "East. You see nothing of interest in that direction, just another\nintersection. This one leads east and south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7038, "room_id": "69f4d0cb71c523514c803f80", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8d66b2b7af250509"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Another intersection lies to the south. It leads west and south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7026, "room_id": "69f4d0cb71c523514c803f80", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbeec659edfd2269ef"}

name: Wall Road
description:
You are walking along wall road, between the northern gate of the city and the
northeastern corner of the city walls.  You can see bloodstains on the road...
better be on guard for thieves.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the northeastern corner of the city walls.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3264, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdf5cdd0546ae1bc4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba2f863011b3f33d7"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The northern gate of the city lies east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3262, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdf5cdd0546ae1bc4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbed31ef17a53ae2c2"}

name: A Massive Sand Dune
description:
You stand now on a massive sand dune on the southern side of
the pyramid.  At the foot of the sand dune to the north you see a
small hole where the stones of the pyramid have collapsed.  Not
far to the south is a massive roiling sandstorm; the wind from the
storm howls and bites at your face even here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sand dune sandstorm", "description": "The sand is very white, and very sandy.  There sure is a lot of it.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a small hole leading back into the pyramid.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8747, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8344a57af3414430", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb64546145f1f37161"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see only a wall of whirling, blowing, dry sand.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8754, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8344a57af3414430", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9f4e6a6862763b9d"}

name: At the sand bar
description: You are on a little sand bar in the water.

name: North West Corner of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: Smurfy Road
description:
There's no place like smurf.  There's no place like smurf.  Sorry wrong
movie.  A smurfy home is to the west.  Papa Smurf's backyard is to the
north but you can't go there.  Smurfy Road continues to the south and
east.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: Hall of the Damned
description:
This hallway is a monument to the millions of damned souls in Hell.
The walls are made up of various body parts and other, unidentifiable
things. Many of the faces that make up the wall scream out to you for
help. Their arms desperately grasp at your clothing as you pass.

name: The Ivy Bush
description:
You are in the Ivy Bush, one of the most famous inns in all of Shiredom.
Chique Shire urbanites and seasoned travelers fill the confines of the room
with gay and lively talk.  A jovial innkeeper stops all that he is doing to
await your command.  The only exit lies to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The only exit lies to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1113, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdbfb7a4a0b38dacf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb226cc479a64f49fa"}

name: A Top Chamber of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in one of the top chambers of the Golden Citadel.  The decorations
of this room looks like a dragon's hoard.  The whole room is carved out of pure
gold, and gems of all types glitter from the walls, ceiling, even the floor.
It is obvious that this room was not meant for you to intrude upon.  A stair-
case leads back down, and a doorway leads south.

name: A junction
description:
This one seems interesting, a big difference from all the other junctions.
It seems cleaner than the rest of them. Weird. Something that looks like
an air shaft leads upwards, but it looks far too slippery to climb.
The pipes lead to the south, west and north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT\nthe smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "North. You see an intersection there, leading north and east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7025, "room_id": "69f4d0cbeec659edfd2269ef", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb71c523514c803f80"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south there's ANOTHER junction leading west and east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7028, "room_id": "69f4d0cbeec659edfd2269ef", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe6e8d9d7f93af092"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west you see a load of mud and sediment in the sewer. That should\nbe an intersection there but you're not quite sure.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7013, "room_id": "69f4d0cbeec659edfd2269ef", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcb5cb2ec6e8ce3fb"}

name: The Temple Square
description:
You are standing on the meeting grounds of those with holy intentions.
Monks, bards, paladins and clerics mill around either preaching or
listening to their fellows preach. Huge marble steps lead up to the
gates of the temple and Main Street lies to the south.

name: A Side Street
description:
You are in the common section of the city. Ruined buildings made of
clay and stone is all the view has to offer. Most of these homes are
nothing but piles of rubble, but some look almost safe enough to venture
into. The street continues north and south and buildings line the street.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A small doorway leads into a partially collapsed house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5244, "room_id": "69f4d0cb75430afdacb70730", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3f729d1f804be5c1"}

name: The Northeast Corner
description:
Wall road turns the corner here, as you pass by the northeastern edge of the
city wall.  The north gate lies to your west, and the road south leads to the
eastern gate of Midgaard.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "Wall road continues to the south, along the eastern wall of the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3265, "room_id": "69f4d0cba2f863011b3f33d7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb58775bb1dafdba92"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Wall road continues to the west, along the northern wall of the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3263, "room_id": "69f4d0cba2f863011b3f33d7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdf5cdd0546ae1bc4"}

name: A Swirling Sandstorm
description:
You are caught in the midst of a massive sandstorm.  Howling winds
buffet you from all sides, and the sand tears at your skin, blinding
you and choking you.  You have lost all sense of direction.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sand", "description": "Sand is about all you CAN see right now.  Unfortunately, it isn't very\ninteresting sand, only white, dry, and blowing all over the place.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see only a wall of whirling, blowing, dry sand.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8753, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9f4e6a6862763b9d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8344a57af3414430"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You see only a wall of whirling, blowing, dry sand.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8754, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9f4e6a6862763b9d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9f4e6a6862763b9d"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see only a wall of whirling, blowing, dry sand.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8755, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9f4e6a6862763b9d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcecd100ed815acf9"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see only a wall of whirling, blowing, dry sand.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8754, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9f4e6a6862763b9d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9f4e6a6862763b9d"}

name: North Wall of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  You can barely see the ceiling.  You feel as if you are being watched
by some divine being.

name: Stone Path
description:
You are walking along a cute little stone path.  To the south lies Papa
Smurf's house.  A Smurfy house is to the west.  Smurfy road is to the east.
Everything is so peaceful here.  You could stay forever.

name: A hallway
description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

name: Hall of the Damned
description:
This hallway is a monument to the millions of damned souls in Hell.
The walls are made up of various body parts and other, unidentifiable
things. Many of the faces that make up the wall scream out to you for
help. Their arms desperately grasp at your clothing as you pass.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see a dark stairway leading down.", "keyword": "stairs", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10421, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd175475cb7662419", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9d6d549df0903a73"}

name: Shiriff Training Grounds
description:
The sounds of mock battle and feigned death cries fill your ears.  Every
which way you turn you see halfling trainees at the prime of their youth.  A
wizened old battle instructor meets your gaze and asks if he may be of
service.  The only exit lies to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The only exit lies to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1112, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf276dec76b51d6ab", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba5d9a2e0d91b4eea"}

name: A Top Chamber of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in one of the top chambers of the Golden Citadel.  The decorations
of this room looks like a dragon's hoard.  The whole room is carved out of pure
gold, and gems of all types glitter from the walls, ceiling, even the floor.
It is obvious that this room was not meant for you to intrude upon.  A stair-
case leads back down, and a doorway leads east.

name: The sewer junction
description: You stand in a junction of sewer pipes leading north, east and west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you can see a bend in the pipe going south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7034, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe6e8d9d7f93af092", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb628373f540139660"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west you can just make out an old well.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7015, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe6e8d9d7f93af092", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb33d6196b2a8621a5"}

name: Wall Road
description:
Just south of you is an intersection with a crowded clan street.  The
eastern wall of Midgaard is beside you, and to the north you can see the
northeast corner of the city wall.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can see the northeast corner of the city wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3264, "room_id": "69f4d0cb58775bb1dafdba92", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba2f863011b3f33d7"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see an intersection with a crowded street.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3266, "room_id": "69f4d0cb58775bb1dafdba92", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfddde513916407f2"}

name: Nabil's Exotic Animals
description:
You stand in a large building decorated with black marble and red satin.
A lavishly flourished sign details several exotics creatures and Nabil's
smiling face.  Cages crowd the room, some large, some small, and filled with
animals from the four corners of the world.  Various feeding and grooming
supplies fill the back half of the room, along with an assortment of
leashes for everything from giant rats to minotaur lizards.

name: A Side Street
description:
This small side street leads away from the garden path to the south.
Around you stand large piles or rubble where the houses of commoners
used to be. A lone howl makes you worry greatly about your safety here.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "An unusually tall dwelling stands looming over you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5237, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc10aef51a598d6a6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2b228e788cb4f405"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A garden path circles around the temple.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5204, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc10aef51a598d6a6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd22db436798e1582"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Here lies a small stone house with a thatched roof.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5227, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc10aef51a598d6a6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9590cdf7c938c2c5"}

name: A Swirling Sandstorm
description:
You are caught in the midst of a massive sandstorm.  Howling winds
buffet you from all sides, and the sand tears at your skin, blinding
you and choking you.  You have lost all sense of direction.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sand", "description": "Sand is about all you CAN see right now.  Unfortunately, it isn't very\ninteresting sand, only white, dry, and blowing all over the place.", "valid": true}

name: The end of the hallway
description:
You are at the end of a long hallway. The walls here glow with a faint
magical energy which provides plenty of light.
Stairs lead up to the next level here and the hallway continues south.

name: Smurfy Road
description:
Yet another part of Smurfy Road.  Hey if you go west its the last
section of Smurfy Road.  You can go back to the smurfy well to the east.

name: North Wall of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: Bywater Road
description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the east and west.  A large, imposing building lies to the south.
You catch a glimpse of the Brandywine River to the north.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you see the entrance to the Shire.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1103, "room_id": "69f4d0cb581692236a9d9e87", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2b933c713491c251"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A large, imposing building lies to the south.  A sign reads 'Shiriff Post'.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1119, "room_id": "69f4d0cb581692236a9d9e87", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1a41a6ca8d2b1771"}

name: Hall of the Damned
description:
This hallway is a monument to the millions of damned souls in Hell.
The walls are made up of various body parts and other, unidentifiable
things. Many of the faces that make up the wall scream out to you for
help. Their arms desperately grasp at your clothing as you pass.

name: The Dragon Chamber
description:
You are in a vast chamber carved from gold and platinum.  Gems the size of
a man's fist protrude from the walls, ceiling, and the floor, making your step
painful.  A vast open sky-light lets fresh air come in from the top.  In the
center of this chamber, you see a great wealth of coins, and on top of that
pile of coins, you see a golden dragon squinting at you.  Exits lead to the
cardinal directions to the anterooms.

name: The Triple Junction
description:
You stand in the middle of a huge junction of concrete sewer pipes. The
pipes lead into three different directions : east, south and west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "East. You can see a bend in the sewer pipe leading north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7035, "room_id": "69f4d0cb47a2dfa582f99af9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb85547180f4e4bec4"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south there's a ENORMOUS quadruple sewer junction, all lit up by\nan odd light.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7030, "room_id": "69f4d0cb47a2dfa582f99af9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1cc5f4813b6a89f4"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west you can just make out another junction similar to the one\nyou are standing in.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7021, "room_id": "69f4d0cb47a2dfa582f99af9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3daa51966c88d9ff"}

name: A side street
description:
This small side street leads south away from the temple into the
business section of town. The destruction that leveled this city was not
biased; these important looking buildings have been almost totally
destroyed. There is a hole in the wall of a very large structure to the
east.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A small garden path encircles the temple.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5206, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf4d433af48039600", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb252c7cc0f6df77b9"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "This possibly could be the city hall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5232, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf4d433af48039600", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf34b4120c62228f7"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "Inside the building you see long pieces of metal, an oven, and some\nanvils.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5221, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf4d433af48039600", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb51aa5961f5488c4b"}

name: Wall Road
description:
Here, wall road meets up with a busy clan street heading off towards the
west, and the far wall of the city.  You can smell spices, perfume, freshly
cured hide, and other strange scents, all mingle together in one heady aroma.
Wall road continues to the north and south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Wall road continues to the north, along the eastern wall of the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3265, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfddde513916407f2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb58775bb1dafdba92"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Wall road continues to the south, towards the east gate of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3267, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfddde513916407f2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba7bcdca97eb19da1"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a mass of people heading down Clan Road.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3316, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfddde513916407f2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb144f077bf9787951"}

name: The Butchary
description:
This shop has the aroma of freshly slaughterd beasts.  You feel right at home.
You see a fairly simple set up.  The corpses..er...selections hang on hooks,
still bleeding into catch pans that drain into a single underground vat.
You wonder where that leads....  Taped to the counter, almost obscured by
blood, there is a barely readable sign.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "note sign", "description": "LIST : gives you a list of items for sale.
VALUE : tells you how much an item is worth
SELL : sells an item to Butch for a generous sum
BUY : Butch's FAVORITE command lets you have an item for his low low price.

NEWBEE INTRUCTOR COMMITEE", "valid": true}

name: Smurfy Road
description:
The last piece of Smurfy Road.  You can go back to Smurfy Road to the east.
A nice, beautiful, smurfy, mushroom home is to the south.  In the distance to
the north you can see Gargamel's Castle.

name: A corridor
description:
You are at the east end of a long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with
ancient runes of power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to
crackle with power all around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost
as if the corridor it self were alive.

name: Mural of the Dead
description:
You stand before a large mural. The mural depicts mountains of dead
bodies piled up to the sky. The mural covers the whole north wall from
floor to ceiling. You can smell the stench of decaying flesh.

name: North Wall of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: Shiriff Post of the Bridge
description:
You are in the Shiriff Post which acts as the nucleus for the three shiriffs
of the Bridge.  As you examine the shiriffs on duty, you come to realize that
the halflings of the Shire are not to be reckoned with.  You cower with awe.
The only exit is to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The only exit is to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1118, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1a41a6ca8d2b1771", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb581692236a9d9e87"}

name: A Top Chamber of the Golden Citadel
description:
You are in one of the top chambers of the Golden Citadel.  The decorations
of this room looks like a dragon's hoard.  The whole room is carved out of pure
gold, and gems of all types glitter from the walls, ceiling, even the floor.
It is obvious that this room was not meant for you to intrude upon.  A stair-
case leads back down, and a doorway leads west.

name: A side street
description:
This small side street is lined with the remains of once great
buildings. To the north is a dark, foreboding structure while to the
east lies the entrance to a small tavern. The street continues north
and south.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "From the looks of it, this was once a two story abode. The entire second\nfloor has collapsed leaving a very little part of the bar still free\nfrom debris.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5230, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdaa7561c0de96df4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7a2e1cf61f209e6b"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "This seems to be the only guild house in the entire city. Its dark nature\nmakes you wonder about its origins.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5219, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdaa7561c0de96df4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba83efb2af579a10e"}

name: The Quadruple Junction Under the Dump
description:
You are standing in something that reminds you of an entry to an ant hive.
There are enormous concrete pipes leading north, south, east and west.
There's also a metal ladder built into the concrete wall leading up through
a layer of garbage.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "ladder", "description": "It looks as if it's made of stainless steel, and it would very well function\nas a club of considerable power, but alas ... You can't take at all since\nit's firmly set into the concrete wall.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can see a huge triple junction with sewer pipes leading\nwest and east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7029, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1cc5f4813b6a89f4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb47a2dfa582f99af9"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south there's a huge junction with pipes leading east and west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7031, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1cc5f4813b6a89f4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb13a9eb7cef43dcf0"}

name: Wall Road
description:
You are near the center of wall road, just north of the east gate of the city.
To the north, you can see an intersection with a crowded clan street.
The guards at the gate eye you suspiciously from afar.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see an intersection with a busy clan street.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3266, "room_id": "69f4d0cba7bcdca97eb19da1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfddde513916407f2"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see the well-guarded east gate of Midgaard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3041, "room_id": "69f4d0cba7bcdca97eb19da1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb008c96301e4d9696"}

name: The Witch's Brew
description:
The first thing you notice as you walk into this spacious shop is the
hundreds of candles that line the shelves. The swirling mist that surrounds
your feet makes it seem that you have stepped into a gateway to another
plane. A tall brunette stands behind her cluttered table unaware of
your entrance.  An ornately lettered sign floats above your head.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "note sign", "description": "LIST : gives you a list of items for sale.
VALUE : tells you how much an item is worth to Elvira
SELL : sells an item to Elvira for a generous sum
BUY : Elvira's FAVORITE command lets you have an item for her low low price.", "valid": true}

name: Smurfberry Patch
description:
Delicious smurfberries grow here.  You could probably eat a year's worth of
smurfberries in one sitting.  Smurfy Road is back to the west.  Another
smurfberry patch is to the north.

name: A corridor
description:
You are in a long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with ancient runes
of power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to crackle with
power all around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost as if the
corridor itself were alive.

name: Living Walls
description:
The walls here actually consist of greying and sinewy flesh - faces, hands,
broken bones, feet, and toes jutting from the surface. You hear low moans
of horror, pain, and sorrow issuing from within.

name: North East Corner of Arena
description:
You are in the Arena.  Remember, if you wish to get out of this Arena, just
go up.  Ceilings can barely be seen in this huge Arena.  You feel as if you are
being watched by some divine being.

name: Bywater Road
description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the east and west.  To the south you spy the Grocer's Delight,
the premium grocer's shop in all the realm while to the north lies Brandywine
Bridge.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Brandywine Bridge offers safe passage across the tumultuous river.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1131, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1c7bdbeca4e77fa8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb58f16abc6b42a5e9"}

gold, and gems of all types glitter from the walls, ceiling, even the floor.
It is obvious that this room was not meant for you to intrude upon.  A stair-
case leads back down, and a doorway leads north.

name: A side street
description:
You are at the end of a long street leading to the center of the city.
A long dark alley runs east and west.

name: A triple junction
description: You stand in a junction with pipes leading west, north and east.

name: Outside the North Gate of Midgaard
description:
You stand outside the north gate of the walled city of Midgaard.  A dusty
trail is visibile to the north, it stretches around the walls of the city.
Further north are the wide expanses of the northern plains, leading to the
village of Ofcol.  You can return to Midgaard to the south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a dusty trail leading around the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3904, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0b2d97945d803202", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb17c6a5a4a5e661d4"}

name: Braheem's Magic Shop
description:
You enter a shop crowded with bookshelves and clutterd with scrolls. The
owner seems to be hard at work on his latest magical creation. You see a
small sign on the wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "Welcome to Braheem's.
LIST -Shows you all of my wonderful creations.
VAL  -Shows what an item might be worth to me.
SELL -Allows you to rid yourself of excessive magic items.
BUY  -Allows you to rid youself of excessive cash.", "valid": true}

name: Wastedump
description:
This room is filled with bone shards and fragments.  Something (or things)
very big lives here.  A small plaque is on the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "plaque", "description": "This zone (trollden) is created by MERC for any MERC Mud.\ncopyright 1992", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You find the stench is stronger inside.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 2803, "room_id": "69f4d0cba5b9e9c91bb73003", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe33079e2a46e5543"}

name: A Massive Sand Dune
description:
Somehow you managed to make your way through the howling winds
of the sandstorm, and clamber up on this sand dune.  You can see the
storm to the north of you, and presumably the pyramid is somewhere
beyond it.  Nothing but flat, featureless, open dunes of sand lie in
every other direction.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sand dune", "description": "The sand is very white, and very sandy.  There sure is a lot of it.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see only a wall of whirling, blowing, dry sand.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 8757, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbc45d16dfe5d51f2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7a2e35a5deff342e"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "On the southern side of the sand dune is a small hole in the sand.\nFor some reason you seem unable to get to it.", "keyword": "riddle", "exit_flags": 2, "key": 8717, "to_room_vnum": 8759, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbc45d16dfe5d51f2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd56f3f6e8612232e"}

name: Smurfberry Patch
description:
Another patch of smurfberries is growing here.  The smell is driving your
nostrils crazy.  It almost, ALMOST, makes you forget all the singing going
on.  Smurfy Road is to the west, while smurfberry patches are to the north
and south.

name: A bend in the corridor
description:
You are at a bend in the long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with
ancient runes of power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to
crackle with power all around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost
as if the corridor itself were alive.

name: Trapped souls
description:
There are many souls trapped behind the walls of this room, almost as though
they were trapped beneath the surface of a frozen lake. Even the floor and
ceiling show the screaming faces behind them.

name: The Center of the Dungeon
description:
You are in the center of a large room.  A faint light from above shows that
the floors are all covered with slime.  A feeling of dread comes over you as
you notice that this is NOT a great place to go.  Exits go in all directions.
Of special note is the one that brings you back up!!!

name: The Grocer's Delight
description:
You tremble with ecstasy as the tempting odors of freshly made pipeweed
bread fill your lungs.  Rumor has it that the pipeweed bread sold here can
restore vitality.  You look around but find no one to take your order.
You then peep over the counter and discover a friendly grocer who is too
short to be seen over the counter.  The only exit is to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The only exit is to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1120, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdcd3769490ad533c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1c7bdbeca4e77fa8"}

name: Above the Dragon Chamber
description:
You are above the Dragon Chamber.  You curiously note that this shaft that
connects the chamber to the sky is wide enough that even a dragon can fit
through.  This shaft leads up and down.

name: Under a ruined watchtower
description:
You stand at the base of a tall watchtower built to protect the city
from invaders. From the looks of things, it did not do a good job.

name: A bend in the sewer pipe
description: You can look in two directions where the pipe leads : south and west.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can see another bend leading west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7035, "room_id": "69f4d0cb628373f540139660", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb85547180f4e4bec4"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "West. You can just make out a triple junction leading north and west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7028, "room_id": "69f4d0cb628373f540139660", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe6e8d9d7f93af092"}

name: On the Concourse
description:
The strong stone walls of Midgaard rise up to the west, keeping evil at bay.
The concourse heads towards a bridge to the north, and continues south
alongside a beautiful park.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The concourse continues to the north, along the city wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3100, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe449857ad537ab7e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb101002a4618f9f01"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The concourse heads south, passing by a beautiful park.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3271, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe449857ad537ab7e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd0cf0a2fdeaa48d7"}

name: Entrance to the Mage's Tower
description:
The entrance hall is a small poorly lit room. It would seem its only
purpose is to house the powerful sorcerer standing here guarding
the entrance.

name: Troll's Larder
description:
This room has blood and grime all over the walls.  You see maggots and other
insects crawling up them.  The resident is definitely uncivilized.  Half-eaten
and rotting body parts scatter the floor, each having its own colony of flies,
worms, and maggots.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "Half-eaten body rotting corpse", "description": "YUCK!  You find worms crawling in and out this poor unfortunate former human.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You welcome the fresh breeze coming from the east, but wrinkle your nose when\nthe stench bears down on you once more.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 2803, "room_id": "69f4d0cb88c85894b4b43453", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe33079e2a46e5543"}

name: Through the Hole in the Sand
description:
You squeeze through the small hole in the sand and land in a small
white chamber.  Above you is a small hole, reachable by climbing up
the small sandy slope down which you slid.

name: Smurfberry Patch
description:
The northernmost of the smurfberry patches grows here.  It looks just
as scrumptious as all the rest.  Just take a few; they'll never know.  Smurfy
Road is to the west.  A smurfberry patch is to the south.

name: A corridor
description:
You are in a long corridor leading north and south. Obsidian walls
engraved with ancient runes of power stretch out before you. Magical
energies seem to crackle with power all around and whisper in tongues
long forgotten, almost as if the corridor itself were alive.

name: Tortured Beings
description:
This room is filled with instruments of torture. Beings of all shapes and
sizes are being brought to the thresholds of pain and beyond. Some are
being sliced into thousands of pieces.  Others are being stretched as though
they were made of rubber.  All are caught in an unending play of agony.

name: The North West Corner of the Dungeon
description:
You are against a wall in the dungeon.  It is quite dark here.  The lack of
any windows in the area explains the smell around you.

name: A back alley
description:
This alley leads to the rear of what used to be a meat stand. You wince
at the stench. South is one of the city watchtowers.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the back-side of the market place meat stand.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5217, "room_id": "69f4d0cba88f6c5f46d9e00c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbac751c63d5eda361"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5215, "room_id": "69f4d0cba88f6c5f46d9e00c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4fd288a4b19427db"}

name: Bywater Road
description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the east.  A small hill lies to the west while you can see a
watermill to the far south.  You catch a glimpse of the Brandywine River to
the north.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "An entrance to the watermill lies to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1123, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe20c3c2b2bf26b58", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba7a62a11df3c9cf3"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A small hill to the west blocks your view.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1126, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe20c3c2b2bf26b58", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2fa4787dfe0cf6ed"}

name: In the Shaft from the Dragon Chamber
description:
You are in the shaft leading from the Dragon Chamber.  Below you lies the
Dragon Chamber of the Golden Citadel.  Above you, you see the sky, but
currently, the way out is sealed by a layer of diamond that looks impenetrable.

name: The sewer pipe bend
description:
You can look in two different directions where the pipe goes : west and
north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "North. You see another bend leading west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7034, "room_id": "69f4d0cb85547180f4e4bec4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb628373f540139660"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can see another junction although this one is a triple one with pipes\ngoing south and west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7029, "room_id": "69f4d0cb85547180f4e4bec4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb47a2dfa582f99af9"}

name: On the Concourse near the park
description:
You are walking down the Concoruse, along the western wall of Midgaard.  To
the north, the road passes by a beautiful park, to the south, you can see
the southwest corner of the city wall.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The concourse heads north, passing by a beautiful park.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3270, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd0cf0a2fdeaa48d7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe449857ad537ab7e"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You can see the southwest corner of the city wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3127, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd0cf0a2fdeaa48d7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe1cc5adfd7ea662e"}

name: Entrance to the Guild of Warriors'
description: This small hall is merely a check point to keep the unwanted out.

name: Troll's Living Room
description:
This small cave opens to the north, south, east, and west.  You are
overcome by the stench and consider turning around.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "There is a trail of bone shards and fragments leading north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 2801, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe33079e2a46e5543", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba5b9e9c91bb73003"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Good God!  You spy corpses all over the floor in there.  It looks like a\nvirtual graveyard in there.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 2804, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe33079e2a46e5543", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb3ed23b795335db7"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Whoa!  You reel back from the stench.  You believe you have found the source\nof this bad smell.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 2805, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe33079e2a46e5543", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe6e0f9c4bd514af7"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You puke as you watch worms crawl between this room and the room west of here\nas they bore new holes into a corpse laying on the far wall of the west room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 2802, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe33079e2a46e5543", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb88c85894b4b43453"}

name: Brainy Smurf's Home
description:
You rip the roof of the home to get a good look inside.  You see
many smurfy books.  The print is so small you couldn't even read it
with a magnifying glass.  I wonder if Brainy Smurf minds if you
destroy his home?  Smurfy Road is back to the south.

name: An intersection
description:
You are at an intersection in the corridor. The obsidian walled halls
lead off in every direction from here, pulsing with the power of their
ancient runes.

name: Gluttony
description:
Before you is a room filled with all sorts of food. The smells of pastries and
hamburger assault your senses. All sorts of food lay everywhere you look.
Cookies, twinkies, steak, prime rib, almost anything you can think of, call
out to you. You suddenly feel VERY hungry.

name: The North Wall of the Dungeon
description:
You are against a wall in the dungeon.  It is quite dark here.  The lack of
any windows in the area explains the smell around you.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the center of the dungeon.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3748, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1687b084f983deb0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb6b170580c563ac4"}

name: Inside the Entrance to the Golden Citadel
description:
You are inside the entrance to the Golden Citadel.  Rich golden tapestries
line the walls, and golden tiles cover the floors.  The exit to this citadel is
to the west, while the citadel itself is to the east.

name: Entrance to Watermill
description:
You stand at the entrance to a watermill.  You hear the bustle of busy
workers and the sound of a creaking mill.  Bywater Road is to the north while
the watermill continues to the south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see Bywater Road to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1122, "room_id": "69f4d0cba7a62a11df3c9cf3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe20c3c2b2bf26b58"}

name: The meat stand
description:
A large stand has been set up here with metal hooks and wooden racks
in the background. Hanging on the hooks are very small scraps of meat
and other game. This stand is relatively empty, and a sudden burst of
howling and screaming makes you realize why this is so.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "This is a cart full of rotted vegetables and fruits.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5220, "room_id": "69f4d0cbac751c63d5eda361", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5ebb1b317f6b32cf"}

name: On the Concourse at Penny Lane
description:
You are on a road leading around the inner walls of Midgaard.  To the north,
the concourse heads towards a bridge into northern Midgaard.  To the south,
you can see an intersection with Elm Street.  The quaint paved streets of
Penny Lane lie west.
