exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The concourse continues to the north, towards the east bridge.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3104, "room_id": "69f4d0cb94da4995a1590867", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf90113adf5d9579c"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The concourse continues south, towards an intersection with Elm Street.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3273, "room_id": "69f4d0cb94da4995a1590867", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb91d34b96b7db4653"}

name: The pit
description:
You stand in a section of a pipe that leads to a dead end. In the floor
there's a pit leading down. There are bars set in the side of the pit wall
functioning as a ladder.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "West. You can see a dimly lit quadruple junction with an exit up.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7030, "room_id": "69f4d0cb06e5ddb2fb144eb5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1cc5f4813b6a89f4"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "Down the pit it's utterly dark you can't see a thing.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7122, "room_id": "69f4d0cb06e5ddb2fb144eb5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb16453c599edf46f6"}

name: The Repair Shop
description:
One of the most popular shops in New Thalos, this shop is always a hive
of activity. It is almost inhuman the way one man can fix all the area's
armor singlehandedly. If you have an item in need of repair simply give
it to the man behind the counter.

name: The Playpen
description:
The walls are covered with blood (and body parts!?!?).  Plastered on the far
wall you see what looks like a human arm.  A half-eaten body lies here with
its chest ripped out.  The predator seems disinterested in it.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "arm rotting", "description": "This reminds you of what a baby would do to its formula during dinnertime,\nplastering it on the wall.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You welcome the fresh breeze coming from the west, but wrinkle your nose when\nthe stench bears down on you once more.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 2803, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb3ed23b795335db7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe33079e2a46e5543"}

name: Handy Smurf's Home
description:
This home was well built.  Of course, until you rip it apart you big meany
you.  Tools are all over the place.  Too small for you to use.  Smurfy Road is
back to the west.

name: A corridor
description:
You are at the end of a long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with
ancient runes of power stretch out before you. A darkened door is to the
east. Tendrils of mist cling to the floor here, they seem to be seeping
from under the door.

name: Greed
description:
What luck! A room full of treasure. Gold, diamonds, riches beyond
imagination! Wait! You suddenly feel as if it were all slowly disappearing.
Someone is taking your treasure. They have no right! It is yours! You
found it first. Let them go get their own treasures!
You see a door to the east.

name: A Path from the Plains
description:
You are on a path away from the Plains of Ofcol.  The path doesn't look well
tread, but it is relatively well kept.  To the south are the Plains of Ofcol,
while this path leads north.

name: Outside the Entrance to the Golden Citadel
description:
You are outside the entrance to the Golden Citadel.  A great gate is to
to the east, marking the entranceway into the citadel.  The road also leads
back west to Raff Way.

name: The North East Corner of the Dungeon
description:
You are against a wall in the dungeon.  It is quite dark here.  The lack of
any windows in the area explains the smell around you.

name: On the Concourse at Elm Street
description:
The air grows chill as you pass near the Elm Street graveyard.  The walls of
Midgaard are to the east, and the concourse continues to the north and south.
To your west, you see Elm Street at the graveyard entrance.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The concourse continues to the north, towards an intersection with Penny Lane.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3272, "room_id": "69f4d0cb91d34b96b7db4653", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb94da4995a1590867"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The concourse continues to the south, towards the southeast corner of the wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3130, "room_id": "69f4d0cb91d34b96b7db4653", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb73d59abf8b61c303"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see Elm Street and the graveyard entrance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3124, "room_id": "69f4d0cb91d34b96b7db4653", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb44838b9ec4f5aadb"}

name: The Watermill
description:
Halfling workers are scattered everywhere, busy at work.  You see the river
to the west and get a compelling urge to grab the nearest worker and to toss
him into the river.  The entrance stands to the north while a door offers
passage to the south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A wooden door leads to the rear of the watermill.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1125, "room_id": "69f4d0cb18c4d1d197a187e4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb93c55eba8444f89c"}

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow alley leads east to a wider street and west to one of
the city watchtowers.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5215, "room_id": "69f4d0cb262b6b486e170d15", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4fd288a4b19427db"}

name: The round room
description:
As you enter the room it starts rotating - at first slowly, later faster
and faster - You get totally confused as to where up and down are, but you are
certain that the doorway is in the opposite direction of what it was when
you entered. It now leads east. There was only this one exit.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You can just make out a smaller room with a chair.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7050, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9e27179fc210f215", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbeb5edf59c5b58de1"}

name: The General Store
description:
The new found wealth of this beautiful city is apearant in the exotic items
for sale here.  You wonder what would happen if you typed....LIST...

name: Troll's Bedroom
description:
Obviously something REALLY big lives here.  The stench is quite unbearable.
There are piles and piles of rotten and half-eaten body parts of animals,
orcs, (and humans?) strewn across the floor.  There is a larger, more
prominent pile of rotten parts over in a corner.  It seems to have been
flattened by something.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You welcome the fresh breeze coming from the north, but wrinkle your nose when\nthe stench bears down on you once more.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 2803, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe6e0f9c4bd514af7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe33079e2a46e5543"}

name: Rough East-West Path
description:
You are on a very rough and overgrown path heading east-west over rugged
terrain.  To the east the path passes between low hills.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The road heads into low hills this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1602, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4fd38e155ff35f2e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7c01d8139eac96ee"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "The cross-roads and a trading post lie in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1702, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4fd38e155ff35f2e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7b7848e4774346ad"}

name: Hefty Smurf's Home
description:
Hefty is anything but wimpy.  So is his house.  It actually took you a
couple of minutes to destroy his house.  Better watch out -- he might be
a little mad at you.  Smurfy Road is back to the north.

name: The scrying chamber
description:
You are in the scrying chamber of the high tower of sorcerery. It is here
that arcane rituals are performed to enable those of the art to look in
upon denizens throughout the world and spy out their darkest secrets.
A huge black cauldron is in the center of the room, bubbling and gurgling,
it pours forth a constant stream of smokey fog into the air about you. Here
and there on stands of different sizes are crystal balls and oddly shaped
mirrors.

name: Bedroom.
description:
This is a small bedroom. It is well furnished and is a drastic change from
the room you just stepped out of. A bed stands against the far wall.
Upon the headboard of the bed are carved two cherub-like figures, with the
the words 'DEE & DEE' written below them.
The door to the bedroom is to the west.

name: Along the Path
description:
You are on the path away from the Plains of Ofcol.  The main path leads north
to an overlook and south back toward the Plains of Ofcol.  Western and eastern
side paths can be seen, probably deer trails by the width of them.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the path back toward Ofcol.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7800, "room_id": "69f4d0cb75203cbbc3a9c0d1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd77fbe5e9ca76ee4"}

name: The West Wall of the Dungeon
description:
You are against a wall in the dungeon.  It is quite dark here.  The lack of
any windows in the area explains the smell around you.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the center of the dungeon.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3748, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1636cef268e93da1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb6b170580c563ac4"}

name: The guild house
description:
You are standing in what once was this city's ONLY guild house.
Tables and chairs have been smashed and broken weapons lie strewn about
the floor as if some massive battle had taken place here. Draped along
the back wall is a tattered, jet-black banner with the symbol of the
Darkside set upon it.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A small side street runs past the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5213, "room_id": "69f4d0cba83efb2af579a10e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdaa7561c0de96df4"}

name: Clan Road
description:
You are standing on the western end of Clan Road.  The traffic here
is light.  This is a quieter section of Midgaard.  You can hear the sound of
haggling coming from the east.

name: Rear of watermill
description:
You stand in a damp, dimly lit room.  Mildew clings to the walls and it
appears as if you were the first person to enter the room in ages.  A barely
visible portal in the ground catches your eye.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "A hidden portal reveals a passageway down.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1146, "room_id": "69f4d0cb93c55eba8444f89c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6163b3e73a97e1d4"}

name: The three way junction
description: You are standing in a junction of pipes that lead west, east and south.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "East. You can make out a dimly lit Guard Room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7045, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8d66b2b7af250509", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7c9bb7f520c8c7ad"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can see what looks like a store room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7039, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8d66b2b7af250509", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb60031b03d07817e8"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "West. You see another junction similar to this one leading north and south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7025, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8d66b2b7af250509", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb71c523514c803f80"}

name: Abdul's Armor
description:
The sound of hammering metal grows louder as you enter the armory.  Young
boys run to and fro carrying buckets of water and coal.  A few dwarves work
on sections of armor in the back of the shop, their hammers working too fast
to follow.  The walls are adorned with all of Abdul's prize creations.  Here
you can purchase suits of armor meant to keep monsters from hacking you into
little pieces.
A note on the wall beckons newbies.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "note", "description": "LIST : gives you a list of items for sale.
VALUE : tells you how much an item is worth to Abdul
SELL : sells an item to Abdul for a generous sum
BUY : Abdul's FAVORITE command lets you have an item for his low low price.", "valid": true}

name: Sleepy Smurf's Home
description:
Be vewy vewy quiet.  Sleepy Smurf is probably sleeping.  You see so many
beds you can't even tell if he is here.  Maybe you should quietly go back to
Smurfy Road to the east.

name: Rough Path Between the Hills
description:
Here the path passes between low hills. The going is very rough, but
to the east the ground is smoother. In that direction a pair of tower
looms above the hills.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a pair of tall towers in the distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1603, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7c01d8139eac96ee", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5073d93f5b2681d8"}

name: A corridor
description:
You have reached an end in the long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved
with ancient runes of power stretch out before you. The sound of snoring
can barely be heard through the door to the west.

name: Ancient Shrine
description:
This is an ancient, abandoned shrine of some unknown god. It has been
vandalized and torn apart. What used to be the shrine has been reduced to
a large pile of stone and other debris. Various runes and demonic faces
have been spray-painted on the walls and floor.  Nailed to the ceiling are
an assortment of skeletons.  All seem to have been dead for a very long
time. All surfaces of the room are covered with dried blood and dust.

name: A Small Trail
description: This small deer trail leads north and east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The main path is to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7801, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb890e7279aa143bf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb75203cbbc3a9c0d1"}

name: The East Wall of the Dungeon
description:
You are against a wall in the dungeon.  It is quite dark here.  The lack of
any windows in the area explains the smell around you.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the center of the dungeon.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3748, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7f5382d1ef7bbc70", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb6b170580c563ac4"}

name: Clan Road
description:
You are walking along Clan Road.  To the south of you is the money changer.
Clan Road continues on to the east and the west.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The money changer is to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3334, "room_id": "69f4d0cbadc2802729a09315", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1ddf68cef07183c0"}

name: The produce stand
description:
A large cart sits here carrying rotted fruit and vegetables. Flys
swarm all about what seems to be the last remaining bits of food left
in the city.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A strong stench emanates from the meat stand next to you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5217, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5ebb1b317f6b32cf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbac751c63d5eda361"}

name: Took Hill
description:
You stand on top of Took Hill, named after the legendary Bandobras Took.
You feel honored to be standing on a hill named after your hero.  From this
vantage point you can see all of shiredom.  You get the feeling that with
one stomp you could eliminate their great city.  You can see the outline of
Midgaard to the far east.  Sounds of joyful celebration are heard from the
fields west of here.  The Brandywine flows by lazily nearby.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see a grassy field to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1128, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2fa4787dfe0cf6ed", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb94b6e61700c94271"}

name: The Sewer Store Room
description:
You stand in a small room lit by a single torch set in the wall. The only
way out of here is to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you see a pipe junction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7038, "room_id": "69f4d0cb60031b03d07817e8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8d66b2b7af250509"}

name: The Mercenary's Guild
description:
This guild is frowned upon by most of the population of New Thalos, but
the laws of supply and demand are irresistable. People come here when
they feel unable or are unwilling to fight their own battles. For a
small fee you may hire henchman.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You notice some small scratches in the floor next to the eastern wall.", "keyword": "secret door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9632, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb9c3dcd26a9c75dd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc44f41cba01927bb"}

name: Grumpy Smurf's Home
description:
This is Grumpy Smurf's home.  He is pissed at you.  Of course, he is pissed
at everyone.  So don't take it bad.  Maybe you'd better leave before he really
gets mad.  Smurfy Road to the east is your only salvation.

name: Path through an Open Area
description:
You are on a path through an open area. East of here loom two tall towers,
joined by a barbican and surrounded by a murky moat. West the path passes
between low hills.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Two fantastic towers surrounded by a moat rise before you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1604, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5073d93f5b2681d8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd9cf026870f44ac8"}

name: The entrance to the library
description:
You are in the entrance to the great library of magic. A giant desk is
here, covered with books parchments and scrolls. Long shelves loaded with
row upon row of books stretch out in every direction as far as the eye can
see.

name: Room full of Body Parts.
description:
The room is filled with piles of arms, legs, heads, and other, unidentifiable
parts of many different creatures. The stench is overwhelming. The body
parts seem to wiggle and scream as you get closer. They are still alive!!

name: A Small Trail
description: This small deer trail leads north and west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The main path is to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7801, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5ad038f7a852a430", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb75203cbbc3a9c0d1"}

name: The South West Corner of the Dungeon
description:
You are against a wall in the dungeon.  It is quite dark here.  The lack of
any windows in the area explains the smell around you.

name: Clan Road
description:
The shops on this stretch of Clan road are long-closed and boarded up.
Not much traffic passes through this part, as there is nothing to buy.

name: The smithy
description:
In here you find tools and anvils used to make various weapons
and items. The walls have been stripped clean and only a few incomplete
pieces of armor and weaponry are left.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A small side street runs past the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5212, "room_id": "69f4d0cb51aa5961f5488c4b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf4d433af48039600"}

name: Northern end of grassy field
description:
You stand in a grassy field--nothing to get too excited about.  The field
extends toward the south and the west.  To the east you see Took Hill.

name: The Shaft
description:
You are standing by the edge of a deep, dark shaft leading down. A single
ladder is your tool to work your way down if you so wish. The sewer pipe
leads south from here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "ladder", "description": "Firmly set into the wall of the shaft it's impossible to even rock, is your\nestimate.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can see the pipe leading further south into darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7043, "room_id": "69f4d0cb52d7e3c4a49bbbb4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb57824f5a6ddbfcfd"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "Down and utter darkness. There's absolutely nothing to be seen in that\ndirection.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7123, "room_id": "69f4d0cb52d7e3c4a49bbbb4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb23e0561d8bc52817"}

name: The Mercenary's Guild
description: This is the storage room for the mercenaries to be hired.

name: Jokey Smurf's Home
description:
You pull the top of his house and it explodes in your face.  That Jokey
Smurf, what a kidder.  You can hear his laughter as you wipe the ashes off
your face.  You better get even.  Smurfy Road is to the north.

name: West Side of Moat
description:
You stand on the west side of a moat that encircles two towers, each
over 50 feet high. You will need a boat to go east across the moat. A
rugged path heads west, and another one heads north to a cluster of low
buildings.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A worn path leads to a cluster of low buildings.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1605, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd9cf026870f44ac8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfe6dbfc153efc7b3"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "The Towers loom directly over you, just beyond the moat.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1620, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd9cf026870f44ac8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4df8d0eb388d7bf5"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "An old ill-kept roads leads away to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1603, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd9cf026870f44ac8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5073d93f5b2681d8"}

name: In the library
description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of
books, tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive
books seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes.
It is very quiet here.

name: Fountain of Blood.
description:
This room is made of a rough black stone. The walls seem to ooze black
sludge. In the middle of the room stands a stone fountain of a demon spitting
blood.

name: The Overlook
description:
You are above a large valley.  Below you, you see humanoid forms wandering
around the valley.  Rich green grass covers the valley, with some small trees
dotting the landscape.  To the south is the trail back toward Ofcol.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the path back toward Ofcol.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7801, "room_id": "69f4d0cba702ff4c650f3842", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb75203cbbc3a9c0d1"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see the entrance to the valley.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7805, "room_id": "69f4d0cba702ff4c650f3842", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb637ee7c116adeb40"}

name: The South Wall of the Dungeon
description:
You are against a wall in the dungeon.  It is quite dark here.  The lack of
any windows in the area explains the smell around you.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the center of the dungeon.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3748, "room_id": "69f4d0cb562eca3677b6faa7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb6b170580c563ac4"}

name: Clan Road
description:
Noise and light abound on this part of Clan Road.  Clan road continues off
to the east and west.

name: The tapestry stand
description:
Tattered and torn tapestries and rugs lie heaped in piles. Fancy
robes and various articles of clothing are now just rags. You stare at
the strange piles for a long time until a piercing howl makes you
think these might be beds.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A fine jewelry stand lies in ruin next to you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5225, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4a09a29879ae0954", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb92889e14d46115c2"}

name: A grassy field
description:
You stand in the center of a grassy field.  A great birthday party appears
to be taking place.  Great tables of food are spread out and a young halfling
beauty offers you welcome.  You are enticed by her generosity and suggestive
winks.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A small hill to the east blocks your view.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1126, "room_id": "69f4d0cb94b6e61700c94271", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2fa4787dfe0cf6ed"}

name: The Sewer Entrance
description:
You stand in the middle of a pipe that leads from north to south. Above you
an air shaft leads up into sunlight. It seems totally impossible to go up
that way.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can just make out a huge shaft leading down.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7041, "room_id": "69f4d0cb57824f5a6ddbfcfd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb52d7e3c4a49bbbb4"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can see a triple junction leading west and east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7044, "room_id": "69f4d0cb57824f5a6ddbfcfd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb8fdce98b070f482"}

name: Entrance to the Thieves' Guild
description:
This small, dark room has a single torch mounted in the wall for light.
There is a small wooden bench and a book lying on it. The assassin
guarding the entrance from 'outsiders' stands as you walk in.

name: Papa Smurf's Home
description:
It's the home of the leader of the smurfs.  Papa Smurf has a nicely decorated
home.  He takes pride in his work.  You could get to know him or just squash
him.  If Papa Smurf is not here he is probably at Smurfette's putting the
moves on her.  A stone path lies to the north.

name: Path North of Moat
description:
You walk on a faint path heading south toward the west side of the moat,
and north to three small buildings.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The path ends west of the moat.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1604, "room_id": "69f4d0cbfe6dbfc153efc7b3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd9cf026870f44ac8"}

name: Bloody Stairway.
description:
You are standing on a very slippy stairway. The walls and stairs are
covered with blood and gore. Pieces of goo and ooze drip from the
ceiling overhead. You almost slip a couple times on the stairway.
The stench here is overwhelming.

name: In the library
description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of
books, tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive
books seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes.
It is very quiet here.

name: The Entrance to the Valley of the Elves
description:
You are at the entrance to the Valley of the Elves.  Elves stare at your
intrusion, but most are too busy to bother with you.  The valley spreads to
the north, while enlarging toward the east and west.

name: The South East Corner of the Dungeon
description:
You are against a wall in the dungeon.  It is quite dark here.  The lack of
any windows in the area explains the smell around you.

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow alley leads north to one of the city watchtowers while
to the south there lies a market stand full of torn clothes and rugs.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5224, "room_id": "69f4d0cb932e435d5c80ad77", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba121bda20a701d02"}

name: Clan Road
description:
Clan Road seems to widen here slightly, allowing more traffic to
travel through the area.  To the south is another entrance to the busy
pub.  This door is also open wide and spilling forth the sounds of
happy patrons.  Clan Road continues to the east and west.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A busy pub is to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3356, "room_id": "69f4d0cbce6ec0873a1c911d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb12a517d5fbe2b15c"}

name: Southern end of grassy field
description:
You stand in a grassy field--nothing to get too excited about.  The field
extends toward the north and the west.  To the east you see Took Hill.

name: The Whet Stone
description:
Very large men with very large swords drink beer from very large mugs. Every-
thing in this room is BIG. The large round tables are scuffed and nicked from
the numerous bar brawls that have sprung up. It might be a good idea to hold
your tounge for a while as you soak up the atmosphere. There is an exit to
the east where the master swordsman awaits pupils to train with.

name: The junction going three ways
description:
You are in a passageway in the pipes of the sewer system leading north, east
and west.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a sewer pipe leading north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7043, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb8fdce98b070f482", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb57824f5a6ddbfcfd"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "West. You see another junction very similar to this one that leads north\nand west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7031, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb8fdce98b070f482", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb13a9eb7cef43dcf0"}

name: Path to Gargamel's Castle
description:
You are walking along a path to Gargamel's Castle to the North.
Smurfy Road lies to the south.

name: Cluster of Buildings
description:
You are in the middle of a cluster of small buildings. There is a building
to the north, east, and west.  A sign over the eastern building says
'House of Pancakes'.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "There is an entrance to a building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1609, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd95a8763e02d9974", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1e0c285534c54598"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "A sign over the door reads 'House of Pancakes'.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1607, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd95a8763e02d9974", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4948ce2de7278a78"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A path heads south toward the west side of the towers.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1605, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd95a8763e02d9974", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfe6dbfc153efc7b3"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "There is an entrance to a building here.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1608, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd95a8763e02d9974", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb473507284054149e"}

name: Ancient Room
description:
This is a very old and dusty room. It looks empty except for a few shards
or bone and flesh.

name: In the library
description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of
books, tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive
books seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes.
It is very quiet here.

name: The Edge of the Valley
description:
You are at the edge of the Valley of the Elves.  High above you, you see a small
trail circling the entire valley.  The valley continues north and east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The entrance to the valley is to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7805, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe79a346805a51234", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb637ee7c116adeb40"}

name: A Room in Mud School
description:
You are in a room in Mud School.  Paintings of the heroic graduates of mud
school adorn the walls. To the west is Furey's Training Room, and to the east
is Zump's Guild Room.  North of you is the next Station of Mud School.
There is a sign on the wall (type 'LOOK SIGN' to read it).
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "To find out your attributes, type 'score'.  You can improve your attributes
in Furey's Training Room to the west.  You can practice your skills and spells
in Zump's Guild Room to the east.  You can continue through mud school by
going north.

If you are a new character, you should go 'WEST' from here, train your
abilities, and then come back here and go 'NORTH'.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the next station of Mud School.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3701, "room_id": "69f4d0cb16cce7434bdff9a4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe34e5416cbf862a4"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You see Zump's Guild Room.  Go there to practice your skills.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3759, "room_id": "69f4d0cb16cce7434bdff9a4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb16908a75f40762a6"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see the entrance to Mud School.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3700, "room_id": "69f4d0cb16cce7434bdff9a4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9f43475fa9ee8c91"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see Furey's Training Room.  Go there to train your attributes.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3758, "room_id": "69f4d0cb16cce7434bdff9a4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb714fb9fad9e603d3"}

name: Clan Road
description:
You are at the eastern end of Clan Road.  To the east of you, the
tall wall around the city looms up before you and casts its shadow on
you.  Clan Road continues to the west.

name: Under the watchtower
description:
You stand under one of the city watchtowers built to protect
the city from invaders. Obviously, it failed.

name: Western end of grassy field
description:
You stand in a grassy field--nothing to get too excited about.  The field
extends every which way but west.

name: Tournament and Practice Yard
description:
This is a wide expanse of grass filled with dummies, punching bags and
swordpupils. To the north you see a man dressed in black robes, unlike
his iron clad comrades, who you assume to be your master.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the grass near the base of the wall here is slightly torn.", "keyword": "secret door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9573, "room_id": "69f4d0cbad045fd58a90b6b5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc7b4c0daf64ebf1d"}

name: Outside Gargamel's Castle
description:
You are standing outside Gargamel's Castle.  You can hear him screaming at
Azreal from inside.  You can also him cursing out those wretched smurfs.
His Castle is to the north while Smurfy Road is to the south.

name: The Sewer Room
description:
You are standing in a large room with chairs set in the walls. You have the
feeling of being watched. To the south there's an entry to a larger room.
The room is lit by five torches, also set in the walls. To the west there
is a doorway leading out to the sewers.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You can see an even larger room than this one, filled with light.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7046, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7c9bb7f520c8c7ad", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb41eddc06a9b64fbc"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "To the west you can see the sewers.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7038, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7c9bb7f520c8c7ad", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8d66b2b7af250509"}

name: House of Pancakes
description:
The moment you enter this room, the ceiling descends and crushes you
into a pancake.  Don't you hate it when that happens?

name: Room of Lost Souls
description:
This looks like a waiting room or sorts. Dust and cobwebs are everywhere.
Wooden benches line the walls. A digital number sign is posted on the wall.
It currently reads, 'Now Serving Number 1'.
A ticket dispenser is bolted to the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "dispenser", "description": "This is one of those red ticket dispensers that never seem to work right.", "valid": true}

name: In the library
description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of
books, tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive
books seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes.
It is very quiet here.

name: Furey's Training Room
description:
You are in Furey's Training Room.  Around you are all sorts of physical
and mental training tools.  The whole room is filled with magic, holiness,
and sweat.  There is a sign on the wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "Welcome to Furey's Training Room.  Here you can train your attributes.  To
train an attribute, you need enough practices.  To find out how many practice
sessions you have, type 'train' while you are in this room.  To train for a
specific attribute, type 'train <attr>' where attr is the first 3 letters of
the attribute you want increased.  Type 'help train' for more information.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the room you came from, and the room you should go to.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3757, "room_id": "69f4d0cb714fb9fad9e603d3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb16cce7434bdff9a4"}

name: The Edge of the Valley
description:
You are at the edge of the Valley of the Elves.  High above you, you see a small
trail circling the entire valley.  The valley continues north and west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The entrance to the valley is to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7805, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc592fe58eaef8de0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb637ee7c116adeb40"}

name: A Money Changer's Room
description:
A few strategically placed lanterns keep this place well-lit in the
absence of any windows.  The room is surprisingly well appointed with
tapestries hanging on the walls.  You'd wager your life the moneylender's
guards are behind them, as there are none here.  The moneylender himself
works from behind a large desk, no doubt holding a fortune in gold and silver.
A smallish sign hangs on the wall, lettered in common.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "Give me your coins, and I shall change them for you, taking but 1 in 20 for\nmy fee.  --- Otho the Changer", "valid": true}

name: Brandywine Bridge
description:
You stand on a solidly built bridge.  As you look down you spy gaily
colored fish swimming with the current of Brandywine River.  The cool water
looks invitingly refreshing and you get a sudden urge to strip and bathe in
the river, but you hear the laughter of women nearby and so resist the urge.
Delving Lane extends to the north while Bywater Road can be seen to the south.

name: The jewelery stand
description:
A table has been tipped over, spilling fine jewelery and gems
across the market place. Most of these trinkets are battered and
tarnished and few would have any value anymore.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "Next to you is a stand full of ruined clothes and rugs.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5222, "room_id": "69f4d0cb92889e14d46115c2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4a09a29879ae0954"}

name: The Bread Stand
description:
A small stand has been set up here, showing the shopkeep's humble
selection. You notice he has added a few things to his list.

name: Gargamel's Castle
description:
This is Gargamel's Castle.  His big black kettle is in the middle of the room.
Where else would he put it?  The place has only one room.

name: The Sewer room
description:
This is a Room with walls that glitters like gold though not quite like it.
This is strange as it looks as if the glitter lights the whole room. It
looks very bright. To the south the floor is covered with yucky water. The
North leads to sort of a Guard Room.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can see the guard room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7045, "room_id": "69f4d0cb41eddc06a9b64fbc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7c9bb7f520c8c7ad"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south there is nothing but water and an exit leads east from there.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7047, "room_id": "69f4d0cb41eddc06a9b64fbc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb259f6e802930c967"}

name: Room of Lost Souls
description:
This looks like a waiting room or sorts. Dust and cobwebs are everywhere.
Wooden benches line the walls. A digital number sign is posted on the wall.
It currently reads, 'Now Serving Number 1'.
A ticket dispenser is bolted to the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "dispenser", "description": "This is one of those red ticket dispensers that never seem to work right.", "valid": true}

name: Old Store Room
description:
You have entered what appears to be an old storeroom. Most of the items
that were in here appear to have been ruined long ago.

name: In the library
description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of
books, tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive
books seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes.
It is very quiet here.

name: Zump's Guild Room
description:
You are in a room filled with weapons, books, and many combat dummies, some
cut and stabbed many times, others burnt to a crisp.  The room is filled with
sweat and an aura of magic.  There is a sign on the wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "Welcome to Zump's Guild Room.  Here you will learn your skills and spells.
To find out what skills and spells you can practice and how many practice
sessions you have, type 'practice'.  To practice the specific skill, type
'practice <skill>', where 'skill' is the skill or spell you wish to practice.
Practicing increases the amount you know of that skill or spell, up to a
certain maximum.  When you have practiced all you wish to practice, go west.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the room you came from and the room you should go to.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3757, "room_id": "69f4d0cb16908a75f40762a6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb16cce7434bdff9a4"}

name: The Edge of the Valley
description:
You are at the edge of the Valley of the Elves.  High above you, you see a small
trail circling the entire valley.  The valley continues north and east.

name: Grebe's Tavern
description:
Dive.  That's all you can say about this place; its a
dive.  You step carefully over the dead and/or drunk sailors
on the floor toward the center of the room.  There's no
decorations on the wall; they've all been ripped down in anger
or for use as weapons at one time or another.  Looking around,
you search vainly for a clean table to sit at, and then give up.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "table tables", "description": "You find a table that's relatively vomit-free.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A dark alley is to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 3026, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf74beef41b4bcbb8", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd8c200a7bdb6b632"}

name: Delving Lane
description:
Delving Lane runs north and south in this small borough of the Shire.  To
the south stands Brandywine Bridge.  The Green Dragon, the undisputed leader
in the art of innkeeping, offers rest and comfort to the east.  You hear the
bray of horses from the west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The Green Dragon offers food, drink, and above all hospitality for mere gold.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1144, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf881c4832d1ccc42", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf2c4d23e9fd5e996"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "Brandywine Bridge offers safe passage across the tumultuous river.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1131, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf881c4832d1ccc42", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb58f16abc6b42a5e9"}

name: A ruined clay dwelling
description:
This was once a very plain house with nothing more than a few chairs
and a bed. A cold fireplace suggests that the city has been abandoned
for quite a while. Almost nothing remains of this humble abode.

name: Igor's Implements of Destruction
description:
You can't help but shiver as you look at the selection of vicious weapons.
Huge swords and wicked looking axes hang on pegs around the room.  A dwarf
sits at a bench in the back hammering away on his latest creation.  It is
here you can buy rare and exotic items not found in other parts of the world.
A note catches your eye.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "note", "description": "LIST : gives you a list of items for sale.
VALUE : tells you how much an item is worth to Igor
SELL : sells an item to Igor for a generous sum
BUY : Igor's FAVORITE command lets you have an item for his low low price.

NEWBEE INTRUCTOR COMITEE", "valid": true}

name: Pit of Fire
description:
You enter a plain stone room with a large fire pit in the center of it.
As you look closer at the pit you realize that hundreds of people are being
burned inside it. They Scream out to you. The noise is deafening. Several
minor imps and workers push more people into the pit, whistling while

name: The Pool in the Sewer
description:
You stand in water to your waist.  To the north is the entrance to this room.
A single door leads east.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you see the entrance to this room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7046, "room_id": "69f4d0cb259f6e802930c967", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb41eddc06a9b64fbc"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You can see an enormous hall through the doorway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7053, "room_id": "69f4d0cb259f6e802930c967", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb97f68ce0cc140a43"}

name: Smurfette's House
description:
This house is conveniently next to Papa Smurfs.  Makes it easier for Papa
Smurf to sneak over at night.  I hope he uses protection.  I would hate to
have little smurfs running around.  The only exit is to the east.

name: Empty Room
description:
This room appears to be completely empty. The only exit seems to be the
way you came.  There are some scratches around the floor.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see a concealed opening leading down.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1610, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1e0c285534c54598", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbfb924158e3c7d08c"}

name: In the library
description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of
books, tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive
books seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes.
It is very quiet here.

name: The Valley of the Elves
description: You are in the Valley of the Elves.  The valley continues in all directions.

name: A Safe Room
description:
You are in a safe room, away from all the mean rabbits and snails of the Arena.
You can rest here, and go up to go back to the Temple of Midgaard.

name: Andy's Pub
description:
The busy pub is filled with patrons.  People are laughing and singing.
A minstrel plays his lute in another part of the pub, and a few people
are even dancing.  Andy, the pubs owner, wanders around and checks to see
that the needs of his customers are met.  The bar is to your south.  East
of you is another section of the pub.  You know that there are rooms to
be had somewhere around here...
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see another room in the pub.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3356, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe7e368e751d26764", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb12a517d5fbe2b15c"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "The bar is to the south of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3357, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe7e368e751d26764", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb77c1f960ddf37900"}

name: A collapsed stone dwelling
description:
This small house has completely collapsed upon itself leaving piles
of debris here and there. A few rafters still stand with thatched straw
hanging down and a hot wind gusts through the hollow dwelling.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A small side street runs past the house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5211, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9590cdf7c938c2c5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc10aef51a598d6a6"}

name: Delving Lane
description:
Delving Lane runs north and south in this small borough of the Shire.  A
large, imposing building lies to the east.  You hear the bray of horses from
the west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A large, imposing building lies to the east.  A sign reads 'Shiriff Post'.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1145, "room_id": "69f4d0cb16c63dc2097336f1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba8e48814d5a5186d"}

name: The Sewers
description:
You stand in a dead end of the sewer. The only way out is south.
You can see a shaft leading up but it looks too difficult to go up
that way.

name: Ye Old Leather Shoppe
description:
You are standing on a thick oriental rug surrounded on all sides by racks
of numerous leather goods. A few women sit on leather cushions sewing in
some detail work on custom ordered jackets.  There is a note on the counter.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "note", "description": "LIST : gives you a list of items for sale.
VALUE : tells you how much an item is worth
SELL : sells an item for a generous sum
BUY :  buy an item for an outrageous price.", "valid": true}

name: Blackened Hallway
description:
This dark hallway looks as if it was made by a lavaworm...All the surfaces
in it are melted and burnt. The smell of brimstone and sulfur fill the air.

name: Minotaur's Room
description:
You have entered a secret chamber under the empty room. In this room is
the worn but cared-for gear and trappings of some large humanoid.

name: Between the shelves
description:
You are in the great library of magic. The shelves seem uncomfortably
close here, you can barely maneuver between them. The musty smell is still
strong, and the elusive books still hover just out of reach.
A faint flicker of light can barely be made out to the north.

name: The Valley of the Elves
description:
You are in the Valley of the Elves.  The valley continues in all directions.
The entrance to the valley is towards the south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the entrance to the valley.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7805, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3a4ffd86fba0a92b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb637ee7c116adeb40"}

name: A Room in the Pub
description:
This part of the pub is filled with dancing and singing.  A wandering
minstrel is on a chair in a corner with his lute.  A busty red headed
woman is standing near him and singing a tale of comedic heroism. Drunk
men sit laughing at their tables and busy bar maids weave through the
crowd with full mugs and horns of ale and mead.  Another part of the pub
is located to your west. The bar is to the south.  A set of steps occupy
in a corner of the room.  They lead up to the inn section of this
prosperous establishment.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "Another room in the pub is to your west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3355, "room_id": "69f4d0cb12a517d5fbe2b15c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe7e368e751d26764"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "A set of stairs leads up to the reception area.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3359, "room_id": "69f4d0cb12a517d5fbe2b15c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb06e9f42ad0de0672"}

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow alley leads east to one of the city watchtowers and west to
a small side street.

name: Delving Lane
description:
Delving Lane runs north and south in this small borough of the Shire. There
is a small house to the west, nothing to the east, and up ahead you see a round
door which leads to a rather impressive abode.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A large, magnificent house meets your steady gaze.  Above the round door a\nsign reads 'Bag End'.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1135, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2529ee51b5eb1a2b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4ca435355b505903"}

name: The junction
description: You stand in a junction leading north, west and east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Darkness has closed in on that part of the sewer system, you can't see\na thing in that direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7060, "room_id": "69f4d0cb95f03223b5834a30", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbccb02b6fdadc8aa3"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "West. You see another junction very similar to this one that leads north\nand west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7044, "room_id": "69f4d0cb95f03223b5834a30", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb8fdce98b070f482"}

name: Smuggler's Inn
description:
You are inside a filthy inn, that seemingly hasn't  been cleaned in decades.
Poker tables line the walls and everyone stares at you as you walk in.
You don't feel very welcome. The bar has numerous knife holes in it
and the bartender leans over waiting for your order.  A large sign, pinned
to the wall by a knife, awaits your inspection.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "LIST : gives you a list of items for sale.\nBUY :  buy something drinkable.", "valid": true}

name: Blackened Hallway
description:
This dark hallway looks as if it was made by a lavaworm...All the surfaces
in it are melted and burnt. The smell of brimstone and sulfur fill the air.

name: The Valley of the Elves
description: You are in the Valley of the Elves.  The valley continues in all directions.

name: Western Moat
description:
You are in the middle of the moat, on the west side of the tower.  There is a
landing on both sides of the moat.  Deep throated 'ribbids' come from the
water all around you.

name: The reading room
description:
You are in a small room completely devoid of furnishings. The only thing
here is an enormous tome, lying face open on the floor. The great book looks
both heavy and ancient. Its jewel encrusted bindings are well worn as the
bark of a tree. Spidery writings seem to crawls across the pages, totally
incomprehensible to your mortal eye. Something seems to be wedged between
the pages.

name: An abandoned shop
description:
From the outside this place looks like an ordinary pile of rubble,
but inside these cramped quarters you discover what used to be a shop
filled with armor, weapons, and various other goods. A small sign flutters
in the wind.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A small side street runs past the shop.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5214, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9cddcf08b9365ac1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5523b69c950bb705"}

name: The Bar
description:
A long mahogany bar is set in the back of the pub.  Mugs line a shelf
behind the bar.  Bottles of strong, nasty looking liquids decorate one
of the lower shelves.  A large cask rests on a table behind the bar.  A
strong but friendly-looking bartender stands next to the cask polishing
glasses.  A couple of the bar maids stand in a corner and throw the most
inviting glances your way.
A sign is on the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign says: Don't forget our dinner menu.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The pub proper is to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3355, "room_id": "69f4d0cb77c1f960ddf37900", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe7e368e751d26764"}

name: Bag End
description:
You stand in a comfortably well-equipped house, a palace by humble halfling
standards.  On the wall you see a banner which reads "Home Sweet Home".
A solid oak door to the east leads to a pantry while you see a cozy bedroom
to the west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Through the keyhole you see what looks like a well stocked pantry.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1137, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4ca435355b505903", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf34046f355f9f4a7"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a bedroom.  It looks like the beds have recently been slept in.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1136, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4ca435355b505903", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb024c3346a3a70319"}

name: The small room
description:
The only thing in this room of interest is a chair, and that's tight to the
rock floor. A doorway leads south and another leads east into darkness.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "chair", "description": "This chair is made of marble, but the fact that it is worn and attached to the\nfloor makes you think twice about taking it along with you.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You can see a room with a lot of light in it. You can't make out any details.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7051, "room_id": "69f4d0cbeb5edf59c5b58de1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbaf9f8f3351df20d"}

name: The Filthy Unicorn
description:
A draft chills your bones as you enter, though you see no open window or
door. Hooded figures lurk around in the shadows and speak in low voices.
A flash of steel lets you know that weapons are in great abundance
in this crowd. As you quickly check your beltpouch you notice
a small staircase leading down.

name: Blood Room
description:
You enter the room and are immediately assaulted by the smell of rotting
flesh and blood. The walls are covered with the crimson fluid as it runs
down from the ceiling.

name: The Edge of the Valley
description:
You are at the edge of the Valley of the Elves.  High above you, you see a small
trail circling the entire valley.  The valley continues north and west.

name: Northern Moat
description:
You are in the middle of the moat, on the north side of the tower.  There is
no place to land here.  Deep throated 'ribbids' come from the water all
around you.

name: A corridor
description:
You are in a long corridor leading north and south. Obsidian walls
engraved with ancient runes of power stretch out before you. Magical
energies seem to crackle with power all around and whisper in tongues
long forgotten, almost as if the corridor itself were alive.

name: The Tavern of the Sun
description:
A glorious place in it's prime, this tavern now lies in ruin; tables
and chairs are broken scattered, bottles and glasses shattered, and
a small performance stage crushed. Musical instruments and personal
belongings lie under the rubble, but the people they once belonged to are
not with them. Looking up you see that the entire second floor and roof
has fallen in, leaving a gaping hole above.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A small side street runs past the tavern.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5213, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7a2e1cf61f209e6b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdaa7561c0de96df4"}

name: The Bar
description:
A long mahogany bar is set in the back of the pub.  Mugs line a shelf
behind the bar.  Bottles of strong, nasty looking liquids decorate one
of the lower shelves.  A large cask rests on a table behind the bar.  A
strong but friendly looking bartender stands next to the cask polishing
glasses.  A couple of the bar maids stand in a corner and throw the most
inviting glances your way.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign says: Don't forget our dinner menu.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The pub proper is to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3356, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb248dc326015c25e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb12a517d5fbe2b15c"}

name: Bedroom
description:
You stand in the private bedroom of Bag End.  There are two beds to the
side, neither of which are made.  Portraits of halflings hang on the wall,
and as you gaze upon them you come to the conclusion that the owner of
Bag End comes from a long line of distinguished halflings.  A cozy fire
in the fireplace keeps the room warm and comfortable.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Through the doorway you see the main room of Bag End.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1135, "room_id": "69f4d0cb024c3346a3a70319", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4ca435355b505903"}

name: Warehouse
description:
You are standing in a large room used to store merchandise made in the
city before it is shipped off. All the items here are made in New Thalos
and shipped to other parts of the land.

name: The Sewer pipe
description:
You are in what reminds you of a foul sewer, as if you liked being here!
You can see two exits leading either north or south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you can see a strange light flowing from there.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7052, "room_id": "69f4d0cbbaf9f8f3351df20d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba24a1c19bd062303"}

name: Living Walls
description:
The walls here actually consist of greying and sinewy flesh - faces, hands,
broken bones, feet, and toes jutting from the surface. You hear low moans
of horror, pain, and sorrow issuing from the walls.

name: The Edge of the Valley
description:
You are at the edge of the Valley of the Elves.  A steep trail leads up toward
the deer trail circling the valley.  The valley continues north, south, and
east.

name: Southern Moat
description:
You are in the middle of the moat, on the south side of the tower.  There is
no place to land here.  Deep throated 'ribbids' come from the water all
around you.

name: The end of the corridor
description:
You are at the end of a long corridor. The obsidian walls come to an
abrupt halt at the edge of a golden archway here. The hum of power is so
strong it nearly numbs your body.
The archway lies before you, glowing and pulsing with energy.

name: South wing of the city hall
description:
You stand in a large room attached to this end of the hallway which
leads back north to the reception area.  Pedestals and columns have fallen
and most of the valuable items have been taken, leaving worthless debris.
A few chairs have survived, as well as a large curved desk. To the east
is a vine-covered archway leading out into a private courtyard.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The long hallway leads back to the main reception area of the city hall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5232, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5879652ba8916019", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf34b4120c62228f7"}

name: Pantry
description:
You are inside the pantry.  Shelves filled with food and drink surround
you on all sides.  You wonder why a halfling would need so much to eat.
The presence of something unseen chills you to your bones.  On the floor
you spy a trapdoor.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "Beyond the door you see the main room of Bag End.", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1135, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf34046f355f9f4a7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4ca435355b505903"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "It's anyone's guess as to where the trapdoor leads.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1156, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf34046f355f9f4a7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2742450b18800ee7"}

name: The Inn
description:
You are standing upstairs from Andy's Pub at Andy's Inn.  A few chairs
and a couple of end tables give the room a `homey' atmosphere.  A large
stone fireplace burns brightly against one wall and warms the room.  A
large oak desk is nestled in one corner of the room.  A small man with
wire-framed glasses sits behind the desk working dilligently on his books.
He looks up as you enter the room.  He looks at you quizzically.  He is
probably waiting for you to ask him for a room.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "The stairs lead back down to the pub.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 3356, "room_id": "69f4d0cb06e9f42ad0de0672", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb12a517d5fbe2b15c"}

name: Warehouse
description:
Men walk to and fro counting crates and writing down their findings. This
area of the warehouse is used for storing the raw materials brought in
from areas outside the city. These goods are then delivered to the various
guilds. The export area of the warehouses is to the south.

name: The Grand Sewer
description:
You are in a Grand Sewer Pipe. This stretches toward the south. It's large
indeed! A doorway leads to the east from here.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can see a doorway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7051, "room_id": "69f4d0cba24a1c19bd062303", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbbaf9f8f3351df20d"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You can't see anything in that darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7056, "room_id": "69f4d0cba24a1c19bd062303", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf72b42be218a3fbd"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "In the south end of the pipe the \"floor\" is completely covered with water.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7053, "room_id": "69f4d0cba24a1c19bd062303", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb97f68ce0cc140a43"}

name: Skeleton Factory
description:
This is probably where they make all the skeletons for nightmares and
graveyards. The room is simply littered with bones. A poster on the
wall reads, "Remember ....the head bone is connected to the neck bone.."
The poster continues on...but it seems to get very technical and boring..

name: The Valley of the Elves
description: You are in the Valley of the Elves.  The valley continues in all directions.

name: Tower Foyer
description:
You are on a foyer on the west side of the structure. The moat is west of
here. There is also a large door eastward into the structure.  You notice that
the walls are ornately decorated with very life-like stone gargoyles.

name: The arched entrance
description:
You feel a slight tingle as you pass through the archway, as if the living
magical energies here had infused your body, found it wanting and left. The
intense glow from the arch above you is almost blinding. Through the light
you can barely make out a stairway leading up.

name: The city hall
description:
This is the main reception area of Thalos' city hall. The walls have
been charred and scored massively and debris is spread from wall to wall.
A large gaping hole in the west wall allows you to see out to one of
the city's side streets. Obviously no one will be seeing you through today.
Hallways lead south and east.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Main street runs past the city hall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5202, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf34b4120c62228f7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb801c888fa7fe755f"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "A hallway leads to the east wing of the city hall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5233, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf34b4120c62228f7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf360ea2782add655"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A hallway leads to the south wing of the city hall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5231, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf34b4120c62228f7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5879652ba8916019"}

name: A grassy field
description:
You stand upon a grassy field.  A bull stands grazing not far away and
out of the corner of your eye you can see him considering you.  The sound
of animals fill the air from the north.  To the south you see a pig pen.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A rather large pig pen is to the south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1139, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0b19ce95f1850869", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc4c720bd10fcb37d"}

name: Shipwright
description:
The wood under you feet creaks from years of being soaked in saltwater. An
old man with a curly, grey beard stand behind a small counter waiting to
take your order. Behind him are mounted various model sailboats and large
fish.  There is a large poster stapled to the counter.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "note poster", "description": "LIST : gives you a list of items for sale.
VALUE : tells you how much an item is worth to the shipwright
SELL : sells an item to the shipwright for a generous sum
BUY : The shipwright's FAVORITE command lets you have an item for his low low pr
ice.", "valid": true}

name: The South end of the Grand Pipe
description:
You stand in water to your knees. A doorway leads west from here. The Pipe
stretches north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a lot of pictures decorating the walls.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7052, "room_id": "69f4d0cb97f68ce0cc140a43", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba24a1c19bd062303"}

name: Bottom of Stairway
description:
You are standing at the bottom of a bloody stairway. Or at least you
thought it was a stairway. It seems to be just a painting the the wall.
This roughly carved room with evil runes carved  in to the stone floor.
There is a hallway to the east.

name: The Grand Lobby
description:
You have entered a vast lobby. This lobby appears to have once been very
ornately furnished, but now everything is decayed and moldering.  A highly
ornate balcony surrounds the lobby. To the east, below the balcony, is an
opening. The door leading out is west.  You notice that the balcony is
covered in highly ornate and life-like stone gargoyles.

name: East wing of the city hall
description:
Here lies the remnants of a fancy office, possibly the mayor's. A few
withered plants and broken pieces of furniture make this place anything
but fancy, though. The only thing remaining intact here is a large
glass cabinet. A long hallway leads west back to the reception area and
an ivy-covered archway leads south into a private courtyard.

name: The Valley of the Elves
description: You are in the Valley of the Elves.  The valley continues in all directions.

name: The landing
description:
You are on a small landing in the middle of a long stairway leading up.
Your senses seem dulled here, no sound or smell can be detected at all, and
the only thing you can see in any direction is endless stairway.

name: Pig pen
description:
You feel your boots sinking into the mud.  Numerous pigs roam about,
oblivious to your company.  A grassy field is to the north while you see
a small path winding to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A small path winds its way eastward.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1140, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc4c720bd10fcb37d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc0e5458c110376b5"}

name: Drafting Room
description:
The walls are covered with paper sketchings of hull designs. This room is
used by the shipwright to build his creations on paper before making
a single cut in wood.

name: The Edge of The Water Sewer
description:
You stand in a room where half of the floor is covered in water. The water
leads east and a doorway leads west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "water", "description": "It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You can hardly make out much more than that the next place is in a pipe\nwith more water.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7061, "room_id": "69f4d0cb57e5fa1f5bb75d92", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6bc4a6ef5d6a09a1"}

name: Stone Hall
description:
This is a roughly carved hallway. The air here is damp and musty. You
hear the sound of something dripping in the distance. Your footsteps
echo down the hall as you walk. There is a strange and deathly silence
that fills these halls...
The hall continues to the south and the west.

name: Base of the Western Tower
description:
You stand in the center of the Western tower's base. Torch brackets occupy
the four corners of this huge room. Above each torch is a lifelike ornate
stone gargoyle.  There are doors north and south, and passages east and west.

name: The Valley of the Elves
description: You are in the Valley of the Elves.  The valley continues in all directions.

name: The private gardens and courtyard of Thalos
description:
What a shame that this mass destruction also touched this once
beautiful place. The temple's garden path has nothing on this garden.
Flowers and trees have been smashed into the ground and lawn benches
thrown through walls. A large marble fountain in the center of the
courtyard still stands, though, defying any attempts to destroy its
beauty. Above stands the remnants of one of the watchtowers. Archways
north and west lead back into the city hall.

name: An intersection
description:
You are at an intersection of several hallways. You feel as if strange
mystical forces are pushing and pulling at each other from all around you.
The sensation of being trapped, in the middle is almost tangible in the air
here.
A grey tiled hallway leads south, black tiled east, white tiled west, and
a multi-colored hallway swirling with patterns that remain just barely
unrecognizable is to the north.

name: The Forge
description:
Very much like the weaponsmith this man deals in the molding of metal. It
seems that most of his creations deal with horses. On the walls you see
several horseshoes made of iron. The room is hot, hotter than the desert
just south of here, and one wonders how the smithy can stand it.  Some
letters have been burned into the wooden wall.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "letters wall", "description": "LIST : gives you a list of items for sale.
VALUE : tells you how much the blacksmith will give you for his merchandise
SELL : sells an item to the blacksmith
BUY : buy an item from the blacksmith for a fair price", "valid": true}

name: A stony path
description:
You walk on a stony path which leads to a small residence to the north.
From the east you hear the noisy din of pigs.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you see a modest house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1141, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc0e5458c110376b5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbff9d4f08b420e7e7"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "A rather large pig pen is to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1139, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc0e5458c110376b5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc4c720bd10fcb37d"}

name: The Dark hallway
description:
You can't see much of this, even with a light. The hallway goes into a
passageway to the south. A doorway leads west.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You can see nothing at all, because it's completely dark in that direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7057, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf72b42be218a3fbd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb062a3c24bc9a0190"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a lot of light, bright as daylight, but nothing of interest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7052, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf72b42be218a3fbd", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba24a1c19bd062303"}

name: Cell
description:
The cell is very damp and very musty. The walls are covered with moisture
and dirt. The smell of urine is very potent here.
The steel bars to the cell are to the south.

name: The Edge of the Valley
description:
You are at the edge of the Valley of the Elves.  A steep trail leads up toward
the deer trail circling the valley.  The valley continues north, south, and
west.

name: The Musty Corridor
description:
You are walking along a musty east-west corridor joining the two towers.
There are room on each side of the corridor, and openings at each end.

name: A small guard house
description:
This was once the barracks for Thalos' cityguards. Now just an empty
shell, this small shack still stands guarding the entrance both to the
city and to the city hall.

name: A grey tiled hallway
description:
You are in a grey tiled hallway leading north and south. Dim balls of
energy float here and there shedding a warm light, and showing the way.
A feeling of peace and balance comes over you.

name: Gamgee Residence
description:
You stand inside a modest home.  You deduce that this is indeed the home
of whomever owns the surrounding lands.  The air is somewhat musty and
the smell reminds you of a stable.  As you look around disdainfully, you
think to yourself that this is more of a shack than a proper residence and
you long for the urban riches of the Shire proper.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a small path winding its way southward.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1140, "room_id": "69f4d0cbff9d4f08b420e7e7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc0e5458c110376b5"}

name: The Royal Stables
description:
Nothing you wouldn't expect is here. Several stalls hold the Sultan's
choice Arabian Stallions, and each has its own trough for drinking.
A small boy wanders in sometimes with a shovel to remove the offensive
by-product of such beasts.

name: The dark passageway
description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
passageway seems to continue south and north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light\nthat far.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7056, "room_id": "69f4d0cb062a3c24bc9a0190", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf72b42be218a3fbd"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light\nthat far.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7058, "room_id": "69f4d0cb062a3c24bc9a0190", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5c547e7e11c87f22"}

name: Stone Hall
description:
This is a roughly carved hallway. The air here is damp and musty. You
hear the sound of something dripping in the distance. Your footsteps
echo down the hall as you walk. There is a strange and deathly silence
that fills these halls...
The hallway continues to the east and the south.

name: The Edge of the Valley
description:
You are at the edge of the Valley of the Elves.  High above you, you see a
small trail circling the entire valley.  The valley continues south and east.

name: Kitchen
description:
You have entered what must once have been a kitchen. The rusting remains of
various utensils lie on countertops. There is also an old wash basin and a
pot-belly stove.  There is a door south, and a serving hatch east.

name: A collapsed home
description:
All that's left of this house is a few scattered piles of rubble
and a very large blast crater. Obviously someone or something important
was once housed here. A shrieking howl chills your blood.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "Main street runs past this ruined home.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5202, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd119d2f23a12626e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb801c888fa7fe755f"}

name: A grey tiled hallway
description:
You are in a grey tiled hallway leading north and south. Dim balls of
energy float here and there shedding a warm light, and showing the way.
A feeling of peace and balance comes over you.
Large grey metal double doors can be seen to the south.

name: A barn
description:
Animals of every sort fill the small barn.  You feel the hot breath of
horses and cows on your neck and you feel the sudden need for fresh air.
Other than that, you feel cozy and protected and don't mind staying for a
bit longer.  All the warmth and good vibes remind you of the days when your
mother would hold you in her arms and sing you to sleep.  You find yourself
wanting to cradle all the animals.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a chicken coop to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1143, "room_id": "69f4d0cb91d960cc5749ac54", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6ac7448a8f74739c"}

name: The Secret Yard
description:
This is a hidden yard known to only a few people in New Thalos. Here you
may train in the arts of stealing, picking locks, and becoming almost
invisible. A small staircase leads back up to the unicorn.
