exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see some small scratches in the wall to the south.", "keyword": "secret door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 9589, "room_id": "69f4d0cb60df3b24ce7de0d2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb16c2baf84026d541"}

name: The dark passageway
description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
passageway seems to continue south and north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light\nthat far.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7057, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5c547e7e11c87f22", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb062a3c24bc9a0190"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light\nthat far.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7059, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5c547e7e11c87f22", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7cfd05d0615332dc"}

name: Stone Hall
description:
This is a roughly carved hallway. The air here is damp and musty. You
hear the sound of something dripping in the distance. Your footsteps
echo down the hall as you walk. There is a strange and deathly silence
that fills these halls...
To the south you see the steel bars of a cell.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the steel bars of a cell.", "keyword": "bars", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10445, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8b3d9fbca934ecde", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3fdcdbca6a19fa7d"}

name: Conservatory
description:
You are in the tower's private conservatory. However, through years of neglect,
the plants have grown into a hideous jungle.  The only exit is north.

name: The Valley of the Elves
description: You are in the Valley of the Elves.  The valley continues in all directions.

name: A tall dwelling
description:
This seems to be the tallest structure remaining in the city. At
one time this could have been an inn of some sort, but now it's just
a mess. The back wall as been completely knocked down revealing an
entrance into another building through yet another collapsed wall.
Between the two buildings are a few blast craters and boulders. An old
set of wooden steps leads up to a creaking second floor.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A small side street winds past the dwelling.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5211, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2b228e788cb4f405", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc10aef51a598d6a6"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "The stairs and even the entire second floor itself looks very unsafe\nfor travel. Gusts of wind make them creak and shudder.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5245, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2b228e788cb4f405", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb00df8125511a6c24"}

name: The antechamber
description:
You are in the antechamber of the master magician of the grey light. A
feeling of strong magic floats in the air about you, almost as if you could
taste the power held within these walls.
Once your eyes adjust to the semi-light, you can make out a larger room
to the south.

name: A chicken coop
description:
You stand inside a rather crowded chicken coop.  The cackle of hens fill
the air.  The only exit is to the south.

name: The Dump
description:
This is the place where the people of the city dump their trash. Due to
the constant winds blowing down the moutains the smell is usually blown
outside the walls and over the desert.

name: The dark passageway
description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
passageway seems to continue south and north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light\nthat far.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7058, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7cfd05d0615332dc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5c547e7e11c87f22"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light\nthat far.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7060, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7cfd05d0615332dc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbccb02b6fdadc8aa3"}

name: Stone Hall
description:
This is a roughly carved hallway. The air here is damp and musty. You
hear the sound of something dripping in the distance. Your footsteps
echo down the hall as you walk. There is a strange and deathly silence
that fills these halls...
The hallway contines to the south and the west.

name: The Valley of the Elves
description: You are in the Valley of the Elves.  The valley continues in all directions.

name: The Dining Hall
description:
You have entered a fabulous dining hall.  The wrecked remains of a long table
dominate the room. A horrible odor pervades the room, like some foul-smelling
beast has been eating and shitting in here.  There is a serving hatch west and
a door south.

name: A small shack
description:
This cramped dwelling could not have housed more than one person. Now
with the back wall missing, it could hold many more. Looking around you
find broken shelves and workbenches with various vials and pouches spilling
contents all across the floor. This was possibly the magic shop of the
city. The doorway to the east is blocked, making the only exit back west.

name: The Green Dragon
description:
Welcome to the Green Dragon, the undisputed leader in the art of
innkeeping.  A rather charming and friendly hostess stands to the side,
ready to offer you food and drink.  While most of the patrons are halfling
locals, you spy an occasional human or two.  As you listen more closely
to the conversations that fill the inn, you hear the tales of great and
seasoned adventurers as well as the usual gossip.  You feel as if you've
found your second home in the Green Dragon.  You see a stairway leading
upwards.

name: The main chamber
description:
A feeling of tranquility comes over you as you enter the main chamber of
neutrality. Some artifacts are hung on the walls here, or set on stands.
The room in general looks both comfortable and official. Probably where the
master of neutrality holds audience.

name: The Mage's Laboratory
description:
You stand in the top of an old stone tower. Along the walls hundreds of
potions, scroll, and wands lie in disarray. The man you see before you
sits hunched over a small wooden table with two beakers of bubbling
liquid in front of him. He looks up as you enter and smiles broadly.

name: The dark passageway
description:
You can't see anything but the ground where you put your feet. The
passageway seems to continue west and north. To the east there's water
covering the floor and that leads through an arched entry to a watery
sewer.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "water", "description": "It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.", "valid": true}

name: Cell
description:
The cell is very damp and very musty. The walls are covered with moisture
and dirt. The smell of urine is very potent here.
The steel bars to the cell are to the south.

name: The Valley of the Elves
description: You are in the Valley of the Elves.  The valley continues in all directions.

name: Art Gallery
description:
You are in the ruined remains of an art gallery. Everything appears to
have been stolen long ago, however.  The only exit is north.

name: Shiriff Post of Delving Lane
description:
You are in the Shiriff Post which acts as the nucleus for the three shiriffs
of Delving Lane.  As you examine the shiriffs on duty, you come to realize
that the halflings of the Shire are not to be reckoned with.  You cower with
awe.  The only exit is to the west.

name: The study
description:
You are in a large study. Shelves filled with many books or arcane
knowledge are on every wall. A large oaken desk is in the center, with
many parchments and scrolls on it. The most notable thing in the room is
a small set of scales, which floats about eye level. In perfect balance,
the scales are no doubt a sign of the master's neutrality.

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow back alley goes south to main street and north towards
a watchtower. A mass of howls catches you off guard.

name: The Hay Loft
description:
Not as big as the ones you see on farms in the country, this hay loft
serves as a storage area for the horses in the stables. The young boy
you saw with the shovel seems to have taken up residence on the second
story.

name: The Watery Sewer Bend
description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to bend and lead south and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "water", "description": "It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.", "valid": true}

name: Stone Hall
description:
This is a roughly carved hallway. The air here is damp and musty. You
hear the sound of something dripping in the distance. Your footsteps
echo down the hall as you walk. There is a strange and deathly silence
that fills these halls...
The hallway contines to the west and the east.

name: The Edge of the Valley
description:
You are at the edge of the Valley of the Elves.  High above you, you see a small
trail circling the entire valley.  The valley continues south and west.

name: A dark tunnel
description:
You stand inside a small underground tunnel.  The ceiling is so low that
you must crouch to avoid hitting your head.  You see light from a small
hole in the ceiling while to the east you see nothing but darkness.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see a portal which leads to a small room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1125, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6163b3e73a97e1d4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb93c55eba8444f89c"}

name: Base of the Eastern Tower
description:
You stand in the center of the Eastern tower's base. Torch brackets occupy the
four corners of this huge room.  Above each torch is a lifelike ornate stone
gargoyle.  There are are open doors to the north and south, and passages east
and west.  In addition, a spiral staircase leads up to the next level of this
tower.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see a spiral staircase leading up.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1635, "room_id": "69f4d0cb127496f18c157274", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbebf4a3a50f46ccd0"}

name: A closet
description:
You are in a small closet. It is filled with many cloaks, and some other
apparel.

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow back alley leads north to one of the city watchtowers
and south towards main street. To the west is a doorway to a small
house blocked by debris.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5241, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcf3bf2c50817d2f4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb480b858fc502394c"}

name: The Grand Entrance
description:
Nowhere have you seen such an obscene display of wealth than in this
corridor. The shag carpeting under your feet makes it seem as if you are
walking on a cloud. Platinum candelabras hang delicately from the ceiling
casting light on the ancient tapestries adorning the walls. The crick
in your neck tells you it's time to stop staring. To the west the
numerous halls of the palace begin and the gate lies to the east.

name: The Watery sewer
description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

name: The Edge of the Valley
description:
You are at the edge of the Valley of the Elves.  High above you, you see a small
trail circling the entire valley.  The valley continues south and east.

name: The Common Room
description:
You are in what must once have been a common room for all residents of the
tower. There is a huge fire pit with a chimney in the center, and the smashed
remains of a great many table and chairs.  The exit is south.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You notice a grate in the bottom of the fire pit.  Maybe it's an opening ...", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1634, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3d4a1aed02b0ddff", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5ebea6c07496fd80"}

name: A dark tunnel
description:
You stand inside a small underground tunnel.  The ceiling is so low that
you must crouch to avoid hitting your head.  The tunnel continues east and
west.  All you can see is darkness.

name: A bedroom
description:
You are in the bedroom of the master magician of neutrality. Curtained
windows can be seen on the south wall. A large comfortable looking bed
takes up most of the room.

name: Under a watchtower
description:
You stand under a tall watchtower. Narrow back alleys lead west and
south and a very weak looking ladder leads up into the tower.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "Winds howl high above your head in the tower above.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5248, "room_id": "69f4d0cb480b858fc502394c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb324502b7a6899b0a"}

name: The Library
description:
This building holds the vast collection of books and documents that
have been brought here by the committee appointed to recover the
lost knowledge of Thalos.  Rows of shelves, filled with book in every
condition, lines the walls.  The air has the aroma of old parchment and
glue.

name: The Watery sewer
description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

name: A dark tunnel
description:
You stand inside a small underground tunnel.  The ceiling is so low that
you must crouch to avoid hitting your head.  The tunnel continues east and
west.  All you can see is darkness.

name: Cell
description:
The cell is very damp and very musty. The walls are covered with moisture
and dirt. The smell of urine is very potent here.
The steel bars to the cell are to the west.

name: The Edge of the Valley
description:
You are in the Valley of the Elves.  The valley continues in all directions.
To the north, a small, narrow trail leads away from the valley.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A small trail leads away from the valley.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7826, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9375e40f596d2125", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb367491197d6ee8ed"}

name: Servant's Quarters
description:
You are in what once was the servant's quarters, as evidenced by the shabby
belongings and decor. What little remains is rotting and of little value
anyway.  The only exit is north.

name: A dark hallway
description:
You are in a long dark hallway leading east and west. Not much can be
seen in the unnatural darkness here, but you get a deep sense of dread
the further you go.

name: A bath house
description:
This was once the bath house for the commoners of the city. Hot
steamy water still wells up from a hole in the floor. Obviously there
is a hot spring located under the city (making the decision to put
a city here seem much more reasonable). Closer inspection of the water
yields a dead body floating around in it, skin melted away from months
of floating in there. The west wall has collapsed revealing another
collapsed house.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The wall has collapsed on the adjoining house, creating a new opening\nin it.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5244, "room_id": "69f4d0cbeb9dc63138db66ca", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3f729d1f804be5c1"}

name: The Dance Hall
description:
You seem to have missed a huge party.  The janitors are here cleaning up
the confetti and cigarette butts.  Hundreds of empty beer mugs on the
tables surrounding the dance floor suggest that the citizens love their
drink.  There is still a banner on the wall.

name: A three way intersection
description:
You stand at an intersection.  The tunnel continues east and west while
to the north you can barely make out a smaller trail.

name: The Watery Sewer Junction
description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead into a junction going south, north and east.

name: Hidden Room
description:
This is a long forgotten room. Ancient torture equipment stands around
collecting dust. Most of this stuff was probably replace with modern
hi tech torture devices and for sentimental reasons wasn't thrown away.

name: The Edge of the Valley
description:
You are at the edge of the Valley of the Elves.  High above you, you see a small
trail circling the entire valley.  The valley continues south and west.

name: A Large Murky Cellar
description:
You are in a large, murky cellar. An almost tangible air of horror pervades
the room.  A thin layer of nitre covers the walls and ceiling.  Rotting
furniture looms obliquely about the room.

name: A dark hallway
description:
You are in a long dark hallway leading east and west. Not much can be
seen in the unnatural darkness here, but you get a deep sense of dread
the further you go.

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow back alley leads west to a small side street and east to one
of the city watchtowers. Great amounts of steam issue forth from the
building to the south.

name: Jail
description:
You are in jail. For some reason the god's feel you've screwed up
pretty bad and should be put away safely for a while.

name: The Watery sewer
description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

name: On the First Staircase
description:
You are on a Spiral staircase connecting the first and second levels of
the eastern tower. You can go up or down.

name: Stone Hall
description:
This is a roughly carved hallway. The air here is damp and musty. You
hear the sound of something dripping in the distance. Your footsteps
echo down the hall as you walk. There is a strange and deathly silence
that fills these halls...
The hallway contines to the north and east.

name: End of a dark tunnel
description:
You stand at the end of a dark tunnel.  The underground tunnel continues
to the west.  From a trapdoor in the ceiling you can hear the din of
adventurers.

name: A Trail Leading from the Valley
description:
You are on a narrow trail leading away from the Valley of the Elves.  This
trail leads north and south.  A rope ladder leads up to a rope bridge.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The trail leads back to the valley.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7824, "room_id": "69f4d0cb367491197d6ee8ed", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9375e40f596d2125"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "You see the rope bridge above you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7858, "room_id": "69f4d0cb367491197d6ee8ed", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb5678d51038b7cf62"}

name: The end of the hallway
description:
You are at the end of a long dark hallway. The darkness here is almost
tangible in its thickness. A deep sense of fear and loathing comes over
you.
A pair of obsidian doors can be seen to the east.

name: An upright house
description:
This home is practically the only one around that is still standing.
Except for the massive hole in the east wall, everything else looks
intact, including the windows. Great amounts of steam issue forth from
the hole in the east wall.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A small side street runs past the house.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5210, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3f729d1f804be5c1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb75430afdacb70730"}

name: City Hall
description:
You stand inside the administrative head of the city. Here the decisions
regarding city policy are made. Although the Sultan's word is law, he
usually spends his time on affairs outside the city wall.

name: Second Level of the Eastern Tower
description:
You are in the center of the second level of the Eastern tower. This large
room appears quite empty, except for the candle abras firmly fixed to the
walls.  An opening leads westward, and a spiral staircase leads down.

name: The Watery sewer junction
description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead into a junction that goes north, south and east.

The hallway contines to the east and west.
The bars to a cell are to the north.

name: A dark tunnel
description:
You stand inside a small underground tunnel.  The ceiling is so low that
you must crouch to avoid hitting your head.  The tunnel continues north and
south.  To the west you see a Shirriff Post while to the east lies a small
home.  All you can see is darkness.

name: Along the Trail
description:
You are on the trail away from the Valley of the Elves.  The hills around you
keep this trail narrow.  The trail continues east, south, and west.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The trail continues south back toward the valley.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7826, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcc13dc599c8a09f7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb367491197d6ee8ed"}

name: The chamber of darkness
description:
You are in a vast chamber. The walls fade into darkness, leaving you
with a very vague idea of the actual size of the room. Swirling here and
there in the dark, are patches of pure black which seem to suck in your
light and leave it that much darker here.

name: The Boyer/Fletcher's
description:
The walls in this room are covered with pegs that hold various types of
bows.  There are few people working here, lending to the fact that
the skills are rare to come by in the general populous.  A few boys are
busy in the corner preparing feathers for the fine shafts used in making
arrows.  Some Elven craftsmen are carefuly inspecting each bow as it is
finished.

name: On the second floor
description:
The minute you step off onto this floor you realize it was a mistake.
The old rotted floorboards suddenly give way and you fall down, impaling
yourself on jagged boards below.

You've fallen, and you can't get up!!!

name: The Elegant Hall
description:
You are in what was once a elegant hall, although everything is moldering now.
The rotted remains of a plush carpet covers the floor, while several moldy
tapestries adorn the each side of the hall.  There are door north and south,
and openings east and west.

name: Stone Hall
description:
This is a roughly carved hallway. The air here is damp and musty. You
hear the sound of something dripping in the distance. Your footsteps
echo down the hall as you walk. There is a strange and deathly silence
that fills these halls...
The hallway contines to the north and west.

name: The Watery sewer
description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to lead south and north.

name: A dark tunnel
description:
You stand inside a small underground tunnel.  The ceiling is so low that
you must crouch to avoid hitting your head.  The tunnel continues north and
south.  To the west lies a small home.  All you can see is darkness.

name: A Bend in the Trail
description:
You are on the trail away from the Valley of the Elves.  The hills around you
keep this trail narrow.  The trail continues north and back west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "The trail goes back to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7827, "room_id": "69f4d0cba53e33c075b2a46f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcc13dc599c8a09f7"}

name: The Mason's
description:
There is no doubt that the Dwarves here know what they're doing.  They
have been invaluable in the building of this beautiful city.  Here they
are hard at work doing what they do best.  The hammers fly in a blur as
these talented craftsmen work the stone into ornate bricks, pillars, trim,
and many other forms.

name: It is very dark here...
description: It is very dark here...

name: The north-west watchtower
description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent
from here and you can see all the way to the western mountains. No wonder
this place stood for so long.

name: Cell
description:
The cell is very damp and very musty. The walls are covered with moisture
and dirt. The smell of urine is very potent here.
The steel bars to the cell are to the north.

name: The Shaman's Room
description:
You have entered an elegantly furnished room that looks to be still in use!
Costly paintings and pieces of furniture are tastefully situated.  On the
north wall is an altar to Knar, the ghastly patron of Gargoyles.  The only
exit is south.

name: The Watery sewer bend
description:
You can't see anything but the water you're in up to your hips. The sewer
seems to bend and lead west and north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "water", "description": "It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light\nthat far.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7067, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1c131256fd13b70d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb756e684bab8ff518"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can't see anything in that direction and your light isn't enough to light\nthat far.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7060, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1c131256fd13b70d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbccb02b6fdadc8aa3"}

name: Shiriff Post of the Lower Shire
description:
You are in the shiriff Post which acts as the nucleus for the three shiriffs
of the Lower Shire.  As you examine the shiriffs on duty, you come to realize
that the halflings of the Shire are not to be reckoned with.  You cower with
awe.  The only exit is to the east.

name: A Smaller Valley
description:
You are in another valley within these hills. To the north, you can see a
building, and to the south you see the trail away from this valley.  The
west and east paths surround this building.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the trail around the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7831, "room_id": "69f4d0cb614bddce2de2f16a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8353a2e1e84d6a11"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see the trail leading away from this valley.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7828, "room_id": "69f4d0cb614bddce2de2f16a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba53e33c075b2a46f"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see the trail around the building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7830, "room_id": "69f4d0cb614bddce2de2f16a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba61fe3f7bf9948d0"}

name: Guard House
description:
You stand inside the southern of the two main guard houses. The stone
interior has a spartan look to it, only the bare neccesities. A few
weapons are mounted on the walls in case they might be needed.

name: Torture chamber
description:
You are in an ill lit chamber. Instruments of torture hang from a rack
on the wall, they seem to quiver with anticipation of a victim as if they
had a mind of their own. An operating table is here, though it is bare.
An extreme feeling of evil permeates the entire area.

name: The south-west watchtower
description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent
from here and you can see all the way to the western mountains. To the
south the desert stretches to the horizon. No wonder this place stood
for so long.

name: Stone Hall
description:
This is a roughly carved hallway. The air here is damp and musty. You
hear the sound of something dripping in the distance. Your footsteps
echo down the hall as you walk. There is a strange and deathly silence
that fills these halls...
The hallway contines to the north and east.

name: A ledge by the dark pool
description:
You can't see much here but the echo tells you that there's quite a drop
down. You can just make out a huge dark pool out there in the darkness,
mostly because of the trickling of water. The water from the sewer actually
washes over this ledge and makes it quite slippery. From here it drops,
like a waterfall, into the pool far down.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "water", "description": "It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You can't see a thing. It's too dark.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7070, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc8021897fe1e8f0e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9f11a9306508e468"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can't see a thing. It's too dark.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7064, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc8021897fe1e8f0e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf2ff5dee0d3cf2b9"}

name: A halfling hole
description:
You stand inside a rather crudely built halfling hole.  The many passageways
and winding paths remind you of a rodent's lair.  The air is musty and damp
and you feel the need for fresh air.

name: The Library
description:
This room appears to have been a library.  Empty book shelves line each wall.
The only exit is north.

name: A Trail in the Valley
description:
You are on the trail in the Valley of the Elves.  This trail leads north and
east.  To the north-east is a building.

name: The Palace Gate
description:
You stand before a magnificantly crafted gate wrought in solid gold. You
gape in awe at the splendor of the spiraling towers beyond the portal. The
ruler of all the eastern lands resides in this fine palace, and he is not
a poor man. The grand entrance lies byond the gate, and Sultan's walk is
to the east.

name: The inner chamber
description:
You are in a small dark chamber. Upon the walls are glowing sigils of
dark power, scrawled and traced in an evil language no longer known to most
of this plane of existence. There is an obsidian altar here which seems to
glow, but does not shed any light, in fact it seems to be taking light in.

name: The north-east watchtower
description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent
from here and you can see a great floating pyramid to the north-east.
Desert sand stretches to the horizon. No wonder this place stood for so
long.

name: Stone Hall
description:
This is a roughly carved hallway. The air here is damp and musty. You
hear the sound of something dripping in the distance. Your footsteps
echo down the hall as you walk. There is a strange and deathly silence
that fills these halls...
The hallway contines to the east and west.
You see bars to a cell to the north.

name: A ledge by the dark pool
description:
You can't see much here but the echo tells you that there's quite a drop
down. You can just make out a huge dark pool out there in the darkness,
mostly because of the trickling of water. The water from the sewer actually
washes over this ledge and makes it quite slippery. From here it drops,
like a waterfall, into the pool far down. Under you there is a small fissure
in the rock. It seems big enough to contain a few people.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "water", "description": "It looks dark and murky, and emanates a foul stench.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can't see a thing. It's too dark.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7069, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9f11a9306508e468", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc8021897fe1e8f0e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can't see a thing. It's too dark.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7066, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9f11a9306508e468", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4a56e0cbe5cbd797"}

name: A halfling hole
description:
You stand inside a rather crudely built halfling hole.  The many passageways
and winding paths remind you of a rodent's lair.  The air is musty and damp
and you feel the need for fresh air.

name: Second Level of the Western Tower
description:
You are in the center of the western tower's second floor.  A large spiral
staircase of 29 steps connects this level with the third.  There are doors
to the east and west.  Except for a torch bracket in each corner, the
room is barren.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see the spiral staircase leading up.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1642, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2ef228dd865d5a93", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb64b605346ac89ce7"}

name: A Trail in the Valley
description:
You are on the trail in the Valley of the Elves.  This trail leads west and
east.  To the north is a building.

name: North-West Tower
description:
You stand on one of the four towers guarding the city. The view from here
is great! To the west you see the tall mountains that make up the divide
between here an Midgaard. The Ishtar river slowly flows from that direction.
South you can see the entire city of New Thalos and the Sands of Sorrow
to the south.

name: The Temple of Thalos
description:
You stand within one of the most holy places in the realm. This
stunning domed temple once housed the city's worshipers en masse.
Unfortunately, it succumbed to the destruction brought on this city.
Long benches lie toppled and the altar desecrated. Large chunks of stone
have fallen from the walls and roof, sending sunlight streaming in on
you. A few books lie about, conveying to you a holy message in a
strange tongue.
Wind gusts through the four archways and howls and screams can be
heard from all parts of the city.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A side street leads to the northern half of the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5205, "room_id": "69f4d0cb653b5ea7ff596215", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7cb16d8c28f6a23b"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "Main street leads out to the main gate of the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5203, "room_id": "69f4d0cb653b5ea7ff596215", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb31f3fa6b2a3f6d03"}

name: A bright hallway
description:
You are in a long well lit hallway leading east and west. The walls here
are a milky white color, and glow with a warm luminescence, as does the
floor. A feeling of goodness permeates the area, and you feel unworthy to
tread upon these sacred floors.

name: Stone Hall
description:
This is a roughly carved hallway. The air here is damp and musty. You
hear the sound of something dripping in the distance. Your footsteps
echo down the hall as you walk. There is a strange and deathly silence
that fills these halls...
The hallway contines to the north and west.

name: End of a dark tunnel
description:
You are at one end of a dark tunnel.  The tunnel continues to the south
while on the ceiling you can make out a trapdoor.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "A trapdoor on the ceiling reveals a passageway.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1137, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2742450b18800ee7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf34046f355f9f4a7"}

name: The fissure under the ledge
description:
This is a small fissure in the solid rock. Under you lies the deep dark pool.
The water trickles quietly down from the ledge above you. The water smells
like the water in a sewer.

name: On the Balcony
description:
You are on the balcony overlooking the Grand lobby.  You have a fabulous
view of the entire room.  The only exit is the way you came in.

name: Guard House
description:
You stand inside the northern of the two main guard houses. Strong
guards are seated here, playing cards. The stone interior is clean
but bare walled save the weapons and armor mounted in the walls.
The only exit is south.

name: A Trail in the Valley
description:
You are on the trail in the Valley of the Elves.  This trail leads north and
south.  To the east is a building.

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow alley leads east to a wider street and west to one of
the city watchtowers.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5252, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb52b8ead0ba1c699", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0c89c2164eea5f95"}

name: A bright hallway
description:
You are in a long well lit hallway leading east and west. The walls here
are a milky white color, and glow with a warm luminescence, as does the
floor. A feeling of goodness permeates the area, and you feel unworthy to
tread upon these sacred floors.
A huge set of double doors in finely worked ivory can be seen to the west.

name: Cell
description:
The cell is very damp and very musty. The walls are covered with moisture
and dirt. The smell of urine is very potent here.
The steel bars to the cell are to the north.

name: The Inn of the Green Dragon
description:
You are standing in the Inn of the Green dragon.  Large paintings of
halflings at work, and halflings at play adorn the walls.  Comfortable
benches and seats line the walls.  A stairway leads down.

name: Under the mudhole
description:
You stand in a small room with a great big opening in the ceiling. From this
opening there's mud dripping down in large lumps. >YUCK<. You can smell the
foul stench of the slimy sediment as you try not to get covered by the
falling sludge. To the east there is an entryway leading out from here and
it seems absolutely impossible to force the muddy descent.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "You never saw such disgusting matter before, it nearly makes you puke.", "valid": true}

name: The Spiral Stairs
description:
You are on a large spiral staircase of 29 steps, leading between the
second and third floors.  You can go up or down.

name: Kitchen
description:
Your footsteps echo off the stone tiles of the kitchen. On the south wall
you see the large fireplace and a huge copper pot bubbling merrily. The
chef is busy chopping up greens and other vegetables at the wooden table
for tonight's meal. Servants scurry about grabbing utensils and preparing
fresh hares. A small door leads out into the hall northward and the door
to the dining hall is west.

name: A Trail in the Valley
description:
You are on the trail in the Valley of the Elves.  This trail leads north and
west.  To the north-west is a building.

name: Under a ruined watchtower
description:
You stand at the base of a tall watchtower built to protect the city
from invaders. From the looks of things, it did not do a good job.

name: An antechamber
description:
You are in a small antechamber. It is well lit here, though the source
of light cannot be seen. It is almost as if the room itself exudes a warm
glow of goodness. A larger chamber can be seen to the west, but you do not
feel worthy to pass into it.

name: Hot Stairs
description:
You are standing on a long stairway. The air around you is heavy and hot.
The stone walls are hot to the touch and your sweat sizzles as it hits the
ground. Cool air flows out from a crack in the wall to the east.
The smell of brimstone and smoke is all around you.
The stairs continue down.

name: Under the Dark Pit
description:
Nice place you found yourself. You stand in the middle of a room with only
two exits, Up and East. A tall ladder is left here so that you can climb
up through the Pit without the use of a rope.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "ladder", "description": "This is funny enough a wooden ladder and, after closer inspection, you\ndiscover it is magically held towards the wall! You can't, even with your\ngreatest effort, rock it at ALL!", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "Up. You can't see a thing up there, it's way too dark.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7004, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6bd2efa0207fe790", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdec58e9b70c60239"}

name: Third Level of Western Tower
description:
You stand in the center of the western tower's third floor.  This large room
glows mysteriously with a strange light all its own.  From a door to the east
comes a strange inky blackness.  A spiral staircase leads down.

name: The Elf Home
description:
You are in the home of the valley elves.  The building continues to the north
and the east, and the exit is to the south.

name: North-East Tower
description:
You stand on one of the four towers guarding the city. To the north you
see the wide plains and then the forest. South of here you see the city
and the great eastern desert beyond.

name: A back alley
description: A narrow alley leads south to one of the city watchtowers.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "A tall watchtower stands a silent vigil over the city.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5252, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8c19b09ed096dad0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0c89c2164eea5f95"}

name: The chamber of the white light
description:
You are in a vast chamber, its walls floor and ceiling are of an unknown
metallic material, the brightest white, almost blindingly stark. A flickering
flame is in the center of the room, seeming to feed off of darkness and
cleansing the room of any evil. You feel a slight tug at your being as the
flame flickers towards you.

name: Crack in Wall
description:
This is a rather large crack in the wall. On closer inspection it appears to be
a passageway that was closed off long ago. It was probably reopened by
an earthquake or something.
An ancient passageway continues to the north.
Hot gusts of air come from the west.

name: A muddy bend in the sewer system
description:
You are standing in what looks like a bend in the pipe system of the
sewer. The 'floor' is covered completely by mud! This includes covering
your legs up to your knees as well. The pipe leads west and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "You never saw such disgusting matter before, it nearly makes you puke.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "To the south there's less mud than here! It actually seems to end there!\nYou have a feeling it would be nice to have your feet free from mud again.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7104, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4eea274cf39fd601", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba96e1e23f7b90733"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can see a room in which mud drips from the roof onto the floor in\ngreat cakes of sludge. There doesn't seem to be any exits from that room\napart from in you direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7101, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4eea274cf39fd601", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc57663c8194d3af4"}

name: Hall
description:
You are at the eastern end of the southern hallway. A small servants'
entrance give access to the kitchen and the hall continues west.

name: It's too dark to see anything!
The Kitchen
description:
You are in a community kitchen for this valley elven home.  Pots and pans line
the walls, along with shelves filled with many foodstuffs.  A big oven is to one
side, and you can smell elfcakes being baked.
There is a doorway to the north and one to the west.

name: The meditation chamber
description:
You are in a small meditation chamber. White silk cushions are everywhere,
looking very comfortable. You get an easy peaceful feeling of relaxation
here, almost making you want to lie down and fall asleep.

name: The south-east watchtower
description:
You stand atop one of the city watchtowers. The view is magnificent
from here and you can see all the way to the western mountains. To the
south the desert stretches to the horizon. No wonder this place stood
for so long.  There is a small plaque on the stones.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign plaque", "description": "This extension to Thalos, along with the dwarf forest, is made by Hatchet for\nany Merc Mud.\ncopyright 1992", "valid": true}

name: Stone Arch
description:
Before you stands the a large stone arch decorated with many runes you
cannot decifer. It looks as though it has been closed up for a long time.
To the east is a hallway of fire.
To the south you see a large metal door with the words, 'FOREMAN'
written on the door.
There is a dark stairway down in the corner of the room.

name: A junction in the sewer pipes
description:
You stand in the middle of what looks like a triple junction of pipes
going east, west and north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can see a mud area starting in that direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7103, "room_id": "69f4d0cba96e1e23f7b90733", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4eea274cf39fd601"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "East. You can't even make out what it might look like, it's just too dark.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7112, "room_id": "69f4d0cba96e1e23f7b90733", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb899fe270ddbf7aeb"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "West. There's a room with a ladder leading up.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7102, "room_id": "69f4d0cba96e1e23f7b90733", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6bd2efa0207fe790"}

name: The Tanner's Guild
description:
You first notice the pungent smell of freshly tanned leather goods as
you enter this strange place.  The next thing that grabs your attention
is the many colors that these people have transformed the beautiful
skins into.  The people are stretching the leather and cutting it into
the shapes they need.  You notice a small message on a wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "message", "description": "I hate being a Tanner", "valid": true}

name: The Armory
description:
In this room, which has somehow evaded the ravages of time, are neatly stored
racks of common weapons.  They appear to be quite ordinary; however, a chest
in one corner catches your eye.  The only exit is the way you came in.

name: A Trail in the Valley
description:
You are on the trail in the Valley of the Elves.  This trail leads north and
south.  To the west is a building.

name: A study
description:
You are in a spacious study. It is extremely tidy here, to an almost
antiseptic nature. One would wonder how anyone could study without a
mess all around them, the master of this chamber obviously can.

name: A back alley
description:
A narrow alley leads north to the main street, and south toward a tall
watchtower.  A ruined building is to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "It looks in bad shape inside, but structurally intact.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5235, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8c81a134fe341933", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb26f4ea7ab6513cb9"}

name: Hall of Fire
description:
You are standing in a hallway made of fire. The walls are ablaze with
yellow and blue flames. The smell of the hot air and sulfur burn your
lungs as you inhale, and dry your mouth as you exhale. The stone floor
burns at your feet and hungrily drinks up every drop of sweat as they
fall from your body.
The hall of fire continues to the east.
You see a stone archway to the west.

name: Down the old well
description:
You are dangling on the slippery sides of the old well leading down and up.
The only secure point here is the metal bars that are cemented into the
sides, the ones that you cling frantically to so that you don't fall. Who
knows how deep this well is?
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bars", "description": "These look like they're pretty slippery, and not very safe.  You'd better\nnot go down any further.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "There's a slight, dim light from above, or maybe it's your imagination.\nAnyway it SEEMS darker down here than up there, if that is possible.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7015, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd2590f766965847e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb33d6196b2a8621a5"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "Down there nothing at all can be spotted. The darkness that engulfs this
descent seems utterly impossible in a mortal world. It's so thick that a
torch down there would be utterly useless.  You'd better not go down any
further.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": -1, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd2590f766965847e", "to_room_id": null}

name: Hall
description:
You have come to the eastern end of the northern hallway. The only exit
is west except for the simple wooden door to the north. There is a
golden plaque above the door.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "plaque", "description": "The Holy Shrine of Allah


(remember Allah is a god, I wouldn't attack him)", "valid": true}

name: The Officer's Quarters
description:
You have entered a lavish but functional room decked out in a military style.
Murals on the wall show battle scenes in gargoyles, minotaurs, and huge,
flying snake-like reptiles with poisonous tails fight humans and dwarves.
Various objects in the room give evidence that it is occupied by individuals
of authority.  The only door is north.

name: A closet
description:
You are in a small closet. Cloaks and vests hang from hooks in the wall,
and a few old boots are all that can be seen here. Rather featureless.

name: A Trail in the Valley
description:
You are on the trail in the Valley of the Elves.  This trail leads north and
south.  To the east is a building.

name: A trail at the end of the dwarf forest
description:
The trail ends here, with short, dry stumps of trees all around you.
To the west, you can see the ruins of a huge city.  Something about it gives
you an uneasy feeling.  To the east is your way back to home and safety.

name: Hall of Fire
description:
You are standing in a hallway made of fire. The walls are ablaze with
yellow and blue flames. The smell of the hot air and sulfur burn your
lungs as you inhale, and dry your mouth as you exhale. The stone floor
burns at your feet and hungrily drinks up every drop of sweat as they
fall from your body.
The hall of fire continues to the south and west.

name: The northwestern corner of the ledge
description:
You stand, swaying out from the ledge, with only a couple of inches of safe,
solid ledge under your feet. The ledge continues to the east but not back
south. It seems that the ledge is too narrow to turn on so you'll have to
continue forward.

name: Shrine of Allah
description:
As you step into this room you seem to leave the material plane. The
walls here are decorated with beautiful, multi-colored tiles. There
is a strange stillness about the air. You sense the presence of an
almighty being.

name: Third Level of Eastern Tower
description:
You are in the center of the Eastern Tower's third floor.  The room you are in
glows with a mysterious light that has no source.  In the center of the room a
ladder climbs up to a hatchway in the ceiling.  The hatchway is a strange
looking keyhole.  There is also a door to the west.
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "The hatchway appears securely fastened.  In it is a strange keyhole.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 1648, "room_id": "69f4d0cb42431121edf04cae", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb115b9117bbb3519d"}

name: A wide hallway
description:
You are in a large hallway, wide enough to accommodate several people
standing abreast. The floor here is a swirl of multicolored patterns, in
constant motion.
A huge grey metal door blocks the way north, it looks quite sturdy.

name: The Living Room
description:
You are in the living room of the elven home.  Mats cover the floor, and a
on a table is a bowl full of fruits.  Through the window you can see the
valley, with its wild flowers and tall, green grasses.

name: A trail at the end of the dwarf forest
description:
A side trail here leads from the dwarf forest.  It is definitely drier
and hotter here.  The trail continues to the west, and to the east, you see
the T-intersection.

name: Construction Area
description:
This part of Hell seems to be under repair. Workers are fixing and replacing
what look like various gas mains and other pipework. You can see many
gas lines and electrical conduits within the dismantled walls. Partially
hidden fire sprinklers are being installed in the ceilings.
You see more contruction to the east and south.

name: Turret of the Eastern Tower
description:
You stand in the turret of the eastern tower.  A huge hole has been
made in the roof by some enormous beast, letting the daylight (or moonlight)
in.  There is a hatchway in the floor, and an opening to the west leading out
onto a catwalk.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "There is a small opening this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1649, "room_id": "69f4d0cb115b9117bbb3519d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb9084cce3891a06b1"}

name: Outside the Northern Gate of New Thalos
description:
You stand outside the gate of New Thalos. The city lies to the south, and
wilderness to the north.  The Sands of Sorrow continues to the east
and west.

name: The narrow ledge
description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "North. The ledge leads into a corner and turns eastward.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7106, "room_id": "69f4d0cb760a10eedb933984", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbffe19f19addd6bb0"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but\ndarkness. You shiver by the thought of falling an utterly unknown distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7190, "room_id": "69f4d0cb760a10eedb933984", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba634cc7c1f2a918f"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "South. The ledge leads further south into utter darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7108, "room_id": "69f4d0cb760a10eedb933984", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe646550d415da738"}

name: A wide hallway
description:
You are in a large hallway, wide enough to accommodate several people
standing abreast. The floor here is a swirl of multicolored patterns, in
constant motion.
A huge black obsidian door blocks the way north, it looks quite sturdy.

name: The Storage Room
description:
You are in the storage room of the elven home.  Sacks of flour cover one side,
and cleaning accessories cover the other side.  You find nothing of use here.
A staircase leads up.

name: The dwarf forest
description:
You see more stunted trees here.  A side trail leads west from here.
To the east, you THINK you see a trail, but you can never be sure.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the trail lead back north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5259, "room_id": "69f4d0cba5d968cd6ab2c1ef", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb178a9daa2ab368fa"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You can't see into the gloom of this forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5262, "room_id": "69f4d0cba5d968cd6ab2c1ef", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd3dc01a8ed593db1"}

You see more contruction to the east and west.

name: On the Catwalk
description:
You are outdoors on a catwalk between the turrets of the eastern and
western towers.  There is a 40 foot drop to the north and south.  You have
a fabulous view of the surrounding countryside, which consists of a bleak
wilderness.  At the east end of the catwalk is a small opening leading
inside the eastern turret.  At the western end, a strange mirror-like portal
leads into the western turret.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A mirror-like portal glimmers, allowing entry into the western turret.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1650, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9084cce3891a06b1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0e9a6334b07d9351"}

standing abreast. The floor here is a swirl of multicolored patterns, in
constant motion.
A huge white ivory door blocks the way north, it looks quite sturdy.

name: Outside the Eastern Gate of New Thalos
description:
You stand outside the protective walls of the city. The massive iron gate
sits to the west and the unknown awaits you eastward.

name: A Trail in the Valley
description:
You are on the trail in the Valley of the Elves.  This trail leads north and
south.  To the west is a building.

name: Construction Area
description:
This part of Hell seems to be under repair. Workers are fixing and replacing
what look like various gas mains and other pipework. You can see many
gas lines and electrical conduits within the dismantled walls. Partially
hidden fire sprinklers are being installed in the ceilings.
You see more contruction to the south and west.

name: The dwarf forest
description:
You see more stunted trees here.  It looks almost as if this place was
cursed by a god to be short and dry.  The trail leads north and south.

name: The narrow ledge
description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
