You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7190, "room_id": "69f4d0cba5a5b06e618f399c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba634cc7c1f2a918f"}

name: Turret of the Western Tower
description:
You are in the turret of the western tower.  You feel very strange here.
Scattered about this room are a great many coins and valuable articles.
Yet you can't get rid of a feeling of dread!  A mirror-like portal is in the
western wall.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "A mirror-like portal glimmers in this wall.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1651, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0e9a6334b07d9351", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbac170056dc1d7d79"}

name: The entranceway
description:
You are at the entrance to the audience chamber of the grand master of
magic. Beautiful tapestries displaying the ancient masters of lore are on
the walls, and the floor is covered with a plush multicolored carpet, which
seems to rustle and move at the touch of your boots.

name: Outside the West Gate of New Thalos
description:
You stand outside the city walls, the iron gate to the east. The city lies
in that direction and the road to Midgaard lies west.

name: A Trail in the Valley
description:
You are on the trail in the Valley of the Elves.  This trail leads south and
east.  To the south-east is a building.

name: Hall of Fire
description:
You are standing in a hallway made of fire. The walls are ablaze with
yellow and blue flames. The smell of the hot air and sulfur burn your
lungs as you inhale, and dry your mouth as you exhale. The stone floor
burns at your feet and hungrily drinks up every drop of sweat as they
fall from your body.
The hall of fire continues to the east and south.

name: The dwarf forest
description:
You see more stunted trees here.  It looks almost as if this place was
cursed by a god to be short and dry.  The trail leads north and south.

name: The narrow ledge
description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but\ndarkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7190, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9a103d33c0792296", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba634cc7c1f2a918f"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "South. You can just make out the south-western corner of this ledge.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7111, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9a103d33c0792296", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb19de8b681a90f70d"}

name: The audience chamber
description:
You are in a large chamber. Small bolts of energy leap from wall to wall,
crackling with power. The floor is a swirl of indeterminable colors and
patterns ever changing. Bright bursts of color seem to explode into the air
and fade again at random times. All this splendor plays about and draws
attention to a large throne in the center of the room, it seems to be cut
from a single enormous emerald.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "throne", "description": "The giant emerald is flawless, and must be incredibly valuable.", "valid": true}

name: On the Other Side
description:
You are outdoors on a catwalk between the turrets of the Eastern and Western
towers.  There is no opening into the western tower of any kind.  You have a
fabulous view of your surroundings, a murky city partially obscured by strange
smoke that creeps along the ground instead of rising. The city stretches as far
as the eye can see under the conditions.

name: Outside the wall
description:
You are in a small clearing outside the east wall of the city. The
ground seems well trodden but you can see no apparent exit save that
north.

name: A Trail in the Valley
description:
You are on the trail in the Valley of the Elves.  This trail leads west and
east.  To the south is a building.

name: Hall of Fire
description:
You are standing in a hallway made of fire. The walls are ablaze with
yellow and blue flames. The smell of the hot air and sulfur burn your
lungs as you inhale, and dry your mouth as you exhale. The stone floor
burns at your feet and hungrily drinks up every drop of sweat as they
fall from your body.
The hall of fire continues to the west.
A room full of fire pits lies to the east.
A wall of fire crackles merrily to the south.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a room full of fire pits.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10460, "room_id": "69f4d0cb21d8f9fb7629465d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbcf987e4e79178adc"}

name: The dwarf forest
description:
You see many stunted trees here.  You don't see any leaves on these barren
trees.  No grass grows on the ground.

name: A dressing room
description:
You are in a plush dressing room. Fine garments of many styles and some
outlandish colors hang from a rack suspended in mid air at eye level. The
only other interesting feature in the room is a large silver mirror on a
finely crafted gold stand.

name: The southwestern corner of the ledge
description:
This seems like a ledge that is a little broader than the one just to the
north of here. The ledge seems to lead around some sort of Abyss of total
darkness. The ledge seems to have an odd-looking edge here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "edge odd-looking", "description": "This is truly a weird piece of craftsmanship in your eyes. The edge seems to\nform a step leading down, but WHAT a STEP DOWN. The Abyss opens down there\nleading to seemingly total destruction.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a broad ledge leading eastward.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7115, "room_id": "69f4d0cb19de8b681a90f70d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba4e3230e742db28b"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "South of here is the exit from the ledge.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7112, "room_id": "69f4d0cb19de8b681a90f70d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb899fe270ddbf7aeb"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "The Abyss lies down there. Who knows what might lurk down there?", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7279, "room_id": "69f4d0cb19de8b681a90f70d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc2bcc130c97bbaf6"}

name: The Chamber
description:
You are in a small carpeted chamber. The chamber is empty except for a single
chair facing a mirror on the wall.

name: Grand Dining Hall
description:
A long oaken table, coverd with silverware, plates, and a tablecloth
with gold trim, dominates the room. Although no diners occupy the room
as of yet, servants sprint about setting the table and placing condiments.
The kitchen entrance is to the east, and two huge double doors open into
the hallway north.

name: A Trail in the Valley
description:
You are on the trail in the Valley of the Elves.  This trail leads east and
west.  To the south is a building.

name: Fire Pits of Hades
description:
This room is filled with many small fire pits. Countless damned souls are
being burnt and roasted within the the white flames that erupt from the
many pits. Wailing and screams of pain chill your bones in this hot room.
To the south you see a lake of fire.
A fire hall lies to the west.

name: The dwarf forest
description:
You see more stunted trees here.  It looks almost as if this place was
cursed by a god to be short and dry.  The trail leads east and west.  It looks
dark toward the east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a darker part of the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5263, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd3dc01a8ed593db1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbeac07dc317bb9c22"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see the lighter forest and the T-intersection west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5258, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd3dc01a8ed593db1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba5d968cd6ab2c1ef"}

name: An odd intersection
description:
You stand in a rather odd intersection of pipes. The pipes actually don't
resemble pipes anymore. They look more like a real stone tunnel, or a
passageway hewn directly into the rock. The ways from here lead north, east
and west.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "North. You see a ledge to something that looks like an abyss.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7111, "room_id": "69f4d0cb899fe270ddbf7aeb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb19de8b681a90f70d"}

name: The library
description:
You are in a small cozy looking library. A few well made books sit atop
shelves which span every wall. A large oaken writing table is in the center
of the room with odd papers and parchments on it. The illumination here,
to your surprise is a quite un-magical oil lamp.

name: Hall
description:
You stand at a T-crossing in the long hallways. There are two
large double doors to the south.

name: Main Eastern Road
description:
You are on the old Eastern Road.  The crossroads to the east joins ANOTHER
northern route to this road, which continues east.  South of the crossroads is
an old building.  The area around here is lightly timbered.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a cross roads and an old building.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1702, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0ccd9e3e3b542cf4", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7b7848e4774346ad"}

name: A Trail in the Valley
description:
You are on the trail in the Valley of the Elves.  This trail leads south and
west.  To the south-west is a building.

name: Fire Mural
description:
Apon all the walls of this room is an enormous mural. Pictures of burning
bodies and tortured souls seem to be the main theme of the art. Bright reds
and hot blues are enphasized throughout the mural. As you stare at it the
characters within it seem to move and struggle in pain. The hot air around
you smells of sulfur and methane. To the south you see a stone hallway.
Hot air blows in at you from the doorway. The air stirs up the methane and
steals your breath. You choke and gag...

name: The narrow ledge going east to west
description:
You are in the process of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but\ndarkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7190, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe68314b1e9ad444f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba634cc7c1f2a918f"}

name: The darker dwarf forest
description:
You see a more dense foliage in these stunted trees.  The gloom caused
by them is enhanced by a draft coming from all around.  The trail turns south
from the west.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see nothing in the gloom south of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5264, "room_id": "69f4d0cbeac07dc317bb9c22", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb31009c6203781d29"}

name: Hall
description:
You stand at an intersection of the hallways. Wooden corridors lead off in
all directions except west; the garden of the palace can be entered there.

name: Crossroads to the Wilderness
description:
You are at a crossroads to the wilderness areas east and north of here,
and the more civilized areas to the west. The main road is west, an
older road continues east, and a simple trail heads north.  To the south,
an old ram-shackle building is being used as a trading post for the
surrounding wilderness.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The old Eastern road continues this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1601, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7b7848e4774346ad", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4fd38e155ff35f2e"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "An old, ram-shackle building serves as a trading post here.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1703, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7b7848e4774346ad", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc0b293c76fad1dc0"}

name: The altar
description:
You are in a small chapel designed around a beautifully crafted golden
altar. Many icons to lesser deities line the room, but it is obvious by one
glance at the symbols on the altar, that this room was designed for the
worship of Mystra, the goddess of magic.

name: The Elders' Room
description:
You are in the room of the valley elf elders.  Books written in strange
languages line the numerous shelves, and scrolls cover a table.  There is a
smooth spheric object in the center of the room.

name: Foreman's Office
description:
You stand in a crudly constructed office. Blueprints and change orders are
scattered everywhere. A metal filing cabinet stands in the corner. Before
you stands a stone table covered with blueprints. On the wall is a
construction plaque that reads, "4th DEMONsion Contruction"
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the door to the office.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10452, "room_id": "69f4d0cb989efbf9b58e130b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb164403f13321b42d"}

name: Mid-air
description:
You've just stepped into the most unlucky position in the whole of Merc Mud.
The result of such a foolish act should be punished with death, you know.
With an acceleration of approximately 9.82 metres per second per second, you
are now descending the Abyss. What awaits you at the bottom will continue to
be a mystery. Bye Cruel World.

You've fallen, and you can't get up!!!

name: The darker dwarf forest
description:
You see a more dense foliage in these stunted trees.  The gloom caused
by them is enhanced by a draft coming from all around.  The trail turns east
from the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see nothing in the gloom north of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5263, "room_id": "69f4d0cb31009c6203781d29", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbeac07dc317bb9c22"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You see nothing in the gloom east of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5265, "room_id": "69f4d0cb31009c6203781d29", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2077beb29c00dec2"}

name: Hall
description:
You have come to a T-crossing on the hallways. The wooden corridors
continue east, west and south. There is a large iron door to the north.

name: Trading Post
description:
You are in a trading post just south of the crossroads, where rangers,
trappers and hunters from the surrounding area come to buy, sell, and
barter goods.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The door opens out on the crossroads.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1702, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc0b293c76fad1dc0", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7b7848e4774346ad"}

name: The treasury
description:
You are in a small chamber, the stale air here is testament to the fact
that it has gone undisturbed for many years.

name: The Storage Room
description: You are in a storage room.  Many useless (to you) items fill this room.

name: Cold Stairway
description:
You stand apon a cold stone stairway. Hot air blows down on you from
higher up the stairwell. From below you a freezing gusts bite at your skin
and make you shiver. Icicles drip slowly from the ceiling onto the frosted
stone floor.

name: The Broad ledge
description:
You are standing on a ledge that seems quite a lot larger than the rest
of the ledges. This one leads to the west and the east, plus it has an exit
going to the south. Though you could jump into mid-air, but it probably
wouldn't be such a good idea. The way south is in utter darkness.

name: The darker dwarf forest
description:
You see a more dense foliage in these stunted trees.  The gloom caused
by them is enhanced by a draft coming from all around.  The trail leads
east and west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see nothing in the gloom east of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5266, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2077beb29c00dec2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb96040b2f63979d03"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see nothing in the gloom west of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5264, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2077beb29c00dec2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb31009c6203781d29"}

name: Entrance to the Dungeon
description:
You enter a cold damp room with bare, roughly hewn stone walls. This
room seems very out of place compared to the splender of the rest of the
palace. A large steel grating leads down into darkness, and an iron door
returns you to the hallway.

name: Trail north of crossroads
description:
You are on a primitive north-south trail. South of here is a major cross-
roads and an old building. To the north the trail continues toward a
deep, dark forest.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The trail continues toward a deep, dark, forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1705, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1bffde37d8a7048d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb314a90cd10877b65"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "A major crossroads and a building lie in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1702, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1bffde37d8a7048d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7b7848e4774346ad"}

name: A passage
description:
You are in a small dark passage, which would be unremarkable if not for
the fact that it ends in a blinding blue light to the west. On hooks set
into the wall here there hang several travel worthy cloaks, and a small
leather backpack.  It looks as if someone has prepared this room to be used
in the event speedy of a evacuation.

name: The Sleeping Quarters
description:
You are in the sleeping quarters of the valley elves.  Cots line the floor,
with two windows showing a view of the valley.  Books in strange languages
line the shelves, but nothing of interest is here.

name: Hall of Fire
description:
You are standing in a hallway made of fire. The walls are ablaze with
yellow and blue flames. The smell of the hot air and sulfur burn your
lungs as you inhale, and dry your mouth as you exhale. The stone floor
burns at your feet and hungrily drinks up every drop of sweat as they
fall from your body.
The hall of fire continues to the north and east.

name: The northeastern corner of the ledge
description:
You stand, swaying out from the ledge, with only a couple of inches of safe,
solid ledge under your feet. The ledge continues to the west and leads south
from here into darkness.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "ground ledge rock", "description": "The ground here seems a little different from all the other ledges along the\nAbyss. There's a kind of soft soil on this ledge, maybe you should look\ncarefully at this. It seems to be of some interest.", "valid": true}

name: The darker dwarf forest
description:
You see a more dense foliage in these stunted trees.  The gloom caused
by them is enhanced by a draft coming from all around.  The trail leads
down into a valley and west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see nothing in the gloom west of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5265, "room_id": "69f4d0cb96040b2f63979d03", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2077beb29c00dec2"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see the trail lead down into gloom.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5267, "room_id": "69f4d0cb96040b2f63979d03", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf064037013cea84e"}

name: Trail south of forest
description:
You are on a primitive north-south trail.  Just north of here looms the
entrance to a deep, dark forest. To the south the trail continues.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "The trail enters a dark forest of thick oaks this way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1706, "room_id": "69f4d0cb314a90cd10877b65", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7413d911815dc37d"}

name: Guest Room
description:
This is a simple room used for visiting noblemen. A small dresser stands
on the east wall with a mirror hung right above it. A queen sized bed made
up in satin sheets stands in the middle of the room against the south
wall under a window. The only obvious exit is north back out into the
hallway.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mirror", "description": "You see a the fighting image of some armor clad humanoid wielding a weapon.", "valid": true}

name: In the light
description:
You seem to be floating in a magical energy field, though you cannot see
the source of the energy, you can feel its power pushing at you from all
sides, completely negating the effects of gravity.
An imperfection in the uniform blue can be seen overhead, it might be an
exit.

name: Study
description:
You are in the study room of the valley elves.  Comfortable mats are on the
floor, and musical instruments are neatly stacked on shelves.  Books in
strange languages line some other elves.  A stairway leads down to the
first floor.

name: Construction Area
description:
This part of Hell seems to be under repair. Workers are fixing and replacing
what look like various gas mains and other pipework. You can see many
gas lines and electrical conduits within the dismantled walls. Partially
hidden fire sprinklers are being installed in the ceilings.
You see more contruction to the north and east.
A hall of fire is to the west.

name: The narrow eastern ledge
description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards. And THAT is west of here so watch your step.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but\ndarkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7114, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5cb454816498b69e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb21a810771974e16b"}

name: A valley in the dark dwarf forest
description:
You are in a valley in the dark dwarf forest.  Short black grass grows
around you.  Trails lead in all directions.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a large mountain on the far side of a canyon.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 9201, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf064037013cea84e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1cf771a7d08c4e38"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a dark fox hole.", "keyword": "hole fox", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5268, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf064037013cea84e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6e3c3854bba4894b"}

name: Hall
description:
The long hall continues here with a wooden door in the south wall. On the
north wall hangs the picture of some forgotten nobleman who once ruled
the land.

name: Entrance to the forest
description:
You are at the entrance to dark forest comprised mostly of huge black oak
and towering firs.  A trail from the south continues north on into the
woods at this point.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the trail continuing into the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1707, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7413d911815dc37d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb83936b5b8f34ea70"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see the trail head back on south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1705, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7413d911815dc37d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb314a90cd10877b65"}

name: Skylar's Hideout
description:
You are in a small, very messy room. An unmade bed is against one wall, and
books and papers cover every available flat surface. Empty beer cans lie here
and there, discarded with total abandon. A few over full ashtrays can be seen
on a desk.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You can see mortals pitifully begging for help below.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": -1, "room_id": "69f4d0cb93426863a77cfecb", "to_room_id": null}

name: Along a Windy Trail on the Rim of the Valley
description:
You are on a narrow trail on the rim of the Valley of the Elves.  Below you,
you can see the valley, filled with wild flowers and tall, green grasses.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "The trail down doesn't look safe to travel on at all.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7883, "room_id": "69f4d0cba0cdbbfa9abf5882", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd35ec6858d65f0d1"}

name: A small ugly cave
description:
You see a small cave.  Skeletons of many types of creatures litter the area.
Obviously, no fox lives here!  The oppression makes you want to leave and
vomit.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "skeleton skeletons", "description": "Something is strange about these skeletons.  Upon further investigation, these\nskeletons appear illusionary.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the exit from here!", "keyword": "fox hole", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5267, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6e3c3854bba4894b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf064037013cea84e"}

name: Garden
description:
You have entered the Sultan's private gardens. A light sweat breaks out
on your skin from the humidity here. All around you are thousands of
exotic plants and flowers. The sweet smell of jasmine and honeysuckle
reminds you of happier days at home. Off to the north, through the palm
trees, you see a delicate white gazebo. To your right stands a gold sign.
A path leads out into the hallway and west towards the gazebo.

name: Trail in Dark Oak Forest
description:
The trail here passes through groves of closely knit Black Oak. Some of
these trees are of enormous size.  Rustling and other low noises come
from the forest on either side of the trail.  The trail continues on north
and south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the trail continue into thick, dark forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1708, "room_id": "69f4d0cb83936b5b8f34ea70", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb80a4a9bf5edac9b"}

name: A small ugly cave
description:
You are in a small ugly cave.  More skeletons lie around.  It is obvious
that the owner doesn't want you here.  The exit north is still visible.
Some writings are on this wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "writings writing words", "description": "This cave along with the valley and dwarf forest is made by Hatchet for any\nMerc Mud.\ncopyright 1992", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see a path leading down into the dark gloom.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5270, "room_id": "69f4d0cba549e60cef4ba583", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb6029f98d56033ab"}

name: Hall
description:
The long stretch of hallway continues east and west from here. The small
red carpet covering the centerline is always underfoot and an occasional
bench or potted plant lines the wall. There is a door here to the north
with a plaque mounted over it.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "plaque", "description": "ART EXHIBIT
of
NEW THALOS


-management is not responsible for lost items.", "valid": true}

name: Junction in Dark Forest
description:
You are in the midst of a deep dark forest of huge oak trees.  There is a
junction of trails here, with paths leading south, west and east.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the path to the Centaur village.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1709, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb80a4a9bf5edac9b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8d41d3dcf3475ca2"}

name: Hall of Fire
description:
You are standing in a hallway made of fire. The walls are ablaze with
yellow and blue flames. The smell of the hot air and sulfur burn your
lungs as you inhale, and dry your mouth as you exhale. The stone floor
burns at your feet and hungrily drinks up every drop of sweat as they
fall from your body.
The hall of fire continues to the north.
There are loud noises of contruction to the west.

name: Art Exhibit
description:
You are standing in the Sultan's tribute to the finer virtues. Large
paintings hang from the walls displaying nature scenes, nudes, and
glorious victories in battle. Strange scupltures rest on pedestals
at each corner of the room and mirrors are placed in strategic
locations so the viewer may see an entire sculpture at a glance. Your
eyes, however, are pulled towards a painting that dominates the far wall.

name: The narrow eastern ledge
description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since there's
no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards. And THAT is west of here so watch your step.
You also see a small opening to the east.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but\ndarkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7114, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe3a17131722ad2c7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb21a810771974e16b"}

name: Down the path into a dead end
description:
You are down the path.  There is no obvious exit in this place, exit the
one back up north.  All around you, you see skeletons.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "skeleton skeletons", "description": "Something is strange about these skeletons.  Upon further investigation, these\nskeletons appear illusionary.  In fact, through the skeletons, you see a\nsecret door!!", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see your only way back up.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5269, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb6029f98d56033ab", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba549e60cef4ba583"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see nothing on the floor except skeletons.", "keyword": "secret", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 5100, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb6029f98d56033ab", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2c017dd6941de15f"}

name: Path to Centaur Village
description:
You are on an east-west path in the forest.  Here the forest is mostly
towering firs, not quite as dense as the oak groves that can be seen eastward.
Westward, the trail heads toward a small clearing.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "There is a small clearing in this direction.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1710, "room_id": "69f4d0cb8d41d3dcf3475ca2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0bc573b718e54d29"}

description:
You are on a narrow trail on the rim of the Valley of the Elves.  Below you,
you can see the valley, filled with wild flowers and tall, green grasses.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "The trail down doesn't look safe to travel on at all.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7883, "room_id": "69f4d0cb54af8a87ccf29724", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd35ec6858d65f0d1"}

name: Wall of Fire
description:
This large room is cut in into sections by small walls of fire. The walls
to move slowly changing the layout of the room. As you examine the room
further you notice various posts around the room to which people are
chained. The firewalls seem to move in patterns that leave the poor
people directly in the path of the oncoming fire. The walls seem to creep
ever so slowly towards them. The people blister and scream as the fire gets
closer. Their deaths seem like minutes of agony and pain, and even as they
burst into flames they seem incapable of grasping the merciful attention of
death...
To the north you see a hall of fire.
To the east you see a lake of fire.

name: The southeastern corner of the ledge
description:
This seems like a ledge that is a little broader than the one just to the
north of here. The ledge seems to lead around some sort of abyss of total
darkness.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "North of here you can see a ledge.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7120, "room_id": "69f4d0cb48eee262d2f400b2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe3a17131722ad2c7"}

name: Guest Room
description:
This is another room made up for visiting nobles. There is a dresser up
against the eastern wall with a mirror above it and a queen sized bed,
made up in satin sheets, against the south wall.

name: The Valley in the dark dwarf forest
description:
You are in a valley in the forest.  To the north is a trail out of this
dark valley.  South is more of this valley.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a trail away from this gloomy valley.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5272, "room_id": "69f4d0cb826d3ce733fa0c9c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb27613ddcf18b5cf9"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see more of this gloomy valley.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5267, "room_id": "69f4d0cb826d3ce733fa0c9c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf064037013cea84e"}

name: The East side of the Centaur Clearing
description:
You are on the east side of a clearing.  Small primitive huts are scattered
about the edges of this clearing.  Beyond these on all sides are towering
fir trees.  A path leads east out of the clearing. The clearing continues to
the west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A path leads away through the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1709, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0bc573b718e54d29", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb8d41d3dcf3475ca2"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see the west side of the clearing.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1711, "room_id": "69f4d0cb0bc573b718e54d29", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe62ea08ebb80f588"}

name: Along a Windy Trail on the Rim of the Valley
description:
You are on a narrow trail on the rim of the Valley of the Elves.  Below you,
you can see the valley, filled with wild flowers and tall, green grasses.
A safe trail leads down into the valley.

name: Lake of Fire
description:
You stand one the shore of a large lake of fire. The smoke and heat fill this
enormous room. You can barely make out shapes of something moving
withing the dancing flames of blue and gold..

name: Under the pit
description: You stand in a completely dark cavern leading west. The wall looks weird here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "wall", "description": "There is a crack here that looks like it has been made recently.", "valid": true}

name: A dim trail in the dwarf forest
description:
You are in a dim trail in the dwarf forest.  Not much light passes through
here.  To the south is a gloomy valley, while to the north the light grows
brighter.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can actually see the trail north of you!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5273, "room_id": "69f4d0cb27613ddcf18b5cf9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf6d4360b3a0c814b"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You can barely see the gloomy valley south of you.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5271, "room_id": "69f4d0cb27613ddcf18b5cf9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb826d3ce733fa0c9c"}

name: Hall
description:
You have reached the western end of the southern hallway. The only exit
is east except for the doors in the southern and western walls.

name: West side of the Centaur Clearing
description:
You are on the west side of the clearing in the center of the Centaur village.
Huts surround the clearing on all sides, and beyond are towering firs.  The
clearing continues to the east.  To the west is a very large hut.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the east side of the clearing.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1710, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe62ea08ebb80f588", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0bc573b718e54d29"}

name: Hot Hall
description:
The stone floor below you heats your feet uncomfortably. The ceiling and
walls glow a dull red and you sweat uncomfortably under the heat.

name: Under The Shaft
description:
A ladder leads up from here to the Shaft.
A small opening leads west from here.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You can see a narrow ledge going north and south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7120, "room_id": "69f4d0cb23e0561d8bc52817", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe3a17131722ad2c7"}

name: A dim trail in the dwarf forest
description:
You are in a dim trail in the dwarf forest.  Not much light passes through
here.  The trail runs north and south, and the light seems to come from the
north.  To the east, you see a small path into darkness.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the dim trail lead north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5274, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf6d4360b3a0c814b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6af12052116651fe"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see the dim trail lead south.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5272, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf6d4360b3a0c814b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb27613ddcf18b5cf9"}

name: A Centaur's Hut
description:
You are inside a smallish hut, the home of a family of Centaurs.  The hut
is sparsely furnished, mostly the trappings of survival.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "The opening leads out onto the clearing.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 1710, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2eda1817b07f5268", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0bc573b718e54d29"}

name: Garden Gazebo
description:
Walking through the gardens you come across a small white wooden structure.
The sounds of birds, the smell of flowers, ahhh paradise. You believe
you have never been in a more peaceful setting.

name: Along a Windy Trail on the Rim of the Valley
description:
You are on a narrow trail on the rim of the Valley of the Elves.  Below you,
you can see the valley, filled with wild flowers and tall, green grasses.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "The trail down doesn't look safe to travel on at all.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 7883, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7c0c8402ef5fa780", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd35ec6858d65f0d1"}

name: The sewer line.
description:
You are in a narrow part of the sewer. Down the sewer continues and to the
north is the ledge.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can see the southern part of the ledge.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7115, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1c9e4cbfed9b281c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba4e3230e742db28b"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You look deeper down into the drain.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7221, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1c9e4cbfed9b281c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb26f36bacb5cd68e9"}

name: Icy Landing
description:
This landing is made entirely of ice. Its walls bear carvings of battle and
hunting scenes in bas-relief. These carved scenes show ice devils slaying
angels, hunting mortals and other gruesome pictures.
To the east you see a room of ice.

name: A Centaur's Hut
description:
You are inside a smallish hut, the home of a family of Centaurs.  The hut
is sparsely furnished, mostly the trappings of survival.

name: Hall
description:
This is the western end of the northern hallway. Two doors are set in the
walls here, one to the north, another to the west.

description:
You are on a narrow trail on the rim of the Valley of the Elves.  Below you,
you can see the valley, filled with wild flowers and tall, green grasses.

name: Ice Room
description:
You are standing in a room of ice. Icicles of every size hang from the
ceiling. Some shake with every sound. Your reflection off the ice walls
seems to dance and wiggle as you move about.
To the south you see more of the frozen room.
To the west you see an Icy landing.

name: The sewer pipe.
description:
You are in an odd sewer pipe You see some odd scratches on the pipe wall, as
from a gigantic rat. You can see some slimy water gently running down into
a sewer drain, and north the drain continues.

name: Guard Room
description:
You stand in a barren chamber lined with nothing but cots and footlockers.
The guards come here when off duty to sleep, for they may only leave the
palace grounds with special permission. The only exit is to the south.

name: A Centaur's Hut
description:

description:

than the one leading south.

name: Mid-air
description:
You've just stepped into the most unlucky position in the whole of DikuMUD.
The result of such a foolish act should be punished with death, you know.
With an acceleration of approximately 9.82 metres per second per second, you
are now descending the Abyss. What awaits you at the bottom will continue to
be a mystery. Bye Cruel World.

You've fallen, and you can't get up!!!

name: Meat Locker
description:
You are standing in what looks like a meat locker. Rows of beef and other
meats hang from large steel hooks. You also notice that many of the
things hanging from the hooks are corpses of people. They reach out to
you as you pass them as if to plead for help from their frozen mouths.
The meat locker continues to the east and south.

name: Guard Room
description:
This is living quarters for the guards of the palace. Barren compared to
the rest of the palace, you see only cots and footlockers here. On the
walls you see pictures of well known knights who have given a proud name
to the Sultan's Guard.

name: A trail in the dwarf forest
description:
You are in a trail in the dwarf forest.  The trees are stunted and it
looks dry around here.  The trail leads east and west.  It looks dimmer to
the east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The trail continues east to the dimmer parts of the forest.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": 0, "to_room_vnum": 5275, "room_id": "69f4d0cb987f3ac8022c9ed1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb993a861705539d40"}

name: On the Rope Bridge
description:
You are on the rope bridge.  From here, you can see the whole Valley of the
Elves.  To the south, you see the main valley.  To the north-east, you see a
smaller valley with a building in the center of it.  To the north-west, you
can see a very small valley with a shack in it's center.  A rope ladder
leads down into a trail.

name: The Edge of the Water
description:
The pool side is dimly lit up by your light. You can see absolutely nothing
else nearby. The darkness here seems enormously oppressive. The air is
damp and the rock on which you stand is slippery. The pool seems too dark
to make anything clear. The rock can be climbed upwards from here.

name: Meat Locker
description:
Rows of beef and other meats hang from large steel hooks. You notice that
many of the things hanging from the hooks are corpses of people. They
reach out to you as you pass them as if to plead for help from their frozen
mouths.
The meat locker continues to the south and west.
There is a freezer door to the east.

name: Harem
description:
This is the room where the Sultan keeps the beautiful women of his palace.
There are ten girls here lying about the room dressed in silks you can
almost see through. In the western end of the room stands a large mound
of pillows and a beautiful young maiden sits perched atop. It is
unfortunate for you that only the Sultan is allowed in here.

name: A trail in the dwarf forest
description:
You are in a trail in the dwarf forest.  The trees are stunted and it
looks dry around here.  The trail leads east and west.

name: Entrance to a Large Hut
description:
You are in the entry foyer of a large hut.  A curtain separates this section
of the hut from the next section to the west.  To the east is an opening out
onto the clearing.

the wall.  The ceiling has a funny glow, which enables you to see.  You can
get back into the inner lair through the stone door which is east.

description:

the room pecking at many poor souls half trapped in the icy floor. You
seem to be outside, as the walls are painted to seem as if you are standing
on a vast icy slab with nothing but ocean around you.
The iceberg continues to the south and east.
There is a freezer door to the west.

the front of the hut to the east.  This room is finely decorated, if
somewhat primitive.  The decor suggests someone of authority lives here.

description:
You are in a bend in the trail in the forest.  The trees are stunted, but
not so dry around here.  The trail leads east, and to the south, you see a
waterfall.

name: Throne Room
description:
You stand in the throne room of the mighty Sultan of New Thalos. Guards
stand at attention near his side ready to make the ultimate sacrifice for
their beloved leader. The gold inlaid throne studded with jewels stands
upon a mable dias. The Sultan is not a man to be trifled with.

name: Eastern Path in Dark Forest
description:
You are on an east-west path through extremely old growths of oak.  The path
is fairly faint here.  Undergrowth closes in so closely that little can
be seen in any direction.

see a lot of slime. On the wall is a torch sitting in its sconce. To the north

description:
You have somhow managed to gain access to the treaure vault of the Sultan.
The alarm sounding in the background tells you that you must have
tripped off some kind of alarm system. It might be adviseable to grab
as much stuff as you possibly can and run for the door.

name: Ice Creamery
description:
You appear to be standing in a ice-creamery. Many ice-cream workers run
frantically around tending to the various machines.
The factory continues to the east and south.

name: A dark bend in the forest
description:
You are in a dark bend in the forest.  To the west, you see the trail
leading back to the dwarven forest, and to the south, you see a dark and
dismal path.

name: By the beautiful waterfall
description:
You see a VERY beautiful waterfall here.  It looks almost as if diamonds are
falling down the mountain.  (You reach out and grab and no, it IS only water.)
It looks so nice here, you feel like taking a nap.
The trail leads north and south.

name: Jailer's Room
description:
Climbing down the old wooden ladder you enter a small cave-like
room. There is a small bench with some old magazines and a low
burning candle sitting off to one side. A door is set into the
stone on the east wall, and the steel grating opens up above.

name: Ice Creamery
description:
You appear to be standing in a ice-creamery. There seems to be a
group of people here shouting into containers and then quickly covering
them. How odd...
The factory continues to the south and west.
There is a steel door to the east.

description:
You are on a narrow trail on the rim of the Valley of the Elves.  Below you,
you can see the valley, filled with wild flowers and tall, green grasses.
A safe trail leads down into the valley.

portraits of demons and devils in business suits adorn the walls on either
side of you.
The hall continues to the south.

description:
You are standing in a room of ice. Icicles of every size hang from the
ceiling. Some shake with every sound. Your reflection off the ice walls
seems to dance and wiggle as you move about.
To the north and west you see more of the frozen room.
To the east you see a freezer door.

name: Secret Cell
description:
This room seems more like a lair than a cell. Small bits of hay lie
strewn about the floor covering bones of unkown origin. Spatterd blood
and tufts of grey hair lie matted in one corner. As you turn to leave
you notice a pair of small red eyes peering at you from the darkness.

name: Meat Locker
description:
You stand in a large meat locker. Chunks of meat hang on the wall and
larger corpses hang from steel hooks. Frozen blood and other
unrecognizable pieces are littered on the floor.
The meat locker continues to the north and east.
There is a freezer door to the west.

cooking over it.  You see nothing valuable.

name: A dry sewer drain.
description: You are in a dry but dirty sewer drain. The drain continues east and south.

name: Small Altar
description:
This is the private prayer room of the high priest. a small altar stands
against the west wall. Evil symbols and pictures are plastered everywhere.
The new propaganda posters for Hell are posted behind the altar.
You see a blackened hall to the east.

name: Saska's Library
description:
Fine, golden dust swirls and then settles as you enter Saska's
library. Leatherbound volumes of Shakespeare rest next to paperbacks by
Tom Robbins, and Toni Morrison's _Sula_ is open on the striking table: an
antique birdbath of polished blond wood, with glass set over the waterwell
to give the appearance of a perfectly still pool.  Trinkets, lightly
lifted from the mantles of the wealthy whose chimneys she cleaned, line
the windowsills and create space between the different sections of books.
A crystal oil lamp seems to float on the table; a piece of paper on the
wall, written in Saska's own lingering script, reads: "For what is your friend
that you would seek him with hours to kill?  Seek him always with hours to
live.  --Kahlil Gibran."
A cat purrs somewhere, though you cannot see the source, and you feel
yourself tugged into the softened space. Have a seat in one of the enormous
papasan chairs, and choose a title that strikes you.

name: Beneath the Small Shack
description:
You are beneath the small shack, in a tunnel that leads south.  It feels
quite warm down here.

name: A boring drain.
description: You are in yet another sewer drain.

description:
This hall looks as if it was burned out recently. The walls are charred and
smoking. Ashes and bits of burnt timber crunch under your feet as you
walk down the hall. A sign on the wall reads, 'No Non-smoking Please'.
The hall continues to the south.
There is a stone door to the east and a prayer room to the west.

name: Headwaters of the River of Lost Souls
description: The waters of the swamp pool in this low area and begin to flow southward.

name: The Den of the Pyrohydra
description:
You are in the den of the pyrohydra.  All the walls are charred, and this
room is filled with a smell close to that of burning tar.

name: Office of the High Priest
description:
This is the office of the High Priest of Hell. A black stone desk stands
before you. The office is lavishly furnished with gold, gems and many
antiques. A large portrait of a demons face is on the wall behind his desk.
You see a stone door to the west.

name: Ishtar River
description:
The river calms a bit after being thrashed in the interior of
the mountain. Although still deep within the rocks you can see
faint traces of green to the east.

name: The Workroom
description:
This room looks like it is used for magical studies.  Potions bubble over
burners, and the whole room spells of herbs and dead animal flesh.  A furnace
to the side casts a bright light in this room.  The whole room radiates with
a magical aura.

name: The Storage Room
description:
This room is used to store scrolls, potions, and other magical items.  The
whole room radiates with a magical aura.

The river begins its decent out of the mountains now and continues
its flow to the east.

name: WAY Far Down into the Valley
description:
You have fallen trying to go down this steep hill.  Maybe that wasn't that
good an idea, huh?


You've fallen, and you can't get up!

description:
You stand in a junction of three sewer drains. You see some odd scratches on
the pipe wall, as from a gigantic rat.North and south the sewer continues
as usual, but west it looks a little strange.
