name: Administration of Hell
description:
This is the entrance to the Administration offices of Hell. The secretaries
desk sits quietly in the middle of the room. To the south is a metal door
labeled, 'Authorized Personnel Only'
To the west is a large glass door.
There is a stairway down on the opposite side of the room.
There is a sign posted next to the stairs.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "sign", "description": "****ATTENTION***
The Abyss is CLOSED for construction.

We will open for your painful pleasures

soon....

-Strahd-", "valid": true}

name: Ishtar River
description:
The river flows under the wall of the city to the east and stretches
off towards high snow capped mountains far far to the west.

name: The sewer
description:
You are in a sewer, where the slimy water runs down through a tiny hole.
You see some odd scratches on the pipe wall, as from a gigantic rat. There
is a sewer drain south.

name: Halls of Judgement
description:
You are standing in the Halls of Judgement. There are many alcoves
which contain different methods of torture. Each more grotesque than
the one before it. On the wall a plaque reads, 'If you are here...You are
Guilty...You have been judged...sound fair? Too bad..'
The hall continues to the east.
The Courtroom is to the south.

name: Ishtar River
description:
The river flows out from the city down a long winding gully towards
the Sea of Dragons. To the south of you lies the great eastern desert
and north a wide open expanse of grass. You can just barely make out
a road that seems to be traveling alongside the river but the banks are
too steep for you to see very far.

name: The strange sewer
description:
You are in a very strange sewer indeed, there are some odd scratches on the
pipe wall, as from a gigantic rat. And you can see a lot of organic decay
like bones from animals AND humans. West the drain runs slightly upwards.

name: Halls of Judgement
description:
You are standing in the Halls of Judgement. There are many alcoves
which contain different methods of torture. Each more grotesque than
the one before it.
The hall continues to the east and west.
The hall of records is to the north.

name: Ishtar River
description:
The river continues its descent down the lowlands flowing
ever so gently south. It's hard to believe this is the same river that
came cascading down the mountainside.

name: The damp sewer
description:
You are in a sewer drain with a funny damp substance on the floor, in the
substance you see a lot of decay. You see some odd scratches on the wall, as
from a gigantic rat. Both to the east and west the pipe seems to run down.

name: Halls of Judgement
description:
You are standing in the Halls of Judgement. There are many alcoves
which contain different methods of torture. Each more grotesque than
the one before it.
The hall continues to the east and west.
The Office of Complaints is to the south.

name: Ishtar River
description:
Small animals and herd animals can be heard in the distance, though
you don't actually see any near the river. Perhaps the steep slopes
pervent them from using the river.

name: The strange sewer
description:
You are in an ordinary sewer except for a lot of scratches on the sewer wall,
ad a lot of debris on the floor.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "debris", "description": "You see a lot of organic decay on the floor.", "valid": true}

name: Halls of Judgement
description:
You are standing in the Halls of Judgement. There are many alcoves
which contain different methods of torture. Each more grotesque than
the one before it.
The hall continues to the east and west.

name: The River of Lost Souls
description:
The river flows south through a valley in the mountains. You can see a
small village to the west.

name: The sewer
description:
You are in a sewer with more scratches on the walls. And of course a whole lot
of decay. The drain runs east and north.

name: Halls of Judgement
description:
You are standing in the Halls of Judgement. There are many alcoves
which contain different methods of torture. Each more grotesque than
the one before it.
The hall continues to the east and west.

name: The River of Lost Souls
description:
The river flows south in the southern end of this wide valley. The walls
of the valley close in to the south.

name: The sewer drain
description:
You stand in in a sewer drain, you are able to see some kind of cave-like
room. You see some odd scratches on the drain wall, as from a gigantic rat.
The sewer leads south.

name: Blackened Hall
description:
This hall looks as if it was burned out recently. The walls are charred and
smoking. Ashes and bits of burnt timber crunch under your feet as you
walk down the hall. A sign on the wall reads, 'No Non-smoking Please'.
There are exits in all directions.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see the hallway of the Mall from Hell .", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10516, "room_id": "69f4d0cb710f708ed935e3ab", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbef44a3ac6f97f5e1"}

name: The River of Lost Souls
description:
The river begins to speed up as it cascades down this mountain
crevase. High above you a small rope bridge sways in the wind.

name: The rat's lair
description:
You are in a little cave. You are able to see quite a lot of debris on the
floor. There is a sewer drain west of here.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the sewer system that way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7233, "room_id": "69f4d0cb97cfb9137db511cb", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb040e807e99004d3b"}

name: Blackened Hall
description:
This hall looks as if it was burned out recently. The walls are charred and
smoking. Ashes and bits of burnt timber crunch under your feet as you
walk down the hall. A sign on the wall reads, 'No Non-smoking Please'.
The hallway continues to the east and west.

name: The River of Lost Souls
description:
The river rapidly flows down this crack in the side of the mountain
to the south. Hopefully you will hear any aproaching rapids.

name: The Wall of the Abyss
description:
You hang onto some steps leading down into utter darkness. There's an exit
leading up as well, though you'll have to open the tiny rock again to do so.

name: Blackened Hall
description:
This hall looks as if it was burned out recently. The walls are charred and
smoking. Ashes and bits of burnt timber crunch under your feet as you
walk down the hall. A sign on the wall reads, 'No Non-smoking Please'.
The hallway continues to the north and west.

name: The River of Lost Souls
description:
The river seems to calm a bit as the crevase widens lessens its
stranglehold on the waters. The river continues to the north
through a crack and flows to the south.

name: The entrance.
description:
You are in a very dark room. You notice that some faces are
staring at you from inside the walls. In the middle of the room
there is a small altar. To the north there is a small round
door.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "altar", "description": "This altar are very special. Faces are smiling from it. There\nis a triangle in top of it.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "A beam of red light seeps through a hole in the door.", "keyword": "small round door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7281, "room_id": "69f4d0cb108767b2f6b14c85", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbf504cb2d79de6ca9"}

name: Stairs to the Abyss
description:
These dark stairs are made out of the bones of the damned. They rattle
softly as you tread apon them as if to cry out in protest. The air is filled
with the wailing of lost souls and the blood curdling screams of the
punished.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see the eternal darkness of the Abyss.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10518, "room_id": "69f4d0cb1c3dc901ab8f3ead", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbe2fb71db892c0965"}

name: A Split in the River
description:
The waters of the river crash down upon a rock and split into
two bodies of water. The river you are on continues its southern
course and the new river heads off to the east. To the west you notice
a flat area in the sheer rock where it would be possible to shore your
craft. The River of lost souls also continues to the north.

name: The corridor.
description:
The corridor is glowing oppressively in a red hue. You can hear wailing
through an open black hole to the east. To the south there is a round door.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "small round door", "description": "The door is completely round without a keyhole.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "The hole seems more black than the night. It is appears to be \"eating\" the\nred light around it.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7282, "room_id": "69f4d0cbf504cb2d79de6ca9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb48e61cd59adeecbc"}

name: Maintenance Walkway
description:
This is a maintence accessway. You walk on a metal catwalk hundreds of
feet above the floor. The catwalk sways unsteadily as you walk on it.
The catwalk continues to the south.
To the north is a steel door.

name: The River of Lost Souls
description:
The river continues north and south from here through a water
eroded valley.

name: The Realm of lost souls
description:
You are standing in nothing. All around you there are stars.
Sometimes a shadow flies closely by you, wailing very loudly.
To the north there is a small bright hole. To the west there is
a small red hole.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "shadow", "description": "The shadow looks like a man in great pain.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You look into a very bright hole.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7283, "room_id": "69f4d0cb48e61cd59adeecbc", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb02bee7bb1e47e293"}

name: Court Room
description:
This is the Courts of Hell. Here you are convicted, sentenced and punished.
And no...you don't get a trial. You don't deserve one. The courtroom is
filled with spectators and jury members. They seem to have no real reason
to be here since there isn't going to be a trial. They jeer and boo you as you
stand in the middle of the courtroom.
To the north is the Halls of Judgement.
Behind the judges bench is a wooden door.

name: The River of Lost Souls
description:
The river continues north and south from here through a water
eroded valley.

name: The T-crossing
description:
You are in a small hallway. There are doors to the east and to
the west. To the south there are a black hole. There is writing
in the wall. Wails can be heard from the south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "writing", "description": "The writing says 'The one to the east, belongs to the beast.\nTo the west you will surely END your quest!'.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You can see a big fire to the west. It looks like a unhealthy\nplace to enter!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7284, "room_id": "69f4d0cb02bee7bb1e47e293", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb95991ffd1cc5dd6c"}

name: Lawyers Office
description:
As you look around you, you realize you've entered a lawyers office. Now
you know you are in Hell....Everything in this office seems to be made of
snakeskin. This is the only lawyers office in Hell, so if you don't  like them
you're out of luck. But then again...if you are in Hell...you must've run
out of luck a while ago.
To the east is the Office of Complaints.
To the south you see a courtyard.

name: The River of Lost Souls
description:
The river continues north and south from here through a water
eroded valley.

name: The firedeath
description:
This room is very hot. There are flames surrounding you.  You can
see no exits at all!  Skeletons are lying all over the floor.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "skeletons", "description": "The skeletons looks like they had suffered the death of hunger.\nOne of them looks like he has written something at the wall.", "valid": true}

name: The River of Lost Souls
description:
The river makes a sharp bend here and heads east towards a large
mountain and north through a valley.

name: Office of Complaints
description:
This is a relatively small office. There is a large hole in the wall where a
clerk usually sits and takes complaints about Hell. As you peek behind
the counter you see a large paper shredder and alot of shredded complaints.
a sign over the clerks desk reads, 'Hours: 12:00am - 12:01am'
To the west is a lawyers office.
To the north you see the Halls of Judgement.

name: The tortureroom.
description:
You are standing in a middle of a square room. Along the walls skeletons
are hanging in rusty chains. In the middle of the room there is a big metal
box, covered with dust. To the south you can just make out a small exit.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "skeletons", "description": "When you look at the skeletons, you can see that they once had been in great\npain. They are hanging in their arms, and some of them has been killed\nwith a sharp instrument.", "valid": true}

name: Ishtar River
description:
The river widens here, no longer bounded by rock, and flows east
towards a plain.

name: Pawn Shop
description:
You are standing in Hiramoto's Buy & Sell. This poor bastard has
been damned to Hell to serve the public for eternity. He will buy most
anything you have, since business is slow. Not many people visit
Hell. The store is filled with worthless junk. Piles of aluminum balls,
and bottle cap collections fill the corners of the room. Junk of
all kinds is scattered about the store.
To the east you see the Mall from Hell.

name: The hells yard
description:
You are standing in a lot of mud. A disgusting smell surrounds
the place, and makes you feel sick. Small flames sometimes shoot
up from the hot mud. To the west there is a small door. To the
north you can see an iron door.

name: Ishtar River
description:
The river continues here east to west.  There is a landing area to the
north where you can gain access to the shore.

name: Hallway of The Mall from Hell
description:
This is definitely the Mall from Hell...there are no stores!
Only in Hell would they have a mall with no stores.
To the east you see the Mall from Hell.
To the west you see Hiramoto's Buy & Sell.
The hall continues to the east and south.

name: The Entrance to the Realm of silence
description:
This is an utterly silent place. As you look around you see that there
hasn't been a living thing in a long time. The dust lies here in a thick
layer on the floor and on the furniture. On the wall hangs a bleak and
worn tapestry. A winding stone staircase leads up into darkness. On the
wall to the west you can see a huge torch stuck into the solid rock.
A large portcullis blocks your way to the north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "portcullis gate", "description": "This seems like an exceptionally heavy gate, made of thick iron.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "Through the portcullis, you can see a faintly lighted hallway leading east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": -1, "room_id": "69f4d0cb69e11528ce5c4dbd", "to_room_id": null}

name: Ishtar River
description:
The river meanders through the foothills of the eastern mountains.
The air is dryer on this side of the continental divide and it seems
a bit warmer.

name: Hallway of The Mall from Hell
description:
This is definitely the Mall from Hell...there are no stores!
Only in Hell would they have a mall with no stores.
To the north you see a blackened hallway.
To the east you see the office of Big Mouth.
The hallway continues to the west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see the office of Big Mouth.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10517, "room_id": "69f4d0cbef44a3ac6f97f5e1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb58de80b295f5805a"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see the hallways of the Mall from Hell.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10515, "room_id": "69f4d0cbef44a3ac6f97f5e1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4d2d206021c93089"}

name: On the walls of the Abyss
description:
You are clutching the steps on the wall so that you don't fall to the ground
down below.
A large sign says : I haven't gotten any further ... Yet. But  I'm pushing
to get finished with this sewer.
Greetings and Good Health :)

Redferne The Gentle
This stops your journey down, the only exit is up.

name: Ishtar River
description:
The river continues its journey eastward flowing through the
plains. To the west you see the peaks of large snow capped
mountains and to the east you see the outline of a large city.

name: The Office of Big Mouth
description:
This is the office of Big Mouth, head demon of Hell's Administration.
The room is decorated posters of naked women and autographed pictures
of famous tortured souls. Behind a large oaken desk sleeps Big Mouth.
This mouth looks large enough to step into if it were open. You wonder
what this guy eats...
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see the hallways of the Mall from Hell.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10516, "room_id": "69f4d0cb58de80b295f5805a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbef44a3ac6f97f5e1"}

{"direction": 5, "description": "You see Big Mouth's mouth.", "keyword": "mouth big mouth's", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10526, "room_id": "69f4d0cb58de80b295f5805a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc307aef796a21092"}

name: Cave entrance
description:
You are standing in the cave entrance. It is very dark
down here. There is writing at the wall. There is an exit
to the north. A stairway leads up.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "writing wall", "description": "The writing says 'BEWARE adventurer!'", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can see a small tunnel.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7401, "room_id": "69f4d0cb95c4ef16778926b3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdca99f7260bf585f"}

{"direction": 4, "description": "You can see the stairs going up into darkness.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7102, "room_id": "69f4d0cb95c4ef16778926b3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6bd2efa0207fe790"}

name: Ishtar River
description: The river flows east and west from here.

name: Stairs to the Abyss
description:
These dark stairs are made out of the bones of the damned. They rattle
softly as you tread apon them as if to cry out in protest. The air is filled
with the wailing of lost souls and the blood curdling screams of the
punished.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see the eternal darkness of the Abyss.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10527, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe2fb71db892c0965", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb699d528be7fb4ab"}

name: Cave tunnel
description:
You are walking in a tunnel. It is very cold. You
can feel the presence of a living thing ... SOMEWHERE.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "To the north you can see the tunnel continuing.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7402, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdca99f7260bf585f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc993d9f27506766d"}

name: Ishtar River
description:
The river slows as it widens and meanders through the lowlands. A
small dock give access to the north shore.

name: Maintenance Walkway
description:
This is a maintence accessway. You walk on a metal catwalk hundreds of
feet above the floor. The catwalk sways unsteadily as you walk on it.
The catwalk continues to the east and south.

name: Cave room
description:
You are standing in a room. It's much cooler now.
The walls are glowing.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east you see the tunnel going downwards.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7403, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc993d9f27506766d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba83a26b7b7ca19de"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "To the south you see a dark cave tunnel.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7401, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc993d9f27506766d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdca99f7260bf585f"}

name: Cave T-cross
description:
You are standing in a mud-like substance. The smell here is
awful, it is rotten. To the west you can see some light.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "mud", "description": "When you examine the mud, you notice small worms crawling\naround.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "To the east the tunnel still goes downwards.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7404, "room_id": "69f4d0cba83a26b7b7ca19de", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc894bbf7f8b567c2"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can see some light to the west.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7402, "room_id": "69f4d0cba83a26b7b7ca19de", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc993d9f27506766d"}

name: Maintenance Walkway
description:
This is a maintence accessway. You walk on a metal catwalk hundreds of
feet above the floor. The catwalk sways unsteadily as you walk on it.
The catwalk continues to the north and west.

name: Cave turning-point
description:
The mud are getting deeper. You are wondering, 'Would
it be an idea to leave, before I disappear?'. To the
south you notice a flat round stone are blocking the
way. To the west you can see mud.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "flat round stone", "description": "The stone looks very uninteresting. BUT as you are\nabout to turn away, you see a lightstribe coming\nthrough a small hole. Conclusion: The stone is movable.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You can see an opening behind the stone.", "keyword": "flat round stone", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7405, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc894bbf7f8b567c2", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb43d0a2a20af1116a"}

name: On the Dark River
description:
The river flows to the east under the walls of Midgaard and west
snaking through a dark forest.

name: Judge's Chambers
description:
This is the private chambers of the High Judge of Hell. He has a cushy job
and his office reflects that. Golden torches light the walls with dancing
blue and yellow flames. The judge's black crystal desk sparkles in the
torchlight.

name: The secret room
description:
There is dust all over the place. It looks like nobody
has been here for ages. In the middle of the room you see
a socket with a crystal globe. The globe glows with a
pulsing light. To the north you see a stone door. To the
south you see a grey block.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "socket", "description": "The socket looks like the work of a dwarf. It is VERY beautiful.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a round stone door.", "keyword": "round stone door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7404, "room_id": "69f4d0cb43d0a2a20af1116a", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbc894bbf7f8b567c2"}

name: Courtyard
description:
This courtyard is barren and neglected. Small weeds grow up in between
the concrete slabs. An old defunct fountain sputters with a grey-brown
ooze.
A lawyers office is to the north.
The courtyard continues to the east and south.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a more of the courtyard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10523, "room_id": "69f4d0cb69f61864ca2fe6ec", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb63bcd62da39f9389"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "You see a more of the courtyard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10532, "room_id": "69f4d0cb69f61864ca2fe6ec", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4fa04ca11f1ad5d6"}

name: On the Dark River
description: The river continues east and west meandering through the woods.

name: Courtyard
description:
This courtyard is barren and neglected. Small weeds grow up in between
the concrete slabs. An old defunct fountain sputters with a grey-brown
ooze.
The courtyard continues to the west and south.
Stanley's Magical Steeds is to the east.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a more of the courtyard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10533, "room_id": "69f4d0cb63bcd62da39f9389", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7685baf8af157e0e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a more of the courtyard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10522, "room_id": "69f4d0cb63bcd62da39f9389", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb69f61864ca2fe6ec"}

name: The mudhole
description:
You are standing in a lot of mud. The mud goes to your
chest. You feel the presence of something IN the mud.
The only obvious exit is to the west.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can see nothing at all.", "keyword": "grey block", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7405, "room_id": "69f4d0cbe47fc17ecb07fa3d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb43d0a2a20af1116a"}

name: On the Dark River
description:
The river continues east and west meandering through the woods. You
hear the sounds of chopping wood far off in the distance.

name: Stanley's Magical Steeds
description:
This is the shop of Stanly. He used to be an old mage selling cursed
trinkets at the town of Solace. He has recently set up shop in Hell selling
magical figurines. Each figurine is in the shape of some sort of steed.
Some are recognizable and some are not. Rumor has it that Stanley made
a deal with a devil....so I guess his lease is up in seven years.....
A courtyard is to the west.
To the south you see the Mall from Hell.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see a hallway of the Mall from Hell.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10534, "room_id": "69f4d0cb535db1fc1b8b34e9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbaf731d0315569d4e"}

name: Tunnel
description:
The mud goes to your knees. Otherwise the tunnel looks
very normal.

name: On the Dark River
description: The river continues east meandering through the woods.

name: Hallway of The Mall from Hell
description:
This is definitely the Mall from Hell...there are no stores!
Only in Hell would they have a mall with no stores.
The hallway continues to the north and south.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a hall of the Mall from Hell.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10515, "room_id": "69f4d0cb06466f7ab766af5e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4d2d206021c93089"}

{"direction": 1, "description": "You see a hall of the Mall from Hell.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10535, "room_id": "69f4d0cb06466f7ab766af5e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2c0a112aa38a6b06"}

name: The long tunnel
description:
Here There is almost no mud, as you stand at the top
of a small rock. Just beside you there are a sign which
says 'WARNING! The worms are dangerous!'.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can see a lot of mud..Yarck!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7403, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb350c6bc8216e1e7", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cba83a26b7b7ca19de"}

name: Freefall
description:
As your fingers slowly slip from the handguides you feel a sudden
euphoria as you freefall the 200 + feet to your death.

name: Inside Big Mouth's Stomach
description:
You are standing inside Big Mouth's stomach. It is roomy in here. Small
animals and other odds and ends lie about the stomach. Is that a dragon
you see? Nah...couldn't be...
exits: {"direction": 4, "description": "You see Big Mouth's throat.", "keyword": "mouth big mouth's throat", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10517, "room_id": "69f4d0cbc307aef796a21092", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb58de80b295f5805a"}

name: The hot room
description:
You are very surprised, as this room for a change are
hot instead of cold. To the north it goes downwards into
some mud. There are also an exit to the west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see a entrance to a small room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7410, "room_id": "69f4d0cb9315546128542a08", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb71b4e6d668bedc2"}

name: On the Plains
description:
You stand on an open expanse of grass extending in all directions. To
the south of you stand the might northern gates of New Thalos. East
and west of you the grassy fields continue and north, in the distance,
you see a line of trees.

name: Stairs to the Abyss
description:
These dark stairs are made out of the bones of the damned. They rattle
softly as you tread apon them as if to cry out in protest. The air is filled
with the wailing of lost souls and the blood curdling screams of the
punished.
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "You see the eternal darkness of the Abyss.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10536, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb699d528be7fb4ab", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb62579c7d6336234b"}

name: The small room
description:
As you look around you notice a small statue. There are
exits to the west and to the east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "small statue", "description": "This is a statue of a imp, pointing to the west. The imp\nlooks like a man with horns and a tail.", "valid": true}

name: On the Plains
description:
You stand on an open field of grass. The forest to the north is
closer but still a good distance away. To the south a small dirt
path has been trodden into the ground heading towards New Thalos.

name: Reactor Control Room
description:
This is the reactor control room of Hell. From here the workers control
the main reactor and power supply for all of Hell and the abyss. Workers
stroll back and forth, from station to station monitoring the reactor core.
A large glass window looks out onto the reactor floor below.
There are some stairs down to the reactor floor to the south.
There is a maintenance room to the east.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You see stairs down to the reactor floor.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10538, "room_id": "69f4d0cb6ad00be8bcd5d04c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7e36f8bd07d39cde"}

name: The stalagmite cave
description:
You are standing in a stalagmite cave. Water is dripping
from the walls. It is very cold in here.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "stalagmite", "description": "The stalagmites are very tall, and looks very beautiful.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a long hallway, and some mud.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7410, "room_id": "69f4d0cb136ef0a173a4cc52", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbb71b4e6d668bedc2"}

name: Edge of the forest
description:
You stand at the edge of a huge forest. The line of trees
continues as far as the eye can see to the east and west. A large
expanse of grass spreads out to the south.

name: Maintenance Room
description:
You are standing in the primary maintenance room of Hell. Tools of all
shapes and sizes are neatly hung on the walls, each with its own painted-on
silhouette behind it.
To the west is the reactor control room.
To the east is the break room.
To the north is a maintenance walkway.
To the south is the secondary control room.

name: The stalagmite tunnel
description:
You have entered a small tunnel. Here it is quite dry.
Maybe it would be an idea to rest here.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You can see a small cave to the north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7411, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4a9e87b8a0d3093c", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb136ef0a173a4cc52"}

name: Ishtar River
description:
The river broadens even more here and the waters become murky. The
smell of saltwater has reached you from the east. The Dragon Sea
cannot be far away. To the east you can see the faint outline
of a city and to the north you see a large expanse of grass.

name: Break Room
description:
This is the break room for the maintenance workers. tables are filled with
donuts and coffee. As a cruel joke, the cheif engineer has posted his guard
dogs to guard the room so that no one can take a break.
To the west is the primary maintenance room.
To the south is the chief engineers office.

name: The spongy room
description:
You definitely NOT like this area. It is very dank, and most
of the places it is wet.

name: The river delta
description:
This is where the river empties out into the Dragon Sea. The backrush
of water has kicked up a lot of sand and the blue sea is stained where
the river empties. Looking east, all you can see is water....all the way
to the horizon. North of here is a small dock you think you should be
able to reach with out too much trouble. The river stretches off to
the west back towards New Thalos.

name: The stalagmite T-cross
description:
You are standing in a cross. To the north you can see
some light. Otherwise it is dark.

name: Hell's Kitchen
description:
Welcome to Hell's kitchen, where everything is delicious....you just can't
have any....This is where the many foods of the world of Farside are made.
The chefs are usually very busy, but they always have extra time to torture
a guest....
To the east is a courtyard.

name: The Dragon Sea
description:
You are on the clear blue seas of the Dragon Sea.
Water extends in all directions as far as the eye
can see. Off in the distance you think you might
see a small dock to the north.

name: The blind end room
description:
This room is obviously a blind end. To the north you see
a primitive picture.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "primitive picture", "description": "You see some persons dancing around a huge sun. The\nsun is about 7 feet in diameter, which shows the size\nof the picture.", "valid": true}

name: Courtyard
description:
This courtyard is barren and neglected. Small weeds grow up in between
the concrete slabs. An old defunct fountain sputters with a grey-brown
ooze.
The courtyard continues to the north and east.
You see a kitchen to the west.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a more of the courtyard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10533, "room_id": "69f4d0cb4fa04ca11f1ad5d6", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7685baf8af157e0e"}

name: The Dragon Sea
description:
The Dragon Sea comes up along the shore here, the deep blue waters
rolling in and crashing against the beach. To the north you see a
small dock jutting out into the surf.

name: The treasure room
description:
This room is rich ornamented. The walls has carves showing
persons dancing around a sun which is drawn at the floor. It
looks very old, and it is very dusty. To the south you see a
secret door.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "you can see a picture with some persons crawling around a\nhuge moon.", "keyword": "door picture sun moon", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7415, "room_id": "69f4d0cbb358d054bd0d9758", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb41542dd4df91e485"}

name: Courtyard
description:
This courtyard is barren and neglected. Small weeds grow up in between
the concrete slabs. An old defunct fountain sputters with a grey-brown
ooze.
The courtyard continues to the north and west.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You see a more of the courtyard.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10532, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7685baf8af157e0e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb4fa04ca11f1ad5d6"}

name: The Dragon Sea
description:
You are on the clear blue seas of the Dragon Sea.
Water extends in all directions as far as the eye
can see. Off in the distance you think you might
see a small dock to the south.

name: The square lair
description:
You are standing in the south-east part of the lair. You can
see a skeleton lying at the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "skeleton", "description": "It looks like a adventurer who wasn't lucky. You better\nwatch out-", "valid": true}

name: Hallway of The Mall from Hell
description:
This is definitely the Mall from Hell...there are no stores!
Only in Hell would they have a mall with no stores.
The hallway continues to the east.
Stanley's magic steeds are to the north.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a hall of the Mall from Hell.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10535, "room_id": "69f4d0cbaf731d0315569d4e", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb2c0a112aa38a6b06"}

name: The Dragon Sea
description:
You are on the clear blue seas of the Dragon Sea.
Water extends in all directions as far as the eye
can see. Off in the distance you think you might
see a small dock to the west.

name: Hallway of The Mall from Hell
description:
This is definitely the Mall from Hell...there are no stores!
Only in Hell would they have a mall with no stores.
The hallway continues to the north and west.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a hall of the Mall from Hell.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10525, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2c0a112aa38a6b06", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb06466f7ab766af5e"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a hall of the Mall from Hell.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10534, "room_id": "69f4d0cb2c0a112aa38a6b06", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbaf731d0315569d4e"}

name: The square lair
description:
You are standing in the north-east part of the lair. You see
a sign at the wall
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign wall", "description": "The sign says 'Gods of War I call you, my sword is by my side,\nI seek a light free from all false pride'\nReyemle Grug.....", "valid": true}

name: On a road
description:
The people of New Thalos take great pride in the services their
city may provide. One of these services is the construction crews
that go to great lengths to keep all the roads in order. Although
the taxes in New Thalos are higher than other cities in the realm
most of the money is used for the good of the people.

name: Stairs to the Abyss
description:
These dark stairs are made out of the bones of the damned. They rattle
softly as you tread apon them as if to cry out in protest. The air is filled
with the wailing of lost souls and the blood curdling screams of the
punished. You can't seem to find the Abyss...you seem to recall a seeing a
sign....now what did it say again?......

name: The square lair
description:
You are standing in the north-west part of the lair. Here's
another sign. There are a exit from the lair to the north.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign says 'I'm wandering around in a everlasting tale,\nseeking the light to regain my pride\nCorama...", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see a small tunnel leading north.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7422, "room_id": "69f4d0cb5c5affa2301729b9", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbddb55bbb2ef2e783"}

name: On a road
description:
You walk along a well used road with beautiful scenery. To the north
tall pine trees form a wall that goes on for miles. Between the road
and the trees lies a great expanse of grassy plains. South of here,
beyond the river, lie the Sands of Sorrow. The road continues
east and west.

name: Inside the Reactor Core
description:
You are standing on the inside of the reactor core. Actually you seem to
be floating in the plasma energy of the reactor. You can see the core
chamber fall off into the distance as it seems to be bottomless. Nuclear
particles and other strange things whiz by you at blinding speeds.
You see a maintenance hatch to the east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a maintenance hatch.", "keyword": "hatch maintenance reactor core", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10538, "room_id": "69f4d0cb885e0013066064cf", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb7e36f8bd07d39cde"}

name: The lair end
description:
You can see a table in front of you. It's very dusty.
Around the table five skeletons are siting. Exits are
north and east.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "table", "description": "On the table there is dust, in the center there is a small statue of a\nDragon sleeping.", "valid": true}

name: On a road
description:
The Dragon Sea can be seen to the east now spreading out to unkown
lands. The road continues east and west. To the south you hear the
sounds of boats traveling the Ishtar delivering goods.

name: Reactor Room Floor
description:
The room is taken up almost entirely by the enormous reactor core. The
core pulses rhythmically as it generates the heat and power for the entire
region of Hell. Many workers in orange jumpsuits run frantically around
with geiger counters and plasma torches fixing breaches in the core.
You see a reactor core maintenance hatch to the west.
A stairway to the control room is to the north.
exits: {"direction": 0, "description": "You see the stairs to the control room.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10528, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7e36f8bd07d39cde", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb6ad00be8bcd5d04c"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You see a reactor core maintence hatch.", "keyword": "hatch maintenance reactor core", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 10537, "room_id": "69f4d0cb7e36f8bd07d39cde", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb885e0013066064cf"}

name: East tunnel
description:
You are standing in dark tunnel, the exits are east
and west. To the west you see a wooden door.
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You can see a wooden door.", "keyword": "wooden door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7418, "room_id": "69f4d0cb3f2ba23f623e1fe1", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb1de80924e08fd731"}

name: On a road
description:
This is the main land route through the land. Merchants can bring their goods
to the coastline and have them ferried onto ships for export. Travel
by foot west will take you through New Thalos up and over the Eastern
Mountains and down into Midgaard.

name: North tunnel
description: You are standing in a dark tunnel, it leads upwards.

name: Secondary Control Room
description:
This is the secondary control room for the reactor core. It is usually used in
emergencies when the primary control room is contaminated or damaged.
It isn't used very often since the primary control room is in perfect
working order.

name: Near the shore
description:
The road ends here turning into a small dirt path leading down the
beach and onto a dock. To the north and south you see the coastline
stretching out before you. West of here the lowlands roll up into
huge snow capped mountains.

name: The L-shaped room.
description:
You are standing in deep darkness. To the south there is a small exit.
To the east you can see a gaping hole.

name: Office of the Chief Engineer
description:
This office belongs to the chief engineer of Hell. Blueprints and pencils
are scattered about the room. The air is heavy with the smell of ammonia
and sweat. A display of the reactor core is mounted into the wall.
One wall is completely filled with monitors, each showing various
status reports for the reactor core.

name: On a dock
description:
You stand on a simple wooden dock that acts as an extension of the road
to the west. The dock seems to have been here for quite a long time
but is still sturdy. A small ladder has been built on the eastern end
to allow easy access to and from ships.

name: The Circular hall.
description:
You are standing in round hall. To the north, east and south you
can see a stone head hanging on the walls.
extraDescription:
{"keyword": "head heads", "description": "When you study the faces of the heads you see that it
is faces of dragons. The face to the north is red, the
face to the east is green and the face to the south is
blue.", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "you see nothing special.", "keyword": "green head dragon sculpture face", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7425, "room_id": "69f4d0cbdf269b07ae32051d", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb96fe1aee1bc3dba3"}

name: The Dragon Sea
description:
You are on the clear blue seas of the Dragon Sea.
Water extends in all directions as far as the eye
can see. Off in the distance you think you might
see a small dock to the west.

name: Ice Room
description:
You are standing in a room of ice. Icicles of every size hang from the
ceiling. Some shake with every sound. Your reflection off the ice walls
seems to dance and wiggle as you move about.

name: Dusty tunnel
description:
You are standing in dust. This place has not been
touched for a long time. Otherwise it is quite boring
here, looks like a place to rest! To the west you see
the outline of a door. A tunnel leads to the east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "You see a tunnel which leads downwards. It is quite\ndark.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7426, "room_id": "69f4d0cb96fe1aee1bc3dba3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb47afe7111ce03fa0"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "You can see the outline of a door. Just like in the\ndescription!", "keyword": "door", "exit_flags": 1, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7424, "room_id": "69f4d0cb96fe1aee1bc3dba3", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbdf269b07ae32051d"}

name: The Dragon Sea
description:
The ocean spreads out in all directions rolling gently. In the distance
you can see an island on the horizon. To the west you see the mainland.

name: The crossing
description:
You are standing in a crossing of hallways. You can leave this place
in every direction, except up and down. In the dust you notice strange
footprints.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "footprints foot", "description": "You have never seen this kind of footprints before!", "valid": true}

name: Under the dock
description:
You are swimming underneath the dock. You can see the four wooden
pylons that support the structure. The murky water clouds your vision
as you gaze westward, but you think you can make out an iron grating in
that direction.

name: The L-shaped room
description:
You are standing in a L-shaped room. You can hear noises from the long
tunnel to the east. You can feel fear! A sign is hanging on the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "sign", "description": "The sign says 'DANGER!!'.", "valid": true}

name: Lair of the Ixitxachitl
description:
Blood swirls around in the water as the Ixitxachitl devours the
last of its meal. Swirling around quickly as you intrude upon
its meal the large sting ray attacks!

name: Dragons lair
description:
You can see burned walls, the floorstones are fiery red.  All kinds of bones
are scattered all over the floor.  On the walls you can see some burned
shapes.  You smell burned flesh.  Two creatures are melted into the floor.
You're next.

name: The burned room
description:
You are in a room, which once had been quite burned.
There is writing on the wall.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "writing", "description": "The writing says 'DANGER!!!'", "valid": true}

name: The wind tunnel
description:
You are standing in a tunnel. Above you, you can feel
a breeze.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "breeze", "description": "The breeze comes from a hole above you. NO way to get up\nthere.", "valid": true}

name: The glittering room
description:
This room are all bright. In the walls you can see some
silver. Exits are: West, east and south.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "glitter walls silver", "description": "The glittering silver looks like it is INSIDE the walls.", "valid": true}

name: The secret passageroom
description:
You have entered a tiny room. There WAS an exit down, and an
exit to the west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "down", "description": "A sign is blocking the way. It says 'we have closed an entrance to DEATH'", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 3, "description": "You can see a light to the west", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7431, "room_id": "69f4d0cbd0b874351fb9601b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb688d5bafa67133ca"}

name: End of long tunnel
description:
You are at a end of a long tunnel. Right in front of you,
you can see a grey mass. To the east you can see a tremendous
long tunnel, but you know that, you has just been there.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "grey mass", "description": "The mass is nothing but a mass, but it is quite suspicious!", "valid": true}
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "Long tunnel. JUST like in the description!", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7431, "room_id": "69f4d0cb10e8b8f49747bc5b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb688d5bafa67133ca"}

{"direction": 3, "description": "A grey mass is blocking the way.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7434, "room_id": "69f4d0cb10e8b8f49747bc5b", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb151292a32093a10e"}

name: Stair-room
description:
You are standing in a small room. Drawings of faces in pain
are on the walls. You can feel that darkness is ruling this place.
there are two exits: south and down. You have a feeling the downward exit
isn't finished yet...
exits: {"direction": 5, "description": "A sign is blocking the way: 'This has not been implemented\nyet'.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": -1, "room_id": "69f4d0cb151292a32093a10e", "to_room_id": null}

name: Dark tunnel
description:
You are standing in a dark tunnel. It continues to the north
and to the south. Bones are spread on the floor
extraDescription: {"keyword": "bones bone", "description": "it looks like bones of a human.", "valid": true}

name: Entrance to lair
description:
The smell here is awful.  To the south you can see some smoke.
A tunnel leads north, and east.
exits: {"direction": 1, "description": "A small cave is to the east.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7422, "room_id": "69f4d0cb76a0b7913f3c6bc5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbddb55bbb2ef2e783"}

{"direction": 2, "description": "the only thing you can see are smoke.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7437, "room_id": "69f4d0cb76a0b7913f3c6bc5", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb0549d4357f09e43c"}

name: North-eastern part of Basilisks cave
description:
It is hard to see here because of the smoke. To the north you
can see barely see a small tunnel. Other exits are to the south
and to the west.

name: South-eastern part of basilisks cave
description:
There are a very small hole in wall, from where the smoke
are coming from. Otherwise it is pitch dark. Exits are north
and west.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "hole small", "description": "It's a small hole. About 1 feet in diameter.", "valid": true}

name: North-western part of basilisks cave
description:
You can see some hay spread on the floor. The smell is awful here,
and it makes you feel sick.  The basilisk sleeps here.
Watch out ... Maybe it is not far away.
extraDescription: {"keyword": "hay", "description": "The hay is very dirty. The smell of it makes you feel sick.", "valid": true}

name: South-western part of basilisks cave
description: You can see nothing but smoke.

name: The small cave
description:
You are standing in small cave. You can see
some light in the end. Exits are north and south.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You can see a blue glow. And you feel a fresh breeze.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7442, "room_id": "69f4d0cbcac9357e3d8bec09", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cbd40d945eaf259fc1"}

name: The northern end of the pool
description:
You have wet feet, you are standing in water. The water looks calm. You can
see that it's a big lake. Light seeps from the water.

name: The pool
description: You are swimming in water. It is getting deep here. It is dark in this end.
exits: {"direction": 2, "description": "You can see some bubbles in the water.", "keyword": "", "exit_flags": 0, "key": -1, "to_room_vnum": 7445, "room_id": "69f4d0cb991c71d0a53d447f", "to_room_id": "69f4d0cb3c16da30dcd5a5ee"}
